A space that is in harmony with nature, abundant in vibrant interactions, epitomises comfortable living and offers a fulfilled life experience.

Community.name: Innovate to Regenerate
Community.description: Innovate to Regenerate. WWF Australia. Campaign Strategy & Messaging. It's Up to You. WWF have been a leading voice for conservation, regeneration and environmental protection for over half a century. They are present in over 100 countries and have the help of 5 million supporters, and growing. Partnering with businesses, individuals and the community, WWF address pressing environmental issues that can be fixed through collaborative action. They spread messages of positive, community action to ensure our planet is cared for and protected for years to come. Innovate to Regenerate is about finding innovative solutions to regenerate and future-proof Australia’s precious natural environment and communities. Challenge: Looking back across just one generation, we have experienced remarkable weather events which have undeniably changed the Australian environment. Through these repeated shared experiences, we have gained an understanding that we can do more to protect our world when we are connected with nature. WWF attest that regenerative development is what can actively reverse environmental degradation, creating a positive impact for people and the planet. TOAST was tasked with redefining this WWF message to engage wider audiences, in the hope that WWF’s initiative has a larger reach and therefore a more positive outcome for our shared natural environment. Solution: To reach the appropriate brand solution to WWF’s initiative, TOAST refocused on their key organisational outputs, their existing audience and the opportunities available to them. Our team looked to redefine their strategic angle, focusing on their longstanding message of collective community action. WWF call on the government and business stakeholders to reach a platform where their messages can be heard by the masses. But, why wait? On our own, we too can make a statement. It’s never too late to take action into our own hands. It’s in the hands and interest of everyone to create a future in which people and nature live in harmony. And if not now, when? If not you, who? Ultimately; It’s Up To Us. It’s Up To You.

Community.name: The Salvation Army
Community.description: The Salvation Army. Brand Transformation / Campaign Activation. The Freedom Partnership. Together with The Salvation Army, TOAST devised a campaign to educate, raise public awareness and empower those affected by modern slavery within Australia today. Slavery in Australia comes in many forms including trafficking, forced labour, abusive living and working conditions, isolation, violence, psychological and sexual abuse. It is often hidden and goes unreported despite being a serious crime affecting the lives of thousands. Challenge: A social media campaign was implemented using an animated project video EDM, which prompts the viewer to show support by ‘Making The Pledge’ and ‘Joining The Chain of Good’. The two-year awareness campaign also aims to extend its impact and engagement by leveraging social media communities on Facebook and Twitter. Solution: ‘The Freedom Pledge’ is a striking and bold campaign utilising an ancient symbol of law and justice, slavery and captivity known as ‘Epa’. The symbol reminds offenders of the uncompromising nature of the law and discourages all forms of slavery. This iconic symbol acts as the primary brand asset for the ‘Ending Modern Slavery’ campaign across all channels.

Community.name: MECLA
Community.description: MECLA. NSW Govt, WWF, Lendlease & Presync. Brand Activation. Game Changer Leadership. Materials Embodied Carbon Leaders’ Alliance (MECLA) is an association of leaders in the building & construction industry, government bodies and not-for-profit organisations who are committed to improving the procurement, supply chain and use of materials that cause harm to the environment. The core members of MECLA, NSW Government, WWF-Australia, Lendlease & Presync, came together with the belief that Australia can tackle the climate change threat and aligned with the Paris Agreement targets if we help transform the building and construction industry. Challenge: The built environment sector is responsible for one-quarter of Australia’s emissions. The majority of these emissions (at least 40%) occur from the embodied or upfront carbon of the materials used in building and construction in particular, steel, cement, concrete and aluminium representing over 9% of global emissions. TOAST was briefed to create a strategic positioning and brand identity to engage multiple stakeholders involved in the construction industry and rally them towards a common goal of creating a better future for Australia. The new MECLA brand needed to inspire radical collaboration, provide guidance to all market players, facilitate knowledge sharing and the uptake of low/zero-carbon materials. Solution: TOAST delved into the reason for why MECLA exists, the values that drive the organisation, and how it could be translated into a visionary brand by creating a strong strategic framework. Based on its research and the insights derived through the interviews with multiple stakeholders, TOAST created a well thought out strategic platform for the organisation: “Game Changer Leadership”, focusing on the central belief that “We are the change needed to reach net-zero emissions”. The logo and the overall brand identity created by TOAST explores the unified action of the different sectors in the construction industry; it demonstrates the intention of the organisation, with the central diamond representing a perfect collaboration between all entities' purity and a brighter future. It signifies the collaborative efforts to tackle this complex issue, the integrity to work in an ethical manner, the transparency to share knowledge and expertise, and the opportunity to move towards a zero-carbon economy future, positioning Australia in the top 5 zero-carbon materials suppliers.

Community.name: Sanctuary
Community.description: Sanctuary. Sekisui House. Masterplan / Stage one. One With Nature. ‘Satoyama – Harmony between the built environment and nature.’ Since its inception, Sanctuary has shifted from being a desirable project to a very tangible precinct that will positively impact the residents and neighbourhood life at Wentworth Point. This masterplan development would be a feat of effort to transform the run-down factory land into a tranquil setting worthy of the water’s edge. The first building “Landing” (stage 1) has started to shape the new landscape of the masterplan, giving the projection of the future experience of living at Sanctuary. Challenge: TOAST was selected to position the project, name it and define a unique and strong identity for this new place achieving longevity for the 10-year development plan and its 7 stages of construction, while helping to connect the vision of the place to the community and its future residents. We also had to ensure the brand footprint of this new development was perfectly aligned with Sekisui House’s overarching brand value of ‘Satoyama – harmony between the built environment and nature’. With the launch of “Landing”, the goal was to hook Sanctuary’s brand as a centre of life for people in perfect connection with its surroundings. Solution: The agency developed the Masterplan to be named “Sanctuary’’ with the Place Essence identified as 'To be both inspired by and “one with nature”'. This strategic platform has influenced Sanctuary’s architecture, placemaking and design initiatives, demonstrating how a brand-first approach creates compelling destinations and place identities. TOAST’s long-term project involvement has encompassed strategy and naming through holistic branding, marketing and community consultation services; illustrating how Sanctuary is becoming a place that reconciles humanity and nature with architecture inspired by Wentworth Point’s environment.

Community.name: Flamingo
Community.tagline: Act of Life, Act of Love
Community.description: Grey Matter. Brand Visualisation. Act of Life, Act of Love. Advance care planning is the process of planning for future health care. It gives people the opportunity to think about, discuss and record their preferences for the type of care they would like to receive and the outcomes they would consider acceptable for the end of their life. In 2020, this has become a priority for the federal government. However, few people are aware of the necessity to communicate their preferences or make decisions relating to the care you would like to receive at the end of your life. Further, nobody is comfortable to think, talk or make decisions about it...not the person themselves, nor their relatives or carers. Grey Matter wanted to develop a user-friendly "End Of Life Planning" (EOLP) digital solution aiming to be a single destination for Australians seeking End of Life Planning information, products and services. Challenge: Our brief was to help Grey Matter bring the new disruptive platform to market with the aim to reframe how individuals perceive and interact with EOLP - a classically taboo subject. The first iteration of the App would focus on the provision of digital Advance Care Directives, and will be offered via both B2B and B2C channels. With healthcare providers soon to experience pressure to adopt new compliance requirements, challenging the status quo in Advance Care Planning by presenting information in a fresh way is an important driver for the future success of the EOLP Australia business. To be successful, we knew we would need to reframe the conversation about EOLP while re-imagining the traditional user journey and choice architecture that surrounds it. To achieve this, we worked with Grey Matter in developing this user journey built around a wider community insight and concept. Solution: Whilst EOLP Australia's product offering has the potential to benefit the lives of many, the brand itself needs to be defined and developed to most effectively engage with its target audiences. From a comprehensive strategic framework including research interviews and workshop, we were able to articulate a unique strong idea: present the act of planning your end of life like an act that is part of life (in the same way you would subscribe to an insurance policy); framing the big Idea: Act of Love, Act of Life. With this idea, we believe that end-of-life planning is - an 'act of love' to ensure your family and friends are supported through the transition. An 'act of life' to help individuals let go of fear and get back to enjoying their life. The Flamingo name and symbolism brings softness to the overall topic, capitalising on the rich symbolism of this unique bird: maintaining a sense of balance in your life? Looking to remain steadfast amid chaos? Flamingo, as a Spirit, Totem, and Power Animal, is here to help! Flamingo teaches you how to stand strong in the face of a storm, all while showing you how to tap into your inner well of harmony! In addition, the app works to simplify, accelerate and take the sting out of EOLP by skipping the jargon and transforming long forms into a series of quick targeted questions. This smart solution and product brand shifts the conversation away from 'death' and towards an 'act of love', so individuals and families can live more and worry less, knowing an EOLP is in place.

Community.name: Anglicare
Community.description: Project Branding & Activation. Seed Your Future. Anglicare has long strived to discover and implement new services, initiatives and projects, establishing themselves as a service provider who is able to help people from all walks of life (e.g. newly launched Bushfire Relief Efforts). The not-for-profit organisation saw an opportunity to operate in Affordable Housing as there's an urgent need for Australian communities: Expected waiting times for Social Housing applicants in areas such as Liverpool is between 5 - 10 years. Anglicare Australia research found that for single pensioners, only three percent of available rentals were affordable. The project's unique characteristics present an attractive market proposition: Anglicare acquired three sites on which they would build properties, providing affordable housing, in addition to a small selection of strata units that act as an entry point to the market; this initiative was a direct extension of Anglicare's three core pillars: Centred in Christ, Serving customers, and Strengthening community. Whilst they may be new to the product, Anglicare's long history of serving the community and assisting those in need gives them the credibility required to make this initiative a success. "Seed your future". Challenge: A few critical threats were identified and needed to be overcome. The first one was the fact that Anglicare, whilst they were operating as a developer, didn't want to be perceived as a property developer which wanted to make money from a market opportunity; the offer would have to be well explained, and market education of the market would need to be considered. Furthermore, affordable housing carries a lot of stigma which needs to be addressed by demonstrating the overall benefits of such a program to the future residents, to the people living around them and to the broader community. Launching a brand which would encapsulate the offering without compromising Anglicare's brand footprint and would work across three different buildings was about achieving the 3 key objectives: Understand the characteristics of suburbs and potential prospects, as each market had their specifics (integrating the fact that living in a 'charity building' is a perception that neither SAHF nor strata residents wish to portray); Protect Anglicare's existing brand equity (avoid being perceived as a profit-generating property developer); Sell units in a unique product offering (The product type means purchasers will predominantly be owner occupiers (FHB, upgraders and downsizers) although investors may show growing interest based on favourable market conditions). Solution: From a comprehensive strategic framework including research, interviews and workshop, TOAST was able to articulate a unique strong idea: present the act of living in such a place as a great new chapter in life. We unravelled the product proposition thinking the new apartment developments would present the beginning of a new stage in people's lives: A new home; the habitat for a new chapter in life; A new building to enjoy a good quality of life; A new environment with like-minded people; A new day-to-day life from now onwards; A new opportunity to shape their future; A future with Anglicare commitment for 25 years; A relevant platform for Anglicare for years to come. With this idea, we believed the 3 programs will offer the opportunity for people to have new hope, a fresh new start in life; a concept was born: Seed Your Future. We wanted to articulate the positive outcome to enrich people's lives, while creating a concept that works for everyone: affordable housing tenants, investors, future renters, owner occupiers, broader community and Anglicare's key stakeholders and partners. "Seed your future" is the start of a new cycle in life. We chose to illustrate this idea through symbolic native Australian plants, drawing similarities between the life cycle of people with life cycles in nature. Within this big idea, each building would have a name born from an Australian native plant, a full marketing suite including digital experience, a multidimensional concept delivering positive outcomes for all audiences. In collaboration with the appointed real estate agency McGrath, the campaign was a full success to attract interest from local buyers, as long as proper communication processes and collateral was established.

Community.name: City of Ryde
Community.description: Site Activation/ Brand Engagement. Ryde Here, Ryde Now. The City of Ryde is the council which holds jurisdiction over the Ryde LGA. Their youth division is oriented towards 12 - 24-year-olds who work, live, study or play within the region, and offer a range of programs (of varying commitment) all aimed at helping the LGA's young individuals to grow and develop. Challenge: Whilst the City of Ryde's youth programs offer a variety of valuable experiences to prospective participants, the number of young people who actually engage with the offerings was far too low. Ryde city council needed to pivot their youth brand to drive engagement in local discussions and connect with the younger demographic. Thus, the City of Ryde's youth brand needed to be addressed and re-engineered from the ground up, to help more effectively communicate its value proposition. Solution: Through a series of interviews and community engagement, TOAST uncovered that the Youth were seeking much more than recreational fun and social media recognition. They live in the moment, and possess a strong commitment to tackling today's societal and environmental challenges, pushing away the stigma that they are the future. They share common beliefs based on a sense of urgency to be heard and to act now. Our workshop process allowed us to define the organisation's core identity and the findings to create the name and visual look and feel that will eventually inspire the Youth Initiatives logo. The brand needed to mirror that the youth community is actively seeking opportunities to make a genuine impact and to obtain the skills they'd need to become the leaders of not just tomorrow, but today. This led to the development of a range of new community programs promoted through the strategic positioning of 'Ryde here, Ryde now' and a unique look and feel connected with our audiences, based on playful brand narratives and icons. This positioning was rolled out across a series of communications, shining a light on the programs which supported the needs of the youth community of Ryde.

Community.name: Renewable Recovery
Community.tagline: Clean Energy is not the Future...It's the Now!
Community.description: WWF Australia. Campaign Development. Clean Energy is not the Future...It's the Now! As the world shifts to a low carbon future, Australia has everything we need to take the lead and become a renewable energy export superpower. We've got endless sunshine, plenty of space, powerful winds, world-class expertise and strong trade relationships: it's a winning combination. The twin crises of the 2019/2020 bushfires and the Covid-19 pandemic have created a need for a recovery package that helps the country rebuild. WWF-Australia is calling on our leaders to make Australia the world's leading exporter of renewable energy by 2030. Challenge: In September 2020, WWF flagged the fact that there was a critical opportunity before the delivery of the next Federal budget to see the work commence, through the delivery of a renewable recovery stimulus package. WWF-Australia believes that renewable energy should be a major focus of stimulus investment, and we have specific projects in mind. But, to secure that stimulus investment, we need to change the thinking within bureaucracy and government. TOAST's challenge was to convince key decision-makers that a clean energy stimulus was the best way to accelerate Australia's economic recovery. The campaign required bipartisan appeal in order to change the minds of detractors and secure our nation's future. Solution: WWF-Australia planned a print-driven advocacy campaign, with the centrepiece being a 'wrap' of the Canberra edition of The Australian masthead. Our central insight was to challenge people's initial perceptions surrounding renewable energy, allowing them to actively engage in a new conversation. By grabbing the attention with a challenging message while telling the story of what's possible through an investment in renewable stimulus, we wanted to secure significant government investment in 5-6 key initiatives proposed by WWF-Australia. To cut through, we decided rather than starting our communications with the traditional renewable communications format, we could take the opposite stance to drive engagement. Framing the role of renewables as a tool for job creation and using the language of big businesses to explain the benefits. The campaign's seemingly anti-renewables hook 'Clean Energy is Not the Future' and black & white colour scheme draw the attention of audiences, before subverting their expectations and emphasising the campaign's true positioning - 'It's the NOW!' The 'wrap' of The Australian newspaper distils the dense, technical text contained within WWF-Australia's reports into its most concise and interesting form, including infographics, quotes, and key stats. TOAST's strategic communications helped WWF-Australia's advocacy campaign to win the attention of Federal and State Government policymakers. The organisation received numerous invitations to discuss its proposed stimulus after the launch of its media campaign. These meetings created tangible outcomes, including a federal commitment to invest over $140million in a hydrogen export hub, renewable and battery storage microgrids, and programs to support community organisations to lower their energy bills. TOAST is immensely proud to have created an impactful campaign on behalf of an organisation seeking to create a better present and future for all Australians.

Community.name: The Orchards
Community.description: Sekisui House. Place Visioning. A Place to Grow. Located to the North West of Sydney's CBD in the Hills Shire (NSW), The Orchards is one of the most significant residential master-planned communities to be introduced to Australia in over a decade. Comprising approximately 1300 residencies and mixed-use amenities designed by award-winning architects Turner Studios, The Orchards is bringing a new precinct to Sydney, nestled in preserved forestry and beautifully landscaped gardens - reclaiming the home of Australia's traditional orchard industry. Challenge: Significant development was taking place in the area, which had grown rapidly over the last decade with the introduction of low density detached and semi-detached family homes. Apartment developments were then being encouraged due to the increase in demand and Sekisui House acquired 80,000m2 to develop a mix of accommodation with buildings ranging from 6 storeys to 12 storeys. This is an 8-year project developed in several stages so "longevity" was key to the branding. As a result, the brand had to be visionary while perfectly in line with Sekisui House's belief in Satoyama philosophy and other Japanese design principles. There was already conflict with adjacent developers owning the surrounding area so signing was a predicted challenge and wayfinding to the site problematic. Treatment of the brand was also noted as key, it needed to stand out if used on signage some distance from the development site. We also needed to create awareness and interest on the apartment offering by providing evidence of the benefits to buying within a master plan while avoiding all the challenges and potential issues from owning a home on your own. To achieve these outcomes, the brand needed a strong educational component and a very aspirational proposition to engage, elicit interest and generate consideration to purchase off-plan. Solution: The creative platform was based on the principle of building the brand narrative from the legacy of the land. Through the research process, TOAST discovered that the property would be built on one of the first orchards in Australia. We thought it was a beautiful idea to bring back the orchard trees to the community and create a unique brand experience around the overall replanting of the orchards in the area; the tree became the hero of the brand and everything would be framed around this creative idea. The entire brand remit was based on the creative platform including the delivery of an amazing sales space that draws the visitor in using highly visible cues marrying technology and nature. The visitor's journey has been carefully designed so information is 'collected' as an interested buyer navigates the space, assisting the sales team to access relevant and useful information for prospective buyers and sales follow-ups. This culminates in the Immersion Room (first of its kind in Australia) where a 7-minute brand video takes visitors on an emotional journey of a 'day in the life' intending to truly bring the experience of The Orchards' brand alive. For our work on The Orchards' branding experience and marketing platform, the TOAST team was presented with 3 awards at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards in the following categories: Gold - Digital - Expanded Service or Application; Silver - Graphic Design - Illustration and Type; Silver - Marketing - Film, Video, Viral.

Construction.name: SHEETH
Construction.description: SHEETH. A Blueprint for Building Relationships. Built Right. Together. Lasting relationships are a tough thing to build in construction. The stakes are high, the pressure even higher, and clients want to be certain they can trust the builders whose shoulders their vision (quite literally) rests on. Against this challenging backdrop, SHEETH wanted to forge partnerships with more developers, architects and business owners all over Australia. And to build those relationships, they needed to build a new brand. Sectors: Construction, Architecture. Services: Brand Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, UX/UI, Web Design, Prototyping, Stationery, Big Idea, Merchandising, Brand Strategy. Challenge: So, what are clients looking for in a new builder? What qualities seal the deal, and which ones break it? Throughout our client interviews, industry trend research and in-depth discovery calls, the same criteria came up time and time again: Clients don't just want technical mastery, they want good old-fashioned empathy. Safety and quality are essential expectations, but if their partner doesn't put as much effort into the relationship as the structure itself, it won't be a pleasant experience overall. From start to finish, they want someone who's responsive, approachable and, crucially, keeps their cool when latent issues (inevitably) rear their head. No egos, no finger-pointing, no dramas. Until they see that kind of emotional intelligence, they won't switch to someone new. Solution: To earn clients' trust, SHEETH needed to show up differently. We positioned them as the firm that brings both excellence and engagement to every partnership. Drawing inspiration from the satisfying symmetry of their name, we developed the Double E Experience, a methodology demonstrating how they deliver precision and collaboration at every project stage, from early coordination to post-completion. This double DNA formed the core pillars of the new brand, supporting every layer of their new look, feel and messaging. Their imagery captured their meticulous processes and moments of human connection alike; the tone of voice channelled the dual personality of the "engineer next door"; and the iconography featured a series of interlocking cinder blocks, a beautifully reassuring metaphor for SHEETH's rock-solid partnerships. The takeaway from all this? In an industry that offers an abundance of expertise, empathy is the most vital material.

Construction.name: Solutions +
Construction.description: Solutions +. Brand Transformation. We Bring the +. Uniting a World of Services Under One Plus. Solutions Group was a huge collection of specialisms and services. They had one business for turfcare, another for golf courses, another for civil engineering, another for habitat protection... and so on. If you had a construction, maintenance or landscaping issue, chances are they'd be able to fix it. Sectors: Construction, Technology, Community. Services: Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Motion Graphics, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: They'd grown to the point where they needed an overarching brand to unite these services. This would not only create more belonging and coordination between their teams, but also show clients the full breadth of what they could do, allowing them to cross-sell and grow more easily. But to bring all these services together, we needed to find the thread that ran through every single thing they did - from the boardroom all the way to the teams on the ground. Solution: We audited the business on every level, reviewing their capabilities, interviewing staff and workshopping with team leads, to uncover the group's common values, principles and practices. What we found was a common culture of added value: whether it's mowing grass, laying brickwork or fixing faults, their staff always overdeliver. They don't just get the job done: they go above and beyond what's expected with a range of extra benefits and services - from being on-call whenever you need them and engaging with the local community to flagging risks well before they happen. We made this incredible work ethic the value proposition of the whole group, giving them a new name, Solutions+, a new tagline, "We bring the +", and a visual identity brimming with energy. Then it was a question of re-aligning their brand architecture. Their different business units were all re-designed under the new brand, but each one would now be listed as a sub-service on their website, instead of a separate company. And to make sure visitors could quickly find the right specialism for their needs, we restructured the site with plenty of signposts, a simple UX/UI navigation and a clear user journey from start to finish. Result: With one simple symbol to rally behind, every employee now has a clear idea of what unites the group, allowing the whole business to push in the same direction, with more cohesion, efficiency and coordination on every level. And now that clients can see that Solutions+ is a one-stop shop for all their construction, maintenance and landscaping needs, the group is winning business more seamlessly. A plus for their culture, a plus for their operations and, ultimately, a plus for their profits.

Construction.name: FORGE
Construction.description: FORGE. Brand Transformation. Unlock the Outdoors. FLEETWOOD BECOMING FORGE. How Strategy is a Key Weapon in Brand Transformation. Fleetwood, a leader in outdoor infrastructure solutions, faced the challenge of evolving into a more dynamic, scalable brand that could attract larger clients, expand its community projects from design to delivery, and increase its market share. Through competitive global benchmarking, national industry research, key stakeholders involvement and cultural assessments, we crafted the 2030 Fleetwood strategic-led solution defining a company's unique DNA and positioning for lasting impact. Sectors: Construction, Corporate, Community. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Naming, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, UX/UI, Web Design, Motion Graphics, Video Production. Challenge: How can a well-established business with strong equity reposition itself for greater national impact while retaining its legacy of success? In a fast-changing market, even established brands must evolve to stay competitive. Legacy alone isn't enough and strategic repositioning unlocks new opportunities, strengthening market presence, and driving long-term growth. The challenge was to strategically transition from Fleetwood's existing identity to a stronger, unified national presence; one that encapsulated its ambition, growth mindset, and long-term vision. Solution: Through our rigorous process, we had to extract Fleetwood's core strengths and aspirations, incorporating creative thinking, emotional engagement, and pragmatic execution to establish a new, differentiated brand territory with a compelling name: FORGE. Through our strategic methodology, TOAST helped Fleetwood evolve into FORGE with a comprehensive solution that included: A Unified Brand Vision: Establishing a clear and future-focused brand strategy that strengthens FORGE's leadership in outdoor infrastructure. An Incomparable Selling Weapon: A structured, results-driven methodology that empowers FORGE with a winning approach to pitches, project delivery, and client success. A Compelling and Engaging Tagline: "Unlock The Outdoors"; a brand promise that captures the essence of FORGE's mission to create spaces that inspire and connect. A Strong Brand Visualisation: A distinctive and powerful identity that highlights FORGE's expertise in design thinking, engineering excellence, and flawless execution. A Full Suite of Marketing Collateral: Comprehensive capability statement, look book and brochures designed to enhance FORGE's ability to succeed in every selling opportunity. An Incredible Video Launch: A high-impact brand reveal that engaged stakeholders, elevated FORGE's positioning, and set the stage for future growth. A Lead-Generation Website: A high-performance digital platform optimised for conversion, effectively driving engagement, inquiries, and business growth. The Results: A Future-Proofed Brand. With a renewed vision and strategic foundation, FORGE now stands as a national leader in outdoor infrastructure, ready to scale, innovate, and create lasting impact for Australian communities. Unlocking the outdoors. Building possibilities.

Construction.name: Sekisui House
Construction.description: Sekisui House — Advancing Sekisui House's brand impact within Australia. Here for better. Since 2016, TOAST has partnered with global property leader Sekisui House, the world's largest residential developer and a benchmark for sustainable living. What began as a single engagement has grown into a long-term collaboration built on shared ambition, integrity and an obsession with craft. Together, we've helped redefine how a property brand can look, feel and behave in the Australian market. Challenge: Sekisui House's legacy of innovation is unmatched globally, yet in Australia the brand needed a refreshed, connected experience—one that translated its philosophy of better living into a contemporary, local context. The task was to bring clarity, cohesion and emotional resonance to a brand operating in a competitive and rapidly shifting property landscape, while honouring its deep design principles and human-centred values. Solution: TOAST worked side-by-side with Sekisui House to elevate every touchpoint of its brand experience—uniting strategy, design and storytelling into a single, purposeful narrative. This collaborative foundation ultimately led to TOAST being entrusted with full branding and marketing responsibilities for Sekisui House Australia's two newest Sydney communities in Norwest and Wentworth Point. The result is a partnership that continues to shape how Australians engage with place: thoughtful, detailed, quietly bold—and always moving toward what's next.

Construction.name: Anchor Group
Construction.description: Anchor Group — Elevating the Brand to Reflect the Business. The Art of Elevated Living. What do you do when your business has outgrown your brand? That was the key challenge Anchor Group came to us with. As a leading development, construction and asset management firm, they excel at designing luxury homes and commercial spaces that embody elegance, detail and distinction in Sydney's most aspirational areas. They now wanted to align the way they looked with the way they worked, so that their true philosophy could shine through everything they do. It was a textbook case of harmonising business and brand on every level. Challenge: But why are Anchor's properties so exceptional? What was the essence of the business that the new brand needed to express? Following a detailed audit of the business, the answer became unmistakably clear: Anchor Group don't just design properties to impress, but to enhance the way people live. In other words, their focus isn't just on the buildings themselves, but the lifestyles they house, shape and support. Solution: We made this distinctive approach the foundation for the brand, giving rise to a value proposition that's all about lifestyle curation: "The Art of Elevated Living". Elevated Logo: Smooth, sophisticated but also sturdy, the logo embodies the flair and practicality that defines Anchor Group. Elevated Design System: Designed not just for clarity, but also emotion, the artisanal fonts and intricate patterns reflect Anchor Group's obsessive attention to detail. Elevated Website: The art of elevated scrolling: stunning property photography, clean layouts and effortless navigation all come together to create a flawless user experience. The Results: Today, the look, feel and tone of the brand doesn't eclipse the excellent work Anchor Group does, but reflects it. With brand and business singing from the same hymn sheet, their underlying value is clear for all to see. When an elevated brand meets an elevated business, it leads to elevated results.

Construction.name: Arclane
Construction.description: Arclane — Brand Transformation. Makers of Modern Living. Standing Out by Standing for Artistry. Arclane are an ultra-creative, premium property developer. Like any ambitious business at the height of their craft, they were looking to strengthen their presence in the Australian property market. And they didn't just want an immediate impact or a quick win: they wanted to build a brand that would nurture steady growth for years to come. Challenge: Cutting through in the world of property is a tall order. It's a market with big players and considerable competition, each striving to be top of mind for buyers, architects and investors alike, so it's very easy to be crowded out and become invisible. But while there's no shortage of developers, there is a gap in the market: there are many formulaic, standard-issue developments out there. They tick the boxes and make commercial sense, but lack the sense of flair or beauty that make them a truly high-value property. But Arclane is different. Following a series of in-depth strategic interviews with their team, we discovered their unique value in the market: They approach every space with the care and consideration of a craftsperson, blending aesthetics and functionality to create spaces that are as beautiful as they are usable. They're places that inspire and you can admire, while still having the right features to support living, working and playing with ease. Instead of being places people just spend time in or move through, they're places people love. Solution: This insight led to our brand idea, "Makers of Modern Living". It captures how every development perfectly marries form and function, beauty and purpose, to provide a refined and modern living experience. By giving residents the best of both worlds, and standing for something more aspirational than transactional, it was a real challenge to the status quo of the market. It was then a question of applying this philosophy to everything the brand made, said and did. We created a design system that was spacious, clean and easily navigable, but with plenty of flourishes mixed in: flowing lines, elegant curves and elevated imagery, all the finishing touches that make you stop and stare. The logo then brought it all together in a symbol of incredible visual economy. "Makers of Modern Living" was etched into its very shape, with three arched versions of the letter "M" combining to create a stunning building. A true work of art, just like their developments. The Results: "Makers of Modern Living" proved to be the perfect platform for the brand. Not only is the idea distinctive in the market, it elegantly summarises what makes Arclane's developments of superior value. Which just goes to show: to avoid becoming invisible, you need to lean into your beauty.

Construction.name: Perifa
Construction.description: Perifa. Versatile Group. Brand Visualisation. Your Tomorrow is Our Today. Versatile, a well-established name in the construction and property sector, approached TOAST with a clear objective: to re-establish their group brand architecture and effectively separate their service offerings into distinct verticals. This strategic initiative began with the creation of the 'Perifa' brand, which would serve as the development arm of the business. The new brand would encompass three core verticals: Capital, Investments and Property. TOAST's task was to work closely with Perifa's leadership to craft a visual and strategic foundation that elevated the brand and aligned with their ambitious growth trajectory. The goal was to position Perifa as a forward-thinking, integrated solutions provider in the Australian market. Challenge: Transitioning from the legacy of Versatile, a company renowned for delivering construction, fit-out and refurbishment projects since 1974, to the newly created Perifa brand posed a unique challenge. While Versatile's heritage in the construction industry was strong, the shift to Perifa marked a pivotal moment, positioning the business as a diversified entity offering integrated solutions across Capital, Investments and Property. TOAST needed to clarify and elevate each of these verticals within the brand architecture while ensuring Perifa's overarching identity represented the company's expansive service offering. The challenge lay in creating clarity and cohesion across the newly defined verticals, while simultaneously evolving the market perception to align with Perifa's broader capabilities. TOAST's role was to ensure that Perifa's brand communicated its comprehensive value proposition to investors, clients and internal teams, highlighting its ability to deliver certainty, innovation, and end-to-end value across the entire development lifecycle. Solution: TOAST collaborated closely with Perifa's management to create a brand identity and architecture that clearly distinguished each of the group's verticals while maintaining a cohesive, unified brand presence. Starting with the foundation of Perifa, TOAST developed the strategic framework to ensure it was clearly defined and positioned as a high-calibre entity within the brand. Perifa's new tagline, "Your tomorrow is our today," encapsulates the brand's forward-thinking philosophy and underscores its role in delivering certainty and value across its diverse offerings. To visually communicate this, TOAST crafted an uber-contemporary brand identity, featuring a core metallic teal palette, accentuated by regal-toned foils to differentiate each vertical while maintaining a harmonious aesthetic across the brand. The visual language was anchored by a contemporary brand icon, combining the letter "P" with a forward-pointing arrow, symbolising Perifa's commitment to progress and innovation. This strategic brand architecture allowed Perifa to present itself as an integrated, multi-disciplined group with a strong focus on future-oriented solutions. TOAST's comprehensive rebranding for Perifa ultimately resulted in a clearly defined, elevated group structure that enhanced market perception, bolstered internal cohesion, and positioned Perifa as a leading player in property development, capital investment and construction solutions.

Construction.name: Uplifte
Construction.tagline: Working with and for the best
Construction.description: Working with and for the best. Uplifte, a vertical of Cozzcorp Group, is a pioneering property development company that operates with a unique ethos centred around creating value together. They are renowned for their holistic, end-to-end services that prioritise the needs and aspirations of their clients. With a mission to uplift people's lives through exceptional properties and ongoing relationships, Uplifte has positioned itself as the go-to developer in the industry. TOAST was engaged to create a brand identity and framework for their company that set them apart in the industry and communicated their extensive yet humble expertise. Challenge: TOAST recognised the need to craft a distinct identity that would capture Uplifte's commitment to holistic development and community-centric values. The challenge was to convey Uplifte's unique, client-centric approach and set them apart as the go-to developer for creating value together. Solution: TOAST's strategic branding solution centred on amplifying Uplifte's core values and strengths. Through meticulous research, interviews and client workshops, TOAST worked with their team to develop a brand identity that epitomised progression, innovation and trusted partnerships. The selection of the name 'Uplifte' for the property development vertical of Cozzcorp Group was a strategic decision rooted in the embodiment of key values: progression, success, improvement and growth. The name 'Uplifte' captures the essence of uplifting lives and communities through transformative developments, symbolising a commitment to positive change and advancement. The custom-designed wordmark and understated yet confident palette reflected Uplifte's commitment to excellence and their ability to deliver the best job, every time. Central to TOAST's strategy was the communication of Uplifte's holistic, end-to-end service and their focus on people and partnerships. By showcasing Uplifte's ability to navigate complex challenges and deliver beneficial developments, TOAST highlighted their expertise in property markets and community engagement. The strategic branding efforts culminated in the creation of a compelling tagline, "Working with and for the best," which encapsulates Uplifte's collaborative approach and commitment to consistent excellence. By strategically aligning Uplifte's brand identity with their values and strengths, TOAST has enabled Uplifte to differentiate themselves effectively and appeal as the preferred developer.

Construction.name: Inovi
Construction.description:
Inovi — Cozzcorp Group. Brand Visualisation. Design & Build Excellence. Inovi, a division of Cozzcorp Group, exists to deliver excellence. Delivering end-to-end construction services with a ‘can do’ attitude, this is a brand that rolls up its sleeves and always delivers for its clients. For close to 20 years the Cozzcorp brand has delivered excellence through attention to detail, a love for design and qualified architectural skills, they have grown from experience and display a passion for perfection in all that they do. (Case study includes brand launch videos.)

Challenge: Until recently, Cozzcorp has primarily existed as a brand offering building services across commercial, industrial and office/retail fit out. TOAST was engaged to identify the purpose of their commercial building arm and assess how our team could successfully support its transformation by creating a new, aspirational brand. Looking at a business and brand transformation, our relevant challenges were to: Develop awareness of Cozzcorp in the hospitality industry; Shift the business ambition & model; Communicate the brand’s vision, mission & purpose; Showcase the business’ unwavering client commitment. We needed to clearly express the business’ rational and emotional value; helping to connect and build loyalty with customers.

Solution: Introducing Inovi. Embodying the integrity and ingenuity that underpin the company, Inovi reflects a commitment to delivering excellence. This brand concept positions design and innovation at the centre and harnesses methodologies which advance in tandem with emerging technologies and client needs. Going above and beyond to deliver the perfect outcome, Inovi embraces innovation, builds trustworthy relationships and always goes the extra mile. On an internal level and with small to large scale clients, those at Cozzcorp Group do what they say and say what they do. Always looking to do the right thing and raise the bar in everyday delivery, they apply a superior, qualitative and comprehensive process for their people, clients and suppliers. Building on this foundation of consistently looking to deliver passion and excellence, we created the tagline ‘Design & Build Excellence,’ not only capturing their dedication to raising the bar, yet capturing the two areas wherein they work best. When ideating the brand’s translation into an uplifted visual look & feel, our stakeholder interviews and market analysis revealed that Cozzcorp was seeking an innovative, fresh and clean brand. One that clearly communicated their passion and drive for advancing in tandem with the market and staying abreast of trends and emerging technologies. With a nod to innovation, future-focused thinking and cutting edge approaches, this brand came to life in a bronze-toned wordmark formulated in a uniform grid pattern. This design embodies the forward thinking approach that is core to the brand and conveys the quality techniques that separate Inovi as a leader in the industry. Furthermore, their corporate colour palette features tones of white, charcoal and bronze; monochromatic and metallic colours which are indicative of the quality, strength and dedication that underpin Inovi. Cozzcorp Group successfully launched Inovi in March of 2023. TOAST partnered with their team to deliver their full branding suite, website design, logotype VFX and the creative direction of a brand launch video for this important event.

Corporate.name: ABINITIO
Corporate.tagline: Powering your Path from Molecule to Market
Corporate.description: ABINITIO. Powering your Path from Molecule to Market. ABINITIO Pharma is a drug development partner spanning Research & Development, GMP Manufacturing and Clinical Trials. We partnered with them to create a brand that reflects this integrated model, positioning them as a single, seamless partner from molecule to market. The result is a clear, cohesive identity that simplifies a complex offering and signals progress at every stage. Sectors: Technology, Corporate, Health. Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Big Idea, UX/UI, Web Design, Branded Content, Capability Statement, Brand Architecture, Video Production, Wireframing, Prototyping, Art Direction, Copywriting, Motion Graphics, Stationery. Challenge: Drug development is often fragmented. Businesses rely on multiple partners across different stages, leading to miscommunication, disjointed handovers and increased risk. For ABINITIO, the challenge was to clearly define a model that removes these gaps and to express it in a way that's simple, credible and easy to understand. Solution: We built the brand around a unifying idea: The Power of Three. By defining their offering across R&D, GMP Manufacturing and Clinical Trials, we created a clear, memorable framework that reflects how the business operates. This came to life through a visual and digital system designed for seamless progress - from evolving patterns and colour transitions to a modern typeface and practical tools built for real-world use.

Corporate.name: Goodspace
Corporate.tagline: A Workspace that Keeps Up with its Workers
Corporate.description: Goodspace. Sentumar. Brand Transformation. A Workspace that Keeps Up with its Worker. Sentumar Becomes Goodspace. Sentumar wanted to get more entrepreneurs hustling, collaborating and thriving in their exceptionally versatile workplaces. Sectors: Property, Corporate. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Architecture, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Big Idea, Illustration. Challenge: Entrepreneurs' businesses move as fast as they do. One week, they might need a room to take calls in. The next, a meeting space to pitch to clients in. The next, a full-blown office teeming with fresh hires. The week after that, a showroom for their shiny new products. The week after that, a warehouse to ship their stock to the world. Their needs can change in the blink of an ROI. But unfortunately, most workspace providers can't keep up. Usually, they offer one kind of office space that can't grow with founders' businesses, limiting what they can do, who they can work with and where they can go. Solution: Sentumar won't hold you back. They offer a range of workspaces in one place. Co-working rooms, e-comm hubs, full office floors, warehousing, dispatching, event spaces, photography studios, even podcast rooms... This near-limitless range of spaces unlocks near-limitless possibilities. All of a sudden, entrepreneurs have the space they need to do whatever their business requires and grow faster. We saw the opportunity right away and positioned Sentumar as "Flexible spaces where good things happen". Laser-focused on hungry young business, it reflects how Sentumar provides a breadth of spaces that can scale with anyone's ambition. Good Name - To appeal to our audience's need to succeed, we renamed Sentumar "Goodspace". Simple, informal, punchy, it spoke the language of success with charm and gusto. Good Illustrations - We filled their office walls with kaleidoscopic and inspiring doodles that capture the endless possibilities their offices support. Good Visuals - We used bold type, upbeat photography and a vibrant colour palette, nodding to that "sky's-the-limit" feeling of running a growing business. Results: Good things are now happening for Goodspace, too. People are flocking to their hubs, the business is growing all the time, and they've opened up in three new locations. Just as they help entrepreneurs thrive, we've helped them do exactly the same. Good stuff.

Corporate.name: FORGE
Corporate.description: FORGE. Brand Transformation. Unlock the Outdoors. FLEETWOOD BECOMING FORGE. How Strategy is a Key Weapon in Brand Transformation. Fleetwood, a leader in outdoor infrastructure solutions, faced the challenge of evolving into a more dynamic, scalable brand that could attract larger clients, expand its community projects from design to delivery, and increase its market share. Through competitive global benchmarking, national industry research, key stakeholders involvement and cultural assessments, we crafted the 2030 Fleetwood strategic-led solution defining a company's unique DNA and positioning for lasting impact. Sectors: Construction, Corporate, Community. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Naming, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, UX/UI, Web Design, Motion Graphics, Video Production. Challenge: How can a well-established business with strong equity reposition itself for greater national impact while retaining its legacy of success? In a fast-changing market, even established brands must evolve to stay competitive. Legacy alone isn't enough and strategic repositioning unlocks new opportunities, strengthening market presence, and driving long-term growth. The challenge was to strategically transition from Fleetwood's existing identity to a stronger, unified national presence; one that encapsulated its ambition, growth mindset, and long-term vision. Solution: Through our rigorous process, we had to extract Fleetwood's core strengths and aspirations, incorporating creative thinking, emotional engagement, and pragmatic execution to establish a new, differentiated brand territory with a compelling name: FORGE. Through our strategic methodology, TOAST helped Fleetwood evolve into FORGE with a comprehensive solution that included: A Unified Brand Vision: Establishing a clear and future-focused brand strategy that strengthens FORGE's leadership in outdoor infrastructure. An Incomparable Selling Weapon: A structured, results-driven methodology that empowers FORGE with a winning approach to pitches, project delivery, and client success. A Compelling and Engaging Tagline: "Unlock The Outdoors"; a brand promise that captures the essence of FORGE's mission to create spaces that inspire and connect. A Strong Brand Visualisation: A distinctive and powerful identity that highlights FORGE's expertise in design thinking, engineering excellence, and flawless execution. A Full Suite of Marketing Collateral: Comprehensive capability statement, look book and brochures designed to enhance FORGE's ability to succeed in every selling opportunity. An Incredible Video Launch: A high-impact brand reveal that engaged stakeholders, elevated FORGE's positioning, and set the stage for future growth. A Lead-Generation Website: A high-performance digital platform optimised for conversion, effectively driving engagement, inquiries, and business growth. The Results: A Future-Proofed Brand. With a renewed vision and strategic foundation, FORGE now stands as a national leader in outdoor infrastructure, ready to scale, innovate, and create lasting impact for Australian communities. Unlocking the outdoors. Building possibilities.

Corporate.name: NAV ECO
Corporate.description: NAV ECO. New Age Veneers. Navigating towards a Sustainable Future. ESG & CSR Strategic Framework. New Age Veneers (NAV) has always prioritised responsible sourcing and manufacturing, achieving certifications that attest to the ethical standards of its products. Building upon this foundation, NAV partnered with TOAST and together they launched NAV ECO, a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program rooted in eight United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs). The program's mission is to guide NAV's team and operations towards more environmentally conscious decisions across all activities, ensuring that luxury and sustainability coexist harmoniously. Sectors: Community, Corporate, Environment, Sustainability. Services: Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: New Age Veneers needed to create a long-term sustainability strategic initiative that would not only align with global sustainability standards but also be deeply embedded in their core business practices. The challenge was to structure the program through an ESG framework and translate the CSR in a way that effectively communicates their commitment to ethical sourcing, environmental responsibility, and social impact while achieving measurable business KPIs. Furthermore, the CSR program needed to resonate with both internal teams and external stakeholders, from consumers to business partners. Solution: NAV ECO's objectives are driven by 8 UNSDGs, grouped into four key values: Harmony, Innovation, Equity, and Growth. Harmony: SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) and SDG 5 (Gender Equality) ensure balanced conditions for well-being and gender equity. Innovation: SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) and SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) guide NAV's commitment to sustainable practices and innovative technologies. Equity: SDG 4 (Quality Education) and SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth) provide equal opportunities for education and employment. Growth: SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals) drive partnerships that promote environmental and economic sustainability. NAV ECO has become central to NAV's identity, showcasing its commitment to sustainability. The initiative reduces environmental impact through renewable energy, responsible production, and sustainable luxury products, enhancing NAV's brand reputation. It empowers teams to drive innovation and sustainability, resulting in stronger partnerships and increased lead generation. By aligning with UNSDGs, NAV is positioned as a leader in merging luxury with sustainability, contributing to economic growth and biodiversity conservation.

Corporate.name: Rethink Group
Corporate.description: Rethink Group. Brand Transformation. Wealth of Ideas. At TOAST, we recently had the privilege of working with premium property investment firm, Rethink Investing. Founded by Scott O'Neill in 2009 and based in Bondi Junction, they have created a leading name for themselves in the property investing realm. The company distinguished itself in the early days by focusing on cash-flow-positive commercial properties in high-growth areas, diverging from the conventional focus on residential investments. This success laid the groundwork for the new, consolidated corporate brand 'Rethink Group,' which now includes multiple verticals such as Rethink Financing, Rethink Residential Investing & Rethink Property Lawyers. It was the creation of this group branding approach that TOAST was engaged to establish and lay the foundation for. Sectors: Corporate, Luxury, Property, Finance. Services: Brand Architecture, Brand Strategy, Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Motion Graphics, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: Rethink Investing approached our team at the end of 2023 with a significant challenge: to create an overarching Group brand that would unify their diverse vertical businesses while maintaining their unique identities. They needed a cohesive brand architecture that reflected their rapid growth and industry success, ensuring a consistent and professional image that would resonate with their high-end clients. Solution: Our team of Toasties embarked on a comprehensive strategic roadmap for Rethink Group, initiating the process with extensive research, analysis and numerous stakeholder interviews. This approach allowed us to deeply understand the unique qualities and market positions of each vertical business within the Group. Collaborating closely with Rethink Group's leadership and marketing teams, we developed a brand strategy that highlighted their core values, strengths, and collective vision for the future. A central element of the new brand identity for Rethink Group was the tagline, "Wealth of Ideas," an evolution of their core DNA, "Wealth Creators Through Property," devised in our stakeholder strategy session. This tagline encapsulates Rethink Group's dedication to empowering financial journeys through unique and forward-thinking property investment services. It also offers extensive flexibility, allowing for variations such as "Wealth of Opportunities," "Wealth of Experience," and "Wealth of Knowledge," tailored to different audiences and contexts. Building on this brand narrative of "Wealth of Ideas" we created a 'house of brands' company architecture, enabling each vertical to retain its distinct identity while aligning under the unified Rethink Group umbrella. Our design team crafted a versatile and cohesive visual identity system, including logos, colour schemes, and typography that differentiated each business while maintaining visual coherence. We delivered a comprehensive brand guidelines document with specifications for each vertical, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints. These final designs and colour palettes played a crucial role in conveying each brand's values and the new image of Rethink Group. The primary Rethink Group logotype is an elegant evolution of their original keyhole icon. Our team enhanced its design, reflecting the known 'R' of Rethink in a bespoke style that embodies the dedication and unwavering ingenuity underpinning the brand. This design echoes the values of authenticity, empowerment, excellence, and disruption, setting Rethink apart as a true industry leader. The conceptual framework behind the Rethink Group logotype captures the brand's core values, creating an ownable icon that champions their legacy while elevating it to the highly respectable status it has achieved to date. The Rethink Group corporate colour palette features luxurious tones of navy and champagne, with varying hues indicating the quality, expertise and dedication that underpin the brand. These colours were carefully chosen to reflect the sophistication and premium nature of the Group's offerings. Staying within the elegant, luxurious territory of the Group brand, the palette is slightly tweaked throughout the verticals to create individual identities for each brand while simultaneously setting them apart and uniting them with the overall company. Result: The result of our collaboration was a refined, professional brand identity for Rethink Group that effectively represents their expansive portfolio and industry leadership. This new brand architecture not only unified their vertical businesses but also positioned them for continued growth and success in the competitive property investment landscape.

Corporate.name: Bowerbird
Corporate.description: Bowerbird — Brand Transformation. The Art of Connecting. Crafting the Perfect First Impression. When it comes to property, you only get one chance to make the right first impression. And in the Australian market, where standards are high and competition is intense, every detail matters. From commercial to residential, Bowerbird is an interior design and property styling team that excels at connecting people and place. They've grown quickly by creating success where it matters: curating environments that set the stage for great experiences, and ultimately, great results. As futuremakers, we were asked to support Bowerbird in shaping the brand's next chapter, presenting their offering to the market in a way that hits exactly the right note. Challenge: Right from the outset, it was clear they were all about artistry. Through their unique mix of creativity, passion, expertise and dedication, they can see the full potential of a space, and bring that out through their designs. But they're not just about stunning spaces. They think hard about the functionality of the location, so that it can meet the needs of whoever's living, socialising or working in it, be they a tenant, colleague or customer. In this way, they blend form and function across everything they make. The challenge, then, was to build a brand positioning and identity that married the aesthetic with the strategic; the creative flair with outcomes that create value for their clients, owners and residents. And in a category defined by minimalist branding with little cut-through, the design needed to have more personality, while maintaining the sophistication needed to appeal to clients across a broad range of categories. If that balance was off even a little, potential clients would switch off and move on. Solution: We built a brand that focused on creating a connection between people and place. On a creative level, they connect people to beautiful spaces and design features, so that they can admire them, appreciate them and enjoy them. And on a strategic level, those spaces connect people to each other, so they can live or work to their full potential. In this way, their brand footprint is centered "value creation" in the fullest sense of the word, turning their labour and resources into something that meets the needs of others both aesthetically and functionally. This creative idea translated to a brand identity; a visual territory which celebrates curation and collection, supported by the tagline 'The Art of Connecting'. At its heart was the 'BB' monogram, a seal of quality, taste and also character, without limiting the brand to a particular style or territory. A flexible colour system (revolving around a signature dusty blue) was introduced, allowing the brand to sub-brand their whole suite of services – from private residential and commercial residential to special projects. The Result: With a brand identity that emphasises the connection of ideas, people and places without boundaries, anything is now possible for Bowerbird. By elevating their brand so it's both creatively appealing and commercially compelling, Bowerbird has the identity it needs to secure new clients, expand their business and, ultimately, meet the high expectations of the Australian property market during that crucial first call, pitch or meeting. Because branding isn't just about building the right identity. It's about striking the right impression, too.

Corporate.name: Agylix
Corporate.description: Agilyx (Agylix) — Agresso. Brand Visualisation. Change Ready. Agresso is a change-ready technology services company dedicated to delivering high quality ERP implementations and services to people-focused organisations in the commercial, government, education and not-for-profit sectors. The business delivers an unrivalled business transformation experience through their service offerings: implementation services, project management, training and Cloud services. They operate from their headquarters in Sydney, Australia, along with offices in New Zealand, North America, Asia and Europe. Challenge: Having undergone considerable change and growth since launching in 2001, Agresso wanted to create a new brand to reflect the power and scope of its digitally-ready business solutions, to maintain its authority in the sector and also have stronger female appeal which the old wordmark had lacked. The challenge was to redefine a strategic roadmap for their brand that would include naming and a new wordmark. Solution: Following a series of strategic brand workshops, Agilyx was born. Shifting the brand from the sector's tired look and feel, TOAST designed a wordmark using agility as it's base to clearly communicate the business' competence to change quickly. Then, it conceived "Change Ready" as the brand's descriptor to highlight the same. Agility, efficiency and performance underscore Agilyx's goal to be known for the quality and innovation of their software, services and partnerships. TOAST's new positioning "Change Ready" sets the brand up for exactly that. The brand has been implemented across all key assets including website and all marketing collateral.

Corporate.name: Anchor Group
Corporate.description: Anchor Group — Elevating the Brand to Reflect the Business. The Art of Elevated Living. What do you do when your business has outgrown your brand? That was the key challenge Anchor Group came to us with. As a leading development, construction and asset management firm, they excel at designing luxury homes and commercial spaces that embody elegance, detail and distinction in Sydney's most aspirational areas. They now wanted to align the way they looked with the way they worked, so that their true philosophy could shine through everything they do. It was a textbook case of harmonising business and brand on every level. Challenge: But why are Anchor's properties so exceptional? What was the essence of the business that the new brand needed to express? Following a detailed audit of the business, the answer became unmistakably clear: Anchor Group don't just design properties to impress, but to enhance the way people live. In other words, their focus isn't just on the buildings themselves, but the lifestyles they house, shape and support. Solution: We made this distinctive approach the foundation for the brand, giving rise to a value proposition that's all about lifestyle curation: "The Art of Elevated Living". Elevated Logo: Smooth, sophisticated but also sturdy, the logo embodies the flair and practicality that defines Anchor Group. Elevated Design System: Designed not just for clarity, but also emotion, the artisanal fonts and intricate patterns reflect Anchor Group's obsessive attention to detail. Elevated Website: The art of elevated scrolling: stunning property photography, clean layouts and effortless navigation all come together to create a flawless user experience. The Results: Today, the look, feel and tone of the brand doesn't eclipse the excellent work Anchor Group does, but reflects it. With brand and business singing from the same hymn sheet, their underlying value is clear for all to see. When an elevated brand meets an elevated business, it leads to elevated results.

Corporate.name: Nexee
Corporate.description: Nexee — Brand Transformation. Here. Now. On. Harbour ISP Becoming Nexee. Harbour ISP wanted to take their business to the next level. As an ultrafibre broadband company, they were looking to grow their market share by becoming the go-to provider for customers and property developers. To build trust and win confidence, they needed to create a brand that was laser-focused on customers' needs, tempting them to make the switch with a smart, targeted and compelling brand proposition. Challenge: Our audit of the category uncovered a market that was plagued with frustration. The culprit? Slow, unreliable internet. We've all been there: clicking and tapping and huffing and puffing away at our computers, frustrated at a connection that won't fix itself no matter what you do (or how much you turn it off and on again). And it's not just a problem limited to customers: developers can struggle with the installation speeds many broadband providers offer for their properties, which has a real impact on their tight timelines. Solution: Harbour ISP are here to fix this. Their ultrafibre service not only offers zero interruptions for everyday users, their fibre is integrated into every building and unit, offering a turnkey solution that developers can use straightaway. The key insight in all this? Everything is instant. The installation. The connection. And everything in-between. This led to our core proposition for the brand, "Here. Now. On", showing how they make lives easier through high-speed, reliable broadband. It also inspired a fresh new name for the business: Nexee. A verbal fusion of "Next" and "Connectivity", it's a word that suggests innovation, modernity and the integration of technology into everyday life. Gaming, streaming, browsing, sharing, liking, discovering, striving – all of it is yours to enjoy immediately when you're connected to Nexee. Logo: Inspired by a fibre optic cable that runs from A to B, it symbolises the very technology that makes Nexee's connection possible. Visual Identity: The fibre optic cable from the logo is then applied as a visual device, showing how Nexee facilitates smarter, easier lives. Website: Complete with bold visuals, sharp copy and clear icons, we crafted a web experience that was as simple and streamlined as the broadband itself. The Results: With a brand that appeals to their audiences' need for speed, Nexee are well-positioned to grow for years to come. Their bold new platform shows customers they get them, understand what bad internet feels like, and – ultimately – hate waiting as much as they do.

Corporate.name: FORGE Website
Corporate.description: FORGE Website. Digital Transformation. Unlock the Outdoors. UNLOCKING A NEW ERA Demonstrating Deep Expertise Delivered at Scale. After five decades of excellence as Fleetwood, TOAST rebranded the company to FORGE, marking a new era for the brand. On the back of this dynamic evolution, TOAST transformed the business' website to perfectly position the team to expand its market share and continue delivering some of the largest and most exciting community infrastructure projects across the country. Through a comprehensive digital strategy that included competitive benchmarking, national industry research, involvement from key partners and senior-ranking Government stakeholders, TOAST thoroughly optimised FORGE's user experience. This deep dive into the company's methodologies and unique selling propositions informed a compelling new digital experience, aligning seamlessly with FORGE's strategic and commercial objectives. This evolution not only reflects the company's growth but also enhances its ability to meet and exceed the evolving needs of its partners, communities, and Government and corporate stakeholders. Challenge: In the realm of public infrastructure, the expectations from local governments, property developers, and communities are continually advancing. FORGE has led from the forefront of this movement, consistently delivering structures that not only deliver the necessary functional amenity, but leverages the opportunity for people to connect with the outdoors in ever more enriching and uplifting ways. But beyond the creative imagination of FORGE's awe-inspiring team lies deep knowledge and experience, a company that understands the importance of providing clients with certainty and confidence to execute major projects, addressing significant logistical, safety, and sustainability challenges at every phase. TOAST's task was to understand the needs and decision-levers of prospective clients securing vendors for major public outdoor amenity works, and position FORGE as the ideal partner to seamlessly and consistently deliver positive outcomes. This involved developing a UX/UI solution that achieved the delicate balance between the emotive appeal of FORGE's new brand proposition, "Unlock The Outdoors" crafted by TOAST, and the rational strengths of FORGE's comprehensive expertise and methodology, ensuring confidence and assurance in FORGE's capabilities. Solution: The FORGE website was meticulously crafted to reflect the company's leading role in delivering exceptional public infrastructure. The development process was rooted in a deep understanding of industry needs, derived from category insights and one-on-one interviews with corporate and government clients. This foundational research informed the UI/UX planning, ensuring that the website not only presents FORGE's major Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) but does so in a manner that instils confidence and underscores FORGE's capability for excellence in the sector. The website's user experience is a testament to the importance of thorough UX/UI planning and research. Each element of the interface has been designed with user engagement in mind, making information accessible and interactions intuitive. This strategic approach ensures that each visit to the website is informative, user-friendly, and reassuring, directly reflecting FORGE's expertise and reliability in transforming outdoor spaces. Through well-structured content and a thoughtfully designed user interface, the website effectively communicates FORGE's commitment to quality and their ability to meet the complex demands of modern public infrastructure projects.

Corporate.name: Rethink Website
Corporate.description: Rethink Website. Rethink Group. Website Transformation. Wealth of Ideas. Creating a Group Lead-Generating Digital Ecosystem. In today's digital landscape, a fragmented online presence can hinder a group's growth. At TOAST, we architect digital ecosystems that drive performance, combining strategic brand thinking, human-centred design, and results-driven UX/UI to unlock brands' full digital potential. Challenge: How can Rethink group achieve unity while allowing individual business units to maintain distinct digital identities? Our approach focused on establishing a consistent design language across all sites, developing flexible customised templates, refining the Group Brand Picture to meet each business line business requirements, enabling seamless cross-navigation, and designing conversion-optimised user journeys. Solution: We began with in-depth research to define a unified Brand Picture and UVP, conducting stakeholder interviews, user analytics, competitor analysis, and collaborative workshops. This strategic framework was then translated in an engaging brand visualisation that unified the group while preserving each vertical's unique identity. Next, we focused on user experience and interface design. By collaborating with each unit's leadership, we developed digital narratives aligning with the group's mission and individual objectives. Tailored content strategies, decision-making flows, and actionable CTAs were crafted for each vertical.
