Leveraging our research insights, we crafted a conversion-optimised and visually engaging digital experience. Our approach emphasised mobile-first design, visual consistency, user-centred functionality, performance optimisation, and seamless integrations to enhance marketing and operational efficiency. The Results: Each business unit now boasts a refined, results-driven digital identity. A transformation which was applied across multiple business units within the Rethink Group, including: Rethink Investing: Designed to engage investors and simplify property investment education; Rethink Financing: Connecting clients with tailored financial solutions and mortgage brokers; Rethink Commercial Education: Providing expert-led programs to educate and empower investors; Rethink Property Lawyers: Establishing a trustworthy online presence for property law services, making legal guidance more accessible; Rethink Residential: Elevating the property development experience with an engaging, high-performance digital platform; Rethink Property Insurance: Offering seamless access to property-related insurance policies through a user-friendly digital experience; Rethink Renewables: Showcasing sustainability-driven solutions with a forward-thinking digital strategy. Today, Rethink Group benefits from a cohesive, trust-building brand experience that enhances engagement and boosts lead generation.

Corporate.name: New Age Veneers
Corporate.description: New Age Veneers. Brand Repositioning. Your Space, Your Story. New Age Veneers (NAV) has long been at the forefront of design innovation, providing high-quality veneer products to designers, architects, and creative professionals. Since the business evolved, NAV sought a stronger brand presence and a more engaging website. As a starting point, TOAST developed a strategic brand framework through research, interviews, and workshops to uncover NAV's unique value proposition (UVP), leading to the creation of the powerful tagline: "Your Space, Your Story." This tagline encapsulates NAV's mission to redefine Australian space design through transformative, sustainable materials that inspire stories, leave a legacy, and shape the future. Challenge: Simultaneously, NAV's website needed an upgrade to strengthen its brand presence, boost engagement, and improve user experience for interior designers, architects, and joiners. The goal was to create a digital platform that showcased NAV's curated veneer selection while driving leads and conversions, solidifying its position as the supplier of choice in both residential and commercial markets. Key challenges includes: Articulating NAV's four core values: Customer Centricity, Creativity, Innovation and Sustainability; Capturing NAV's Australian-made heritage while positioning it as a global leader in veneer markets; Optimising the user journey to guide visitors towards conversion points with clear calls to action; Maintaining strong SEO performance and engagement rates while enhancing the user experience. Solution: TOAST conducted a comprehensive UX/UI analysis, including competitor benchmarking, Google Analytics review, and stakeholder interviews. This shaped the website's strategy, aligning with NAV's brand goals while enhancing user experience. The redesigned platform now inspires designers and professionals with stunning visuals, interactive product discovery, and curated content, highlighting NAV's sustainability, quality, and design innovation. Key Features: Immersive Product Exploration: High-quality visuals and detailed product information help users envision how NAV's veneers can inspire their projects; Sample Requests: Users can easily request samples, fostering engagement with NAV's products; NAV ECO Introduction: The site highlights NAV's CSR program, aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Conclusion: The revamped NAV website strengthens its position as a design industry leader, with an improved user journey that enhances lead generation and conversions. It serves as a vital resource for designers, driving engagement and sales.

Corporate.name: Perifa
Corporate.description: Perifa. Versatile Group. Brand Visualisation. Your Tomorrow is Our Today. Versatile, a well-established name in the construction and property sector, approached TOAST with a clear objective: to re-establish their group brand architecture and effectively separate their service offerings into distinct verticals. This strategic initiative began with the creation of the 'Perifa' brand, which would serve as the development arm of the business. The new brand would encompass three core verticals: Capital, Investments and Property. TOAST's task was to work closely with Perifa's leadership to craft a visual and strategic foundation that elevated the brand and aligned with their ambitious growth trajectory. The goal was to position Perifa as a forward-thinking, integrated solutions provider in the Australian market. Challenge: Transitioning from the legacy of Versatile, a company renowned for delivering construction, fit-out and refurbishment projects since 1974, to the newly created Perifa brand posed a unique challenge. While Versatile's heritage in the construction industry was strong, the shift to Perifa marked a pivotal moment, positioning the business as a diversified entity offering integrated solutions across Capital, Investments and Property. TOAST needed to clarify and elevate each of these verticals within the brand architecture while ensuring Perifa's overarching identity represented the company's expansive service offering. The challenge lay in creating clarity and cohesion across the newly defined verticals, while simultaneously evolving the market perception to align with Perifa's broader capabilities. TOAST's role was to ensure that Perifa's brand communicated its comprehensive value proposition to investors, clients and internal teams, highlighting its ability to deliver certainty, innovation, and end-to-end value across the entire development lifecycle. Solution: TOAST collaborated closely with Perifa's management to create a brand identity and architecture that clearly distinguished each of the group's verticals while maintaining a cohesive, unified brand presence. Starting with the foundation of Perifa, TOAST developed the strategic framework to ensure it was clearly defined and positioned as a high-calibre entity within the brand. Perifa's new tagline, "Your tomorrow is our today," encapsulates the brand's forward-thinking philosophy and underscores its role in delivering certainty and value across its diverse offerings. To visually communicate this, TOAST crafted an uber-contemporary brand identity, featuring a core metallic teal palette, accentuated by regal-toned foils to differentiate each vertical while maintaining a harmonious aesthetic across the brand. The visual language was anchored by a contemporary brand icon, combining the letter "P" with a forward-pointing arrow, symbolising Perifa's commitment to progress and innovation. This strategic brand architecture allowed Perifa to present itself as an integrated, multi-disciplined group with a strong focus on future-oriented solutions. TOAST's comprehensive rebranding for Perifa ultimately resulted in a clearly defined, elevated group structure that enhanced market perception, bolstered internal cohesion, and positioned Perifa as a leading player in property development, capital investment and construction solutions.

Corporate.name: 20 Martin Place
Corporate.description: 20 Martin Place. Pembroke. Web Transformation. A Luminous Landmark. Pembroke, an international real estate business with over twenty-five years of experience, operates from eight offices worldwide. Their thoughtful approach combines global insight and local expertise to create community-focused spaces. Pembroke's core mission is to create long-term value through this integration and a passionate real estate team. To enhance their digital presence and streamline documentation, Pembroke enlisted TOAST to revamp their website and produce a comprehensive leasing document for their new city-centre acquisition in Sydney. Our goal was to empower Pembroke to lease and sell office space more efficiently. Challenge: [no descriptive text provided]. Solution: TOAST's website redesign for Pembroke reflected the brands' leading status and cohesive team approach, along with positioning their new acquisition, 20 Martin Place, as a prestigious location, appealing to businesses seeking a prominent address with excellent access and amenities. We focused on User Experience by dividing the site into accessible segments to highlight leasing opportunities at 20 Martin Place and other properties. Implementing a robust CRM-focused solution, we customised the user database to support segmented consumer profiles for personalised engagement. Our mobile-first, responsive design ensured accessibility across all devices, providing a premium user experience. Similarly, the leasing document presented 20 Martin Place as a signature building in Sydney, known for its prime location, flexibility, and top-tier tenant amenities. The refreshed website and leasing campaign bolsters Pembroke's brand credibility establishing them as a leader in connecting buyers, sellers, investors and developers, and encourages tenants to relocate their business to Sydney's premier business address.

Corporate.name: Fairview
Corporate.description: Fairview. Brand & Website Transformation. Defining Architectural Beauty. Fairview, built upon a foundation of excellence and forward-thinking, excels in delivering top-tier facade solutions throughout Australia, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom. The company, founded by Andrew Gillies, building upon his father's industrial paint coating business, has thrived over three decades, upholding its founding client-centric, family values. Safety and aesthetics are paramount to Fairview's committed team as they navigate the dynamic realm of Australian construction. Emphasising community engagement, Fairview builds enduring relationships and champions regulatory compliance. However, while their values have endured since their business' inception, the growth and reputation of the company is not being represented in their brand identity. Thus, TOAST was engaged to re-establish their brand positioning and strategic identity to bring it up to date with their reputable presence. Challenge: Revamping Fairview's branding and website posed an exciting yet complex challenge to our team here at TOAST. The task involved seamlessly blending the company's rich heritage with its forward-looking vision, encapsulating its commitment to quality, innovation and community. Our team embarked on a journey to redefine Fairview's identity, ensuring it resonated with modern audiences while honouring its longstanding legacy. We aimed to create a visually captivating website that not only showcased Fairview's extensive range of façade solutions but also conveyed its dedication to safety, compliance, and customer satisfaction. Balancing tradition with modernity, we sought to craft a brand narrative that captivated stakeholders and positioned Fairview as a leader in the industry. Through meticulous design and strategic storytelling, we embarked on a mission to elevate Fairview's brand presence and set the stage for continued success in the ever-evolving construction landscape. Solution: Phase 1: Crafting a Credible Exterior. When Fairview first approached us back in 2015, they'd acquired an impressive reputation for their dedication to safety, quality and customer satisfaction. But while their reputation had grown, their brand had stayed the same. Our task was to bring the brand in line with the business and set the stage for the next phase of Fairview's evolution. We developed a new look and feel that doubled down on the premium presence they were known for: clear-cut, interlocking lines spoke to the meticulous craft of their façades, while the entire visual identity seamlessly integrated tradition with innovation, enhancing trust with the architects, builders and installers they wanted to influence. By harmonising every brand element, we created a cohesive narrative that reinforced Fairview's position as a leading industry leader. Phase 2: Adding a Layer of Distinction. This positioning laid a strong foundation for success. But ten years later, their product portfolio had expanded across a range of materials and building types (especially residential). With their offering significantly enhanced, they needed to refresh their brand so it captured the collective value of their beautiful new façades. Our deep immersion in the brand via qualitative interviews, quantitative surveys and stakeholder engagement unearthed a twin truth about these products. Their façades didn't just work on a practical level, they were aesthetically inspiring, too. Looking beautiful and working beautifully all the way through. Not only was this a unique proposition in a cluttered category, it played well with their target audience: as professionals who span both design and construction performance, architects ultimately want to choose a façade that delivers on both levels. Read Our Latest Whitepaper.

Corporate.name: Stone & Chalk
Corporate.description: Stone & Chalk. Strategic Campaign. We're Not For Everyone. [Page contains no additional prose; the Challenge and Solution sections are present as labels only with no body text.]

Corporate.name: Governing Principles
Corporate.description: Governing Principles. Brand Visualisation. Good Governance is Good Business. Our strategy and design teams at TOAST collaborated with governance agency 'Governing Principles' to create their strategic brand foundation and brand identity. As a new player in the industry providing corporate governance assistance, this collaboration aimed to establish Governing Principles as a knowledgeable, confident and experienced provider of corporate governance solutions, propelling organisations towards enduring success, sustainability, and a thriving corporate ecosystem. Challenge: Governing Principles sought to differentiate themselves in the competitive landscape of corporate governance assistance. They aimed to communicate their expertise in navigating legal complexities ethically and with principled decision-making. Additionally, they wanted to emphasise their commitment to upholding the highest standards of integrity and their belief that good corporate governance fosters ethical business practices, leading to financial viability. Solution: TOAST worked closely with Governing Principles to develop a comprehensive brand foundation and identity that aligned with their values and objectives. The brand DNA, 'Safeguard,' which came about during our workshopping process, reflects Governing Principles' role in safeguarding and protecting businesses, allowing them to thrive long into the future. This concept emphasises their expertise in effective governance, strategic legal counsel and upholding the highest standards of integrity. The tagline, 'Good Governance is Good Business,' reinforces Governing Principles' belief that effective governance practices are not only morally responsible but also beneficial for an organisation's financial performance and overall success. This tagline communicates their commitment to partnering with key stakeholders to elevate their governing principles and assist businesses in upholding fundamental and ethical rules, beliefs, values or guidelines. The brand identity palette and visual territory were carefully crafted to align with Governing Principles' positioning as a modern and approachable brand. The warm purple, orange, and dusty blue hues project a modern image, setting Governing Principles apart from competitors. The fusion of strength and cleanliness symbolises professionalism, making their design direction a distinctive visual statement. The logotype was designed to reflect Governing Principles' people-centred approach, focus on financial growth and their institutional strength. It portrays a robust, corporate brand that offers an edge in the industry, utilising a unique geometric language to create a distinctive visual identity. Overall, the brand foundation and identity developed by our cohesive teams at TOAST effectively communicate Governing Principles' expertise, values and commitment to excellence in corporate governance assistance. It positions them as a trusted partner for organisations seeking to uphold ethical business practices and achieve enduring success in a competitive corporate landscape.

Corporate.name: Highland Website
Corporate.tagline: We Are More Than Just Property
Corporate.description: Highland Website. Website Transformation. We Are More Than Just Property. In the hyper-competitive property and real estate market, breaking down all barriers to search, sell, rent or buy can be the difference between stagnation and success. With an attitude of dynamic innovation at its core and growth in its ambition, Highland approached TOAST with the challenge of genuinely raising the bar for how property services could be delivered. Challenge: On the back of two major digital transformation projects (our work for Juror and Caselaw) delivered for the NSW State Government, TOAST once again partnered with renowned UX/UI expert and published author Jerry Gaffney to transform and evolve the digital experience for real estate agency Highland. From residential to commercial sales, and property management to financial services, Highland offers it all. Our team's objective for the website transformation was to deliver these services in the most intuitive, compelling and customer-centric way possible. Naturally, this involved a period of deep and thorough research, with our team devoting two months to a methodological audit and discovery process interviewing and aligning key stakeholders, before casting a net across the entire competitive property landscape — both nationally and internationally — a process of industry benchmarking and collecting insights. But it also required boundary-pushing bravery, and asking ourselves and our client: 'What could we do differently in the UX/UI space that hasn't been done before?' Solution: Creating compelling, relevant solutions relies on more than closed-door strategy and theoretical insight. In a process that was as much geared to stakeholder alignment as it was to discovery to ensure the rebuild pathway addressed genuine needs and objectives, TOAST conducted a series of one-on-one interviews with business founders, leaders, managers and operators from all levels of the organisation who contributed to our real-world understanding of the customer journey optimisation and user experience performance required to drive success. To deliver a website with a strong CRM focus to achieve targeted traction for Highland's multifaceted service offering, we customised the user database solution to create segmented consumer dimensions and user profiles to ensure the needs of target audiences were serviced with relevance in accordance to their individual likes, needs and preferences with a responsive, mobile-first design. Stakeholder interviews, site audits and accessibility tests and analytics tests were repeatedly run to ensure its performance efficacy and suitability to the business' needs. What resulted from deep analytical research and insight generation was so much more than a website. It was a robust lead-generation conversion funnel, seamlessly directing engagement towards relevant property solutions; an elevated mobile-first user experience to reflect the quality of Highland's team and brand, and a benchmark-raising digital destination to connect buyers, sellers, investors and developers, proudly leaving competitors in its wake.

Corporate.name: Uplifte
Corporate.tagline: Working with and for the best
Corporate.description: Working with and for the best. Uplifte, a vertical of Cozzcorp Group, is a pioneering property development company that operates with a unique ethos centred around creating value together. They are renowned for their holistic, end-to-end services that prioritise the needs and aspirations of their clients. With a mission to uplift people's lives through exceptional properties and ongoing relationships, Uplifte has positioned itself as the go-to developer in the industry. TOAST was engaged to create a brand identity and framework for their company that set them apart in the industry and communicated their extensive yet humble expertise. Challenge: TOAST recognised the need to craft a distinct identity that would capture Uplifte's commitment to holistic development and community-centric values. The challenge was to convey Uplifte's unique, client-centric approach and set them apart as the go-to developer for creating value together. Solution: TOAST's strategic branding solution centred on amplifying Uplifte's core values and strengths. Through meticulous research, interviews and client workshops, TOAST worked with their team to develop a brand identity that epitomised progression, innovation and trusted partnerships. The selection of the name 'Uplifte' for the property development vertical of Cozzcorp Group was a strategic decision rooted in the embodiment of key values: progression, success, improvement and growth. The name 'Uplifte' captures the essence of uplifting lives and communities through transformative developments, symbolising a commitment to positive change and advancement. The custom-designed wordmark and understated yet confident palette reflected Uplifte's commitment to excellence and their ability to deliver the best job, every time. Central to TOAST's strategy was the communication of Uplifte's holistic, end-to-end service and their focus on people and partnerships. By showcasing Uplifte's ability to navigate complex challenges and deliver beneficial developments, TOAST highlighted their expertise in property markets and community engagement. The strategic branding efforts culminated in the creation of a compelling tagline, "Working with and for the best," which encapsulates Uplifte's collaborative approach and commitment to consistent excellence. By strategically aligning Uplifte's brand identity with their values and strengths, TOAST has enabled Uplifte to differentiate themselves effectively and appeal as the preferred developer.

Corporate.name: Oxplo
Corporate.description: As Tough As Australia. In the rugged expanse of the Australian industrial landscape, Oxplo emerges as a beacon of durability and reliability, crafted by the experienced hands of Luyu and the strategic ingenuity of our brilliant team here at TOAST. Designed to embody the spirit of exploration and resilience, Oxplo seamlessly integrates premium quality with the robustness of the Australian outback. Rooted in the ethos of "For Australians, By Australians," Oxplo stands as a testament to Luyu's commitment to delivering machinery solutions that endure the toughest of challenges. Challenge: Oxplo faced the formidable task of not only establishing itself as a premium brand in the Australian machinery market but also embodying the essence of exploration and resilience. With Luyu's reputation for delivering comfortable, precise and reliable products, Oxplo needed to go beyond mere functionality and embrace the adventurous spirit of exploration. Moreover, the brand had to convey its deep understanding of Australian conditions while cutting through a very busy market. Solution: TOAST embarked on a strategic journey to craft Oxplo, infusing the brand with a sense of adventure, resilience and unwavering strength. Leveraging Luyu's expertise, Oxplo ensured that its products surpassed industry standards for quality and reliability. Every Oxplo machine was meticulously engineered to withstand the rigours of exploration and the harsh realities of Australian landscapes, providing customers with unrivalled performance and durability. Given this, TOAST settled on the name Oxplo, derived from 'Explore,' and 'Exploration,' capturing the essence of adventure and discovery. Additionally, the association with the animal Ox symbolises strength, durability and resilience, aligning perfectly with Oxplo's brand identity. The "For Australians, By Australians" ethos that TOAST strategised reinforces the brand's local roots and dedication to serving the needs of the Australian community, fostering a sense of pride and ownership among customers. Thus the tagline "As Tough as Australia" takes this ethos further and encapsulates Oxplo's commitment to resilience and durability, resonating with customers across construction and farming sectors. The brand's colour palette serves as a visual representation of its rugged, Australian-inspired identity. Drawing inspiration from the vast and diverse landscapes of the Australian outback, the palette features a harmonious blend of charcoal grey and dark orange. Reflecting the solidity and durability of the brand's machinery, the grey hues evoke the ruggedness of construction sites and the resilience required to thrive in challenging environments. Complementing this, dark, rusty orange adds a warm yet energetic element to Oxplo's palette. Inspired by the rich tones of Australian terrain, this earthy tone represents vitality, endurance and the untamed beauty of the Australian landscape. Whether on a bustling construction site or a remote farm, Oxplo's machinery stands out as a beacon of reliability and strength, embodying the spirit of "As Tough as Australia."

Corporate.name: Case Law
Corporate.client: NSW Department of Communities and Justice
Corporate.tagline: NSW Department of Communities and Justice
Corporate.description: NSW Department of Communities and Justice. Having recently and successfully delivered a project for the Department of Justice called Juror, TOAST was appointed UX/digital partner to strategically assess the online navigation and customer experience of its browser application for NSW Case Law platform. Coupled with strategic UX/UI design, our team was to execute a full brand communications audit as well as create the brand identity, digital brand, Style Guide, templates and stationery. Challenge: Prior research undertaken by the Case Law team which was conducted in the sector with judges and those using the system revealed the importance of simplicity, how technology was being adopted by specific audiences and the methods of navigation used. TOAST embraced all findings and was careful to implement these into a more efficient and sector-appropriate UX. The innovation behind the project resides in the simplicity of the data-driven platform and the direct implications this had on design. Resisting what could easily have been an over-design was pertinent. While design was a key component of the project, it is important to understand that too great a focus on aesthetics was potentially to detract from the UX. The conveying of information needed to be done simply and cleanly. Importantly, with many first time users, it was timely to address challenges within the existing user journey (UX) and implement changes that would create a seamless journey for all. The digital components of the project have been developed with a "mobile-first" philosophy to run on mobiles, tablets and laptop/desktop computer. This removes access barriers to the platform's broad audiences including the general and interested public, teachers, lecturers and students alike. Solution: With research conducted early in the process, many of the issues were ironed out early. With the digital communications component of this project being the crux, we worked closely with the Case Law team to understand the market's needs and how each persona required a different approach. TOAST's review of the comprehensive responsive wireframes was developed after an extensive amount of UX testing by the NSW Case Law team. The purpose and outcome of the project is the dramatic simplification of access to NSW Court and Tribunal case decisions while also being universally accessible and device agnostic to responsive design. Clarity around the customer journey facilitated the design and development of the user interface (UI) which presents information logically, in keeping with not only NSW Case Law's tone of voice but that of the legal profession. It is complemented by a design and colour palette that is implemented across all brand applications including a detailed digital Style Guide. The success of TOAST's collaboration with the NSW Department of Justice to deliver the Case Law online platform and digital presence saw our work awarded a GOLD award at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards for 'Service Design - Government'.

Corporate.name: Innovation for Impact
Corporate.description: CSR/ESG Framework. Elevating the award winning strategic brand platform that TOAST completed for the Inovi team in 2023, our teams collaborated once again to embark on defining a tailored CSR framework that emulates the future-focused vision of the Inovi brand and the team behind it. Inovi is a prominent player in the commercial construction sector and introducing a CSR program to their business is leading them on a transformative journey towards sustainability and social responsibility. Strategised by TOAST through extensive workshopping sessions, their program "Innovation for Impact" is rooted in the pillars of 'In,' 'Ov,' and 'I,' and represents Inovi's commitment to integrating sustainability practices, prioritising employee wellbeing, and making a positive impact on communities and cities. Challenge: Introducing a CSR program to their business provides a framework for both their short and long term goals on both an internal and external level. The company recognised that merely transitioning to environmentally friendly procedures and materials wasn't enough; thus a comprehensive CSR strategy was what was needed to drive meaningful change across its business lines. Incorporating it into an already bustling business, TOAST faced the challenge of aligning Inovi's operations with sustainable practices while ensuring the wellbeing of its employees and positively impacting the communities it serves, all under the one program. Solution: Drawing on the similar rationale behind their brand name, the Inovi CSR program was titled "Innovation for Impact" and has three key verticals: 'In,' (Innovation at the Core) 'Ov,' (Overall Wellbeing of Our People) and 'I,' (Impact on Cities and Community). These respectively represent Inovi's commitment to integrating sustainability practices, prioritising employee wellbeing and making a positive impact on communities and cities. Ensuring we created a lasting, robust platform that gave the Inovi team vision and guidance in their CSR / ESG endeavours, each pillar is associated with 3 key United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, providing the Inovi team with a clear and actionable path. The double circle symbol of the Innovation for Impact program represents the Inovi brand through a trademarked icon. Carried through for the CSR program 'Innovation for Impact', this design injects Inovi's absolute dedication to creating a lasting, positive impact within their team and wider community as a key undercurrent of their brand identity. The primary CSR logo for Inovi employs a greyscale palette (warm & dark grey), culminating in a clean and distinct brand identity that effectively embodies the focus and commitment within the brand. When developed into the 3 pillars, brighter more recognisable tones are introduced. The colour palette for CSR remains consistent with the master brand, yet with modifications in colour hierarchy. Greys take on a more pronounced role, accompanied by the addition of the three colours specific to each category. This strategic approach enhances brand recognition and positions CSR as a distinct division of the business. Through the tailored CSR program, "Innovation for Impact," Inovi has successfully addressed the challenge of integrating sustainability, prioritising employee wellbeing, and making a positive impact on communities, but not as a one-off claim, as a framework with vision, longevity and lasting relevance. By embracing innovation, fostering a supportive work environment, and actively engaging with communities, Inovi sets a benchmark for responsible and sustainable business practices in the commercial construction industry.

Corporate.name: Earth Hour x EPSON
Corporate.description: A Simple Switch. Epson, world-leading printing and electronics manufacturer, is a trailblazer in the corporate world for their rigorous sustainability goals and measures. Their commitment to the environment began close to 80 years ago and is stronger than ever today. Their product designs and business decisions focus on low energy consumption, minimised waste, small environmental footprints, high reliability and minimal moving parts. Epson's environmentally focused vision coincides with the mission of WWF's annual campaign Earth Hour and that of our global branding team here at TOAST - all seeking to create a better, greener future for our planet. Bringing together these like minded teams, WWF Singapore and our TOAST team worked with Epson to spearhead a sub-campaign for Earth Hour 2024. As Earth Hour's first international corporate partner, the collaboration between Epson, TOAST and WWF has created an invaluable partnership as we embark on a mission to amplify Earth Hour's message and encourage collective action towards sustainability. Challenge: The primary challenge of this sub-campaign lay in rallying global, cross-demographic support and engagement to foster a unified movement towards a sustainable planet. Working across 3 time zones and uniting 20+ passionate individuals, TOAST, Epson and WWF-Singapore faced the task of inspiring individuals and communities worldwide to actively participate in Earth Hour's mission. Additionally, the emphasis on community involvement required strategies that resonated at both local and global levels. Collaboration across diverse stakeholders and aligning with Epson's existing initiatives, added depth and complexity to the project, necessitating seamless alignment of objectives and approaches. Solution: The sub-campaign for Epson was aptly named 'A Simple Switch', symbolising the small yet impactful changes all individuals can make to support environmental conservation efforts. By simply making a slight switch in our daily habits, we can have a great combined impact on our environment. TOAST's involvement in the campaign was enormously comprehensive, beginning with a 2-day strategic alignment session for the three teams in Singapore. Emile, our Head of Strategy, ran two 6 hour collaborative sessions with the Epson team. This involved strategic visioning and campaign development - pivotal moves for aligning all stakeholders towards a unified vision and approach. Using the defined campaign concept of 'A Simple Switch', The Toasties leveraged our expertise in script writing, storyboarding and video production to create compelling video campaigns that captured the essence of Earth Hour's message and highlighted Epson's dedication to sustainability through its #MakeTheSwitch campaign. A comprehensive social media strategy devised by TOAST and WWF ensured maximum outreach, amplifying Earth Hour's impact and raising awareness of Epson's sustainability initiatives on a global scale. Recognising the importance of internal alignment within Epson's team for the roll out and comprehension of the campaign, with WWF, TOAST produced valuable documentation and resources, including a campaign communications guideline, operations manual and detailed employee e-handbook. These resources empowered Epson's team to champion the campaign internally and externally, ensuring alignment with the campaign's objectives and Earth Hour's initiatives. Beyond the immediate campaign objectives, the collaboration fostered a lasting legacy of partnership and innovation in the fight against climate change. By harnessing the collective power of creativity, technology and environmental advocacy, the collaboration exemplified the transformative potential of cross-sector partnerships in addressing global challenges. In an era defined by environmental urgency, the collaboration between TOAST, Epson and WWF-Singapore stands as a beacon of hope and progress. Through strategic alignment, creative execution and a shared unwavering environmental commitment, our three teams demonstrated the power of collaboration in driving meaningful change. And as the world continues to grapple with environmental challenges, this campaign partnership serves as a testament to the transformative impact that can be achieved when organisations unite towards a common purpose: to create a more sustainable future for generations to come. The collaboration between WWF-Singapore, TOAST, and Epson resulted in a resounding success, with the 'A Simple Switch' sub-campaign making a significant impact on raising awareness and driving action for sustainability. WWF-Singapore is open to develop more meaningful partnerships for now and the future.

Corporate.name: Mezfi
Corporate.description: The Best of Both Worlds. MezFi provides an accessible entry point into the restrictive world of investment platforms. From banks, to brokers and beyond, it can be immensely difficult to enter, understand and grow in the market. Thus, the makers of MezFi wanted to provide an accessible investment opportunity for everyday investors. They disagree with the exclusivity of investment access and thus developed a service built around the idea of providing greater opportunity to benefit from restrictive financial products and more simply enter the world of mezzanine finance. Challenge: Mezzanine finance, a financing instrument used as a method to bridge capital attainment in property development and intervene to supplement bank or equity financing, is a form of highly exclusive investing that restricts wider audiences through requiring a large financial sum to gain entry. With MezFi, the everyday person can benefit from mezzanine finance funds just like high net-worth individuals using the power of grouped investments. MezFi provides access to mezzanine finance with a minimum fee of just $10,000 and pools these funds to reach the required investment. Platforms like this are existing, with property investment a growing industry, yet MezFi differs in the market by being a hybrid instrument. Typically an illiquid fund, MezFi provides access to invested mezzanine finance capital at any time through a digital asset secured in Web3 technology - a liquidity feature which can be actioned (or not) within the period of the fund. Their fund thus merges two financial worlds, providing the benefits of traditional mezzanine finance investments with a liquidity feature from Web3. TOAST was engaged to communicate this unique and game-changing service to the market in an evocative, engaging and empowering brand identity. Our challenge was to develop a corporate brand footprint, determining the best way to clearly communicate this to audiences, without dividing the two worlds. Solution: TOAST conducted extensive research and industry analysis to delve into this financial realm. Benchmarking existing local and international platforms and assessing the benefits of both traditional finance and Web3 technology provided the footing we required to build this forward-thinking brand. Identifying a selling funnel for engaging users to invest with MezFi was a crucial part of our strategic process. We recognised that the introduction of liquidity to this method of investment was a fundamental selling point. Investing with MezFi provides the unique benefits and high returns of mezzanine finance, usually only accessible to high net worth individuals, coupled with the security and liquidity functionality of Web3 technology. This insight led to our big idea and tagline generation: 'The Best of Both Worlds'. By combining two financial worlds, MezFi investors receive double the benefits - the benefits of traditional mezzanine finance investment plus the benefits of Web3 technology. Merging the benefits of transparency, regulation and asset tangibility that come with traditional finance, with the liquidity opportunities, lack of global borders and blockchain tracking introduced by Web3, MezFi delivers an opportunistic finance platform where you receive the best of two very different types of financial advantages at the same time. We reflected this highly innovative service in a uniquely future-focused, empowering look & feel. Building on a customised blockchain-like grid design, our concept for their brand identity is a clear depiction of the stability of traditional finance and the forward thinking approach of Web3 which combine to form MezFi. Focusing on the concept of mutualism and the brand's future focused foundation, the logotype design links two different worlds in a dynamic, fresh and contemporary fashion, showcasing a brand that goes beyond boundaries and continually thinks outside the box. With a colour palette of vibrant pink, green, blue and indigo, a dynamic, 'new world' look & feel is created, one that celebrates innovation and breaks norms, and is differentiated from the primary block colours of traditional financial services. Providing access to a mode of investing that is usually highly exclusive, MezFi is a trustworthy equaliser, levelling the playing field within financial institutions. The brand identity we created presents MezFi as knowledgeable and visionary; a platform that delivers a fresh way to make money and paves the way for innovative investment methodologies into the future.

Corporate.name: So Shall We
Corporate.description: Your growth is our business. For over a decade, digital marketers So Shall We have harnessed the potential of data, creative and marketing strategy to put businesses and organisations on a trajectory of growth, reach and influence. So Shall We's difference lies beyond their creative flair, and can be found in data gained through the latest digital marketing techniques and continual testing and iterations to drive growth, helping B2B & B2C organisations to plan their strategies, anticipate change and make constant improvements in order to meet their acquisition goals. Breathing life and potential into a growing client base of Tier One national and international brands including the Australian Government, Newscorp and several Premier League football clubs, it was time for So Shall We to take the success of their recent past and lay the foundations for the future at the forefront of digital strategy, production and implementation. Challenge: As futuremakers, our role at TOAST is to deeply understand the landscape our clients are performing in, identify their unique strengths, then amplify a creative corridor for the brand to confidently occupy and thrive. We identified the core challenge for So Shall We as elevating the external perception of them from being 'just another digital and social media agency', repositioning the elite team as dedicated growth strategy and execution consultants; establishing confidence in the team's obvious creative talent by grounding the offering in the team's empirical, data and testing-led methodology. This challenge established the foundations of a creative brief, which was: To equally combine artistry with intelligence supported by a strategic territory that appealed to the head as much as the heart. Solution: Through a process of immersion and workshopping, we established 'Business Growth Culture' as the creative platform for their brand evolution. By defining 'growth culture' as a foundational mindset and a set of beliefs that is focused on helping staff and customers develop their limitless potential, So Shall We could 'own' the positioning of Growth Culture as a means to drive business growth – both internally and externally – by mastering creative, data, on-site and media optimisation. Championing the concept of the business growth mindset aligned authentically with So Shall We's methodology and delivery. For So Shall We, it means understanding and appreciating the unique value clients offer their customers, enabling the team to define, implement and follow a growth marketing strategy and action plan that yields the recognition and financial success that So Shall We's clients deserve. From this strategic territory, a bold new creative identity was born. With endless flexibility at its core, the personality-fuelled design concept drew inspiration from ideas of recognition, introduction and interaction, exposing how So Shall We takes action delving into their clients' category, never shying away from complex or adverse ideas. A typographic solution bringing the 'So, Shall We…?' question to life established an invitation for clients to collaborate, learn, explore, create and ultimately grow, delivering on the brand's core purpose within the visual expression of the identity. The tagline 'Your Growth is our Business' creates confidence in So Shall We's role, establishing crystal clear expectations around outcomes to anticipate when partnering with this expert team. So Shall We's growth leadership positioning and bold new brand identity successfully combines the empirical strategy and creative execution, establishing each new client interaction as an opportunity for presence, learning, contribution and excellence, all while constantly improving.

Corporate.name: Coore
Corporate.description:
Coore — Brand Transformation. Your Driving Force. As any Australian car enthusiast who seeks performance when they get behind the wheel would know, you need a car that can support your passion. In the world of elite motorsports, seconds matter and millimetres make the difference between victory and defeat. From road to race, Coore believes every Australian looking to maximise the performance of a vehicle, deserves access to the best products and services on the market. Located in Sydney and servicing a national network of wholesale customers, Coore is an industry-leading team with a background in motorsport. They understand that car modifications represent that “magic power” in moving forward with your vehicle and give you a competitive advantage, through high-end quality automotive parts (especially suspension, brake kits and tuning) delivering speed and performance for all applications and budgets.

Challenge: With deep pockets and extensive international marketing assets at their disposal, many automotive products, particularly elite European products, claim to be the best of their type on the market in both performance and fitment. Regarded by their loyal customers as leaders in their field, and home to several lines of exclusively distributed high-end European product, Coore was doing everything right in terms of product, price and service. It was time for the business to embrace a new brand identity that could play in the elite field of expertise Coore so humbly inhabited, and create a platform to showcase and sell their high-quality product range.

Solution: A process of deep immersion, research and collaborative workshopping was required for TOAST to get to the core of Coore: to authentically understand and appreciate what makes cars perform. By actively seeking high-end products in suspension, brake kits and tunings made overseas and then acting on getting their exclusivity in Australia, Coore’s success lay in being in the business of driving better outcomes for their clients, and their business. This approach has fundamentally structured Coore’s offering and the distribution of the products through an exclusive e-commerce channel. By always looking for the best, for the best performance: Best brands, best products, best delivery and packaging, best warranties, best user journey and online purchase, and best advice along the journey, we identified Coore as ‘a driving force’ for their customers - delivering the best of the best in the industry. ‘Your Driving Force’ became the central creative brief for a brand transformation befitting some of the world’s most coveted automotive products. Under the tagline ‘Your Driving Force’, we were able to position Coore as so much more than a sales team stocking a large volume of automotive enhancement product. A future-forward type-led brand identity was developed to support this strategic positioning based on an interlinking cable chain symbol, representing Coore’s delivery of holistic end-to-end service. Indicative of continuous improvement and expert knowledge, this logotype design celebrates Coore's dedication to uplifting a vehicle's operational power. They exist to empower, to maximise and to inspire. The result of the brand transformation confidently establishes Coore as your pit stop. Coore as being by your side. Coore as part of your team. Alongside its customers, Coore shares the thrill of the challenge. Together, they strive to propel their customers faster along their journey towards performance, and victory.

Corporate.name: Inovi
Corporate.description:
Inovi — Cozzcorp Group. Brand Visualisation. Design & Build Excellence. Inovi, a division of Cozzcorp Group, exists to deliver excellence. Delivering end-to-end construction services with a ‘can do’ attitude, this is a brand that rolls up its sleeves and always delivers for its clients. For close to 20 years the Cozzcorp brand has delivered excellence through attention to detail, a love for design and qualified architectural skills, they have grown from experience and display a passion for perfection in all that they do. (Case study includes brand launch videos.)

Challenge: Until recently, Cozzcorp has primarily existed as a brand offering building services across commercial, industrial and office/retail fit out. TOAST was engaged to identify the purpose of their commercial building arm and assess how our team could successfully support its transformation by creating a new, aspirational brand. Looking at a business and brand transformation, our relevant challenges were to: Develop awareness of Cozzcorp in the hospitality industry; Shift the business ambition & model; Communicate the brand’s vision, mission & purpose; Showcase the business’ unwavering client commitment. We needed to clearly express the business’ rational and emotional value; helping to connect and build loyalty with customers.

Solution: Introducing Inovi. Embodying the integrity and ingenuity that underpin the company, Inovi reflects a commitment to delivering excellence. This brand concept positions design and innovation at the centre and harnesses methodologies which advance in tandem with emerging technologies and client needs. Going above and beyond to deliver the perfect outcome, Inovi embraces innovation, builds trustworthy relationships and always goes the extra mile. On an internal level and with small to large scale clients, those at Cozzcorp Group do what they say and say what they do. Always looking to do the right thing and raise the bar in everyday delivery, they apply a superior, qualitative and comprehensive process for their people, clients and suppliers. Building on this foundation of consistently looking to deliver passion and excellence, we created the tagline ‘Design & Build Excellence,’ not only capturing their dedication to raising the bar, yet capturing the two areas wherein they work best. When ideating the brand’s translation into an uplifted visual look & feel, our stakeholder interviews and market analysis revealed that Cozzcorp was seeking an innovative, fresh and clean brand. One that clearly communicated their passion and drive for advancing in tandem with the market and staying abreast of trends and emerging technologies. With a nod to innovation, future-focused thinking and cutting edge approaches, this brand came to life in a bronze-toned wordmark formulated in a uniform grid pattern. This design embodies the forward thinking approach that is core to the brand and conveys the quality techniques that separate Inovi as a leader in the industry. Furthermore, their corporate colour palette features tones of white, charcoal and bronze; monochromatic and metallic colours which are indicative of the quality, strength and dedication that underpin Inovi. Cozzcorp Group successfully launched Inovi in March of 2023. TOAST partnered with their team to deliver their full branding suite, website design, logotype VFX and the creative direction of a brand launch video for this important event.

Corporate.name: Applaws
Corporate.description:
Applaws — Brand Transformation. Good. Well. Happy. Applaws is a natural pet food company developing 100% natural food. They are passionate about seeing pets thrive on healthy food, to see their eyes sparkle and for each animal to grow to be the best that they can be. The Applaws brand was born in the UK in 2006 and, after proven success, they launched their company and product offering in Australia in 2012.

Challenge: Competing in a saturated market in Australia and New Zealand, the company was suffering from low brand recognition amongst an enormous range of price points and quality disparity in the pet food market. The Applaws team approached TOAST to put together a sustained strategic marketing programme and manage Applaws’ overall strategy to help the brand build a greater share of market voice which, if effective, would grow the brand’s awareness and ultimately gain sales traction in both the Australian and New Zealand markets.

Solution: Through delving into the company’s belief systems and core purposes, whilst mirroring the importance of remaining a globally competitive brand, the fresh Applaws visual identity was conceived by TOAST. This new brand activation held the potential to achieve exceptional brand exposure across multiple channels and generate their business growth and recognition in the Australian and New Zealand markets. Through our strategic research we identified that Applaws is unique in the pet food industry given their focus and unwavering attention to fresh, natural ingredients. Using excellent quality meats, they offer 100% natural wet foods with no additives or fillers. However, this is a claim that is easily stated and oft-declared by multitudes of brands, so we needed to clearly communicate the validity of the product quality to Applaws’ market. To combat this and inject their claims with evidence, TOAST designed packaging that was translucent - pet food bags with a see-through window allowing purchasers to see the product inside and recognise the natural ingredients that are used. Accompanying this packaging redesign, TOAST devised the tagline ‘Good. Well. Happy.’ This simple statement encapsulates the key pillars of their brand, pet and owner values. Always striving to help all pets live the best lives they can, Applaws is an experienced and trustworthy pet lover; offering natural, simple food they are a GOOD brand. By purchasing Applaws food, pets are healthy, their lifestyle is improved and their coat is shiny, thus the pet is WELL. And with a healthy pet, owners are content that they are making the right choice for their pet and giving them quality food, resulting in a HAPPY pet owner. Our team communicated these brand values in both the tagline and the redesigned packaging, providing Applaws with a reputable and engaging new brand with a clearly outlined set of core values.

Corporate.name: Anavo
Corporate.description:
Anavo — The Polyglot Group. Brand Visualisation. The energy to do better. Anavo, a subsidiary of The Polyglot Group, is a global Recruitment Agency specialising in industries focused on Renewable Energy, Environmental action, and Sustainability. Operating in 6 countries, spanning 9 time zones and 4 continents, they partner with clients, from large multinational corporations through to local SMEs, providing access to leading talents across the globe to bring climate action industry projects to life. Their mission is to help with Permanent Recruitment, Project & Specialist Hire, Global Mobility, Executive Search & Temporary recruitment for climate-focused sectors. They partner with some of the most innovative, high-growth companies in the environmental / sustainability sector, to match them with exceptional talent. Anavo creates a bridge between businesses & talent to empower individuals and teams to drive the decarbonising change that our planet urgently requires.

Challenge: TOAST was called upon by The Polyglot Group to create an engaging, progressive, and friendly brand footprint that encapsulates their new company’s vision. The challenge for TOAST to reach, through strategic brand messaging, was “how are we going to engage companies in the sustainability market as well as individual job seekers passionate about and searching for employment in the environmental industry?” It was crucial for Anavo’s final brand to be accessible and recognisable. Not only to stand out as a key player in the recruitment realm, but primarily as champions for sustainability. They need to be known by companies working across the environment/future/net-zero space as well as respected by individuals who are passionate about working collectively toward progressive green action, and by global corporate bodies aiming to expand their business values to reflect a sustainable future.

Solution: The company needed to be recognised as a group that is driven by passion and a dedication to a wider cause. Through an iterative research process of interviews, industry analysis and an in-depth strategic workshop, our team developed Anavo’s unique brand footprint which aligned the visions of all key stakeholders and brought their business values to life. Inspired by the Greek word which means “to ignite,” “Anávo” was chosen for the brand name, encompassing their mission as a collective to instigate positive change and help the world transition to cleaner practices for a better future. Accompanying this, TOAST put forth the tagline “The Energy to do better” for their team to adopt. This showcases to their audience that they are a recruitment agency empowering people within the clean energy & environment industries to drive the decarbonising change that our planet needs. The logo that was settled on encompasses the bright ambition intrinsic to renewable energy. The buoyant typeface design reflects that they are a team who is passionate about going the extra mile and encapsulates their deep expertise that is underpinned by a curiosity for new ideas, systems and innovations. At only 2 years old, having been created amidst the uncertain yet innovation-provoking time of the 2020 pandemic, Anavo already has a 10+ local employment team, a 15,000+ LinkedIn network and an extensive library of successful client case studies. Their team has supported the growth ambitions and sustainability goals of global companies such as: Enphase Energy, Akuo Energy, Cress Consulting, SMA Solar Technology, Yingli Green Energy. This rapid growth not only reflects the success of TOAST’s branding suite, our team being responsible for Anavo’s brand narrative, strategic footprint and visual identity, but the deep necessity for a platform such as this.

Corporate.name: Altis
Corporate.description: Altis. Brand Transformation. Work That Works. Altis is an architectural firm based in Sydney. Through combining both architecture and interior design principles, Altis creates gathering places that people love, and where businesses thrive; the driving force behind their business being to create unique hospitality, club and living destinations that communities embrace. They are passionate about helping hospitality and living businesses excel and enhance the lives of the people in their local communities. Altis expertly delivers multi-disciplined business solutions by integrating architecture, interior design, strategy and deep local immersion. However, this passion and expertise was not evidenced in their brand territory. Their actions were progressing beyond the public face of their brand, which needed to change. Challenge: Our team was presented with the challenge of refreshing and elevating the Altis brand to reflect their market-leading stature and growing reputation in the architecture and design realm. At TOAST, we attest that a brand governs how you make an impact on the world. It leaves lasting memories on the people who interact with it. For Altis, our task was thus to cleanly define and effectively articulate their proposition. This involved increasing the understanding of the firm's expertise and projects and boosting awareness of the value within their services. Solution: Altis creates strategic solutions in response to diverse business challenges. They transform places into unique destinations by designing elevated experiences for business success. In reaching the core of this branding challenge, our team had to unwind Altis' business strengths and opportunities, delve into similar market leaders and audit their factors of success, all to rearticulate and strengthen the brand footprint and principles of the Altis brand. The fundamental strength our team consistently uncovered was that Altis has a unique business vision that works. Through a tailored approach with holistic integration, their design solutions enable growth and create impact. TOAST captured this transformative service in their new logotype and brand image. The logotype concept builds upon the previous logo's heritage with minimalist, clean-cut design language to capture the precise, technical backbone of the brand. Exuding a considered and crafted feel, the branding combines structural lines with subtle curves that convey Altis' professionalism. Meanwhile, the overlapping colours in the "A" hint at a process of transformation. This concept combines a powerful burgundy with a solid charcoal in a sophisticated palette that can be translated through the brand's marketing collateral. Altis' uplifted brand territory and visual identity has been refined to elevate the experiential luxury and functionality they expertly deliver across major commercial and hospitality projects.

Corporate.name: Aurelia
Corporate.description: Aurelia. Brand Transformation. Energy Enhancement Clinic. Aurelia is an energy enhancement clinic built on the belief that everyone deserves to achieve their optimal potential and discover a healthier version of their mind, body and soul. By combining the power of the latest Bio-field technology underpinned by metaphysics and quantum physics, they have created an innovative healing clinic, a 'world-class sanctuary', where everyone is welcome to rest, recharge and regenerate on a cellular level. Their goal is to help the community to understand the benefits of a healthier body, mind and soul, through understanding their needs and conditions. The service offerings include consultations with Energy Medicine practitioners, consultants, natural health professionals and life coaches to customise support for customers every step of the way. Further, they provide seminars to educate a growing audience on their signature treatments and natural health principles. Challenge: TOAST was tasked with assisting with the brand redesign of this company, to engage with a wider audience and portray their unique industry strengths and expertise. Aurelia empowers customers to become their optimum self, offering a unique energy healing experience, where customers relax and learn about their wellbeing through signature advanced technologies. They help their customers to understand the benefits of a healthier body, mind and soul. This business model needed to be presented in an engaging and mindful way, to educate interested parties and open people up to their services. Solution: For this challenge, it was imperative that our team understood the stakeholders' desires and needs; delving into the purpose and drive behind this company and the benefits that their service offers. TOAST's solution presented Aurelia as an innovative healing clinic; a place where everyone is welcome to rest, recharge and regenerate. The name Aurelia pays homage to its namesake, the Aurelia Moon Jellyfish, which has the ability to self-heal and survive. This concept resonates deeply with the clinic, with the chosen name thus symbolising their services in helping people regenerate and heal on a cellular level. Similarly, the logo was chosen for its representation of the Tortion field, a modern and simple visual representation for their energy treatments. The brand narrative and logotypes TOAST designed were chosen to strategically position Aurelia as an industry group taking the lead in Australia's wellness and energy healing industry, focusing on the technologies used and the indepth healing services they offer.

Corporate.name: Space Logic
Corporate.description: Space Logic. Brand Strategy. Medical Solutions. Space Logic is a family business that specialises in space and logistical storage management. The company has been successfully operating for more than 30 years and have been visible in 3 different categories for space and storage solutions: commercial, industrial and medical. They have an enviable reputation for providing end-to-end services to their clients, supplying project design, planning and installation services across their own innovative and customisable range of products. Their strength as a company has increasingly been evidenced through their work in the medical field. Thus through reflecting on their successes, it was decided to reposition their focus for their primary offering to be creating storage solutions for the healthcare and medical industry. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to rebrand the company with its new industry focus, re-creating a refreshed identity for Space Logic that communicates the company's expertise in space management in the medical category. Accompanying this brand redirection, the business sought to develop a monthly subscription package to maintain an informed relationship with their clients. Within this, Space Logic will be activating their resources on the ground, becoming more visible and recognisable for their swift follow-up actions and response manner akin to that of NRMA. Further, they also expressed their desire to expand and deliver their business services beyond Australia, creating further impetus to appropriately redesign their brand footprint. Solution: In reaching their business solution, TOAST first needed to understand their key target audiences across the medical sphere, and what their needs and challenges are at present. A safe and secure storage environment was primarily identified as a need across CSS Departments (Central Sterile Services), Pharmacies and Operation Theatres. To separate Space Logic from its competitors in the market, TOAST positioned their business as one that "enhances the healthcare experience with advanced medical storage solutions". The contemporary shape of their final logotype is symbolic of the bespoke manufacturing solutions offered by Space Logic, separating them from market competitors. Further, the brain iconography of their logotype accompanies this message, demonstrating their company mission of providing a clever and optimised use of space. The curved, organic shapes present an approachable and human-focused company, positively setting them apart in their global expansion ambitions.

Corporate.name: Xavier Knight
Corporate.description: Xavier Knight. Brand Transformation. Life is Multiplied. Established 10 years ago, engineering consultancy firm Xavier Knight aim to raise the standard of engineering services currently available in our built environment. The company combines the capabilities of a Tier 1 consultancy with a dynamic, proactive approach to collaboration and design. They work on an array of engineering projects, across structural and civil construction engineering through to modern digital engineering in a 3, 4 and 5D scope. Their team and endeavours are constantly expanding. TOAST was engaged to represent this in a brand footprint that is fit for their growing and progressive vision. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to bring new life to Xavier Knight's brand identity. The brand's positioning had to emphasise their uniquely people-centric, progressive values, whilst reflecting their professionalism and credibility. This positioning would be launched through a 30-second impact video at a UDIA industry event, and further established through collateral including a website, capability statement and tendering document. Solution: TOAST's interview and brand audit process uncovered a clear insight: that Xavier Knight's core purpose was 'to enrich life and the world we live in'. This insight, coupled with the firm's 'X' brandmark, inspired our Big Idea 'Life is Multiplied'. This statement reflects Xavier Knight's intentions to enrich lives and amplify outcomes. This idea was brought to life in an attention-grabbing 30-second impact video, using the 'X' as a multiplication symbol in a series of brand claims. The entire suite of collateral, from website to official documentation, builds upon this idea. A predominantly black and white palette maintains professionalism and consistency with prior brand positioning. However, people-centric imagery, strategic hero messaging and splashes of colour ensure that the brand is given a sense of life and vitality. TOAST has enjoyed creating a brand identity that gives justice to Xavier Knight's unique, people-centric positioning.

Corporate.name: Highland
Corporate.tagline: We Are More Than Just Property
Corporate.description: Highland. Brand Transformation. “We Are More Than Just Property”. Highland Property Group (HPG) is a full-service real estate group with myriad offerings including residential, commercial, property management, financial services and project marketing. Founded in 2007 by David Highland, the company has grown drastically with an ever-evolving approach to real estate, redefining the industry and positioning themselves as a leader in the Sutherland Shire property market. Challenge: Outperforming their competitors in leasing and property sales, HPG provide a high-level of service and have a strong presence in the St George and Sutherland Shire regions. The challenge that TOAST was tasked to reach through strategic brand messaging, was, how are we going to win the battle and engage the market beyond Southern Sydney and become a national player in the real estate industry? Solution: Highland Property Group (HPG) needed to become bigger, stronger and increasingly performant in new locations. TOAST worked to strengthen and future-proof their brand to be even more unique and recognisable for HPG to resonate across multiple target groups, services and locations. Ultimately, reaching nationwide. The strategic findings of our research uncovered that HPG effectively push the boundaries and the breadth of services offered in the real estate industry to improve the overall customer experience. Their customers are supported throughout the whole process, from beginning to end, providing the confidence that they will be looked after in their real estate decisions. This enabled TOAST to encapsulate the HPG brand narrative: “We build trusted relationships that last for a lifetime”. TOAST’s direction was to shift customers’ perception. HPG are more than just property; they have the confidence to go for it. They build long-lasting, trusted relationships, create unique customer experiences and deliver rewarding, premium results.

Corporate.name: Sammut Group
Corporate.description: Sammut Group. Brand Elevation. Artisans of Lifestyle. Sammut Group is a property development company offering luxurious residential and commercial properties, with an unparalleled scope of service and expertise backed by 30 years of experience in the development and construction industry. They have a strong business presence and have achieved great success in the Sutherland Shire, providing high-end mixed-use developments which positively impact the life of residents, communities and surrounding businesses in the area. However their presence beyond this region of Sydney was less impactful, something they sought to change. Challenge: TOAST was presented with the challenge; How are we going to become an even stronger, leading player across multiple business lines, targeting lifestyle destinations along the Eastern seaboard? Asking, how do we become bigger, stronger and performant in new locations with more offerings...It’s about becoming more corporate without losing the core business culture, team spirit and especially without losing the foundation for what makes Sammut Group a great company to belong to, work with or buy from. Solution: To truly tackle the core of this challenge, TOAST had to unwind the business strengths and opportunities, audit its key assets and factors of success in order to rearticulate the existing brand footprint and its great principles to strengthen the brand of Sammut Group for it to resonate across multiple targets, offerings and locations. Through research and workshopping, TOAST uncovered myriad successes of Sammut Group; they lifted the bar in Cronulla & the Sutherland Shire by delivering uniquely designed high calibre projects with a deep attention to detail. We identified that opportunities existed for Sammut Group to become a new corporate identity to support the credibility of their projects, offering living experiences beyond what the market currently provides. Thus, reaching the new conceptual output, ‘Artisans of Lifestyle,’ expressing the thesis behind a company enhancing people’s lives with immersive luxury experiences through sustainable architecture, natural landscapes and beautiful details. The business has strengthened and diversified to elevate all facets of the Australian lifestyle; creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

Corporate.name: LJ Hooker
Corporate.description: LJ Hooker. Brand Transformation. When You Know, You Know. Iconic real estate brand LJ Hooker is positioned as a major player in the Australian real estate industry, possessing both the legacy of a rich and successful history and a future-focused, innovative mindset. The company identified that in today’s competitive and evolving climate, resting on past success and market dominance is no guarantee for future success. As such, LJ Hooker had to continue to evolve and differentiate from competitors. LJ Hooker engaged TOAST to help refresh its brand identity. With a global network of 600 offices, it was essential that the brand’s key messaging was aligned across every touchpoint to create a unified brand image. Challenge: The brief was to create a unique and flexible brand proposition embedded in the business’ truth, ambition and vision while being flexible enough to support communication across a range of offerings and diverse market segments (e.g. residential vs. commercial, every kind of suburb vs. being perceived as a brand exclusively for Sydneysiders). LJ Hooker’s messaging needed to apply from a corporate, head office level, right through to the level of specific franchisees. The tagline also needed to reflect the customer-centric values that sit at the core of the brand’s identity. Solution: TOAST created the flexible, relatable tagline ‘When you know, you know.’ The new positioning found its roots in the famous statement from its founder Sir Leslie Joseph Hooker; “Real estate is not about houses, it’s about people”, encompassing the brand’s 92 years of industry experience, placing people, trust and results at the core. Its purpose was also to illustrate the fact that often real estate property matters are a gut-led decision for many of us: at the point when you find the right home, you know… when you know, you know. In terms of application, this tagline has also been created with flexibility in mind, allowing it to be customised to meet the needs of franchisees nationwide. The outcomes of this process were summarised in a comprehensive Brand Kit, which embarked LJ Hooker’s network on the brand refresh journey and outlined clear instructions for implementation.

Corporate.name: Allcastle Homes
Corporate.description: Allcastle Homes. Brand Transformation. Make It Home. Allcastle Homes is a residential home builder specialising in high-value, high-quality family homes. The project builder aims to deliver a level of service and product that exceeds industry expectations at every step of the process. However, the organisation’s previous brand identity did not reflect its aspirational vision or holistic value proposition. Challenge: TOAST’s challenge was to create an uplifting brand that would help Allcastle Homes emerge as a clear builder of choice in the minds of its target audiences. The overall objective was to demonstrate the unique proposition and commitment of the business in treating their customers as if they were members of their extended family, providing the opportunity to design their dream home with confidence. This would involve creating a new brand identity from the ground up, from logo and brand messaging to website and marketing collateral. Solution: Immersion into Allcastle Homes’ organisation, including interviews with senior management and sales consultants, revealed that the builder is committed to delivering a high-quality customer experience from start to finish. These insights fuelled the Big Idea ‘Experience is Everything’. This strategic positioning statement reflects both the significant industry experience that the builder has accrued over almost 30 years of operation and the supportive customer experience that the organisation delivers. As a result, the tagline ”Make it Home” was born, aiming to articulate the idea that the customer can transform their home from a dream to reality within a very supportive familial environment (where they feel at home). To ensure that the brand remained instantly recognisable, the company’s signature blue was retained but has been adjusted to a warmer, royal tone. The new gold highlights emphasise Allcastle Homes’ long-standing reputation for quality and prestige. Allcastle Homes’ uplifted identity conveys the builder’s characteristics of experience, legacy and quality, while remaining modern and contemporary, and will help the organisation continue to build the dreams of Australian families, generating both customer acquisition and loyalty for years to come.

Corporate.name: MECLA
Corporate.description: MECLA. NSW Govt, WWF, Lendlease & Presync. Brand Activation. Game Changer Leadership. Materials Embodied Carbon Leaders’ Alliance (MECLA) is an association of leaders in the building & construction industry, government bodies and not-for-profit organisations who are committed to improving the procurement, supply chain and use of materials that cause harm to the environment. The core members of MECLA, NSW Government, WWF-Australia, Lendlease & Presync, came together with the belief that Australia can tackle the climate change threat and aligned with the Paris Agreement targets if we help transform the building and construction industry. Challenge: The built environment sector is responsible for one-quarter of Australia’s emissions. The majority of these emissions (at least 40%) occur from the embodied or upfront carbon of the materials used in building and construction in particular, steel, cement, concrete and aluminium representing over 9% of global emissions.
