Our research revealed that businesses and their employees don't want just fitness perks: they want benefits that enhance their overall wellbeing, going beyond exercise to include their mental health, social life and even their bank balance. Long story short, WHEREFIT needed to step outside of the gym. They needed to promote the full range of what they offer, including meditation apps, group classes and everyday grocery discounts. Solution: We repositioned WHEREFIT around a simple slogan: "Your Way To Wellbeing", highlighting how they help businesses and employees thrive in every sense of the word. Social, emotional, physical and financial, WHEREFIT is the employee benefits provider who offers it all. This wasn't simply a punchy tagline: it allowed them to connect to a broader pool of customers and rise above the competition with a bigger, stronger and ultimately more unique brand position. But we didn't end things there. From a high-performing UI/UX-driven website to hard-working social posts and everything in-between, we rolled the brand idea out across a range of touchpoints. That way, we could reach this wider audience wherever they were clicking, scrolling or relaxing. The Result: With a stronger position and proposition in place, the brand now has everything it needs to gain mass appeal and succeed. Because healthy growth always starts with a healthy brand.

Health & Wellness.name: SHCS
Health & Wellness.description: SHCS — Care That Helps You Get There. Supporting Safety, Confidence & Possibilities. SHCS is a care provider that offers way more than just care. They help people facing physical, social or emotional challenges reach their personal goals by making them feel safe – and confident – enough to try things out. It could be making a meal, taking a walk or getting out of bed for the first time in years. Whatever the goal, SHCS is here to help you get there. To bring this life-changing service to more people across Australia, they needed a brand that would help them expand. One that captured the essence of their care, while building exposure in a crowded sector. They also needed a system that would reflect the kaleidoscopic breadth of what they do, from NDIS and Allied Health to Programs & Engagement, in a neat and digestible way. Here's how we helped their brand flex, grow and show the world what makes them different. Visit Website. Challenge: The problem we needed to solve for our audience became very clear, very quickly. People facing physical or emotional challenges can often very patronised, pitied and limited by society. They're often told they can't do things because of the difficulties they've gone through and the experiences they've had, so much so that they feel judged by the people around them and end up avoiding new activities. This stereotype can be reinforced by the certain brands within the care category, where participants are presented as objects of pity rather than active agents of change in their own lives. If SHCS were to succeed, they couldn't fall into the same trap. Solution: Enter some much-needed optimism. We wanted SHCS to stand for something more upbeat and positive in the sector, positioning them as the care provider who makes new things possible for people, no matter what society has to say about it. To back up this concept, we shone a light on SHCS' process: their support workers really get to know people, structure the care around their needs and encourage them to try new things. This helps people feel safe, accepted and, ultimately, gives them the confidence to go for their goals. Here's how we embedded this can-do philosophy throughout the brand: A Smile on the Typeface. We gave the brand a joyful new font, Gilroy, and added a subtle 'smile' symbol into the 'H' of SHCS. A great way to show that wherever there's SHCS, there's a little more optimism. Colours that Flex the Services. To promote SHCS' range of services, we built a four-colour brand. Each colour represented a clear area of service in a vibrant but distinct hue: NDIS (Pink), Aged Care (Aqua Green), Allied Health (Yellow), and Programs & Engagement (Orange), with gradients that added an extra pop of energy to each vertical. Photography Full of Possibilities. In stark contrast to sector norms, we showed participants enjoying themselves while trying out new things, depicting them in a positive light that celebrates the limitless potential of every individual. A Positive Voice. We gave them the tone of voice of an inspiring support worker. This struck just the right balance: caring and sensitive, speaking to participants' everyday need for safety, but also encouraging and clear, encouraging them to zoom out, look ahead and pursue goals that give their life a greater sense of direction, purpose and fulfilment.

Health & Wellness.name: Healthy Habits
Health & Wellness.description: Healthy Habits. Brand Transformation. Real Food, Real Fast. Healthy Habits is a recognised, leading member of the food outlet industry providing tasty and healthy food options. They offer a healthy lunch alternative to ever-present fast-food outlets. Launched in 1992 and franchising from 2004, they sell fresh meal options to lunchtime customers across Eastern Australia and New Zealand. Almost 40,000 people purchase their sandwiches each week. Challenge: TOAST was called upon by Healthy Habits to create a striking, friendly brand. The brief outlined that their desired brand was to be non-gender specific whilst easily identifiable in a sea of lunchtime options. Fast-food outlets utilise bright, primary colour combinations, making them eye-catching and memorable. This needed to be replicated for Healthy Habits but in a way that made them positively stand out amongst competitors. Solution: (No solution prose text was present on the page under the Solution heading.)

Health & Wellness.name: Today Fitness
Health & Wellness.description: Today Fitness. Brand Visualisation. Your Best You. A new gym operator approached TOAST with the vision of creating a new hyper-premium gym in Villawood (NSW) and duplicable in other areas later on, to cater towards people who wanted more from the fitness and wellness experience designed from the ground up. Challenge: TOAST was tasked to develop a fresh and engaging approach to brand this new gym that challenged the conventions of the category and dive into the core of what real people truly wanted from their fitness and wellbeing experiences. Working with the client’s team, TOAST conducted extensive research into understanding the competitor landscape, national trends and into the hearts and minds of Australians to understand their needs, behaviours and drivers within the fitness and wellbeing industry. Our central insights were that people were sick of being compared to others, tired of intimidating gym environments and were looking for more than just a set of weights and poorly scribbled instructions on the side of gym equipment. Solution: From a robust strategic framework, we created the Big Idea: “Your Best You” and a name to operate the business: “Today”. With a strong purpose, the new brand Today mirrors a humble and genuine proposition that resonates with our audiences: everyone is simply trying to become the best version of themselves, every day, at their own pace, and that also means something different to everyone. Working with the interior designers, we worked to unpack how this guiding philosophy would spread across the environment to make a truly inclusive and collaborative space in which people could become the best version of themselves. Visually, we looked to challenge the traditional colours of the gym industry by creating a fresh, open palette of colours, inviting people to come along for the journey. Your Best You is a promising customer proposition which has been well welcomed and has a long life with inclusiveness at the very core of its value proposition.

Health & Wellness.name: Fitness Playground
Health & Wellness.tagline: You Choose the Game, We Provide the Playground
Health & Wellness.description: You Choose the Game, We Provide the Playground. Fitness Playground was born with the idea to take people out of the mindset that there's no fun in working out, and create a space for people to work out in a way that's different from a traditional gym. Their founder successfully created the rare kind of gym, the kind of place you wanted to hang out in, with a community you want to be a part of. And thus, the newest and most exciting player in the gym sector was born: Fitness Playground. The company continues its Sydney expansion with 2 new venues in Marrickville and Erskineville. Challenge: Already with a growing membership base from its popular Surry Hills site, Fitness Playground approached TOAST to develop and design a new website that could complement the newly launched Fitness Playground brand. The brief stipulated that the design needed to reflect the brand's personality more strongly with a playful and bold UX that could quickly and efficiently communicate key information to members at home and on the go. Solution: The process involved a website audit, UI/UX strategy, wireframe build, design and development. Impactful video and integration of social feeds are both used to encourage community engagement. Overall, our design is a dynamic, cross-device solution that is consistent with the brand and resonates with its customer base.

Hospitality.name: Zama
Hospitality.description: The Beginning of Something New. Bondi Rd is a fast growing foodie scene in the eastern edge of Bondi Beach. Home to Totti's, The Corner House and Carbon, the last few years have seen many acclaimed names pop up in this enviable side of Sydney. Zama is the newest name in the Bondi Rd scene. A bar/restaurant with an exotic Latin American feel, Zama is an innovative foodie sensation adding undeniable value to Bondi locals. Challenge: Zama, meaning 'Dawning of the sun' or 'Sunrise', was created with a vision to deliver an Argentinian asado venue in the heart of Bondi. A place inspired by Tulum - its culture, history and its jungle aesthetic, merging a relaxed restaurant-feel with the enticing allure of a late-night cocktail bar. It is a place full of flavours, recipes and cultures, a blend of seasonality and exotic experiences. TOAST was engaged by their team to ideate the brand behind this vision. Our team was tasked with crafting a place narrative that encapsulated something raw and authentic, a warm, inviting restaurant by the beach with the desirable "Bondi vibe," whilst staying exotic. Zama needed to be recognised as a friendly venue, a place to feel good & make friends. We needed to curate a sense of belonging and desire. Solution: Looking at competing restaurants along Bondi Rd and Argentinian steakhouses throughout Sydney, our team understood that Zama needed to focus on the experience - to be aspirational, not just functional, and to stand out in this way. Drawing on the cultural history of Tulum and the depth of meaning behind 'Zama', we built the Zama brand around this 'new beginning' and crafted assets around nature's four classical elements. Holding endless possibilities and consistently allowing for an essence of discovery, the four elements of Fire, Earth, Air and Water formed the foundation of this brand. Tying in with the unfussy / bohemian chic / Tulum style that formed the brand vision, the four elements bring life to the brand and embody its core values of creating a space that elevates our being and delivers a joyful spark of flavours, experiences and memories. Our team crafted the logotype and overall look & feel using this foundation and tying in the namesake sunrise to sunset notion. The contemporary, geometric custom typography of the logotype draws on the four classical elements of earth, water, air and fire, championing the cultural legacy these elements hold. Tying in with this, Zama's corporate brand colours feature muted, natural tones from bone and beige through to black; the palette comes alive through the day to night organic colour transition, indicative of the cultural exoticism and elemental exploration underpinning the brand. TOAST's branding suite for Zama was delivered across internal and external collateral including brand guideline documentation, external signage, full website, social media and restaurant collateral.

Hospitality.name: Collection
Hospitality.description: Artisans of Lifestyle. When a prospective buyer steps into your display suite, you only get one chance to make a first impression that could inspire the buy. When the stakes are that high, TOAST's creativity goes higher. Taking brand well beyond the page and screen, TOAST is proud to unveil Sammut Group's Collection Display Suite. Having worked in tandem with PBD Architects and Sammut Group through a brand-first design approach from the very foundation of this project, our teams collaborated to create an interactive display suite to introduce the public to Sammut's corporate brand and projects, primarily showcasing the uniqueness of latest development 'Vue'. Challenge: Stepping into an empty shell, TOAST initially collaborated with PBD Architects to map out and envisage a multi-zoned space which had the capability to showcase 1 hero project and 4 additional live projects at any one time, alongside Sammut's own 'Artisan Wall' paying tribute to the Group's history, achievements, accolades and awards to establish confidence and trust in the experienced development team. Devoted to Sammut's corporate identity, crafted by TOAST, this Group section of the display suite stems from their brand positioning as 'Artisans of lifestyle,' communicating their vision for redefining luxury through a considered, crafted approach. Solution: Following a deep immersion and leveraging a decade of understanding of the triggers influencing purchasing decisions, we engaged the DisplaySweet team to support us in showcasing all content digitally within the space. Together, we delivered a sophisticated multi-media, multi-project display hub, bringing to life over a decade of TOAST's best-practice sales suite design experience with cutting edge technology combining plate plans, 3D modelling and lifestyle video content with innovative environmental design to create a truly interactive experience supporting sales agents to convert. Featuring luxurious branding, signage, sales track functionality and informative, inspiring wall graphics along with multimedia branded video content, TOAST's in depth understanding of the property buyer's sales journey and UX understanding is equally on proud display.

Hospitality.name: 120 Edward St
Hospitality.description:
120 Edward St — DWS investment group. Brand Visualisation. Habitat at 120 Edward. 120 Edward st is an office building owned by DWS investment group in the heart of Brisbane. Located between the city’s Elizabeth and Charlotte Streets, it is in a prime luxury retail precinct lined with heritage buildings that are home to high end boutique offerings by Tag Heuer, Hugo Boss, Cartier, Hermes, and Mont Blanc. The site has many distinguishing attributes and unique usages of the space. It boasts a stylish, homely workplace design with open plan offices and flexible breakout spaces. There are landscaped outdoor balconies with bbq/bar installations on some levels, as well as freshly-appointed end-of-trip facilities available to all tenants. Thus the building actively embraces the latest working trend of open plan offices with bright, natural accents. Yet there are aspects of the site that remain under-utilised as well as a disconnect with the exterior branding, meaning there is an inherent lack of awareness of their brand and site offering.

Challenge: 120 Edward’s leasing experience is currently price and convenience driven, leaning on functional and rational building attributes, yet it is immediately evident that this site offers so much more. This however is un-communicated and thus unknown to the outside. TOAST were engaged to elevate the position of this modern building to corporate tenants and develop a higher-level brand proposition that appeals to the target audience, whilst being aware of their unique drivers and needs. There is a need for an emotive, themed marketing platform. With a fairly generic brand identity and marketing experience, the building lacks a compelling brand proposition to leverage and therefore lacks distinction from a crowded market. Plus, there is a need for a more inspiring proposition for the building, and an internal experience that brings this promise to life. To work closely to DWS’ vision, our team needed to focus on establishing a thematic brand proposition that supports the building identity for tenants, guests and the business community at large.

Solution: In researching the surrounding area, competitors, and immersing ourselves in the space, we highlighted key areas requiring attention to expand on the brand experience. The modernised office suite fit-outs promise a workplace adept with current trends, however the identity and arrival experience remained dull, dated and lacking in emotive theming. Thus there existed an overall disconnect between the internal on-trend offerings with the identity of the overall building offering. To bring new life to 120 Edward, we identified a need to elevate the arrival experience, giving tenants and visitors an opportunity to be enriched by the space as part of their working day. TOAST worked to create pride in the address by elevating the experience for tenants and guests. Our brand narrative for 120 Edward focused on the creation of value and awareness for the building by amplifying the building’s existing green theme as a welcome retreat for the city. Introducing 120 Edward as more than a desk; as a green workplace it is a daytime retreat to work, meet or recharge. This thought analysis lead to the big idea ‘Habitat at 120 Edward’. Habitat at 120 Edward is a place where productivity and purpose exist in harmony with cool, green spaces. Where inspired, modern workplaces reside within a green enclave, to be enjoyed by all. This is a building that supports the working day with healthy, vibrant and modern spaces that inspire fertile thinking and growth. This idea aligns with our society’s changing nature of work. We are not tied to our desks from 9-5; we need areas to recharge, environments that inspire and spaces that are conducive with enjoyable and collaborative productivity. 120 Edward was rebranded as a space offering precisely this.

Hospitality.name: 180 Queen St
Hospitality.description: 180 Queen St. DWS Australia. Brand Visualisation. The Bank of Ideas. DWS Australia is an investment company focused on providing investment solutions and direct real estate assets to clients both locally and internationally. They are the investment company behind Queensland's beautiful and iconic 180 Queen St; a piece of the state's history and its future. This landmark trophy asset is in a dominant position in one of Australia's highest performing retail malls surrounded by city defining developments. In the centre of Brisbane, it offers a connected address within walking distance to Brisbane's urban attractions. The building hosts 6 Levels of private office suites with unique floor layouts and charming heritage features, such as ornate marble interior stairwells. Challenge: Blessed with a beautiful heritage site, TOAST was tasked to develop an activation concept to bring this location to life. Our team needed to create an identity and campaign platform to support 180 Queen St's entire leasing program. To reach the requirements of DWS' leasing campaign, we needed to clearly define the thought-process and behaviours of the key audiences in order to define the ideal product & marketing experience. In addition to this, our campaign needed to breathe new life and bring deep purpose to the heritage building. It is a dignified and chic site with immense history, this needed to be respected and appropriately capitalised on to attract new tenants to the space. Solution: In delving into the solution space, TOAST looked into the site's strengths and weaknesses and where there were opportunities for elevation. We identified there was a disconnect between the external presence and internal atmosphere of the building. Accompanying this, we identified that certain rational elements on their website, such as pricing, services, and amenities, were not readily available. This detracted from the user experience and was a potential demotivator for interested buyers. These insights provided us with valid perspective; we needed to uplift the customer experience. To achieve the customer experience uplift, we uncovered 180 Queen St's competitive advantages, identified an audience seeking this proposition, shaped the offer to appeal to the target audience and created a prioritised plan for implementation & execution. To create the identity for 180 Queen St that DWS was seeking, we embedded the customer journey with a sense of energy and inspiration, to attract interest and commitment from better quality tenants. TOAST created a holistic approach to redefine 180 Queen St, positioning it as a point of intersection for those seeking space to work, create, and meet; we sought to appeal to the core drivers of potential tenants. Our campaign presented 180 Queen St as a site with an eclectic mix of curated tenants utilising quaint, affordable office space that is ideal for creative studios and artisan workshops. This repositioning appeals to the increase in creative and start-up industries and breathes new life into an iconic, heritage location. The big idea, 'The Bank of Ideas' presents 180 Queen St as the place where Brisbane's brightest minds congregate.

Hospitality.name: Muse
Hospitality.description: Muse. Brand Transformation / Site Activation. Inspired Minds. MUSE, known as the House of Inspired Minds, is based in a 5-storey heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's iconic, city-fringe suburb Surry Hills. The neighbourhood's industrial buildings date back to the 1840's. It was during the 1920's that it became home to generations of working-class Chinese immigrant tailors and seamstresses serving the thriving rag trade, and later it became the headquarter of The Chinese Republic Newspaper. Their vision was to challenge the status quo and unlock new and effective ways to work, inspiring bespoke and impactful events and experiences, every single day. Today, MUSE is a different kind of community. In 2017, the building was transformed into a private creative community, combining the industrial heritage of yesteryear with the best of both original architecture and sophisticated, innovative interior design. Challenge: MUSE is now home to creative entrepreneurs and businesses and is an inspiring home for creators in design, film, fashion, branding, architecture, art, journalists and copywriters. MUSE prides itself on offering a private and exclusive space for its members with a focus on innovation and relationship building. MUSE is a space for those looking to take their business to the next level, putting life back into the workplace allowing people to become the best version of themselves. TOAST was engaged by MUSE to style their brand message and convey their holistic business offering. A prime heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's desirable Surry Hills, our team was tasked with crafting their brand narrative to assist the leasing of these bespoke work spaces. Solution: In unravelling this challenge, TOAST worked to unwind the business strengths, opportunities and its factors for success to design the MUSE brand footprint. MUSE is a place that challenges. A place that expands your mind and inspires ideas. This led TOAST to define their brand narrative "Inspired Ideas". Muse gets you moving; a place that creates the next level you, where you can collaborate and co-create in a house built of inspired minds. TOAST focused on the empowerment and autonomy MUSE provides its members; going beyond the co-working and office category by seamlessly integrating work & life in a unique, unexpected and rewarding offering. The end result is a bold and inspiring space that brings co-working to life. It is for those looking for renewal and excitement; to take their business to the next level. TOAST, in collaboration with the award-winning architect Vince Alafaci and acclaimed interior designer Caroline Chocker of ACME & Co (The Grounds of Alexandria), helped create an inspired, collaborative and creative workspace that could offer an experience, and a way of working that other co-working spaces are not providing. The team created an understated and luxurious aesthetic that sweeps effortlessly across spaces from meeting rooms and breakout areas on each level to the private courtyard, rooftop garden, the internal library of architecture and design, and across all amenities. The MUSE project was awarded with Silver at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards in the Interior Design - Co-Working & Studio Space category.

Hospitality.name: Trinity Point
Hospitality.description: Trinity Point. Brand Elevation. Above & Beyond. Nestled on the shores of Lake Macquarie, Trinity Point is a Master Plan community offering world-class residential, resort and marina facilities in an immersive 5-star living experience. With the new iconic and transformational design from leading Australian firm Koichi Takada Architects, the Trinity Point precinct is planned to be home to a luxury 220-room hotel, restaurants, function centre, pool and 218 waterfront apartments, along with the already established Trinity Point Marina. The transformational project will inject more than $720million into the local economy and create hundreds of new direct and indirect jobs through construction and, when operational, to service the hotel and restaurant in the longer term. Challenge: Over the project’s 20-year lifespan, Trinity Point’s visual look and feel had undertaken numerous changes to reflect its ever-evolving transformational design without providing true justice to the new luxury regional destination. The brand needed to be uplifted drastically to mirror the prestige of this iconic, environmentally-leading tourism destination for regional New South Wales; one that will showcase the area's greatest quality –Lake Macquarie. A strong elevation of a strategic brand footprint was required to launch the development’s apartment, marina and resort offerings which will set an architectural benchmark for the region. TOAST’s challenge was to find a way to elevate Trinity Point’s Masterbrand identity whilst seamlessly developing and integrating each sub-brand. Solution: TOAST developed a new overarching positioning statement ‘Above and Beyond’ connecting Trinity Point’s commitment to delivering a lakeside lifestyle beyond any other: an architectural and sustainability benchmark for the region. This positioning is being rolled out as a new visual language across the Trinity Point ecosystem including immersive display, online and offline collateral. Allowing Trinity Point to clearly communicate the value of place to drive connection to community and residents.

Insurance.name: Miramar Group
Insurance.tagline: The Group that's Made to Make Waves
Insurance.description: Miramar Group. Brand Architecture. The Group that's Made to Make Waves. Miramar came to us not as one business, but as seven. It was a range of underwriting agencies owned by Steadfast Group, each specialising in a very different category of insurance. From insurance solutions for property and casualty risks, professional and management liability cover, to solutions for niche and under-served industries, these agencies offered coverage for a broad range of risks across many industries. Sectors: Insurance. Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Big Idea, Audience Personas, Brand Architecture, Logo Design, Tone of Voice. Challenge: They wanted to consolidate their seven agencies under one of their most powerful and longstanding brands, Miramar. This would give them more credibility under the banner of one of their most well-established and well-resourced brands, while showing brokers the full range of what they could cover, creating more cross-selling opportunities, and an enhanced customer experience. But they had to do so in a way that didn't detract from the longstanding brand equity of each individual agency. In an industry where niche expertise is essential, the master brand still had to retain the specialist knowledge these agencies were known for: otherwise, the identity would lose the reputations established by the legacy brands, risking relationships and leads. Solution: This was a textbook case of constructing the right brand architecture, one that combined authority and consistency with flexibility across every touchpoint. We started by building a master brand that channelled the collective value of the seven agencies. After speaking to various business leads, auditing the competitive landscape and investigating each business line, a common UVP emerged: through a mix of seamless digital platforms, responsive support, specialist appetites and a wealth of coverages, the group gives brokers everything they need to succeed. This identity came to life with the tagline "Make Waves", capturing how they're disrupting the industry to power brokers' growth, and an elegant wave-like "M", demonstrating momentum while reflecting their new name: Miramar Group. We then absorbed the seven business lines into three new divisions under a Branded House model: Commercial, Financial Lines and Specialty. This linked all their offerings within a coherent group identity, while preserving their specialist offerings for all to see, with the most niche product lines including Sports, Interruption and Engineering, retained under the Specialty business division. This blend of scale and specialist knowledge informed everything we built for the brand: Considered Colours - Deep Blue and Light Blue formed the primary colours for the master brand, while secondary colours like Emerald, Green and Orange differentiated each business division with a pop of colour. A Versatile Voice - We channelled the voice of a seasoned entrepreneur, which blended qualities of both authority and agility. But we built in flex: certain qualities, like simplicity, expertise and energy, could be dialled up or down depending on which business division was talking. Universal Values - We gave the group four values that captured the style, spirit and substance of every agency and addressed brokers' universal pain points across all business units: Real Backing, Simplicity Wins, Made to Move and Scale for Growth. The result: one group, three divisions and endless growth opportunities.

Lifestyle.name: Willow
Lifestyle.description: Willow. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage Three. Immerse Yourself in Nature. Nestled on the water's edge in Wentworth Point, Sekisui House's masterplan community 'Sanctuary' presents a dynamic lifestyle that intertwines people, culture, and the natural environment. Building on the great success of Stage 2 of Sanctuary comprising Laguna, Glade & Revive, the project has advanced gracefully into its third stage, 'Willow'. Overlooking the Parramatta River and bordering the masterplan's neighbourhood green, Stage 3 is beautifully located within national parkland, offering breathtaking river and city views. Willow, sequestered in this serene site, features a holistic design that includes a private lagoon pool and meticulously curated podium gardens, providing an exclusive oasis for Stage 3 residents. Willow comprises 323 premium waterside apartments centred around lush open spaces, achieving perfect harmony with nature. These residences are elegantly designed to facilitate an inside-out connection between landscape and architecture, embracing the tranquil, curious flow of the Parramatta River and the highest international living standards. This development seamlessly integrates the surrounding natural landscape with modern architecture, offering a unique and harmonious living experience. Sectors: Property, Luxury, Lifestyle. Services: Place Visioning, Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Brand Territory, Brand Visualisation, Editorial Design, Marketing, Motion Graphics, Naming, UX/UI, Web Design, Video Production. Challenge: Having worked with Sekisui House from the inception of Sanctuary's Place Vision, our TOASTies were excited to embark on Stage 3's campaign; as a staged addition in a large-scale masterplan, it was imperative that the Sanctuary property branding and strategic vision remained as the common thread that ties all elements together. Harmony, vibrancy, a sense of calm, and livability are fundamental attributes defining a sanctuary and are wonderfully evident across the Stage 3 development. The Willow residences bring newfound energy and life to the Sanctuary precinct. Aligned and connected with the overall branding and message of Sanctuary's masterplan, these buildings have an infectious spirit. Stage 3, nestled in a lush parkland setting, acts as a natural refuge with its unobstructed views and unrivalled access to nature. As an element within the Sanctuary masterplan brand, Willow is identifiable by the unique kaleidoscopic logotype. In creating this gracefully fragmented circular imagery, TOAST was inspired by the fundamental principles within Japanese design, such as simplicity, understated beauty, and tranquillity. It's an intricate but elegant wreath, a symbol that ties all elements of Sanctuary together. Solution: Set back from the water and surrounded by wild parklands, Willow leverages the verdant energy of parkside life. For Stage 3 in Sanctuary's development, TOAST created the tagline 'Immerse Yourself in Nature,' showcasing Willow as the incomparable green heart of Sanctuary and harnessing Sekisui House's principle of 'Satoyama,' to create harmony between humans and nature. Across Willow, nature acts as a bridge between the apartments and the wider landscape, creating an unrivalled living experience where nature and urban living seamlessly integrate. The harmony and communication between our inside and outside worlds are fundamental elements within Sanctuary's brand footprint, making this masterplan evermore unique. Willow's logo was thus inspired by its 47+ hectares of verdant surrounding parklands. Bejewelled by vibrant greens to suggest a life surrounded by the lush, expansive landscape to explore, Willow's logotype and stage identity lives in proud connection to the land. Stage 3, as the absolute green heart of Sanctuary, delivers a beautifully unique experience for residents and the wider community. Spaces that are in harmony with nature and abundant in vibrant interactions epitomise comfortable living and offer a fulfilled life experience.

Lifestyle.name: Bowerbird
Lifestyle.description: Bowerbird — Brand Transformation. The Art of Connecting. Crafting the Perfect First Impression. When it comes to property, you only get one chance to make the right first impression. And in the Australian market, where standards are high and competition is intense, every detail matters. From commercial to residential, Bowerbird is an interior design and property styling team that excels at connecting people and place. They've grown quickly by creating success where it matters: curating environments that set the stage for great experiences, and ultimately, great results. As futuremakers, we were asked to support Bowerbird in shaping the brand's next chapter, presenting their offering to the market in a way that hits exactly the right note. Challenge: Right from the outset, it was clear they were all about artistry. Through their unique mix of creativity, passion, expertise and dedication, they can see the full potential of a space, and bring that out through their designs. But they're not just about stunning spaces. They think hard about the functionality of the location, so that it can meet the needs of whoever's living, socialising or working in it, be they a tenant, colleague or customer. In this way, they blend form and function across everything they make. The challenge, then, was to build a brand positioning and identity that married the aesthetic with the strategic; the creative flair with outcomes that create value for their clients, owners and residents. And in a category defined by minimalist branding with little cut-through, the design needed to have more personality, while maintaining the sophistication needed to appeal to clients across a broad range of categories. If that balance was off even a little, potential clients would switch off and move on. Solution: We built a brand that focused on creating a connection between people and place. On a creative level, they connect people to beautiful spaces and design features, so that they can admire them, appreciate them and enjoy them. And on a strategic level, those spaces connect people to each other, so they can live or work to their full potential. In this way, their brand footprint is centered "value creation" in the fullest sense of the word, turning their labour and resources into something that meets the needs of others both aesthetically and functionally. This creative idea translated to a brand identity; a visual territory which celebrates curation and collection, supported by the tagline 'The Art of Connecting'. At its heart was the 'BB' monogram, a seal of quality, taste and also character, without limiting the brand to a particular style or territory. A flexible colour system (revolving around a signature dusty blue) was introduced, allowing the brand to sub-brand their whole suite of services – from private residential and commercial residential to special projects. The Result: With a brand identity that emphasises the connection of ideas, people and places without boundaries, anything is now possible for Bowerbird. By elevating their brand so it's both creatively appealing and commercially compelling, Bowerbird has the identity it needs to secure new clients, expand their business and, ultimately, meet the high expectations of the Australian property market during that crucial first call, pitch or meeting. Because branding isn't just about building the right identity. It's about striking the right impression, too.

Lifestyle.name: Calico Marina
Lifestyle.description: Calico Marina — Place Visioning. The Place to Be. Located in the pristine waters of Port Hacking River, Calico Marina is a destination of seaside bliss boasting stunning beaches, tidal rock pools and incredible sunset viewpoints. A renewal of this underused side of Cronulla - Calico is a perfectly positioned destination for a sunny day, afternoon and evening by the water. A serene beachside location and community hub bustling with the daily marina activity, the creative vision behind this marina's uplift was for a place of connection, celebration and exclusivity; the place to be in Cronulla. Challenge: The rise in desirability for a coastal lifestyle positions Cronulla as a thriving cosmopolitan area and an increasingly sought-after destination to live and work. This luxe marina destination is built with precision and beautiful functionality; the curvature of the architecture mimicking the coastal grace of its natural setting. This revitalised waterfront precinct integrates luxury that redefines Cronulla. Becoming the main attraction of this previously underused bayside region, the place narrative required the area to be painted as an exclusive opportunity - a unique destination on the water. The overall brand footprint and strategic vision for this site thus needed to encapsulate its natural beauty and deluxe allure, whilst recognising its historical functionality as a marina. Solution: Building on knowledge gleaned from benchmark analyses, our team recognised that successful marinas go beyond their functional purpose. They are destinations in their own right; surrounded by buzzing restaurants, bars and clubs, they are key local access points to the region all wrapped in an air of sophistication. To create this sophisticated site, we capitalised on the marina's neighbouring unrivalled area of Gunnamatta Bay. TOAST looked into the history and usage of this site and in doing so discovered the meaning for Cronulla, or 'Kurranulla' in the local Gweagal dialect, as 'place of the pink seashells'. This became key to the place narrative and led to the name generation of 'Calico', derived from the sleek pink Calico Scallop seashell. Being unique, eye-catching and inspiring, this name mirrors the curved shell-like architectural form of the precinct design whilst beautifully linking with the area's indigenous history. Our strategic brand positioning thus connects community, a coastal lifestyle and innovative design by creating an iconic marina; a true destination reimagining hospitality and engaging the senses. Harmonising a beachside lifestyle with contemporary design, Calico Marina oozes lavish opulence with a laid-back coastal air to deliver a unique destination for all to indulge. Without losing its functional purpose, this is a luxe waterfront destination which enriches daily lives today and into the future; an indulgent place for socialising and celebrating, for love, fun and community connection. With Calico's intrinsic feel of exclusivity, it is more than a destination; a strong statement in the Cronulla landscape, Calico Marina is a game-changer destination.

Lifestyle.name: ACME Framing
Lifestyle.description: ACME Framing — A Brand as Beautiful as their Frames. One of a Kind. The world of framing can be a bit samey. Many framers offer the same materials, the same mats, the same glass, the same dimensions… Based in the heart of Sydney's Surry Hills, ACME Framing takes a more artisanal approach. They always start with the customer, getting to know their tastes, identity and story, before handcrafting a bespoke frame that's true to who they are. The result: a rare masterpiece, infused with care, flair and eye-catching individuality. Challenge: ACME's aim was simple: to build a brand that reflected the craft and originality of their process, while expanding their market share in a competitive category. To do that, they needed to fine tune the way they looked, talked and showed up in the world: a new positioning, new logo and new identity that framed their business in the best way possible. Solution: We crafted a brand as bespoke as their frames. And just like the artisans in their studio, we built it layer by layer. It all started with the brand story. We recentered their identity around individuality, and how every frame they make is a rich and vivid form of self-expression. Hanging at their heart of this idea was the tagline "One-of-a-kind", reflecting how ACME transforms every artwork into something personally significant and undeniably unique. The next layer, of course, was the design. A visualisation ablaze with vibrant colours. A logotype that spoke to the human touch and attention-to-detail of their process. And a frame-like icon, to be worn as a badge of honour by anyone who values craft and creativity in their art and on their walls. The finishing touch: the studio itself. We infused the brand into the very architecture of the studio façade, contrasting clean-cut minimalism with a head-turning pop of colour, while giving enough space for the frames to sell themselves to any passersby.

Lifestyle.name: Rethink Website
Lifestyle.description: Rethink Website. Rethink Group. Website Transformation. Wealth of Ideas. Creating a Group Lead-Generating Digital Ecosystem. In today's digital landscape, a fragmented online presence can hinder a group's growth. At TOAST, we architect digital ecosystems that drive performance, combining strategic brand thinking, human-centred design, and results-driven UX/UI to unlock brands' full digital potential. Challenge: How can Rethink group achieve unity while allowing individual business units to maintain distinct digital identities? Our approach focused on establishing a consistent design language across all sites, developing flexible customised templates, refining the Group Brand Picture to meet each business line business requirements, enabling seamless cross-navigation, and designing conversion-optimised user journeys. Solution: We began with in-depth research to define a unified Brand Picture and UVP, conducting stakeholder interviews, user analytics, competitor analysis, and collaborative workshops. This strategic framework was then translated in an engaging brand visualisation that unified the group while preserving each vertical's unique identity. Next, we focused on user experience and interface design. By collaborating with each unit's leadership, we developed digital narratives aligning with the group's mission and individual objectives. Tailored content strategies, decision-making flows, and actionable CTAs were crafted for each vertical. Leveraging our research insights, we crafted a conversion-optimised and visually engaging digital experience. Our approach emphasised mobile-first design, visual consistency, user-centred functionality, performance optimisation, and seamless integrations to enhance marketing and operational efficiency. The Results: Each business unit now boasts a refined, results-driven digital identity. A transformation which was applied across multiple business units within the Rethink Group, including: Rethink Investing: Designed to engage investors and simplify property investment education; Rethink Financing: Connecting clients with tailored financial solutions and mortgage brokers; Rethink Commercial Education: Providing expert-led programs to educate and empower investors; Rethink Property Lawyers: Establishing a trustworthy online presence for property law services, making legal guidance more accessible; Rethink Residential: Elevating the property development experience with an engaging, high-performance digital platform; Rethink Property Insurance: Offering seamless access to property-related insurance policies through a user-friendly digital experience; Rethink Renewables: Showcasing sustainability-driven solutions with a forward-thinking digital strategy. Today, Rethink Group benefits from a cohesive, trust-building brand experience that enhances engagement and boosts lead generation.

Lifestyle.name: Vue - Brochure
Lifestyle.description: Vue - Brochure. Sammut Group. The Perfect Blend. Sammut Group is a full-service luxury property development company. They elevate industry standards and expectations by applying principles of superior design and construction to residential, commercial, retail and hotel precincts from coast to coast. With a primary focus on strengthening their luxury property development arm and diversifying the company into other lifestyle businesses, the group is creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality-centred projects. This business core rings true in Vue, their latest project, an oceanview luxury mixed-use precinct in the heart of Cronulla. Offering intricately designed apartments, deluxe amenities and streetfront dining and retail, Vue, designed by PBD Architects, will be pivotal in generating economic investment in the heart of Sydney's Southern beaches. Challenge: Vue is set to be a catalyst project for Cronulla. Transforming the iconic Kingsway, this development will create public engagement with the surrounding pedestrian streetscape. It will be a place that goes beyond premium homes, delivering a harmonious interplay between the built environment, individuals, and local communities. Beautifully positioned in the heart of Cronulla, Vue is a residential, retail and commercial precinct of coastal luxury. Having previously worked with Sammut Group, PBD Architects and Highland on multiple award-winning projects, our team at TOAST was brought onboard to craft the Place Vision, Place Thinking, Brand Footprint and Visual Identity of this destination. Founded on deep strategic research, immersing ourselves in the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends and competitors, our team understood that this place branding needed to be suave yet understated, showcasing its luxury lifestyle offering whilst seamlessly integrating into the locale. Solution: TOAST's passion is creating brands for places which become destinations for years to come. With a deep understanding of the marketing fundamentals of the property industry, we craft strategic brand platforms built for success. Sammut Group's Vue embodies the lure of understated luxury. Comprising designer apartments across 8-storeys, state-of-the-art facilities, and curated retail boutiques including one of Sydney's largest Harris Farm Markets, it is the intersection of splendour and contemporary convenience. A place where coastal luxury meets urban grandeur, it is a destination that is set to define Cronulla. The vision for this site was to create a lifestyle unlike anything ever seen before in Cronulla, a 'one-of-a-kind' interwoven expression of the best aspects of a coastal lifestyle harmoniously combined to create an iconic statement for the future. Building on this vision and the development's underplayed sophistication, our team crafted the Big Idea 'The Perfect Blend'; marrying luxe living with urban simplicity and seamlessly integrating resort-style amenities into contemporary dwellings, Vue is an interwoven expression of the best aspects of ocean view living, harmoniously combined with contemporary urban charm. This brand philosophy speaks true to Sammut Group's mission to deliver an elevated design vision achieving the perfect harmony between the building forms, the people, and the natural world of Cronulla. Mirroring PBD's architectural approach and Mim Design's interior visualisations, our designers worked closely with Sammut Group to craft Vue's brand identity as an amalgamation of attributes and cues inspired by its coastal location. The sense of expanse and perspective, the cultural connection and the ripple effect of the tides all combine to create landmark influences that radiate across the landscape, as reflected in Vue's name and timeless visual identity. The identity became a creative launchpad for amplification of a sophisticated suite of lead generation and sales support elements including a luxurious coffee table book, a brochure suite, digital and physical advertising campaign, website and digital-led display suite fit out, produced in close collaboration with sales agents Highland, PR team Left Field and marketers The Collective Co. A cornerstone of the creative campaign and marketing materials was sophisticated lifestyle photography and video content, directed and produced on location by TOAST. Showcasing the effortless luxury of coastal living, a two-day photoshoot captured a series of vignettes from yoga at dawn to cocktails at dusk with dozens of spontaneous moments enjoying salt, sea air and sun in between. Inspired by nature, infused with luxury, engineered for lifestyle; Vue is an elevated vision achieving the perfect blend of coastal and urban style, setting a new benchmark for coastal living.

Lifestyle.name: The Colliery
Lifestyle.description: Home of Bespoke Experiences. Working again with the dedicated team at Inovi Projects, TOAST was challenged to create a luxe and alluring brand suite for a bespoke accommodation offering in a respectfully converted mining precinct, The Colliery. Situated in the midst of Australia's coveted Hunter Region, The Colliery stands as a testament to the seamless integration of history, luxury and natural beauty. Formerly known as the 'Paxton Colliery', this remarkable location is more than just a place to stay—it's an immersive experience that pays homage to the site's rich legacy while offering unparalleled hospitality in a setting of unparalleled natural splendour. Challenge: The transformation of the Paxton Colliery into 'The Colliery' presented a unique set of challenges. Firstly, there was a need to preserve the historical significance of the site, which bore the marks of its past as a thriving coal mine. Secondly, the project had to respect the traditional custodians of the land, while also creating a luxury destination that would attract and delight modern travellers. Balancing these elements while maintaining the integrity of the site's heritage required a delicate and strategic branding approach. Solution: To address these challenges, The Colliery project embraced a holistic approach that celebrated the site's heritage, honoured its traditional owners, and elevated the guest experience to new heights. This was translated by our team into the manifesto of 'The Home of Bespoke Experiences', capturing the stateliness of the site and echoing the myriad opportunities the destination beckons. The Colliery's architectural team approached the restoration of the site with meticulous care, ensuring that every aspect of the original buildings is to be respectfully preserved and elevated in a way that maintains the beautiful legacy of the structure. From the brickwork produced onsite to the timber milled in the sawmill, every element is to be retained to showcase the site's industrial heritage. Our team thus approached the branding in a similar vein; the colour palette, reminiscent of the surrounding natural landscape, was incorporated into the design to create a cohesive and immersive experience for guests that blends effortlessly into the time period of the site whilst introducing the desired level of absolute luxury to the converted space. Each building within The Colliery was reimagined to offer a unique and tailored experience for guests. From the Bath House to the Power House, Engine House, Fan House, Shed, and Dwelling, each venue was designed to showcase its individual character while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic that echoed the site's industrial past. TOAST's branding thus took on a 'brand architecture' approach, adapting the core brand to mould to each of the site's offerings. The result is a collection of branded spaces that seamlessly blend luxury with history, offering guests an unforgettable journey through time. The Colliery stands as a shining example of adaptive reuse done right—a luxury hotel that not only respects the site's legacy but also celebrates it at every turn. Our branding suite, incorporating the iconic chimney and the metalworks inherent to the site, and colouring that heroes the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape, perfectly complements the subtle reinterpretation of the site, integrating design aspects that are innate to the region whilst bringing an uplifted appeal of pure luxury and unforgettable experiences.

Lifestyle.name: Collection
Lifestyle.description: Artisans of Lifestyle. When a prospective buyer steps into your display suite, you only get one chance to make a first impression that could inspire the buy. When the stakes are that high, TOAST's creativity goes higher. Taking brand well beyond the page and screen, TOAST is proud to unveil Sammut Group's Collection Display Suite. Having worked in tandem with PBD Architects and Sammut Group through a brand-first design approach from the very foundation of this project, our teams collaborated to create an interactive display suite to introduce the public to Sammut's corporate brand and projects, primarily showcasing the uniqueness of latest development 'Vue'. Challenge: Stepping into an empty shell, TOAST initially collaborated with PBD Architects to map out and envisage a multi-zoned space which had the capability to showcase 1 hero project and 4 additional live projects at any one time, alongside Sammut's own 'Artisan Wall' paying tribute to the Group's history, achievements, accolades and awards to establish confidence and trust in the experienced development team. Devoted to Sammut's corporate identity, crafted by TOAST, this Group section of the display suite stems from their brand positioning as 'Artisans of lifestyle,' communicating their vision for redefining luxury through a considered, crafted approach. Solution: Following a deep immersion and leveraging a decade of understanding of the triggers influencing purchasing decisions, we engaged the DisplaySweet team to support us in showcasing all content digitally within the space. Together, we delivered a sophisticated multi-media, multi-project display hub, bringing to life over a decade of TOAST's best-practice sales suite design experience with cutting edge technology combining plate plans, 3D modelling and lifestyle video content with innovative environmental design to create a truly interactive experience supporting sales agents to convert. Featuring luxurious branding, signage, sales track functionality and informative, inspiring wall graphics along with multimedia branded video content, TOAST's in depth understanding of the property buyer's sales journey and UX understanding is equally on proud display.

Lifestyle.name: Applaws
Lifestyle.description:
Applaws — Brand Transformation. Good. Well. Happy. Applaws is a natural pet food company developing 100% natural food. They are passionate about seeing pets thrive on healthy food, to see their eyes sparkle and for each animal to grow to be the best that they can be. The Applaws brand was born in the UK in 2006 and, after proven success, they launched their company and product offering in Australia in 2012.

Challenge: Competing in a saturated market in Australia and New Zealand, the company was suffering from low brand recognition amongst an enormous range of price points and quality disparity in the pet food market. The Applaws team approached TOAST to put together a sustained strategic marketing programme and manage Applaws’ overall strategy to help the brand build a greater share of market voice which, if effective, would grow the brand’s awareness and ultimately gain sales traction in both the Australian and New Zealand markets.

Solution: Through delving into the company’s belief systems and core purposes, whilst mirroring the importance of remaining a globally competitive brand, the fresh Applaws visual identity was conceived by TOAST. This new brand activation held the potential to achieve exceptional brand exposure across multiple channels and generate their business growth and recognition in the Australian and New Zealand markets. Through our strategic research we identified that Applaws is unique in the pet food industry given their focus and unwavering attention to fresh, natural ingredients. Using excellent quality meats, they offer 100% natural wet foods with no additives or fillers. However, this is a claim that is easily stated and oft-declared by multitudes of brands, so we needed to clearly communicate the validity of the product quality to Applaws’ market. To combat this and inject their claims with evidence, TOAST designed packaging that was translucent - pet food bags with a see-through window allowing purchasers to see the product inside and recognise the natural ingredients that are used. Accompanying this packaging redesign, TOAST devised the tagline ‘Good. Well. Happy.’ This simple statement encapsulates the key pillars of their brand, pet and owner values. Always striving to help all pets live the best lives they can, Applaws is an experienced and trustworthy pet lover; offering natural, simple food they are a GOOD brand. By purchasing Applaws food, pets are healthy, their lifestyle is improved and their coat is shiny, thus the pet is WELL. And with a healthy pet, owners are content that they are making the right choice for their pet and giving them quality food, resulting in a HAPPY pet owner. Our team communicated these brand values in both the tagline and the redesigned packaging, providing Applaws with a reputable and engaging new brand with a clearly outlined set of core values.

Lifestyle.name: Escape
Lifestyle.description:
Escape — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Live Beyond Boundaries. Luxury property development group ‘Luxcon’ is renowned for delivering highly acclaimed projects that surpass expectations and raise the bar for residential luxury living. Their latest beachfront project on the Gold Coast’s Garfield Terrace is no exception. As part of their recently launched ‘Coastal Collection,’ the site at 63-65 Garfield Terrace is a study in contemporary elegance and an unrivalled waterfront urban sanctuary. Positioned on the cusp of Surfers Paradise, a destination buzzing with vibrant nightlife, oceanview dining, contemporary art and a beautiful connection to the natural landscape, their vision was to build an idyllic place that is designed around reconnecting with your environment, your loved ones, and yourself. Crafted by acclaimed architectural firm PBD Architects, Luxcon’s development comprises 28 deluxe penthouse-style apartments with uninterrupted 360-degree ocean and hinterland views - combining the sophistication of ocean-front glamour with timeless beachy serenity. Having previously worked on successful developments with both teams, TOAST was engaged as the branding agency to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development for this deluxe destination. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: Luxcon’s creative mission for their luxury residential offering was to deliver a world of beachfront bliss which redefines coastal living in the Gold Coast. Communicated through the unique architectural form, their development sets out to harmonise the ubiquitous edge of city charm with the freedom and relaxation innate to beachfront living, introducing a level of contemporary design that is unseen in the Gold Coast. TOAST’s challenge was to develop a unique brand design to communicate the building’s unmatched opulence and a place identity which was bolstered with competitive longevity against the Gold Coast’s ever-growing luxury property market. Luxcon envisioned an iconic place, one which marries inspired architecture with the natural beauty of the Gold Coast; a highly unique destination designed for residents to ‘escape’. Through branding, TOAST needed to craft this visionary story and create an enviable beachfront oasis.

Solution: As embodied in its name, Escape is a place offering freedom and sanctuary from daily routine. Having space to reset, reflect and recharge is integral in life - values which were at the core of our placemaking principles. Building on these ideals, our team devised the tagline ‘Live beyond boundaries.’ Not only does this expression complement the qualities of flight and freedom innate to the development’s name, it also reflects the building’s visionary and expansive architectural facade. Bridging urban design with a coastal lifestyle, Escape’s contemporary architectural form oozes sophistication and showcases character that expresses striking individuality in its contextual coastal scene. ‘Live beyond boundaries,’ and the very essence of Escape, embodies these values by delivering a place of contemporary beauty and absolute luxury unmatched on the Gold Coast. Taking inspiration from PBD’s contemporary architectural design which elegantly echoes a boundless winglike form and sleek ripple symmetry, our team designed the Escape logo to mimic the broad wingspan of a bird in flight and the sleek grandeur of the building’s entrance. Marrying its architectural design and core values of flight and freedom, Escape epitomises contemporary beachfront beauty; it is a place which inspires future residents and their visitors by providing them sanctuary from daily routine. Towering above the Gold Coast skyline, Escape is a study of urban decadence. Full-floor privacy, personal concierge services and eclectic luxe architecture; it offers the finest in resort-style luxury living. Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape is to deliver an exclusive life of luxury, balance and freedom. This Place Mission is encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery with connotations of freedom and flight, and a beautiful reflection of the expanse of its building form. Concurrent to the acquisition of 63-65 Garfield Terrace, Luxcon landed a prime development opportunity in Byron Bay, the launch of which was shared with Escape as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography, alongside the production team, XMEDIA. The colour palette across Escape’s branding suite was designed for two visual territories, a primary ‘Night’ palette of Charcoal, Gold and Chalk, the depth of which reflects the ocean, sand and moonlight under an evening sky, and a secondary ‘Day’ palette of Mint Green, Cream and Chalk, capturing the serene colours of the sea, sand and sun. Encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery, the wingspan connoting life, flight and liberty whilst beautifully reflecting the expanse of the building form, our Place Visioning and Brand Identity reflect Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape to be an enviable oasis, delivering an exclusive life of balance, freedom and inspiration.

Lifestyle.name: Bohemian
Lifestyle.description:
Bohemian — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Life is Beautiful. Luxury developers ‘Luxcon,’ are renowned for delivering projects that surpass expectations and quantify the true meaning of luxury. Acquiring an enviable site at 90-96 Jonson St in the midst of Byron Bay’s town centre, their vision was to bring to life a destination that encapsulates the intangibly tantalising essence of Byron Bay, whilst paying homage to the beauty of the world that oft-inspires their visionary projects. Byron Bay is a place unmatched in its laid back sophistication. Encapsulating the epitome of barefoot luxury, it is a beachfront locale ever the envy of the globe. Luxcon’s development, designed by PBD Architects, was set to be a luxury offering; 44 serene two and three bedroom apartments, exclusive rooftop amenities and an idyllic meander to Byron’s beachfront, for which TOAST was engaged to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: TOAST designs places to work, to live, to come and to come back… we craft compelling stories built on human experiences, culture, landscape, public art and wayfinding. It was with this strategic branding expertise that our team was tasked to ideate the core identity for Luxcon’s development. In a buzzing location that is just moments from the beautiful coastline of Byron Bay, the precinct design for 90-96 Jonson St complements this beachside area’s vibrant community feel. Its worldly touch, through its open-air courtyards, walkable laneways, and interaction with the natural environment, creates an enviably intriguing atmosphere and brings new life to this public realm. With deep strategic research, founded on understanding the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends, global competitors and nearby developments, our team understood that 90-96 Jonson St’s branding and overall place vision needed to seamlessly integrate into the existing Byron environment, remaining on par with the local fashion and beliefs, whilst introducing an air of class and sophistication to elevate the town’s main strip.

Solution: As a name, Bohemian captures the urban and laid-back artistic sophistication of Byron Bay. This destination is a reimagining of home and hospitality that welcomes families and free spirits. Marrying the refined simplicity of a European lifestyle with the blithe and trendy air of Byron; Bohemian was created with a vision to introduce a place to connect, dream and inspire. Mirroring this place ethos, our chosen tagline ‘Life is Beautiful’ expresses the laid-back and eclectic way of life that Bohemian makes its own. Encapsulating the spirit of travel and a taste for exploration and discovery were core to our place-making ethos. Through our brand design, TOAST sought to connect Byron Bay’s coastal way of living with Luxcon’s “Of the World” lifestyle by creating an iconic and unique place; a world where you are grounded, safe and free. Across the brand, our conceptual framework paid homage to Bohemian’s unique architectural form and the contemporary beachside atmosphere unique to Byron Bay. Creating a custom font, with grid lines reflecting its architectural design, the weighted gradient of the building structure and the design’s united feminine and masculine features introduce an organic sense of balance. The logotype is bold as it is subtle, forging the perfect balance between worlds. The stacked structure of the hierarchical logotype layout is replicated for the precinct’s two sub-brands, Plaza and Spice Lane. The identifiable Bohemian logotype is enlarged above, with the sub-brand at the base, maintaining brand equity by remaining uniformly identifiable. Concurrent to the acquisition of 90-96 Jonson St, Luxcon landed a beachfront development opportunity in the Gold Coast, the launch of which was shared with Bohemian as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography. These assets showcased the values at the core of Bohemian’s branding, forging a diptych of harmonised natural elements and vibrant interactions which deliver a place to reset, enjoy and love. Bohemian’s branding suite encapsulates the efficacious, free spirit of Byron Bay. With a neutral colour palette drawn from the dusty-gold of the sand and pure monochromes of the building facade, Bohemian’s campaign assets create an enduring connection to the coast and mirror the natural hues of each meticulously designed apartment. Bohemian is a home that overflows with the alluring aura of Byron. Complementing its contemporary-classical architectural style inspired by renowned beachside towns; Bohemian’s strategic brand assets and visual identity deliver a place with a perfect balance between beach and city life.

Lifestyle.name: Kela X
Lifestyle.description:
Kela X — Brand Activation. by Harry Georje. When internationally acclaimed jewellery designer Harry Georje partnered with KELA Tech, the leading brand behind the world’s first non-slip hair accessory, something incredible was bound to happen. In fact, an entirely new category was to be born: fine jewellery for hair. A proposition that magically blends the luxury jewellery, hair and fashion industries. KELA X is a hair accessories brand delivering high-quality pieces which elevate the style and sophistication of its wearers. This incredible proposition is a world-first, luxury brand in a category of its own. A fusion of fine jewellery, fashion and patented hair technology - KELA X is set to inspire multiple industries at once - industries where both KELA and Harry Georje hold immense respect due to their highly admired bodies of work.

Challenge: Harry Georje is a master of his craft - an unrivalled expert whose reputation precedes him. He is a three times De Beers international award-winning diamond jeweller, with over 30 years’ experience. For Georje, trust is everything. Renowned for his passion and knowledge of diamonds in particular, he treats every piece of jewellery as an investment - a piece to ignite decades of joy. And business partner, KELA, has deep expertise in the hair industry, with an offering that began in hair charms and extended into a patented technology known as KELA Tech. With this in mind, TOAST was tasked with crafting a highly sophisticated, yet approachable and trustworthy brand which reflected skill, knowledge and craftsmanship for this new business partnership. The fusion of carefully crafted design and innovation creates the magic of KELA X, a revolution in fine-jewellery for hair that invites a new level of inspired self-expression; they needed to be showcased as a brand that elevates natural beauty through bold attitude, timeless elegance and absolute luxury.

Solution: For KELA X by Harry Georje, every aspect is considered. With the brand values of artful innovation, sophistication and design aesthetic, unapologetic exclusivity and superior performance, our team at TOAST crafted a brand footprint for KELA X that evokes opulence, expertise and unmistakable quality. With exclusivity as the halo of their prestige; their brand creates unique experiences through which customers and brand loyalists are intrinsically connected. Their narrative is a luxury brand story underpinned by innovation that pushes their brand to excellence and beyond. Encapsulating this brand essence, we identified the USP “we believe in capturing the ultimate form of self expression through pure aesthetics and world-class technology,” reflecting the fusion of carefully crafted design and innovative creation which is the magic of KELA X. They are a brand that elevates natural beauty through bold attitude, timeless elegance and absolute luxury. Thus, our overall branding suite used a deep toned and metallic colour palette to connote their refined sophistication, with the duo of dark blue and gold lending a touch of royalty and signifying the authority and idealism within the brand. These attributes were similarly championed through the Tone of Voice we crafted for their launch; a territory of sophisticated language, effusive descriptions and decorative, idyllic terms painting a brand picture of pure excellence and ultimate luxury.

Lifestyle.name: Bondi Chic
Lifestyle.description:
Bondi Chic — Brand Activation. In and Out Beauty. Established in 2018, Bondi Chic is a premium cosmetics brand operating within the ‘Clean Beauty’ niche of the ‘Green Beauty’ market segment. Their product range is made with only the best of Australia's native, skin-loving ingredients.

Challenge: Faced with a crowded market (both domestically and internationally), Bondi Chic sought a brand identity that would position the skincare company at the forefront of modern trends whilst also creating a strong, ownable brand footprint with genuine longevity. Reaching out to TOAST, it was understood that the brand voice needed to be more consistent across all of their platforms and follow a clear strategy, whilst a target audience needed to be defined and their brand image transformed to be strongly relevant for their demographic. The Bondi Chic brand has unique values, strong principles, and a core purpose to its name - many of which are potential selling points to customers - however, they are combined in an ad-hoc way that indicates a lack of firm brand identity and lead to a confused and ineffective value proposition. TOAST could clearly see a brand that has the potential to satisfy a consumer need and to eventually take ownership of the ‘Clean Beauty’ segment. However, to get there, Bondi Chic needed to clarify exactly where it sits in the crowded cosmetics market, what exactly it offers to consumers and what values the brand embodies.

Solution: Bondi Chic exists because they believe in creating skincare products the right way, helping people feel healthy and beautiful, inside and out. As a brand, they seek to simultaneously innovate solutions and respect age-old traditions; they approach skincare with an open mind to find the best ways to enhance beauty by only using ingredients that holistically care for one’s skin. TOAST devised a brand footprint & USP which reflected this ethos. Building on stakeholder research and user insights, their brand narrative champions that no other brand offers a comprehensive yet uncomplicated program that uses non-toxic, Australian ingredients. Their USP, “Our products create beauty in the healthiest way possible - inside and out,” highlights their difference in the market as dedicated specialists providing natural and innovative products which are kind to your skin. From these insights came our big idea, “In and Out Beauty.” At the core of Bondi Chic is the belief that real beauty begins when we are true to ourselves, our beauty coming from within. Thus, for inner and outer beauty, they only use ingredients that will holistically enhance your beauty - if they don’t belong on your skin, they don’t belong in their products. TOAST identified their market demographic as 25 – 50 year old Australian women who enjoy an active lifestyle and lean toward ‘natural’ and ‘organic’ products. To speak to this audience, the packaging and Tone of Voice we devised used earthy and herbal yet sophisticated language. Emphasising the natural, native Australian ingredients and toxin-free formulas, we showcased Bondi Chic as a classy yet contemporary brand that encompasses all things natural. Disciples of the ‘clean beauty’ philosophy - products that deliver on their promises of completely non-toxic ingredients - Bondi Chic’s brand identity reflects both their connection to nature and their commitment to creating products that deliver real results.

Lifestyle.name: Highlife
Lifestyle.description: Highlife. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage One. Wentworth Point's newest high life. At TOAST, we empower places by providing compelling brand footprints that allow audiences to understand the unique attributes and purposes of the spaces they experience, and our work with Sekisui House demonstrates the success of our approach. In 2016, Sekisui House purchased the 9.4 hectare site that would become Sanctuary. TOAST was brought on board at the project inception stage, working closely with Sekisui House and key architects to immerse ourselves in the site and the region. This process uncovered key insights that would shape the future identity of the masterplanned community. Crafting the core vision and essence of Sanctuary from the project's very inception was a brand-first approach that delivered outstanding outcomes. Challenge: In-depth auditing of the site revealed that a unique characteristic of Sanctuary is the fact that it is completely surrounded by nature, with wetlands, water, and parkland encircling the masterplan's location. The wonder of its geographical positioning paired terrifically with buyer-insights. Market research identified that the top two considerations of Wentworth Point buyers were "safety and security" and "a desirable location". Thus, these insights played a key influence in the creation of Sanctuary's brand identity and the delivery of its First Stage, coined 'Landing'. Landing's delivery consisted of 2 statuesque buildings, home to 364 beautiful, masterfully-built apartments designed for indoor-outdoor living with state-of-the-art appliances and modern finishes. The 'High Life' lifestyle that Landing encapsulates is underpinned by balance and harmony in a community that's perfectly situated to take advantage of the best that Greater Sydney has to offer. The complete synergy between the architecture and natural surroundings established a fantastic standard of living and is an embodiment of the core principles and brand design of Sanctuary. It is this essence of Sanctuary, encompassing balance, harmony, nature and community, that TOAST joined Sekisui House in strategically defining. Each design element is intrinsically linked to natural influences, and demonstrates Sanctuary's vibrant yet calming place identity that lets people live their everyday lives to the fullest. Solution: Landing, and Sanctuary as a whole, offer a unique, integrated living experience.
