The masterplan community features an oasis of vibrant spaces encompassing all states of being: play, reflection, energy and sustainability. This approach has resulted in a rich, purposeful living experience that integrates the site's core elements of nature, water and sky. TOAST reflected these core elements in the precinct's colour palette and collateral asset design. The colour palette of the 'Landing' logo variant, consists of gold and charcoal. With warm hues and a darker tint these colours are both bold and soft, encapsulating the ever-evolving nature of the world around us. The woody tones within this palette blended with the movement of the cyclical logotype reflect the beautiful evolution that occurs in our environment and beautifully represents the Sanctuary ethos of 'one with nature'. In the launch of Landing, TOAST worked with Sekisui House on a series of targeted social media posts, building intrigue and awareness of this new destination in Wentworth Point. This campaign was centred around the concept of living the 'High Life,' promoting the precinct's connectivity to the city, proximity to a world class entertainment hub and the expansive waterfront views creating a luxurious lifestyle that is immersed in nature. Adapting to the Covid-19 rules and gathering limits, TOAST and Sekisui House pivoted and used the campaign as an opportunity to promote exclusive private tours of the apartments, allowing their off-the-plan purchases to continue to thrive. This safe, tailored approach to sales tied back to the buyer insights our teams established and permitted the desirable location of Sanctuary to continue to be experienced for all interested parties. The success of Landing as Stage 1 of Sanctuary was recognised at the 2021 Urban Taskforce awards, winning a Development Excellence Award in the 'High-rise Development Metro' category.

Lifestyle.name: Community
Lifestyle.description: Community. Sekisui House. Sanctuary Masterplan. A place for all. The Sekisui House philosophy 'Love of Humanity', integrated with the ancient Japanese cultural principle of Satoyama 'Harmony between the environment and nature,' has guided Sanctuary's design to reflect the benefits of co-dependence between people, nature, and the built environment. Sanctuary places a deep respect for community at the heart of its design and development. It's about weaving nature throughout, the connectivity to the residents, and linkages to the broader community and Sydney as a whole. With a key focus on 'Michi' or 'Spatial Design Experience' Sanctuary's brand has emerged with the need to evolve and appeal to become a centre of life for people. The incorporation of design, innovation and technology with the natural surroundings through the facilities, landscapes and amenities, plays an essential role in the uniqueness of Sanctuary. Vibrant, fulfilling interactions between people, place and nature bring to life a beautiful spirit of community that occurs within and beyond its boundaries. Challenge: The vision for Sanctuary was to create a masterplanned community where a genuine respect for nature is reignited, and where a harmonious relationship between people and built form is nurtured; Sanctuary is a space that is designed to facilitate community connection. Sekisui House's core design principles and community-building ethos uplift the offering of this masterplan and introduce endless benefits that will elevate the lives of all in Wentworth Point. Maximising parkland within the site, expanding retail opportunities, integrating public transport and offering a calendar of community events at the foreshore park; what was once merely the end of the road is now becoming the heart of a revitalised community. Along with creating opportunities for community activity, the connection to the landscape offers boundless benefits to mental and physical health. By delivering a unique residential and community precinct that is at one with nature, Sanctuary will help its residents experience enriched, fulfilling lives that evolve with time and last for generations. Solution: To encapsulate the deep community spirit that Sekisui House has created through Sanctuary, TOAST crafted the tagline 'A place for all,' championing the neighbourly connections and inclusive atmosphere that Sanctuary fosters. This masterplan generates coexistence and co-prosperity by increasing the amount of public open space, and interactive activity areas for the whole community of Wentworth Point to enjoy. Offering more than 6 football-field's worth of public parkland and open space, over 4km of cycling and pedestrian-friendly paths, and with 34% of the entire masterplan dedicated to public green space, Sanctuary is undeniably alive with experiences and possibilities. This is a precinct designed to facilitate community connection, neighbourly interaction, and easy engagement with your native environment. Reflecting the core brand values of 'vibrant interactions' and 'comfortable living,' this approach delivers a unique experience for residents and the greater community, creating cohesion and instilling life, energy & vibrancy.

Lifestyle.name: Escarp
Lifestyle.description: Escarp. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. A place of outspoken beauty. LAPropertyCo is a development & property group known for their innovative designs that deliver excellence and cultivate maximum return. As a company, they have a history of development and investment in established markets, with their success underpinned by their ability to identify emerging trends and opportunities, particularly within Sydney. The group's core strategy is to acquire and develop high-quality residential and mixed-use buildings that deliver maximum value, both for the company and to the surrounding community. The high achieving property group acquired a site in the Northern Sydney suburb of Northbridge; a gateway project to feature 19 oversized luxury apartments offering expansive Sydney CBD views and an unrivalled lifestyle in one of the Lower North's most historic suburbs. Challenge: For their new site acquisition and property vision, TOAST was engaged to create the brand footprint and place narrative. This residential site was envisioned as a place appealing to the essence of sophisticated Lower North Shore living, embracing the surrounding delights of its stunning Northbridge setting and boasting uninterrupted views of Sydney's vibrant city skyline and picturesque surrounds. Through our strategic design, we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client's expectations. To achieve these outcomes, the brand needed a strong feel of exclusivity and a very aspirational proposition to engage and elicit interest of to-be residents. It needed to be recognised as the next highlight of the Lower North Shore. Solution: To accurately reflect LAPropertyCo.'s visions, TOAST delved into the history of the suburb, the surroundings, the intention for the project and the placemaking approach. We drew key inspiration from the sophisticated and high-end lifestyle of Northbridge and its neighbouring suburbs. Further to this, front and centre of our ideation and design thinking processes were the end-consumers. Our team took the time to delve into their motivations, desires and ambitions, leading to an understanding that they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, ease and tranquility. Additionally, the site is cradled by precincts of style, sophistication and urban polish. Anticipating that residents will quickly become accustomed to the many local conveniences on offer led to the creation of 'Escarp,' a precinct of outspoken beauty presented as the ultimate address where all conveniences are at your command. Escarp is a place made for the indulgence of grand living, for residents to experience the art of exceptional living. To underpin these ideals, for the branding assets of Escarp we settled on a deep blue with copper highlights to build a sense of simple sophistication and high-quality elegance.

Lifestyle.name: Hutch & Hutch
Lifestyle.description: Hutch & Hutch. BridgeLane. Place Visioning. A Place of Beauty. Boutique developer BridgeLane embarked upon a significant and enviable design challenge; converting a warehouse into a home. Their efforts and expertise are revealed in their site Hutch & Hutch, in Sydney's Surry Hills. BridgeLane extended and redesigned the historic warehouse to offer a modernised collection of unique apartments of up to 3-bedrooms. They created a unique building, combining original warehouse features with contemporary design, breathing new life into a luxury residence. Challenge: TOAST was challenged with defining the vision and essence of BridgeLane's new project. Enviably positioned in Surry Hills, Hutch & Hutch's brand image needed to compliment the trendy, vibrant appeal of this city-fringe neighbourhood. Solution: Combined with the location's unique history - the site of Australia's first vinyl record plant - for this project, TOAST took inspiration between the parallels of nostalgia and new. Drawing on the creative flair of the location, and the surrounding streets of Hutchinson Street and Hutchinson Lane, TOAST started with the name, and took it from there, developing a branding platform that took the boutique development to a new level of distinction. Our company was awarded REA brand campaign of the year for its collaboration with BridgeLane and award-winning architects SJB and CBRE.

Lifestyle.name: Laguna & Glade
Lifestyle.description: Laguna & Glade. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage Two. Life Ever Changing. The Sanctuary masterplan in Wentworth Point offers an ever-changing life experience through people, culture and the environments within. Following the completion and success of ‘Landing,’ Stage 1 of Sanctuary, the masterplan is moving forward to its second stage. Positioned to be overlooking the Parramatta River and bordering the neighbourhood green, Stage 2 lies at the very centre of Sanctuary's vibrant community estate and encompasses three new elements, the Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club. Consisting of 171 premium waterside apartments centred around lush open spaces and a multilevel wellbeing facilities building - Revive, the Laguna and Glade residences achieve perfect synergy with nature. This stage is beautifully designed to allow an inside-out communication between landscape and architecture. Embracing the calm, curious flow of the Parramatta River and the best of international living standards, these developments have been designed to allow seamless communication between the surrounding natural landscape and modern architecture. Challenge: As Laguna, Glade and Revive are staged additions in a large-scale masterplan, as opposed to standalone developments, it was imperative that the Sanctuary property branding and strategic vision remained as the common thread that ties all elements together. As, to remain an authentic and highly-regarded brand, it is key to present a united image with a consistent and clear message. Harmony, vibrancy, a sense of calm and liveability are fundamental attributes defining a sanctuary and are wonderfully evident in this Stage 2 development. The Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club bring newfound energy and life to the Sanctuary precinct. Aligned and connected with the overall branding and message of Sanctuary’s masterplan, Laguna and Glade have an infectious spirit. In the heart of the precinct, bookended by both the river and neighbourhood green, these spaces weave beautifully into their natural surrounds and offer occupants a space that is liveable and abundant in lively characteristics. As elements within the Sanctuary masterplan brand, Laguna, Glade and Revive are similarly identifiable by the unique kaleidoscopic logotype. In creating this gracefully fragmented circular imagery, TOAST was inspired by the fundamental principles within Japanese design, such as simplicity, understated beauty and tranquillity. It’s an intricate but elegant wreath, a symbol which ties all elements of Sanctuary together. Solution: Laguna and Glade are highly anticipated boutique developments on the water’s edge offering a serene living experience in the heart of Sanctuary. Across both buildings, nature acts as a bridge between the apartments and the wider landscape, creating an unrivalled living experience where nature and urban living seamlessly integrate. The harmony and communication between our inside and outside worlds is a fundamental element within Sanctuary’s brand footprint, making this masterplan evermore unique. The fluidity of Laguna’s logo variant captures the sense of calm and serenity that the building exudes. The malleable, rejuvenating qualities of water are captured in the building's architecture and are further conveyed in this logo's expression. As for Glade, this logo variant is heavily flora-inspired and integrates natural influences throughout its design. The striking green textural pattern conveys this sense of vitality, promising a life that is energetic and connected to nature. Further, Revive's logo takes the aqueous territory introduced with Laguna and pushes it further. Centred around the uniquely styled, revitalising pool that is a core foundation of the building's offerings, this logo treatment fully reflects the tranquil, restorative qualities of the health club it represents. The Stage 2 triad is an extension of the refuge that is Sanctuary and delivers a beautifully unique experience for residents and the wider community. A space that is in harmony with nature, abundant in vibrant interactions, epitomises comfortable living and offers a fulfilled life experience.

Lifestyle.name: Allcastle Homes
Lifestyle.description: Allcastle Homes. Brand Transformation. Make It Home. Allcastle Homes is a residential home builder specialising in high-value, high-quality family homes. The project builder aims to deliver a level of service and product that exceeds industry expectations at every step of the process. However, the organisation’s previous brand identity did not reflect its aspirational vision or holistic value proposition. Challenge: TOAST’s challenge was to create an uplifting brand that would help Allcastle Homes emerge as a clear builder of choice in the minds of its target audiences. The overall objective was to demonstrate the unique proposition and commitment of the business in treating their customers as if they were members of their extended family, providing the opportunity to design their dream home with confidence. This would involve creating a new brand identity from the ground up, from logo and brand messaging to website and marketing collateral. Solution: Immersion into Allcastle Homes’ organisation, including interviews with senior management and sales consultants, revealed that the builder is committed to delivering a high-quality customer experience from start to finish. These insights fuelled the Big Idea ‘Experience is Everything’. This strategic positioning statement reflects both the significant industry experience that the builder has accrued over almost 30 years of operation and the supportive customer experience that the organisation delivers. As a result, the tagline ”Make it Home” was born, aiming to articulate the idea that the customer can transform their home from a dream to reality within a very supportive familial environment (where they feel at home). To ensure that the brand remained instantly recognisable, the company’s signature blue was retained but has been adjusted to a warmer, royal tone. The new gold highlights emphasise Allcastle Homes’ long-standing reputation for quality and prestige. Allcastle Homes’ uplifted identity conveys the builder’s characteristics of experience, legacy and quality, while remaining modern and contemporary, and will help the organisation continue to build the dreams of Australian families, generating both customer acquisition and loyalty for years to come.

Lifestyle.name: Trinity Point
Lifestyle.description: Trinity Point. Brand Elevation. Above & Beyond. Nestled on the shores of Lake Macquarie, Trinity Point is a Master Plan community offering world-class residential, resort and marina facilities in an immersive 5-star living experience. With the new iconic and transformational design from leading Australian firm Koichi Takada Architects, the Trinity Point precinct is planned to be home to a luxury 220-room hotel, restaurants, function centre, pool and 218 waterfront apartments, along with the already established Trinity Point Marina. The transformational project will inject more than $720million into the local economy and create hundreds of new direct and indirect jobs through construction and, when operational, to service the hotel and restaurant in the longer term. Challenge: Over the project’s 20-year lifespan, Trinity Point’s visual look and feel had undertaken numerous changes to reflect its ever-evolving transformational design without providing true justice to the new luxury regional destination. The brand needed to be uplifted drastically to mirror the prestige of this iconic, environmentally-leading tourism destination for regional New South Wales; one that will showcase the area's greatest quality –Lake Macquarie. A strong elevation of a strategic brand footprint was required to launch the development’s apartment, marina and resort offerings which will set an architectural benchmark for the region. TOAST’s challenge was to find a way to elevate Trinity Point’s Masterbrand identity whilst seamlessly developing and integrating each sub-brand. Solution: TOAST developed a new overarching positioning statement ‘Above and Beyond’ connecting Trinity Point’s commitment to delivering a lakeside lifestyle beyond any other: an architectural and sustainability benchmark for the region. This positioning is being rolled out as a new visual language across the Trinity Point ecosystem including immersive display, online and offline collateral. Allowing Trinity Point to clearly communicate the value of place to drive connection to community and residents.

Lifestyle.name: The Revy
Lifestyle.description: The Revy. Aqualand. Place Visioning. The Doorway to Sydney’s Harbour. Aqualand distinguishes itself as a developer, As both Strategic Urban Regenerators benefiting areas with close proximity to key public transport, retail hubs and education facilities, and as Creators of Prime Foreshore Residences, boasting views across the iconic Sydney Harbour; Aqualand distinguish themselves as unique, multitalented developers in the property industry. One of their prestigious sites is “The REVY”, home to 44 unique heritage-listed residential apartments tucked away on tranquil Darling Island. With its exceptional waterfront location, heritage building and proximity to the CBD, The REVY is set to become Sydney’s most prestigious address. Challenge: In order to sell the apartments, Aqualand worked on an initial campaign. However, in regards to the overall Covid-19 challenges and market uncertainty, the campaign lost traction while there were still 11 residences available for sale. TOAST was asked to develop a lead generation campaign to support the sales success of the remaining residences. The building has lived many lives, being re-invented over and over to cater for the ebb and flow of culture and the needs of the times. Today, The REVY has once again evolved, transforming into a truly unique and luxury residence that provides those who enter its walls a Sydney experience like no other…. And the brand and campaign needed to reflect this evolution in order to be successful. Solution: To achieve this, TOAST has delved into the specifics of this property's essence to fully understand and communicate its unique value proposition: with towering heritage facades and modern luxury interiors The REVY is a site like no other. While the building has a unique history to communicate and build on a lead generation system, it appeared obvious that the new positioning of the brand and its messaging needed to capitalise on a unique proposition that combines the best of two worlds: Incomparable Contemporary Living and Timeless Heritage Exclusivity. “The doorway to Sydney’s Harbour” claimed this idea of unique access to superior Sydney Harbour living. Historical significance, monumental architecture, sophisticated luxury and scenic waterfront location all combined to make an unrepeatable proposition. The campaign was brought to life through a very engaging website that embarks visitors on a unique journey, and a suite of traditional marketing tools including online and off-line marketing collateral which enabled a successful lead generation funnel for the appointed agents, CBRE.

Lifestyle.name: Amaroo
Lifestyle.description: Amaroo. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. Nestled Above Castle Cove. LAPropertyCo. is a visionary property group driven to be market leaders, built on generations of experience. The group has an established track record for investing in and developing Real Estate within premium Sydney markets, remaining focused on creating innovative designs and planning solutions. LAPropertyCo. acquired a prime site overlooking the bay, right next to the golf course in Castle Cove and created an exceptional development of 11 luxurious residences with a deep connection to its surroundings. Challenge: This luxurious project presents the future occupants with the opportunity to experience life in the idyllic North Shore suburb of Sydney, best known for its elevated and leisurely lifestyle suited for an older, affluent population. Even though these attributes present immense advantages to the project and the freedom to create an aesthetic brand, it still presents a challenge of maintaining a fine balance of luxury and connectedness in the brand identity. After TOAST’s successful collaboration with LAPropertyCo. on "The Postern", we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client’s expectations. Solution: TOAST delved into the history of the place, the surroundings, the vision for the project and the placemaking approach. We were inspired by how the land naturally contoured, the topography, the rich textures of the materials and utilised the beautiful, naturally occurring designs to create visual elements that would support the brand. We put the end-consumers at front and centre, taking the time to understand their motivations in life. We realised that at this stage in their lives, they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, peace and tranquility, and a connection to nature. TOAST married the sensibilities of the target market with the modernity of the development and its connection to its natural setting to create an elegant and timeless brand identity.

Lifestyle.name: Sanctuary
Lifestyle.description: Sanctuary. Sekisui House. Masterplan / Stage one. One With Nature. ‘Satoyama – Harmony between the built environment and nature.’ Since its inception, Sanctuary has shifted from being a desirable project to a very tangible precinct that will positively impact the residents and neighbourhood life at Wentworth Point. This masterplan development would be a feat of effort to transform the run-down factory land into a tranquil setting worthy of the water’s edge. The first building “Landing” (stage 1) has started to shape the new landscape of the masterplan, giving the projection of the future experience of living at Sanctuary. Challenge: TOAST was selected to position the project, name it and define a unique and strong identity for this new place achieving longevity for the 10-year development plan and its 7 stages of construction, while helping to connect the vision of the place to the community and its future residents. We also had to ensure the brand footprint of this new development was perfectly aligned with Sekisui House’s overarching brand value of ‘Satoyama – harmony between the built environment and nature’. With the launch of “Landing”, the goal was to hook Sanctuary’s brand as a centre of life for people in perfect connection with its surroundings. Solution: The agency developed the Masterplan to be named “Sanctuary’’ with the Place Essence identified as 'To be both inspired by and “one with nature”'. This strategic platform has influenced Sanctuary’s architecture, placemaking and design initiatives, demonstrating how a brand-first approach creates compelling destinations and place identities. TOAST’s long-term project involvement has encompassed strategy and naming through holistic branding, marketing and community consultation services; illustrating how Sanctuary is becoming a place that reconciles humanity and nature with architecture inspired by Wentworth Point’s environment.

Lifestyle.name: Luxcon
Lifestyle.description: Brand Transformation. Of the World. Luxcon is a luxury property developer with a reputation for delivering sophisticated residential projects. They're pioneers in elevating lifestyles through their redefined standards of quality, comfort, taste and amenity, meeting the needs of discerning clients with exacting expectations. Their projects are destinations that people go out of their way to see and feel - their level of innovation, iconic style and visionary design live long in the minds of all who experience them. However, Luxcon's original brand didn't reflect the crafted, refined nature of the developer itself. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to create a brand identity that conveys Luxcon's worldly, visionary perspective, demonstrating the developer's commitment to bringing international style to Australian shores. TOAST's immersion into the business uncovered the developer's deep commitment to crafting projects that are inspired by diverse, sophisticated cultural influences. The agency had to bring to life Luxcon's vision into a brand footprint which defined luxury as an expectation; a mindset uniting those whose worldview leads them to expect excellence of the world within the homes, destinations and spaces they inhabit. Solution: These insights brought about the brand's Big Idea: "Of the World". Our strategic and creative solution established a rich creative territory that celebrates Luxcon's uniquely global perspective. As a vehicle to showcase international influences, world-class standards and bold, category shifting ideas, "Of The World" possesses an inspired, curatorial quality. This will allow Luxcon to strategically establish itself as a brand possessing the worldliness of a nomadic collector; sourcing ideas, crafts and influences from luxurious international destinations to artfully inspire a series of iconic, world-class destinations. This positioning was brought to life by a logo and visual look & feel featuring design elements that are timeless symbols of style and class, positioning the developer well beyond its category and the industry brand practices. To complete the overall brand uplift, TOAST then crafted an online brand experience that embarked target audiences on a journey into Luxcon's world. The developer's website is a strong statement that is focused on its specific target audiences and is geared toward acquiring not just customers, but loyal advocates. DesignRush, known for its recognition of best logo designs has chosen our design to be featured among The Best Logo Designs Done by Australian Agencies. We are thrilled to be recognised on this level.

Lifestyle.name: The Postern
Lifestyle.description: LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. Crafted In Nature. Located 8 kms north of Sydney's central business district on Middle Harbour on the leafy premium escarpment of Castlecrag, The Postern is a truly unique mixed living development containing 7 luxury apartments and 3 commercial offices. Inspired by the original vision of Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin who developed Castlecrag as a planned development in 1921, The Postern has been created to melt into the natural contours of the land, with flat roofs that preserve the skyline and extensive native landscaping which restore the traditional beauty of the natural environment. Challenge: Castlecrag is a suburb of historical significance. It was designed and created as an experiment in community planning and living, accommodating for "the liberal intellectual, theosophical, anthroposophical and natural history views of its inhabitants". Early homes in Castlecrag were built using natural stone to blend into the environment with the focus on creating "the human touch" as distinct from mass production. As the community is very attached to the local culture and lifestyle, and apartment blocks were not part of the planning until now; there were understandably a few detractors, supported by the community, who were against or reticent towards the project. The brand had to articulate the legitimacy of the architecture of the future Postern, as a natural evolution of the suburb while preserving its unique visual aspect and identity. Solution: TOAST delved into the history, natural environment and community of Castlecrag to understand the core of the community's values. Through this exploration, the strategic platform 'Crafted In Nature' was developed. The purpose of this strategic platform was to capture the spirit of Castlecrag and pay homage to Walter and Marion Griffin's original vision for balanced living immersed with nature. The brand narrative needed to build engagement with the community and excite the potential buyers with content sourced from 3 key strategic pillars; 1. Legacy: A shared vision to connect homes to the natural environment 2. Tranquility: A natural paradise hidden a stone's throw from the bustle of the city 3. Synergy: A community of like-minded people living in balance with the natural space. The Postern was born as a celebration of the existing land, and a building that perfectly marries native beauty with refined luxury. Shaped by the land, this exclusive building is a private entrance to a unique paradise offering the best features of Castlecrag: A perfect fusion with the existing topography; An immersion with nature; Water and bushland views; Refined luxury. The marketing campaign was a success as all apartments were sold within 2 months time while the community welcomed the project as part of Castlecrag.

Lifestyle.name: Coast
Lifestyle.description: Sammut Group. Place Visioning. Sculpted by Water. Coast is a pure expression of modern luxury developed by Sammut Group. This 6-star 43 storey residential building rests on the absolute beachfront of the Gold Coast. Built with precision and functionality to capture the sculpted beauty of nature and the bliss of functional, modern living, Coast is the purest expression of natural, integrated luxury that the Gold Coast has ever seen. Challenge: This property development is the first of its kind and presented the branding and marketing solution with a few challenges to overcome. First of all, it is an offer of absolute luxury for the Gold Coast; a market offering no competition at this level. Furthermore, as much as Sammut Group was highly recognised and well-known for their first class work in the Sydney market, the developer needed to gain awareness, consideration and preference from potential buyers in order to feel comfortable to purchase a property residence from them. The strategic platform and the brand needed to carry the quality and uniqueness of the offering, while demonstrating all the business proof-points which would provide the confidence to buy an apartment from Sammut Group. Solution: TOAST began by digging into the changing dynamics of the beautiful beachside community, understanding the vision of the renowned architects PBD and taking into account the changing structure of the Australian population, their life choices and values resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic. The name Coast was chosen for two reasons: to celebrate the uniqueness of the proposition on the market and, at the same time, showcase the legacy and growth of the developer since their first development, also known as Coast (in Cronulla). This research led to a series of strategic recommendations about the positioning of this truly unique residence and the development of the brand platform 'Sculpted by nature'. Our brand narrative was inspired by the shaping and reshaping of the foreshore by the pure waters of the north coast, the ever-changing shape of the ocean coastline. Coast's design rests as a pure gem, inspired to reflect the layered, refined beauty of the natural environment drawing in the light and revealing to their customers a new perspective on life each and every day. During the month of June, within the first 3 weeks of listing, TOAST ran a campaign that secured sales of over 43 of the 49 total apartments, with sales ranging between $3.5 million and $9 million, at an average of $4.5 million, resulting in record-breaking results for the Gold Coast.

Lifestyle.name: ONE O ONE
Lifestyle.description: Brand Activation. The Voyage of Perfection. ONE O ONE has been designed as a one-of-a-kind superyacht, with handcrafted interiors and bespoke exteriors, forging function and luxury. This spacious and luxurious pleasure vessel is available to charter with staff ready to cater to guests who arrive expecting a high standard of comfort. Perfectly designed to emphasise comfort, speed, and expedition capability, this superyacht is the latest vessel on Sydney Harbour, the ultimate in luxury harbour cruises. Embarking on a cruise with ONE O ONE is more than just an experience - it is a journey, a voyage through a world of true luxury. Challenge: TOAST was approached to develop a brand and website for this luxurious ocean craft experience. One of the main challenges of entering a mature market inhabited by multiple industry players, is to position oneself as a "very distinctive business", with a strong proposition delivering beyond what already exists. Through the brand story, ONE O ONE needed to develop a credible reputation as a one-of-a-kind superyacht provider with a "Unique Selling Proposition" that communicated: Their point of difference: Why choose us? Their commitment to delivering with excellence. By establishing a new positioning in the industry, ONE O ONE needed to demonstrate what they stand for, backed with genuine content and indestructible business proof points. To develop a brand for a product of this magnitude was to delve into understanding the core of what luxury itself was about, and the ways that it has changed over time. Solution: Through our research we uncovered a central insight that luxury was not simply about an object or brand; luxury is a mindset, a way of living and approaching life itself. That luxury as an ideal is different for every individual and thus in creating luxury experiences we must offer flexibility. Developing a framework of modern luxury, we were able to impart recommendations from experiential design to marketplace positioning, which ultimately led to our big idea. The creative platform was nurtured with the understanding that lifestyle is so fast-paced that a feeling of total disconnect in time and space is what luxury means to our audiences... To be able to step back and breathe in the surroundings is to experience true luxury. The brand needed to carry the proposition that ONE O ONE provides a bespoke luxury experience, through an unparalleled journey which speaks to all senses, day and night...an absolute and immersive luxury experience: Absolute perfection. Supporting this unique proposition TOAST created a dynamic website that shifts display, colour and lighting depending on the time of day you visit the site to showcase the varied experiences available on the ONE O ONE superyacht.

Lifestyle.name: The Orchards
Lifestyle.description: Sekisui House. Place Visioning. A Place to Grow. Located to the North West of Sydney's CBD in the Hills Shire (NSW), The Orchards is one of the most significant residential master-planned communities to be introduced to Australia in over a decade. Comprising approximately 1300 residencies and mixed-use amenities designed by award-winning architects Turner Studios, The Orchards is bringing a new precinct to Sydney, nestled in preserved forestry and beautifully landscaped gardens - reclaiming the home of Australia's traditional orchard industry. Challenge: Significant development was taking place in the area, which had grown rapidly over the last decade with the introduction of low density detached and semi-detached family homes. Apartment developments were then being encouraged due to the increase in demand and Sekisui House acquired 80,000m2 to develop a mix of accommodation with buildings ranging from 6 storeys to 12 storeys. This is an 8-year project developed in several stages so "longevity" was key to the branding. As a result, the brand had to be visionary while perfectly in line with Sekisui House's belief in Satoyama philosophy and other Japanese design principles. There was already conflict with adjacent developers owning the surrounding area so signing was a predicted challenge and wayfinding to the site problematic. Treatment of the brand was also noted as key, it needed to stand out if used on signage some distance from the development site. We also needed to create awareness and interest on the apartment offering by providing evidence of the benefits to buying within a master plan while avoiding all the challenges and potential issues from owning a home on your own. To achieve these outcomes, the brand needed a strong educational component and a very aspirational proposition to engage, elicit interest and generate consideration to purchase off-plan. Solution: The creative platform was based on the principle of building the brand narrative from the legacy of the land. Through the research process, TOAST discovered that the property would be built on one of the first orchards in Australia. We thought it was a beautiful idea to bring back the orchard trees to the community and create a unique brand experience around the overall replanting of the orchards in the area; the tree became the hero of the brand and everything would be framed around this creative idea. The entire brand remit was based on the creative platform including the delivery of an amazing sales space that draws the visitor in using highly visible cues marrying technology and nature. The visitor's journey has been carefully designed so information is 'collected' as an interested buyer navigates the space, assisting the sales team to access relevant and useful information for prospective buyers and sales follow-ups. This culminates in the Immersion Room (first of its kind in Australia) where a 7-minute brand video takes visitors on an emotional journey of a 'day in the life' intending to truly bring the experience of The Orchards' brand alive. For our work on The Orchards' branding experience and marketing platform, the TOAST team was presented with 3 awards at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards in the following categories: Gold - Digital - Expanded Service or Application; Silver - Graphic Design - Illustration and Type; Silver - Marketing - Film, Video, Viral.

Logistics.name: Logiko
Logistics.description: Logiko. ZYL Express becomes Logiko. It's All Good. ZYL Express came to us with some big ambitions. Ambitions as big as Australia, you might say: to get businesses and consumers up and down the country using their logistics services. But how could they scale up down under? Especially when there are so many Australian companies dominating this space already? Sectors: Technology, Logistics. Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Big Idea, UX/UI, Web Design, Branded Content, Social Media Kit, Capability Statement. Challenge: ZYL Express were entering a market that's, at best, sceptical towards logistics businesses. And our social media listening and market analysis revealed why: Many companies promise to make deliveries easy. But more often than not, they're a source of stress: damages, delays, lost shipments, lack of support, hidden fees, "attempted deliveries"... the list of disappointments and thwarted expectations goes on and on. This ultimately has weakened trust in the logistics category as a whole, and any new entrant, like ZYL Express, would need to work hard to reassure customers that their goods would be in safe hands. Solution: ZYL Express was primed to succeed in this context, precisely because they don't operate like a typical logistics company. Following a deep company audit, we discovered that they do everything in their power to make things stress-free, and understand that people would rather be doing a million other things than worrying about where their parcel has got to. They use advanced technology to streamline deliveries and inventory management, offer a flexible service that covers everything from unpacking goods to transporting huge items, and their staff always go the extra mile, handling deliveries safely, efficiently and reliably. So we built their brand around the idea of a stress-free logistics experience for businesses and customers alike. We captured this idea with a very Australian tagline, "It's all good", showing people that wherever you are and whatever you're shipping, ZYL Express will handle it. No fuss, no friction, no worries. And to reflect the seamless service they provide, we made sure the whole brand was beautifully well-coordinated under this one organising idea: A more Logikal name - We renamed the company "Logiko", a simple but powerful reflection of how they do logistics more logically. A more Logikal design system - Levitating parcels, spacious layouts and tech-infused iconography all come together to make Logiko look cutting-edge and switched on. A more Logikal website - We segmented their site into three customer journeys to cater to Logiko's range of customers: senders, receivers and businesses needing full-service logistics. Then precision-engineered the messaging and user flows to appeal to each group's needs.

Logistics.name: Space Logic
Logistics.description: Space Logic. Brand Strategy. Medical Solutions. Space Logic is a family business that specialises in space and logistical storage management. The company has been successfully operating for more than 30 years and have been visible in 3 different categories for space and storage solutions: commercial, industrial and medical. They have an enviable reputation for providing end-to-end services to their clients, supplying project design, planning and installation services across their own innovative and customisable range of products. Their strength as a company has increasingly been evidenced through their work in the medical field. Thus through reflecting on their successes, it was decided to reposition their focus for their primary offering to be creating storage solutions for the healthcare and medical industry. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to rebrand the company with its new industry focus, re-creating a refreshed identity for Space Logic that communicates the company's expertise in space management in the medical category. Accompanying this brand redirection, the business sought to develop a monthly subscription package to maintain an informed relationship with their clients. Within this, Space Logic will be activating their resources on the ground, becoming more visible and recognisable for their swift follow-up actions and response manner akin to that of NRMA. Further, they also expressed their desire to expand and deliver their business services beyond Australia, creating further impetus to appropriately redesign their brand footprint. Solution: In reaching their business solution, TOAST first needed to understand their key target audiences across the medical sphere, and what their needs and challenges are at present. A safe and secure storage environment was primarily identified as a need across CSS Departments (Central Sterile Services), Pharmacies and Operation Theatres. To separate Space Logic from its competitors in the market, TOAST positioned their business as one that "enhances the healthcare experience with advanced medical storage solutions". The contemporary shape of their final logotype is symbolic of the bespoke manufacturing solutions offered by Space Logic, separating them from market competitors. Further, the brain iconography of their logotype accompanies this message, demonstrating their company mission of providing a clever and optimised use of space. The curved, organic shapes present an approachable and human-focused company, positively setting them apart in their global expansion ambitions.

Logistics.name: A2B
Logistics.description: Cabcharge. Brand Visualisation. Creating Confidence in People's Plans. Operating since 1976, Cabcharge has long been a dominant player in Australia's personal transport market. However, over the years, the iconic company has become so much more than simply an account payment system provider, developing a range of class-leading innovations in the broader fields of payment solutions and communication platforms. Challenge: Cabcharge has grown to become the market leader in the personal transport sector, however the brand was not reflecting this new business reality and unfortunately, was also generating confusion between the digital account payment system and the holistic personal transport proposition. With technological disruption pushing into the marketplace, it was time for Cabcharge to strengthen and clearly communicate its core value propositions. Part of the challenge was to be able to preserve the existing brand equity while opening up new opportunities for brand growth at the group and business line levels, demonstrating progress to their markets and creating confidence for their customers, partners and shareholders. Solution: Within the very first few weeks of the project, TOAST was integrally involved in proposing to Cabcharge's CEO the drastic recommendation of renaming the master-brand in order to better reflect the vast changes that have occurred within both Cabcharge and indeed the wider world itself. Such an impactful adjustment required the buy-in of stakeholders from the ground up, and TOAST played a substantial role in the development and presentation of the case for change. The result? Widespread approval of the proposal and the consequential transformation of 'Cabcharge' into the new master entity 'A2B'. The overall brand proposition to become the preferred personal transport provider for a lot of Australians was based on the strategic idea that "A2B believes in shaping inspiring realities for tomorrow, in growing their business and in making the world a better place". The holistic brand transformation is represented well by our reimagined A2B logo - the typeface pays homage to Cabcharge's origins, whilst symbolising A2B's overarching goal to help its customers get wherever they need to go. TOAST launched the new brand on the ASX500 with great success, which is a testament to TOAST playing a crucial role in A2B's evolution as a business.

Luxury.name: Willow
Luxury.description: Willow. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage Three. Immerse Yourself in Nature. Nestled on the water's edge in Wentworth Point, Sekisui House's masterplan community 'Sanctuary' presents a dynamic lifestyle that intertwines people, culture, and the natural environment. Building on the great success of Stage 2 of Sanctuary comprising Laguna, Glade & Revive, the project has advanced gracefully into its third stage, 'Willow'. Overlooking the Parramatta River and bordering the masterplan's neighbourhood green, Stage 3 is beautifully located within national parkland, offering breathtaking river and city views. Willow, sequestered in this serene site, features a holistic design that includes a private lagoon pool and meticulously curated podium gardens, providing an exclusive oasis for Stage 3 residents. Willow comprises 323 premium waterside apartments centred around lush open spaces, achieving perfect harmony with nature. These residences are elegantly designed to facilitate an inside-out connection between landscape and architecture, embracing the tranquil, curious flow of the Parramatta River and the highest international living standards. This development seamlessly integrates the surrounding natural landscape with modern architecture, offering a unique and harmonious living experience. Sectors: Property, Luxury, Lifestyle. Services: Place Visioning, Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Brand Territory, Brand Visualisation, Editorial Design, Marketing, Motion Graphics, Naming, UX/UI, Web Design, Video Production. Challenge: Having worked with Sekisui House from the inception of Sanctuary's Place Vision, our TOASTies were excited to embark on Stage 3's campaign; as a staged addition in a large-scale masterplan, it was imperative that the Sanctuary property branding and strategic vision remained as the common thread that ties all elements together. Harmony, vibrancy, a sense of calm, and livability are fundamental attributes defining a sanctuary and are wonderfully evident across the Stage 3 development. The Willow residences bring newfound energy and life to the Sanctuary precinct. Aligned and connected with the overall branding and message of Sanctuary's masterplan, these buildings have an infectious spirit. Stage 3, nestled in a lush parkland setting, acts as a natural refuge with its unobstructed views and unrivalled access to nature. As an element within the Sanctuary masterplan brand, Willow is identifiable by the unique kaleidoscopic logotype. In creating this gracefully fragmented circular imagery, TOAST was inspired by the fundamental principles within Japanese design, such as simplicity, understated beauty, and tranquillity. It's an intricate but elegant wreath, a symbol that ties all elements of Sanctuary together. Solution: Set back from the water and surrounded by wild parklands, Willow leverages the verdant energy of parkside life. For Stage 3 in Sanctuary's development, TOAST created the tagline 'Immerse Yourself in Nature,' showcasing Willow as the incomparable green heart of Sanctuary and harnessing Sekisui House's principle of 'Satoyama,' to create harmony between humans and nature. Across Willow, nature acts as a bridge between the apartments and the wider landscape, creating an unrivalled living experience where nature and urban living seamlessly integrate. The harmony and communication between our inside and outside worlds are fundamental elements within Sanctuary's brand footprint, making this masterplan evermore unique. Willow's logo was thus inspired by its 47+ hectares of verdant surrounding parklands. Bejewelled by vibrant greens to suggest a life surrounded by the lush, expansive landscape to explore, Willow's logotype and stage identity lives in proud connection to the land. Stage 3, as the absolute green heart of Sanctuary, delivers a beautifully unique experience for residents and the wider community. Spaces that are in harmony with nature and abundant in vibrant interactions epitomise comfortable living and offer a fulfilled life experience.

Luxury.name: Rethink Group
Luxury.description: Rethink Group. Brand Transformation. Wealth of Ideas. At TOAST, we recently had the privilege of working with premium property investment firm, Rethink Investing. Founded by Scott O'Neill in 2009 and based in Bondi Junction, they have created a leading name for themselves in the property investing realm. The company distinguished itself in the early days by focusing on cash-flow-positive commercial properties in high-growth areas, diverging from the conventional focus on residential investments. This success laid the groundwork for the new, consolidated corporate brand 'Rethink Group,' which now includes multiple verticals such as Rethink Financing, Rethink Residential Investing & Rethink Property Lawyers. It was the creation of this group branding approach that TOAST was engaged to establish and lay the foundation for. Sectors: Corporate, Luxury, Property, Finance. Services: Brand Architecture, Brand Strategy, Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Motion Graphics, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: Rethink Investing approached our team at the end of 2023 with a significant challenge: to create an overarching Group brand that would unify their diverse vertical businesses while maintaining their unique identities. They needed a cohesive brand architecture that reflected their rapid growth and industry success, ensuring a consistent and professional image that would resonate with their high-end clients. Solution: Our team of Toasties embarked on a comprehensive strategic roadmap for Rethink Group, initiating the process with extensive research, analysis and numerous stakeholder interviews. This approach allowed us to deeply understand the unique qualities and market positions of each vertical business within the Group. Collaborating closely with Rethink Group's leadership and marketing teams, we developed a brand strategy that highlighted their core values, strengths, and collective vision for the future. A central element of the new brand identity for Rethink Group was the tagline, "Wealth of Ideas," an evolution of their core DNA, "Wealth Creators Through Property," devised in our stakeholder strategy session. This tagline encapsulates Rethink Group's dedication to empowering financial journeys through unique and forward-thinking property investment services. It also offers extensive flexibility, allowing for variations such as "Wealth of Opportunities," "Wealth of Experience," and "Wealth of Knowledge," tailored to different audiences and contexts. Building on this brand narrative of "Wealth of Ideas" we created a 'house of brands' company architecture, enabling each vertical to retain its distinct identity while aligning under the unified Rethink Group umbrella. Our design team crafted a versatile and cohesive visual identity system, including logos, colour schemes, and typography that differentiated each business while maintaining visual coherence. We delivered a comprehensive brand guidelines document with specifications for each vertical, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints. These final designs and colour palettes played a crucial role in conveying each brand's values and the new image of Rethink Group. The primary Rethink Group logotype is an elegant evolution of their original keyhole icon. Our team enhanced its design, reflecting the known 'R' of Rethink in a bespoke style that embodies the dedication and unwavering ingenuity underpinning the brand. This design echoes the values of authenticity, empowerment, excellence, and disruption, setting Rethink apart as a true industry leader. The conceptual framework behind the Rethink Group logotype captures the brand's core values, creating an ownable icon that champions their legacy while elevating it to the highly respectable status it has achieved to date. The Rethink Group corporate colour palette features luxurious tones of navy and champagne, with varying hues indicating the quality, expertise and dedication that underpin the brand. These colours were carefully chosen to reflect the sophistication and premium nature of the Group's offerings. Staying within the elegant, luxurious territory of the Group brand, the palette is slightly tweaked throughout the verticals to create individual identities for each brand while simultaneously setting them apart and uniting them with the overall company. Result: The result of our collaboration was a refined, professional brand identity for Rethink Group that effectively represents their expansive portfolio and industry leadership. This new brand architecture not only unified their vertical businesses but also positioned them for continued growth and success in the competitive property investment landscape.

Luxury.name: Bowerbird
Luxury.description: Bowerbird — Brand Transformation. The Art of Connecting. Crafting the Perfect First Impression. When it comes to property, you only get one chance to make the right first impression. And in the Australian market, where standards are high and competition is intense, every detail matters. From commercial to residential, Bowerbird is an interior design and property styling team that excels at connecting people and place. They've grown quickly by creating success where it matters: curating environments that set the stage for great experiences, and ultimately, great results. As futuremakers, we were asked to support Bowerbird in shaping the brand's next chapter, presenting their offering to the market in a way that hits exactly the right note. Challenge: Right from the outset, it was clear they were all about artistry. Through their unique mix of creativity, passion, expertise and dedication, they can see the full potential of a space, and bring that out through their designs. But they're not just about stunning spaces. They think hard about the functionality of the location, so that it can meet the needs of whoever's living, socialising or working in it, be they a tenant, colleague or customer. In this way, they blend form and function across everything they make. The challenge, then, was to build a brand positioning and identity that married the aesthetic with the strategic; the creative flair with outcomes that create value for their clients, owners and residents. And in a category defined by minimalist branding with little cut-through, the design needed to have more personality, while maintaining the sophistication needed to appeal to clients across a broad range of categories. If that balance was off even a little, potential clients would switch off and move on. Solution: We built a brand that focused on creating a connection between people and place. On a creative level, they connect people to beautiful spaces and design features, so that they can admire them, appreciate them and enjoy them. And on a strategic level, those spaces connect people to each other, so they can live or work to their full potential. In this way, their brand footprint is centered "value creation" in the fullest sense of the word, turning their labour and resources into something that meets the needs of others both aesthetically and functionally. This creative idea translated to a brand identity; a visual territory which celebrates curation and collection, supported by the tagline 'The Art of Connecting'. At its heart was the 'BB' monogram, a seal of quality, taste and also character, without limiting the brand to a particular style or territory. A flexible colour system (revolving around a signature dusty blue) was introduced, allowing the brand to sub-brand their whole suite of services – from private residential and commercial residential to special projects. The Result: With a brand identity that emphasises the connection of ideas, people and places without boundaries, anything is now possible for Bowerbird. By elevating their brand so it's both creatively appealing and commercially compelling, Bowerbird has the identity it needs to secure new clients, expand their business and, ultimately, meet the high expectations of the Australian property market during that crucial first call, pitch or meeting. Because branding isn't just about building the right identity. It's about striking the right impression, too.

Luxury.name: Calico Marina
Luxury.description: Calico Marina — Place Visioning. The Place to Be. Located in the pristine waters of Port Hacking River, Calico Marina is a destination of seaside bliss boasting stunning beaches, tidal rock pools and incredible sunset viewpoints. A renewal of this underused side of Cronulla - Calico is a perfectly positioned destination for a sunny day, afternoon and evening by the water. A serene beachside location and community hub bustling with the daily marina activity, the creative vision behind this marina's uplift was for a place of connection, celebration and exclusivity; the place to be in Cronulla. Challenge: The rise in desirability for a coastal lifestyle positions Cronulla as a thriving cosmopolitan area and an increasingly sought-after destination to live and work. This luxe marina destination is built with precision and beautiful functionality; the curvature of the architecture mimicking the coastal grace of its natural setting. This revitalised waterfront precinct integrates luxury that redefines Cronulla. Becoming the main attraction of this previously underused bayside region, the place narrative required the area to be painted as an exclusive opportunity - a unique destination on the water. The overall brand footprint and strategic vision for this site thus needed to encapsulate its natural beauty and deluxe allure, whilst recognising its historical functionality as a marina. Solution: Building on knowledge gleaned from benchmark analyses, our team recognised that successful marinas go beyond their functional purpose. They are destinations in their own right; surrounded by buzzing restaurants, bars and clubs, they are key local access points to the region all wrapped in an air of sophistication. To create this sophisticated site, we capitalised on the marina's neighbouring unrivalled area of Gunnamatta Bay. TOAST looked into the history and usage of this site and in doing so discovered the meaning for Cronulla, or 'Kurranulla' in the local Gweagal dialect, as 'place of the pink seashells'. This became key to the place narrative and led to the name generation of 'Calico', derived from the sleek pink Calico Scallop seashell. Being unique, eye-catching and inspiring, this name mirrors the curved shell-like architectural form of the precinct design whilst beautifully linking with the area's indigenous history. Our strategic brand positioning thus connects community, a coastal lifestyle and innovative design by creating an iconic marina; a true destination reimagining hospitality and engaging the senses. Harmonising a beachside lifestyle with contemporary design, Calico Marina oozes lavish opulence with a laid-back coastal air to deliver a unique destination for all to indulge. Without losing its functional purpose, this is a luxe waterfront destination which enriches daily lives today and into the future; an indulgent place for socialising and celebrating, for love, fun and community connection. With Calico's intrinsic feel of exclusivity, it is more than a destination; a strong statement in the Cronulla landscape, Calico Marina is a game-changer destination.

Luxury.name: Calira
Luxury.description: Calira — Anchor Group. Painting Properties in a Luxurious Light. Where Life Flows Naturally. Nestled near the banks of the Paramatta River, Calira is a luxury development teeming with beautiful amenities. Featuring panoramic views of the Sydney Harbour and CBD, thoughtfully crafted and expansive interiors, a landscaped rooftop wellness zone, and natural walking paths that trace the contours of the water, it has everything you need in one idyllic haven. Anchor Group, the developer of this collection of residences, approached us to create an identity that would reflect its undeniable beauty to Sydney's discerning downsizers. Challenge: The natural stone finishes. The state-of-the-art gym. The thriving local community. The flowing balconies. There were layers upon layers of features that made Calira a premium and high-end property. But in a near-flooded market, we needed to home in on the one thing that made these residences truly distinctive, the one feature that would catch the eye of buyers who had no shortage of excellent choices all over the city. We led research, workshops and collaborative discovery calls with the architect, Lewis Lau, the developer, Charbel Obeid, and the sales agent, Clayton Ross, and conducted our own in-depth site visit to the development and the surrounding urban neighbourhood. Drawing on first-hand insight and desktop research alike, we uncovered what made Calira truly luxurious and one-of-a-kind: the shimmer of the river itself. Solution: With north-facing apartments looking out onto the Paramatta River, Calira's residents are treated to the sunlight dancing on the water every sunrise and sunset, facilitating a lifestyle that's serene, glamorous and calming. This natural glimmer shone a light on the direction for the entire campaign: we gave the development the tagline "Where Life Flows Naturally" and crafted a visual identity that channelled a sense of ease, light and fluidity at every turn, with an iconic glint symbol, undulating lines and gold-tinged fonts at its heart. Campaign materials such as the EDM, website, social cutdowns and brochure then teased the glimmer from every angle: up-close, by the riverbank, from the balcony and from far, far above, while artfully highlighting all the other amenities Calira had to offer, from the interior to the wellness facilities to the surrounding lifestyle. The perfect way to paint a luxurious collection of residences in a truly luxurious light.

Luxury.name: Rethink Website
Luxury.description: Rethink Website. Rethink Group. Website Transformation. Wealth of Ideas. Creating a Group Lead-Generating Digital Ecosystem. In today's digital landscape, a fragmented online presence can hinder a group's growth. At TOAST, we architect digital ecosystems that drive performance, combining strategic brand thinking, human-centred design, and results-driven UX/UI to unlock brands' full digital potential. Challenge: How can Rethink group achieve unity while allowing individual business units to maintain distinct digital identities? Our approach focused on establishing a consistent design language across all sites, developing flexible customised templates, refining the Group Brand Picture to meet each business line business requirements, enabling seamless cross-navigation, and designing conversion-optimised user journeys. Solution: We began with in-depth research to define a unified Brand Picture and UVP, conducting stakeholder interviews, user analytics, competitor analysis, and collaborative workshops. This strategic framework was then translated in an engaging brand visualisation that unified the group while preserving each vertical's unique identity. Next, we focused on user experience and interface design. By collaborating with each unit's leadership, we developed digital narratives aligning with the group's mission and individual objectives. Tailored content strategies, decision-making flows, and actionable CTAs were crafted for each vertical. Leveraging our research insights, we crafted a conversion-optimised and visually engaging digital experience. Our approach emphasised mobile-first design, visual consistency, user-centred functionality, performance optimisation, and seamless integrations to enhance marketing and operational efficiency. The Results: Each business unit now boasts a refined, results-driven digital identity. A transformation which was applied across multiple business units within the Rethink Group, including: Rethink Investing: Designed to engage investors and simplify property investment education; Rethink Financing: Connecting clients with tailored financial solutions and mortgage brokers; Rethink Commercial Education: Providing expert-led programs to educate and empower investors; Rethink Property Lawyers: Establishing a trustworthy online presence for property law services, making legal guidance more accessible; Rethink Residential: Elevating the property development experience with an engaging, high-performance digital platform; Rethink Property Insurance: Offering seamless access to property-related insurance policies through a user-friendly digital experience; Rethink Renewables: Showcasing sustainability-driven solutions with a forward-thinking digital strategy. Today, Rethink Group benefits from a cohesive, trust-building brand experience that enhances engagement and boosts lead generation.

Luxury.name: Vue - Brochure
Luxury.description: Vue - Brochure. Sammut Group. The Perfect Blend. Sammut Group is a full-service luxury property development company. They elevate industry standards and expectations by applying principles of superior design and construction to residential, commercial, retail and hotel precincts from coast to coast. With a primary focus on strengthening their luxury property development arm and diversifying the company into other lifestyle businesses, the group is creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality-centred projects. This business core rings true in Vue, their latest project, an oceanview luxury mixed-use precinct in the heart of Cronulla. Offering intricately designed apartments, deluxe amenities and streetfront dining and retail, Vue, designed by PBD Architects, will be pivotal in generating economic investment in the heart of Sydney's Southern beaches. Challenge: Vue is set to be a catalyst project for Cronulla. Transforming the iconic Kingsway, this development will create public engagement with the surrounding pedestrian streetscape. It will be a place that goes beyond premium homes, delivering a harmonious interplay between the built environment, individuals, and local communities. Beautifully positioned in the heart of Cronulla, Vue is a residential, retail and commercial precinct of coastal luxury. Having previously worked with Sammut Group, PBD Architects and Highland on multiple award-winning projects, our team at TOAST was brought onboard to craft the Place Vision, Place Thinking, Brand Footprint and Visual Identity of this destination. Founded on deep strategic research, immersing ourselves in the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends and competitors, our team understood that this place branding needed to be suave yet understated, showcasing its luxury lifestyle offering whilst seamlessly integrating into the locale. Solution: TOAST's passion is creating brands for places which become destinations for years to come. With a deep understanding of the marketing fundamentals of the property industry, we craft strategic brand platforms built for success. Sammut Group's Vue embodies the lure of understated luxury. Comprising designer apartments across 8-storeys, state-of-the-art facilities, and curated retail boutiques including one of Sydney's largest Harris Farm Markets, it is the intersection of splendour and contemporary convenience. A place where coastal luxury meets urban grandeur, it is a destination that is set to define Cronulla. The vision for this site was to create a lifestyle unlike anything ever seen before in Cronulla, a 'one-of-a-kind' interwoven expression of the best aspects of a coastal lifestyle harmoniously combined to create an iconic statement for the future. Building on this vision and the development's underplayed sophistication, our team crafted the Big Idea 'The Perfect Blend'; marrying luxe living with urban simplicity and seamlessly integrating resort-style amenities into contemporary dwellings, Vue is an interwoven expression of the best aspects of ocean view living, harmoniously combined with contemporary urban charm. This brand philosophy speaks true to Sammut Group's mission to deliver an elevated design vision achieving the perfect harmony between the building forms, the people, and the natural world of Cronulla. Mirroring PBD's architectural approach and Mim Design's interior visualisations, our designers worked closely with Sammut Group to craft Vue's brand identity as an amalgamation of attributes and cues inspired by its coastal location. The sense of expanse and perspective, the cultural connection and the ripple effect of the tides all combine to create landmark influences that radiate across the landscape, as reflected in Vue's name and timeless visual identity. The identity became a creative launchpad for amplification of a sophisticated suite of lead generation and sales support elements including a luxurious coffee table book, a brochure suite, digital and physical advertising campaign, website and digital-led display suite fit out, produced in close collaboration with sales agents Highland, PR team Left Field and marketers The Collective Co. A cornerstone of the creative campaign and marketing materials was sophisticated lifestyle photography and video content, directed and produced on location by TOAST. Showcasing the effortless luxury of coastal living, a two-day photoshoot captured a series of vignettes from yoga at dawn to cocktails at dusk with dozens of spontaneous moments enjoying salt, sea air and sun in between. Inspired by nature, infused with luxury, engineered for lifestyle; Vue is an elevated vision achieving the perfect blend of coastal and urban style, setting a new benchmark for coastal living.

Luxury.name: The Colliery
Luxury.description: Home of Bespoke Experiences. Working again with the dedicated team at Inovi Projects, TOAST was challenged to create a luxe and alluring brand suite for a bespoke accommodation offering in a respectfully converted mining precinct, The Colliery. Situated in the midst of Australia's coveted Hunter Region, The Colliery stands as a testament to the seamless integration of history, luxury and natural beauty. Formerly known as the 'Paxton Colliery', this remarkable location is more than just a place to stay—it's an immersive experience that pays homage to the site's rich legacy while offering unparalleled hospitality in a setting of unparalleled natural splendour. Challenge: The transformation of the Paxton Colliery into 'The Colliery' presented a unique set of challenges. Firstly, there was a need to preserve the historical significance of the site, which bore the marks of its past as a thriving coal mine. Secondly, the project had to respect the traditional custodians of the land, while also creating a luxury destination that would attract and delight modern travellers. Balancing these elements while maintaining the integrity of the site's heritage required a delicate and strategic branding approach. Solution: To address these challenges, The Colliery project embraced a holistic approach that celebrated the site's heritage, honoured its traditional owners, and elevated the guest experience to new heights. This was translated by our team into the manifesto of 'The Home of Bespoke Experiences', capturing the stateliness of the site and echoing the myriad opportunities the destination beckons. The Colliery's architectural team approached the restoration of the site with meticulous care, ensuring that every aspect of the original buildings is to be respectfully preserved and elevated in a way that maintains the beautiful legacy of the structure. From the brickwork produced onsite to the timber milled in the sawmill, every element is to be retained to showcase the site's industrial heritage. Our team thus approached the branding in a similar vein; the colour palette, reminiscent of the surrounding natural landscape, was incorporated into the design to create a cohesive and immersive experience for guests that blends effortlessly into the time period of the site whilst introducing the desired level of absolute luxury to the converted space. Each building within The Colliery was reimagined to offer a unique and tailored experience for guests. From the Bath House to the Power House, Engine House, Fan House, Shed, and Dwelling, each venue was designed to showcase its individual character while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic that echoed the site's industrial past. TOAST's branding thus took on a 'brand architecture' approach, adapting the core brand to mould to each of the site's offerings. The result is a collection of branded spaces that seamlessly blend luxury with history, offering guests an unforgettable journey through time. The Colliery stands as a shining example of adaptive reuse done right—a luxury hotel that not only respects the site's legacy but also celebrates it at every turn. Our branding suite, incorporating the iconic chimney and the metalworks inherent to the site, and colouring that heroes the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape, perfectly complements the subtle reinterpretation of the site, integrating design aspects that are innate to the region whilst bringing an uplifted appeal of pure luxury and unforgettable experiences.

Luxury.name: Collection
Luxury.description: Artisans of Lifestyle. When a prospective buyer steps into your display suite, you only get one chance to make a first impression that could inspire the buy. When the stakes are that high, TOAST's creativity goes higher. Taking brand well beyond the page and screen, TOAST is proud to unveil Sammut Group's Collection Display Suite. Having worked in tandem with PBD Architects and Sammut Group through a brand-first design approach from the very foundation of this project, our teams collaborated to create an interactive display suite to introduce the public to Sammut's corporate brand and projects, primarily showcasing the uniqueness of latest development 'Vue'. Challenge: Stepping into an empty shell, TOAST initially collaborated with PBD Architects to map out and envisage a multi-zoned space which had the capability to showcase 1 hero project and 4 additional live projects at any one time, alongside Sammut's own 'Artisan Wall' paying tribute to the Group's history, achievements, accolades and awards to establish confidence and trust in the experienced development team. Devoted to Sammut's corporate identity, crafted by TOAST, this Group section of the display suite stems from their brand positioning as 'Artisans of lifestyle,' communicating their vision for redefining luxury through a considered, crafted approach. Solution: Following a deep immersion and leveraging a decade of understanding of the triggers influencing purchasing decisions, we engaged the DisplaySweet team to support us in showcasing all content digitally within the space. Together, we delivered a sophisticated multi-media, multi-project display hub, bringing to life over a decade of TOAST's best-practice sales suite design experience with cutting edge technology combining plate plans, 3D modelling and lifestyle video content with innovative environmental design to create a truly interactive experience supporting sales agents to convert. Featuring luxurious branding, signage, sales track functionality and informative, inspiring wall graphics along with multimedia branded video content, TOAST's in depth understanding of the property buyer's sales journey and UX understanding is equally on proud display.

Luxury.name: Escape
Luxury.description:
Escape — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Live Beyond Boundaries. Luxury property development group ‘Luxcon’ is renowned for delivering highly acclaimed projects that surpass expectations and raise the bar for residential luxury living. Their latest beachfront project on the Gold Coast’s Garfield Terrace is no exception. As part of their recently launched ‘Coastal Collection,’ the site at 63-65 Garfield Terrace is a study in contemporary elegance and an unrivalled waterfront urban sanctuary. Positioned on the cusp of Surfers Paradise, a destination buzzing with vibrant nightlife, oceanview dining, contemporary art and a beautiful connection to the natural landscape, their vision was to build an idyllic place that is designed around reconnecting with your environment, your loved ones, and yourself.
