Crafted by acclaimed architectural firm PBD Architects, Luxcon’s development comprises 28 deluxe penthouse-style apartments with uninterrupted 360-degree ocean and hinterland views - combining the sophistication of ocean-front glamour with timeless beachy serenity. Having previously worked on successful developments with both teams, TOAST was engaged as the branding agency to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development for this deluxe destination. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: Luxcon’s creative mission for their luxury residential offering was to deliver a world of beachfront bliss which redefines coastal living in the Gold Coast. Communicated through the unique architectural form, their development sets out to harmonise the ubiquitous edge of city charm with the freedom and relaxation innate to beachfront living, introducing a level of contemporary design that is unseen in the Gold Coast. TOAST’s challenge was to develop a unique brand design to communicate the building’s unmatched opulence and a place identity which was bolstered with competitive longevity against the Gold Coast’s ever-growing luxury property market. Luxcon envisioned an iconic place, one which marries inspired architecture with the natural beauty of the Gold Coast; a highly unique destination designed for residents to ‘escape’. Through branding, TOAST needed to craft this visionary story and create an enviable beachfront oasis.

Solution: As embodied in its name, Escape is a place offering freedom and sanctuary from daily routine. Having space to reset, reflect and recharge is integral in life - values which were at the core of our placemaking principles. Building on these ideals, our team devised the tagline ‘Live beyond boundaries.’ Not only does this expression complement the qualities of flight and freedom innate to the development’s name, it also reflects the building’s visionary and expansive architectural facade. Bridging urban design with a coastal lifestyle, Escape’s contemporary architectural form oozes sophistication and showcases character that expresses striking individuality in its contextual coastal scene. ‘Live beyond boundaries,’ and the very essence of Escape, embodies these values by delivering a place of contemporary beauty and absolute luxury unmatched on the Gold Coast. Taking inspiration from PBD’s contemporary architectural design which elegantly echoes a boundless winglike form and sleek ripple symmetry, our team designed the Escape logo to mimic the broad wingspan of a bird in flight and the sleek grandeur of the building’s entrance. Marrying its architectural design and core values of flight and freedom, Escape epitomises contemporary beachfront beauty; it is a place which inspires future residents and their visitors by providing them sanctuary from daily routine. Towering above the Gold Coast skyline, Escape is a study of urban decadence. Full-floor privacy, personal concierge services and eclectic luxe architecture; it offers the finest in resort-style luxury living. Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape is to deliver an exclusive life of luxury, balance and freedom. This Place Mission is encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery with connotations of freedom and flight, and a beautiful reflection of the expanse of its building form. Concurrent to the acquisition of 63-65 Garfield Terrace, Luxcon landed a prime development opportunity in Byron Bay, the launch of which was shared with Escape as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography, alongside the production team, XMEDIA. The colour palette across Escape’s branding suite was designed for two visual territories, a primary ‘Night’ palette of Charcoal, Gold and Chalk, the depth of which reflects the ocean, sand and moonlight under an evening sky, and a secondary ‘Day’ palette of Mint Green, Cream and Chalk, capturing the serene colours of the sea, sand and sun. Encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery, the wingspan connoting life, flight and liberty whilst beautifully reflecting the expanse of the building form, our Place Visioning and Brand Identity reflect Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape to be an enviable oasis, delivering an exclusive life of balance, freedom and inspiration.

Luxury.name: Bohemian
Luxury.description:
Bohemian — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Life is Beautiful. Luxury developers ‘Luxcon,’ are renowned for delivering projects that surpass expectations and quantify the true meaning of luxury. Acquiring an enviable site at 90-96 Jonson St in the midst of Byron Bay’s town centre, their vision was to bring to life a destination that encapsulates the intangibly tantalising essence of Byron Bay, whilst paying homage to the beauty of the world that oft-inspires their visionary projects. Byron Bay is a place unmatched in its laid back sophistication. Encapsulating the epitome of barefoot luxury, it is a beachfront locale ever the envy of the globe. Luxcon’s development, designed by PBD Architects, was set to be a luxury offering; 44 serene two and three bedroom apartments, exclusive rooftop amenities and an idyllic meander to Byron’s beachfront, for which TOAST was engaged to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: TOAST designs places to work, to live, to come and to come back… we craft compelling stories built on human experiences, culture, landscape, public art and wayfinding. It was with this strategic branding expertise that our team was tasked to ideate the core identity for Luxcon’s development. In a buzzing location that is just moments from the beautiful coastline of Byron Bay, the precinct design for 90-96 Jonson St complements this beachside area’s vibrant community feel. Its worldly touch, through its open-air courtyards, walkable laneways, and interaction with the natural environment, creates an enviably intriguing atmosphere and brings new life to this public realm. With deep strategic research, founded on understanding the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends, global competitors and nearby developments, our team understood that 90-96 Jonson St’s branding and overall place vision needed to seamlessly integrate into the existing Byron environment, remaining on par with the local fashion and beliefs, whilst introducing an air of class and sophistication to elevate the town’s main strip.

Solution: As a name, Bohemian captures the urban and laid-back artistic sophistication of Byron Bay. This destination is a reimagining of home and hospitality that welcomes families and free spirits. Marrying the refined simplicity of a European lifestyle with the blithe and trendy air of Byron; Bohemian was created with a vision to introduce a place to connect, dream and inspire. Mirroring this place ethos, our chosen tagline ‘Life is Beautiful’ expresses the laid-back and eclectic way of life that Bohemian makes its own. Encapsulating the spirit of travel and a taste for exploration and discovery were core to our place-making ethos. Through our brand design, TOAST sought to connect Byron Bay’s coastal way of living with Luxcon’s “Of the World” lifestyle by creating an iconic and unique place; a world where you are grounded, safe and free. Across the brand, our conceptual framework paid homage to Bohemian’s unique architectural form and the contemporary beachside atmosphere unique to Byron Bay. Creating a custom font, with grid lines reflecting its architectural design, the weighted gradient of the building structure and the design’s united feminine and masculine features introduce an organic sense of balance. The logotype is bold as it is subtle, forging the perfect balance between worlds. The stacked structure of the hierarchical logotype layout is replicated for the precinct’s two sub-brands, Plaza and Spice Lane. The identifiable Bohemian logotype is enlarged above, with the sub-brand at the base, maintaining brand equity by remaining uniformly identifiable. Concurrent to the acquisition of 90-96 Jonson St, Luxcon landed a beachfront development opportunity in the Gold Coast, the launch of which was shared with Bohemian as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography. These assets showcased the values at the core of Bohemian’s branding, forging a diptych of harmonised natural elements and vibrant interactions which deliver a place to reset, enjoy and love. Bohemian’s branding suite encapsulates the efficacious, free spirit of Byron Bay. With a neutral colour palette drawn from the dusty-gold of the sand and pure monochromes of the building facade, Bohemian’s campaign assets create an enduring connection to the coast and mirror the natural hues of each meticulously designed apartment. Bohemian is a home that overflows with the alluring aura of Byron. Complementing its contemporary-classical architectural style inspired by renowned beachside towns; Bohemian’s strategic brand assets and visual identity deliver a place with a perfect balance between beach and city life.

Luxury.name: Kela X
Luxury.description:
Kela X — Brand Activation. by Harry Georje. When internationally acclaimed jewellery designer Harry Georje partnered with KELA Tech, the leading brand behind the world’s first non-slip hair accessory, something incredible was bound to happen. In fact, an entirely new category was to be born: fine jewellery for hair. A proposition that magically blends the luxury jewellery, hair and fashion industries. KELA X is a hair accessories brand delivering high-quality pieces which elevate the style and sophistication of its wearers. This incredible proposition is a world-first, luxury brand in a category of its own. A fusion of fine jewellery, fashion and patented hair technology - KELA X is set to inspire multiple industries at once - industries where both KELA and Harry Georje hold immense respect due to their highly admired bodies of work.

Challenge: Harry Georje is a master of his craft - an unrivalled expert whose reputation precedes him. He is a three times De Beers international award-winning diamond jeweller, with over 30 years’ experience. For Georje, trust is everything. Renowned for his passion and knowledge of diamonds in particular, he treats every piece of jewellery as an investment - a piece to ignite decades of joy. And business partner, KELA, has deep expertise in the hair industry, with an offering that began in hair charms and extended into a patented technology known as KELA Tech. With this in mind, TOAST was tasked with crafting a highly sophisticated, yet approachable and trustworthy brand which reflected skill, knowledge and craftsmanship for this new business partnership. The fusion of carefully crafted design and innovation creates the magic of KELA X, a revolution in fine-jewellery for hair that invites a new level of inspired self-expression; they needed to be showcased as a brand that elevates natural beauty through bold attitude, timeless elegance and absolute luxury.

Solution: For KELA X by Harry Georje, every aspect is considered. With the brand values of artful innovation, sophistication and design aesthetic, unapologetic exclusivity and superior performance, our team at TOAST crafted a brand footprint for KELA X that evokes opulence, expertise and unmistakable quality. With exclusivity as the halo of their prestige; their brand creates unique experiences through which customers and brand loyalists are intrinsically connected. Their narrative is a luxury brand story underpinned by innovation that pushes their brand to excellence and beyond. Encapsulating this brand essence, we identified the USP “we believe in capturing the ultimate form of self expression through pure aesthetics and world-class technology,” reflecting the fusion of carefully crafted design and innovative creation which is the magic of KELA X. They are a brand that elevates natural beauty through bold attitude, timeless elegance and absolute luxury. Thus, our overall branding suite used a deep toned and metallic colour palette to connote their refined sophistication, with the duo of dark blue and gold lending a touch of royalty and signifying the authority and idealism within the brand. These attributes were similarly championed through the Tone of Voice we crafted for their launch; a territory of sophisticated language, effusive descriptions and decorative, idyllic terms painting a brand picture of pure excellence and ultimate luxury.

Luxury.name: Bondi Chic
Luxury.description:
Bondi Chic — Brand Activation. In and Out Beauty. Established in 2018, Bondi Chic is a premium cosmetics brand operating within the ‘Clean Beauty’ niche of the ‘Green Beauty’ market segment. Their product range is made with only the best of Australia's native, skin-loving ingredients.

Challenge: Faced with a crowded market (both domestically and internationally), Bondi Chic sought a brand identity that would position the skincare company at the forefront of modern trends whilst also creating a strong, ownable brand footprint with genuine longevity. Reaching out to TOAST, it was understood that the brand voice needed to be more consistent across all of their platforms and follow a clear strategy, whilst a target audience needed to be defined and their brand image transformed to be strongly relevant for their demographic. The Bondi Chic brand has unique values, strong principles, and a core purpose to its name - many of which are potential selling points to customers - however, they are combined in an ad-hoc way that indicates a lack of firm brand identity and lead to a confused and ineffective value proposition. TOAST could clearly see a brand that has the potential to satisfy a consumer need and to eventually take ownership of the ‘Clean Beauty’ segment. However, to get there, Bondi Chic needed to clarify exactly where it sits in the crowded cosmetics market, what exactly it offers to consumers and what values the brand embodies.

Solution: Bondi Chic exists because they believe in creating skincare products the right way, helping people feel healthy and beautiful, inside and out. As a brand, they seek to simultaneously innovate solutions and respect age-old traditions; they approach skincare with an open mind to find the best ways to enhance beauty by only using ingredients that holistically care for one’s skin. TOAST devised a brand footprint & USP which reflected this ethos. Building on stakeholder research and user insights, their brand narrative champions that no other brand offers a comprehensive yet uncomplicated program that uses non-toxic, Australian ingredients. Their USP, “Our products create beauty in the healthiest way possible - inside and out,” highlights their difference in the market as dedicated specialists providing natural and innovative products which are kind to your skin. From these insights came our big idea, “In and Out Beauty.” At the core of Bondi Chic is the belief that real beauty begins when we are true to ourselves, our beauty coming from within. Thus, for inner and outer beauty, they only use ingredients that will holistically enhance your beauty - if they don’t belong on your skin, they don’t belong in their products. TOAST identified their market demographic as 25 – 50 year old Australian women who enjoy an active lifestyle and lean toward ‘natural’ and ‘organic’ products. To speak to this audience, the packaging and Tone of Voice we devised used earthy and herbal yet sophisticated language. Emphasising the natural, native Australian ingredients and toxin-free formulas, we showcased Bondi Chic as a classy yet contemporary brand that encompasses all things natural. Disciples of the ‘clean beauty’ philosophy - products that deliver on their promises of completely non-toxic ingredients - Bondi Chic’s brand identity reflects both their connection to nature and their commitment to creating products that deliver real results.

Luxury.name: Highlife
Luxury.description: Highlife. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage One. Wentworth Point's newest high life. At TOAST, we empower places by providing compelling brand footprints that allow audiences to understand the unique attributes and purposes of the spaces they experience, and our work with Sekisui House demonstrates the success of our approach. In 2016, Sekisui House purchased the 9.4 hectare site that would become Sanctuary. TOAST was brought on board at the project inception stage, working closely with Sekisui House and key architects to immerse ourselves in the site and the region. This process uncovered key insights that would shape the future identity of the masterplanned community. Crafting the core vision and essence of Sanctuary from the project's very inception was a brand-first approach that delivered outstanding outcomes. Challenge: In-depth auditing of the site revealed that a unique characteristic of Sanctuary is the fact that it is completely surrounded by nature, with wetlands, water, and parkland encircling the masterplan's location. The wonder of its geographical positioning paired terrifically with buyer-insights. Market research identified that the top two considerations of Wentworth Point buyers were "safety and security" and "a desirable location". Thus, these insights played a key influence in the creation of Sanctuary's brand identity and the delivery of its First Stage, coined 'Landing'. Landing's delivery consisted of 2 statuesque buildings, home to 364 beautiful, masterfully-built apartments designed for indoor-outdoor living with state-of-the-art appliances and modern finishes. The 'High Life' lifestyle that Landing encapsulates is underpinned by balance and harmony in a community that's perfectly situated to take advantage of the best that Greater Sydney has to offer. The complete synergy between the architecture and natural surroundings established a fantastic standard of living and is an embodiment of the core principles and brand design of Sanctuary. It is this essence of Sanctuary, encompassing balance, harmony, nature and community, that TOAST joined Sekisui House in strategically defining. Each design element is intrinsically linked to natural influences, and demonstrates Sanctuary's vibrant yet calming place identity that lets people live their everyday lives to the fullest. Solution: Landing, and Sanctuary as a whole, offer a unique, integrated living experience. The masterplan community features an oasis of vibrant spaces encompassing all states of being: play, reflection, energy and sustainability. This approach has resulted in a rich, purposeful living experience that integrates the site's core elements of nature, water and sky. TOAST reflected these core elements in the precinct's colour palette and collateral asset design. The colour palette of the 'Landing' logo variant, consists of gold and charcoal. With warm hues and a darker tint these colours are both bold and soft, encapsulating the ever-evolving nature of the world around us. The woody tones within this palette blended with the movement of the cyclical logotype reflect the beautiful evolution that occurs in our environment and beautifully represents the Sanctuary ethos of 'one with nature'. In the launch of Landing, TOAST worked with Sekisui House on a series of targeted social media posts, building intrigue and awareness of this new destination in Wentworth Point. This campaign was centred around the concept of living the 'High Life,' promoting the precinct's connectivity to the city, proximity to a world class entertainment hub and the expansive waterfront views creating a luxurious lifestyle that is immersed in nature. Adapting to the Covid-19 rules and gathering limits, TOAST and Sekisui House pivoted and used the campaign as an opportunity to promote exclusive private tours of the apartments, allowing their off-the-plan purchases to continue to thrive. This safe, tailored approach to sales tied back to the buyer insights our teams established and permitted the desirable location of Sanctuary to continue to be experienced for all interested parties. The success of Landing as Stage 1 of Sanctuary was recognised at the 2021 Urban Taskforce awards, winning a Development Excellence Award in the 'High-rise Development Metro' category.

Luxury.name: Community
Luxury.description: Community. Sekisui House. Sanctuary Masterplan. A place for all. The Sekisui House philosophy 'Love of Humanity', integrated with the ancient Japanese cultural principle of Satoyama 'Harmony between the environment and nature,' has guided Sanctuary's design to reflect the benefits of co-dependence between people, nature, and the built environment. Sanctuary places a deep respect for community at the heart of its design and development. It's about weaving nature throughout, the connectivity to the residents, and linkages to the broader community and Sydney as a whole. With a key focus on 'Michi' or 'Spatial Design Experience' Sanctuary's brand has emerged with the need to evolve and appeal to become a centre of life for people. The incorporation of design, innovation and technology with the natural surroundings through the facilities, landscapes and amenities, plays an essential role in the uniqueness of Sanctuary. Vibrant, fulfilling interactions between people, place and nature bring to life a beautiful spirit of community that occurs within and beyond its boundaries. Challenge: The vision for Sanctuary was to create a masterplanned community where a genuine respect for nature is reignited, and where a harmonious relationship between people and built form is nurtured; Sanctuary is a space that is designed to facilitate community connection. Sekisui House's core design principles and community-building ethos uplift the offering of this masterplan and introduce endless benefits that will elevate the lives of all in Wentworth Point. Maximising parkland within the site, expanding retail opportunities, integrating public transport and offering a calendar of community events at the foreshore park; what was once merely the end of the road is now becoming the heart of a revitalised community. Along with creating opportunities for community activity, the connection to the landscape offers boundless benefits to mental and physical health. By delivering a unique residential and community precinct that is at one with nature, Sanctuary will help its residents experience enriched, fulfilling lives that evolve with time and last for generations. Solution: To encapsulate the deep community spirit that Sekisui House has created through Sanctuary, TOAST crafted the tagline 'A place for all,' championing the neighbourly connections and inclusive atmosphere that Sanctuary fosters. This masterplan generates coexistence and co-prosperity by increasing the amount of public open space, and interactive activity areas for the whole community of Wentworth Point to enjoy. Offering more than 6 football-field's worth of public parkland and open space, over 4km of cycling and pedestrian-friendly paths, and with 34% of the entire masterplan dedicated to public green space, Sanctuary is undeniably alive with experiences and possibilities. This is a precinct designed to facilitate community connection, neighbourly interaction, and easy engagement with your native environment. Reflecting the core brand values of 'vibrant interactions' and 'comfortable living,' this approach delivers a unique experience for residents and the greater community, creating cohesion and instilling life, energy & vibrancy.

Luxury.name: 180 Queen St
Luxury.description: 180 Queen St. DWS Australia. Brand Visualisation. The Bank of Ideas. DWS Australia is an investment company focused on providing investment solutions and direct real estate assets to clients both locally and internationally. They are the investment company behind Queensland's beautiful and iconic 180 Queen St; a piece of the state's history and its future. This landmark trophy asset is in a dominant position in one of Australia's highest performing retail malls surrounded by city defining developments. In the centre of Brisbane, it offers a connected address within walking distance to Brisbane's urban attractions. The building hosts 6 Levels of private office suites with unique floor layouts and charming heritage features, such as ornate marble interior stairwells. Challenge: Blessed with a beautiful heritage site, TOAST was tasked to develop an activation concept to bring this location to life. Our team needed to create an identity and campaign platform to support 180 Queen St's entire leasing program. To reach the requirements of DWS' leasing campaign, we needed to clearly define the thought-process and behaviours of the key audiences in order to define the ideal product & marketing experience. In addition to this, our campaign needed to breathe new life and bring deep purpose to the heritage building. It is a dignified and chic site with immense history, this needed to be respected and appropriately capitalised on to attract new tenants to the space. Solution: In delving into the solution space, TOAST looked into the site's strengths and weaknesses and where there were opportunities for elevation. We identified there was a disconnect between the external presence and internal atmosphere of the building. Accompanying this, we identified that certain rational elements on their website, such as pricing, services, and amenities, were not readily available. This detracted from the user experience and was a potential demotivator for interested buyers. These insights provided us with valid perspective; we needed to uplift the customer experience. To achieve the customer experience uplift, we uncovered 180 Queen St's competitive advantages, identified an audience seeking this proposition, shaped the offer to appeal to the target audience and created a prioritised plan for implementation & execution. To create the identity for 180 Queen St that DWS was seeking, we embedded the customer journey with a sense of energy and inspiration, to attract interest and commitment from better quality tenants. TOAST created a holistic approach to redefine 180 Queen St, positioning it as a point of intersection for those seeking space to work, create, and meet; we sought to appeal to the core drivers of potential tenants. Our campaign presented 180 Queen St as a site with an eclectic mix of curated tenants utilising quaint, affordable office space that is ideal for creative studios and artisan workshops. This repositioning appeals to the increase in creative and start-up industries and breathes new life into an iconic, heritage location. The big idea, 'The Bank of Ideas' presents 180 Queen St as the place where Brisbane's brightest minds congregate.

Luxury.name: Escarp
Luxury.description: Escarp. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. A place of outspoken beauty. LAPropertyCo is a development & property group known for their innovative designs that deliver excellence and cultivate maximum return. As a company, they have a history of development and investment in established markets, with their success underpinned by their ability to identify emerging trends and opportunities, particularly within Sydney. The group's core strategy is to acquire and develop high-quality residential and mixed-use buildings that deliver maximum value, both for the company and to the surrounding community. The high achieving property group acquired a site in the Northern Sydney suburb of Northbridge; a gateway project to feature 19 oversized luxury apartments offering expansive Sydney CBD views and an unrivalled lifestyle in one of the Lower North's most historic suburbs. Challenge: For their new site acquisition and property vision, TOAST was engaged to create the brand footprint and place narrative. This residential site was envisioned as a place appealing to the essence of sophisticated Lower North Shore living, embracing the surrounding delights of its stunning Northbridge setting and boasting uninterrupted views of Sydney's vibrant city skyline and picturesque surrounds. Through our strategic design, we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client's expectations. To achieve these outcomes, the brand needed a strong feel of exclusivity and a very aspirational proposition to engage and elicit interest of to-be residents. It needed to be recognised as the next highlight of the Lower North Shore. Solution: To accurately reflect LAPropertyCo.'s visions, TOAST delved into the history of the suburb, the surroundings, the intention for the project and the placemaking approach. We drew key inspiration from the sophisticated and high-end lifestyle of Northbridge and its neighbouring suburbs. Further to this, front and centre of our ideation and design thinking processes were the end-consumers. Our team took the time to delve into their motivations, desires and ambitions, leading to an understanding that they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, ease and tranquility. Additionally, the site is cradled by precincts of style, sophistication and urban polish. Anticipating that residents will quickly become accustomed to the many local conveniences on offer led to the creation of 'Escarp,' a precinct of outspoken beauty presented as the ultimate address where all conveniences are at your command. Escarp is a place made for the indulgence of grand living, for residents to experience the art of exceptional living. To underpin these ideals, for the branding assets of Escarp we settled on a deep blue with copper highlights to build a sense of simple sophistication and high-quality elegance.

Luxury.name: Muse
Luxury.description: Muse. Brand Transformation / Site Activation. Inspired Minds. MUSE, known as the House of Inspired Minds, is based in a 5-storey heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's iconic, city-fringe suburb Surry Hills. The neighbourhood's industrial buildings date back to the 1840's. It was during the 1920's that it became home to generations of working-class Chinese immigrant tailors and seamstresses serving the thriving rag trade, and later it became the headquarter of The Chinese Republic Newspaper. Their vision was to challenge the status quo and unlock new and effective ways to work, inspiring bespoke and impactful events and experiences, every single day. Today, MUSE is a different kind of community. In 2017, the building was transformed into a private creative community, combining the industrial heritage of yesteryear with the best of both original architecture and sophisticated, innovative interior design. Challenge: MUSE is now home to creative entrepreneurs and businesses and is an inspiring home for creators in design, film, fashion, branding, architecture, art, journalists and copywriters. MUSE prides itself on offering a private and exclusive space for its members with a focus on innovation and relationship building. MUSE is a space for those looking to take their business to the next level, putting life back into the workplace allowing people to become the best version of themselves. TOAST was engaged by MUSE to style their brand message and convey their holistic business offering. A prime heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's desirable Surry Hills, our team was tasked with crafting their brand narrative to assist the leasing of these bespoke work spaces. Solution: In unravelling this challenge, TOAST worked to unwind the business strengths, opportunities and its factors for success to design the MUSE brand footprint. MUSE is a place that challenges. A place that expands your mind and inspires ideas. This led TOAST to define their brand narrative "Inspired Ideas". Muse gets you moving; a place that creates the next level you, where you can collaborate and co-create in a house built of inspired minds. TOAST focused on the empowerment and autonomy MUSE provides its members; going beyond the co-working and office category by seamlessly integrating work & life in a unique, unexpected and rewarding offering. The end result is a bold and inspiring space that brings co-working to life. It is for those looking for renewal and excitement; to take their business to the next level. TOAST, in collaboration with the award-winning architect Vince Alafaci and acclaimed interior designer Caroline Chocker of ACME & Co (The Grounds of Alexandria), helped create an inspired, collaborative and creative workspace that could offer an experience, and a way of working that other co-working spaces are not providing. The team created an understated and luxurious aesthetic that sweeps effortlessly across spaces from meeting rooms and breakout areas on each level to the private courtyard, rooftop garden, the internal library of architecture and design, and across all amenities. The MUSE project was awarded with Silver at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards in the Interior Design - Co-Working & Studio Space category.

Luxury.name: Hutch & Hutch
Luxury.description: Hutch & Hutch. BridgeLane. Place Visioning. A Place of Beauty. Boutique developer BridgeLane embarked upon a significant and enviable design challenge; converting a warehouse into a home. Their efforts and expertise are revealed in their site Hutch & Hutch, in Sydney's Surry Hills. BridgeLane extended and redesigned the historic warehouse to offer a modernised collection of unique apartments of up to 3-bedrooms. They created a unique building, combining original warehouse features with contemporary design, breathing new life into a luxury residence. Challenge: TOAST was challenged with defining the vision and essence of BridgeLane's new project. Enviably positioned in Surry Hills, Hutch & Hutch's brand image needed to compliment the trendy, vibrant appeal of this city-fringe neighbourhood. Solution: Combined with the location's unique history - the site of Australia's first vinyl record plant - for this project, TOAST took inspiration between the parallels of nostalgia and new. Drawing on the creative flair of the location, and the surrounding streets of Hutchinson Street and Hutchinson Lane, TOAST started with the name, and took it from there, developing a branding platform that took the boutique development to a new level of distinction. Our company was awarded REA brand campaign of the year for its collaboration with BridgeLane and award-winning architects SJB and CBRE.

Luxury.name: Laguna & Glade
Luxury.description: Laguna & Glade. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage Two. Life Ever Changing. The Sanctuary masterplan in Wentworth Point offers an ever-changing life experience through people, culture and the environments within. Following the completion and success of ‘Landing,’ Stage 1 of Sanctuary, the masterplan is moving forward to its second stage. Positioned to be overlooking the Parramatta River and bordering the neighbourhood green, Stage 2 lies at the very centre of Sanctuary's vibrant community estate and encompasses three new elements, the Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club. Consisting of 171 premium waterside apartments centred around lush open spaces and a multilevel wellbeing facilities building - Revive, the Laguna and Glade residences achieve perfect synergy with nature. This stage is beautifully designed to allow an inside-out communication between landscape and architecture. Embracing the calm, curious flow of the Parramatta River and the best of international living standards, these developments have been designed to allow seamless communication between the surrounding natural landscape and modern architecture. Challenge: As Laguna, Glade and Revive are staged additions in a large-scale masterplan, as opposed to standalone developments, it was imperative that the Sanctuary property branding and strategic vision remained as the common thread that ties all elements together. As, to remain an authentic and highly-regarded brand, it is key to present a united image with a consistent and clear message. Harmony, vibrancy, a sense of calm and liveability are fundamental attributes defining a sanctuary and are wonderfully evident in this Stage 2 development. The Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club bring newfound energy and life to the Sanctuary precinct. Aligned and connected with the overall branding and message of Sanctuary’s masterplan, Laguna and Glade have an infectious spirit. In the heart of the precinct, bookended by both the river and neighbourhood green, these spaces weave beautifully into their natural surrounds and offer occupants a space that is liveable and abundant in lively characteristics. As elements within the Sanctuary masterplan brand, Laguna, Glade and Revive are similarly identifiable by the unique kaleidoscopic logotype. In creating this gracefully fragmented circular imagery, TOAST was inspired by the fundamental principles within Japanese design, such as simplicity, understated beauty and tranquillity. It’s an intricate but elegant wreath, a symbol which ties all elements of Sanctuary together. Solution: Laguna and Glade are highly anticipated boutique developments on the water’s edge offering a serene living experience in the heart of Sanctuary. Across both buildings, nature acts as a bridge between the apartments and the wider landscape, creating an unrivalled living experience where nature and urban living seamlessly integrate. The harmony and communication between our inside and outside worlds is a fundamental element within Sanctuary’s brand footprint, making this masterplan evermore unique. The fluidity of Laguna’s logo variant captures the sense of calm and serenity that the building exudes. The malleable, rejuvenating qualities of water are captured in the building's architecture and are further conveyed in this logo's expression. As for Glade, this logo variant is heavily flora-inspired and integrates natural influences throughout its design. The striking green textural pattern conveys this sense of vitality, promising a life that is energetic and connected to nature. Further, Revive's logo takes the aqueous territory introduced with Laguna and pushes it further. Centred around the uniquely styled, revitalising pool that is a core foundation of the building's offerings, this logo treatment fully reflects the tranquil, restorative qualities of the health club it represents. The Stage 2 triad is an extension of the refuge that is Sanctuary and delivers a beautifully unique experience for residents and the wider community. A space that is in harmony with nature, abundant in vibrant interactions, epitomises comfortable living and offers a fulfilled life experience.

Luxury.name: Sammut Group
Luxury.description: Sammut Group. Brand Elevation. Artisans of Lifestyle. Sammut Group is a property development company offering luxurious residential and commercial properties, with an unparalleled scope of service and expertise backed by 30 years of experience in the development and construction industry. They have a strong business presence and have achieved great success in the Sutherland Shire, providing high-end mixed-use developments which positively impact the life of residents, communities and surrounding businesses in the area. However their presence beyond this region of Sydney was less impactful, something they sought to change. Challenge: TOAST was presented with the challenge; How are we going to become an even stronger, leading player across multiple business lines, targeting lifestyle destinations along the Eastern seaboard? Asking, how do we become bigger, stronger and performant in new locations with more offerings...It’s about becoming more corporate without losing the core business culture, team spirit and especially without losing the foundation for what makes Sammut Group a great company to belong to, work with or buy from. Solution: To truly tackle the core of this challenge, TOAST had to unwind the business strengths and opportunities, audit its key assets and factors of success in order to rearticulate the existing brand footprint and its great principles to strengthen the brand of Sammut Group for it to resonate across multiple targets, offerings and locations. Through research and workshopping, TOAST uncovered myriad successes of Sammut Group; they lifted the bar in Cronulla & the Sutherland Shire by delivering uniquely designed high calibre projects with a deep attention to detail. We identified that opportunities existed for Sammut Group to become a new corporate identity to support the credibility of their projects, offering living experiences beyond what the market currently provides. Thus, reaching the new conceptual output, ‘Artisans of Lifestyle,’ expressing the thesis behind a company enhancing people’s lives with immersive luxury experiences through sustainable architecture, natural landscapes and beautiful details. The business has strengthened and diversified to elevate all facets of the Australian lifestyle; creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

Luxury.name: Trinity Point
Luxury.description: Trinity Point. Brand Elevation. Above & Beyond. Nestled on the shores of Lake Macquarie, Trinity Point is a Master Plan community offering world-class residential, resort and marina facilities in an immersive 5-star living experience. With the new iconic and transformational design from leading Australian firm Koichi Takada Architects, the Trinity Point precinct is planned to be home to a luxury 220-room hotel, restaurants, function centre, pool and 218 waterfront apartments, along with the already established Trinity Point Marina. The transformational project will inject more than $720million into the local economy and create hundreds of new direct and indirect jobs through construction and, when operational, to service the hotel and restaurant in the longer term. Challenge: Over the project’s 20-year lifespan, Trinity Point’s visual look and feel had undertaken numerous changes to reflect its ever-evolving transformational design without providing true justice to the new luxury regional destination. The brand needed to be uplifted drastically to mirror the prestige of this iconic, environmentally-leading tourism destination for regional New South Wales; one that will showcase the area's greatest quality –Lake Macquarie. A strong elevation of a strategic brand footprint was required to launch the development’s apartment, marina and resort offerings which will set an architectural benchmark for the region. TOAST’s challenge was to find a way to elevate Trinity Point’s Masterbrand identity whilst seamlessly developing and integrating each sub-brand. Solution: TOAST developed a new overarching positioning statement ‘Above and Beyond’ connecting Trinity Point’s commitment to delivering a lakeside lifestyle beyond any other: an architectural and sustainability benchmark for the region. This positioning is being rolled out as a new visual language across the Trinity Point ecosystem including immersive display, online and offline collateral. Allowing Trinity Point to clearly communicate the value of place to drive connection to community and residents.

Luxury.name: The Revy
Luxury.description: The Revy. Aqualand. Place Visioning. The Doorway to Sydney’s Harbour. Aqualand distinguishes itself as a developer, As both Strategic Urban Regenerators benefiting areas with close proximity to key public transport, retail hubs and education facilities, and as Creators of Prime Foreshore Residences, boasting views across the iconic Sydney Harbour; Aqualand distinguish themselves as unique, multitalented developers in the property industry. One of their prestigious sites is “The REVY”, home to 44 unique heritage-listed residential apartments tucked away on tranquil Darling Island. With its exceptional waterfront location, heritage building and proximity to the CBD, The REVY is set to become Sydney’s most prestigious address. Challenge: In order to sell the apartments, Aqualand worked on an initial campaign. However, in regards to the overall Covid-19 challenges and market uncertainty, the campaign lost traction while there were still 11 residences available for sale. TOAST was asked to develop a lead generation campaign to support the sales success of the remaining residences. The building has lived many lives, being re-invented over and over to cater for the ebb and flow of culture and the needs of the times. Today, The REVY has once again evolved, transforming into a truly unique and luxury residence that provides those who enter its walls a Sydney experience like no other…. And the brand and campaign needed to reflect this evolution in order to be successful. Solution: To achieve this, TOAST has delved into the specifics of this property's essence to fully understand and communicate its unique value proposition: with towering heritage facades and modern luxury interiors The REVY is a site like no other. While the building has a unique history to communicate and build on a lead generation system, it appeared obvious that the new positioning of the brand and its messaging needed to capitalise on a unique proposition that combines the best of two worlds: Incomparable Contemporary Living and Timeless Heritage Exclusivity. “The doorway to Sydney’s Harbour” claimed this idea of unique access to superior Sydney Harbour living. Historical significance, monumental architecture, sophisticated luxury and scenic waterfront location all combined to make an unrepeatable proposition. The campaign was brought to life through a very engaging website that embarks visitors on a unique journey, and a suite of traditional marketing tools including online and off-line marketing collateral which enabled a successful lead generation funnel for the appointed agents, CBRE.

Luxury.name: Amaroo
Luxury.description: Amaroo. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. Nestled Above Castle Cove. LAPropertyCo. is a visionary property group driven to be market leaders, built on generations of experience. The group has an established track record for investing in and developing Real Estate within premium Sydney markets, remaining focused on creating innovative designs and planning solutions. LAPropertyCo. acquired a prime site overlooking the bay, right next to the golf course in Castle Cove and created an exceptional development of 11 luxurious residences with a deep connection to its surroundings. Challenge: This luxurious project presents the future occupants with the opportunity to experience life in the idyllic North Shore suburb of Sydney, best known for its elevated and leisurely lifestyle suited for an older, affluent population. Even though these attributes present immense advantages to the project and the freedom to create an aesthetic brand, it still presents a challenge of maintaining a fine balance of luxury and connectedness in the brand identity. After TOAST’s successful collaboration with LAPropertyCo. on "The Postern", we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client’s expectations. Solution: TOAST delved into the history of the place, the surroundings, the vision for the project and the placemaking approach. We were inspired by how the land naturally contoured, the topography, the rich textures of the materials and utilised the beautiful, naturally occurring designs to create visual elements that would support the brand. We put the end-consumers at front and centre, taking the time to understand their motivations in life. We realised that at this stage in their lives, they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, peace and tranquility, and a connection to nature. TOAST married the sensibilities of the target market with the modernity of the development and its connection to its natural setting to create an elegant and timeless brand identity.

Luxury.name: Luxcon
Luxury.description: Brand Transformation. Of the World. Luxcon is a luxury property developer with a reputation for delivering sophisticated residential projects. They're pioneers in elevating lifestyles through their redefined standards of quality, comfort, taste and amenity, meeting the needs of discerning clients with exacting expectations. Their projects are destinations that people go out of their way to see and feel - their level of innovation, iconic style and visionary design live long in the minds of all who experience them. However, Luxcon's original brand didn't reflect the crafted, refined nature of the developer itself. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to create a brand identity that conveys Luxcon's worldly, visionary perspective, demonstrating the developer's commitment to bringing international style to Australian shores. TOAST's immersion into the business uncovered the developer's deep commitment to crafting projects that are inspired by diverse, sophisticated cultural influences. The agency had to bring to life Luxcon's vision into a brand footprint which defined luxury as an expectation; a mindset uniting those whose worldview leads them to expect excellence of the world within the homes, destinations and spaces they inhabit. Solution: These insights brought about the brand's Big Idea: "Of the World". Our strategic and creative solution established a rich creative territory that celebrates Luxcon's uniquely global perspective. As a vehicle to showcase international influences, world-class standards and bold, category shifting ideas, "Of The World" possesses an inspired, curatorial quality. This will allow Luxcon to strategically establish itself as a brand possessing the worldliness of a nomadic collector; sourcing ideas, crafts and influences from luxurious international destinations to artfully inspire a series of iconic, world-class destinations. This positioning was brought to life by a logo and visual look & feel featuring design elements that are timeless symbols of style and class, positioning the developer well beyond its category and the industry brand practices. To complete the overall brand uplift, TOAST then crafted an online brand experience that embarked target audiences on a journey into Luxcon's world. The developer's website is a strong statement that is focused on its specific target audiences and is geared toward acquiring not just customers, but loyal advocates. DesignRush, known for its recognition of best logo designs has chosen our design to be featured among The Best Logo Designs Done by Australian Agencies. We are thrilled to be recognised on this level.

Luxury.name: The Postern
Luxury.description: LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. Crafted In Nature. Located 8 kms north of Sydney's central business district on Middle Harbour on the leafy premium escarpment of Castlecrag, The Postern is a truly unique mixed living development containing 7 luxury apartments and 3 commercial offices. Inspired by the original vision of Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin who developed Castlecrag as a planned development in 1921, The Postern has been created to melt into the natural contours of the land, with flat roofs that preserve the skyline and extensive native landscaping which restore the traditional beauty of the natural environment. Challenge: Castlecrag is a suburb of historical significance. It was designed and created as an experiment in community planning and living, accommodating for "the liberal intellectual, theosophical, anthroposophical and natural history views of its inhabitants". Early homes in Castlecrag were built using natural stone to blend into the environment with the focus on creating "the human touch" as distinct from mass production. As the community is very attached to the local culture and lifestyle, and apartment blocks were not part of the planning until now; there were understandably a few detractors, supported by the community, who were against or reticent towards the project. The brand had to articulate the legitimacy of the architecture of the future Postern, as a natural evolution of the suburb while preserving its unique visual aspect and identity. Solution: TOAST delved into the history, natural environment and community of Castlecrag to understand the core of the community's values. Through this exploration, the strategic platform 'Crafted In Nature' was developed. The purpose of this strategic platform was to capture the spirit of Castlecrag and pay homage to Walter and Marion Griffin's original vision for balanced living immersed with nature. The brand narrative needed to build engagement with the community and excite the potential buyers with content sourced from 3 key strategic pillars; 1. Legacy: A shared vision to connect homes to the natural environment 2. Tranquility: A natural paradise hidden a stone's throw from the bustle of the city 3. Synergy: A community of like-minded people living in balance with the natural space. The Postern was born as a celebration of the existing land, and a building that perfectly marries native beauty with refined luxury. Shaped by the land, this exclusive building is a private entrance to a unique paradise offering the best features of Castlecrag: A perfect fusion with the existing topography; An immersion with nature; Water and bushland views; Refined luxury. The marketing campaign was a success as all apartments were sold within 2 months time while the community welcomed the project as part of Castlecrag.

Luxury.name: Coast
Luxury.description: Sammut Group. Place Visioning. Sculpted by Water. Coast is a pure expression of modern luxury developed by Sammut Group. This 6-star 43 storey residential building rests on the absolute beachfront of the Gold Coast. Built with precision and functionality to capture the sculpted beauty of nature and the bliss of functional, modern living, Coast is the purest expression of natural, integrated luxury that the Gold Coast has ever seen. Challenge: This property development is the first of its kind and presented the branding and marketing solution with a few challenges to overcome. First of all, it is an offer of absolute luxury for the Gold Coast; a market offering no competition at this level. Furthermore, as much as Sammut Group was highly recognised and well-known for their first class work in the Sydney market, the developer needed to gain awareness, consideration and preference from potential buyers in order to feel comfortable to purchase a property residence from them. The strategic platform and the brand needed to carry the quality and uniqueness of the offering, while demonstrating all the business proof-points which would provide the confidence to buy an apartment from Sammut Group. Solution: TOAST began by digging into the changing dynamics of the beautiful beachside community, understanding the vision of the renowned architects PBD and taking into account the changing structure of the Australian population, their life choices and values resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic. The name Coast was chosen for two reasons: to celebrate the uniqueness of the proposition on the market and, at the same time, showcase the legacy and growth of the developer since their first development, also known as Coast (in Cronulla). This research led to a series of strategic recommendations about the positioning of this truly unique residence and the development of the brand platform 'Sculpted by nature'. Our brand narrative was inspired by the shaping and reshaping of the foreshore by the pure waters of the north coast, the ever-changing shape of the ocean coastline. Coast's design rests as a pure gem, inspired to reflect the layered, refined beauty of the natural environment drawing in the light and revealing to their customers a new perspective on life each and every day. During the month of June, within the first 3 weeks of listing, TOAST ran a campaign that secured sales of over 43 of the 49 total apartments, with sales ranging between $3.5 million and $9 million, at an average of $4.5 million, resulting in record-breaking results for the Gold Coast.

Luxury.name: ONE O ONE
Luxury.description: Brand Activation. The Voyage of Perfection. ONE O ONE has been designed as a one-of-a-kind superyacht, with handcrafted interiors and bespoke exteriors, forging function and luxury. This spacious and luxurious pleasure vessel is available to charter with staff ready to cater to guests who arrive expecting a high standard of comfort. Perfectly designed to emphasise comfort, speed, and expedition capability, this superyacht is the latest vessel on Sydney Harbour, the ultimate in luxury harbour cruises. Embarking on a cruise with ONE O ONE is more than just an experience - it is a journey, a voyage through a world of true luxury. Challenge: TOAST was approached to develop a brand and website for this luxurious ocean craft experience. One of the main challenges of entering a mature market inhabited by multiple industry players, is to position oneself as a "very distinctive business", with a strong proposition delivering beyond what already exists. Through the brand story, ONE O ONE needed to develop a credible reputation as a one-of-a-kind superyacht provider with a "Unique Selling Proposition" that communicated: Their point of difference: Why choose us? Their commitment to delivering with excellence. By establishing a new positioning in the industry, ONE O ONE needed to demonstrate what they stand for, backed with genuine content and indestructible business proof points. To develop a brand for a product of this magnitude was to delve into understanding the core of what luxury itself was about, and the ways that it has changed over time. Solution: Through our research we uncovered a central insight that luxury was not simply about an object or brand; luxury is a mindset, a way of living and approaching life itself. That luxury as an ideal is different for every individual and thus in creating luxury experiences we must offer flexibility. Developing a framework of modern luxury, we were able to impart recommendations from experiential design to marketplace positioning, which ultimately led to our big idea. The creative platform was nurtured with the understanding that lifestyle is so fast-paced that a feeling of total disconnect in time and space is what luxury means to our audiences... To be able to step back and breathe in the surroundings is to experience true luxury. The brand needed to carry the proposition that ONE O ONE provides a bespoke luxury experience, through an unparalleled journey which speaks to all senses, day and night...an absolute and immersive luxury experience: Absolute perfection. Supporting this unique proposition TOAST created a dynamic website that shifts display, colour and lighting depending on the time of day you visit the site to showcase the varied experiences available on the ONE O ONE superyacht.

Non-Profit.name: Greenhouse
Non-Profit.tagline: Connected. We Co-Innovate for Climate Action.
Non-Profit.description: Greenhouse — Investible. Brand Visualisation. Connected. We Co-Innovate for Climate Action. The effects of climate change are becoming rapidly evident. Higher temperatures, prolonged natural disasters and rising sea levels forecast for the coming decades. However, with these pressing issues come new opportunities for growth and innovation. The rapidly growing climate-focused technology sector, or 'climate-tech,' is seen as the solution to mitigating the lasting effects of our changing climate, with climate-tech innovation giving rise to entirely new industries that may well determine the future of our planet. Located in Sydney's brand new Salesforce Tower and created by Venture Capital group Investible, Greenhouse is an innovation ecosystem dedicated to accelerating the collaboration, adoption and impact of climate technologies on a global scale. Their core focus is addressing the issues and opportunities introduced by Climate Change through new climate-tech solutions. As part of a government initiative with the City of Sydney, Greenhouse provides affordable space for Australian scaleups to accelerate their expansion and connect with like-minded groups, investors and partners across the globe. Their vision being to unite multidisciplinary knowledge and accelerate the businesses that will help us respond to pressing climate challenges and capitalise on the opportunities therein. Challenge: Working with key stakeholders of the Investible team, TOAST was engaged to strategically design Greenhouse's innovative brand identity, creating a footprint that will generate awareness and boost global consideration for its climate-tech offerings. The Greenhouse brand needed to be respected by diverse key stakeholders and gain credibility among corporate companies - their number one key stakeholder for success. Through fostering a culture formed on disruption, Greenhouse endeavours to create & strengthen new ideas, connections and businesses. It is a place for growth and has a mission to provide climate-focused technology companies with the right expertise and connections to scale. TOAST's brand footprint and visual identity needed to harness this innovative power and unwavering ambition - and communicate it on a global scale. Solution: Strategic industry analysis, research and stakeholder workshops informed Greenhouse's overall brand footprint, building a brand that is optimised for growth and ingrained with modernity and creativity. Connecting groups, companies and visions in a multidisciplinary ecosystem, Greenhouse introduces the potential to create vast change through the immense power that is harnessed when working together. For Greenhouse, this comes to life through the power of 'co-innovation'. Reflecting this core brand value, TOAST crafted the tagline "Connected. We co-innovate for climate action," capturing their brand purpose of connecting the dots between people, ideas, and ultimately, countries, to co-create innovative solutions that will mitigate the effects of climate change. We mirrored their highly prolific, climate-focused world in a visual identity that draws inspiration from the cycle of the sun, the 'warming stripes' climate barcode and soft colour gradients within nature. Our design concept reflects the innate power within our natural, interconnected ecosystem and translates it into the collaborative community that Greenhouse fosters. Mirroring the agility and creativity within the business itself, the Greenhouse branding suite is versatile and highly dynamic. To reflect the 'revolutionary' approach of the brand, we utilised a free form colour gradient across the logotype and brand iconography. This gradient, with each colour connecting to 'co-create' something new, reflects Greenhouse's unstructured, creative approach to tackling climate issues. Complementing this, a halftone effect is applied across the brand, a graphic approach which reflects the 'connecting the dots' culture within Greenhouse and the myriad elements which make up its purpose, reach and impact. Beyond the visual territory, we sought to imbue their brand values across all aspects of the Greenhouse identity, exploring eco-fonts and climate-focused digital design. An eco-font minimises the consumption of ink and paper in print applications, and can reduce power usage by 30% in digital applications on Organic LED screens (increased further in combination with black backgrounds). Gilroy was selected as the Greenhouse typeface. Its sans-serif structure connotes modernity and innovation whilst its compact, clean line design equates to smaller file storage and fewer pixels when digitally presented. The introduction of an eco-font to Greenhouse's branding suite allows for a holistic representation of their brand values and emphasises the forward-thinking approach of their business. With understanding of the interrelationship between Masterbrand and a series of supporting programs and venues, a brand architecture was devised by TOAST and executed across all sub-brands. The signature colour gradient element of the Greenhouse masterbrand logo then became the common visual thread to unite a series of sub-brands, collaborating to execute the organisation's overall mission, with verticals including a climate tech hub, commercialisation booster 'Amped', the 'Greenhouse Challenge' program, and branding for climate supporters and venture capital investors.

Non-Profit.name: United Nations
Non-Profit.description: United Nations — United Nations Association of Australia. A Movement to Move the World Forward. United in Action. The United Nations turned 80 this year. To mark the milestone, they were looking to host a once-in-a-generation conference at Sydney's Sheraton Grand Hotel. NGOs, business leaders, academics and civil servants – the UN wanted to bring them all together for a day of talks, networking, collaboration, and defining the organisation's role in the 21st century. And it was a big deal. Many giants of Australian politics, like Penny Wong, Australian Minister for Foreign Affairs and Dr Anne Aly MP, Minister for Small Business, International Development and Multicultural Affairs, were booked to speak at the event. Challenge: So how were we going to get people to sign up? In recent years, there's a perception that the UN hasn't done enough to solve the modern world's biggest challenges: be that inequality, instability, insecurity or anything in-between. This meant we had to convince people that the conference was worth their while, and that it would be a forum for genuine action (not just talks). A chance to actually get things fixed, in one place, on one day, under one roof. Solution: To solve this problem, we asked ourselves: what does the UN do best? The answer: they unite people (the clue is in their name). For decades, they've brought people together as an international forum to solve major global challenges, from eradicating smallpox and reducing extreme poverty to defining the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Our work reminded people of this superpower, positioning the conference as a rare opportunity to join forces with other leading thinkers and make a tangible impact through collective action. #UnitedInAction became the rallying cry for the event, with messaging that flexed across speaker topics ("Unite for Human Rights", "Unite for Wildlife", "Unite for Facts' Sake") and showed people that they'd be helping to solve a range of issues by taking part. The sense of unity linked up our design system, too. The logo showed three circles interlocking into a single dynamic shape and the individual executions displayed policymakers, gamechangers and humanitarians standing shoulder to shoulder in solidarity. The campaign worked. It was a full house. The atmosphere was electric. And the event played a pivotal role in building alliances and shaping plans of action in multiple industries. A fitting way to mark 80 years of the United Nations.

Non-Profit.name: Good Work Program
Non-Profit.description: Good Work Program. Governing Principles. CSR/ESG Framework. After working with Governing Principles to create the brand for their leading governance company, our teams partnered up again to enhance their brand new corporate brand with the development of a tailored CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) framework. This initiative aimed to elevate Governing Principles' business and align it with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) while addressing economic, social, and environmental challenges. Challenge: Governing Principles recognised the critical importance of good governance in driving organisational success alongside the paramount integration of CSR principles into their operations to foster a sustainable and equitable world by 2030. They reached out to TOAST to create a CSR framework that not only upheld their values of integrity, transparency and ethical conduct but also created a positive social impact for their stakeholders. The challenge lay in developing a program that effectively addressed economic, social, and environmental challenges while aligning with the UN's SDGs to bring longevity and actionable vision to their brand. Solution: TOAST worked closely with Governing Principles to develop their framework, which together we titled the 'Good Work Program'. This tailored framework consists of three core pillars: Good Ethics, Good Wellbeing, and Good Employment. Each pillar is designed to address specific aspects of CSR and is strategically linked to corresponding United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. 1. Good Ethics: This pillar emphasises transparency, accountability, and ethical behaviour in all aspects of operations, aligning with Goal 16 - Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions. 2. Good Wellbeing: Focused on ensuring healthy lives and promoting wellbeing for all stakeholders, this pillar aligns with Goal 3 - Good Health and Wellbeing. 3. Good Employment: This pillar promotes inclusive and sustainable economic growth, aligning with Goal 8 - Decent Work and Economic Growth. The design of the Good Work Program is an iconography set that draws directly from the graphic language of Governing Principles' corporate brand image. This approach enables optimum brand equity and positions their CSR framework as a core vertical of their business operations. The 'Good Work Program' not only enhances Governing Principles' brand reputation but also builds trust with stakeholders by actively contributing to sustainable development initiatives outlined by the United Nations. It demonstrates Governing Principles' commitment to excellence in corporate social responsibility while making a meaningful difference in their work environments and communities - showcasing how aligning with CSR principles can lead to enduring success in a thriving corporate ecosystem.

Non-Profit.name: United We Shine
Non-Profit.description: United We Shine. WWF Australia. Campaign Development. As the world shifts to a low carbon future, Australia has everything we need to take the lead and become a renewable energy export superpower. We've got endless sunshine, plenty of space, powerful winds, world-class expertise and strong trade relationships: it's a winning combination. The twin crises of the 2019/2020 bushfires and the Covid-19 pandemic have created a need for a recovery package that helps the country rebuild. WWF-Australia is calling on our leaders to make Australia the world's leading exporter of renewable energy by 2030. [Page contains no additional prose; the Challenge and Solution sections are present as labels only with no body text.]

Non-Profit.name: Innovation for Impact
Non-Profit.description: CSR/ESG Framework. Elevating the award winning strategic brand platform that TOAST completed for the Inovi team in 2023, our teams collaborated once again to embark on defining a tailored CSR framework that emulates the future-focused vision of the Inovi brand and the team behind it. Inovi is a prominent player in the commercial construction sector and introducing a CSR program to their business is leading them on a transformative journey towards sustainability and social responsibility. Strategised by TOAST through extensive workshopping sessions, their program "Innovation for Impact" is rooted in the pillars of 'In,' 'Ov,' and 'I,' and represents Inovi's commitment to integrating sustainability practices, prioritising employee wellbeing, and making a positive impact on communities and cities. Challenge: Introducing a CSR program to their business provides a framework for both their short and long term goals on both an internal and external level. The company recognised that merely transitioning to environmentally friendly procedures and materials wasn't enough; thus a comprehensive CSR strategy was what was needed to drive meaningful change across its business lines. Incorporating it into an already bustling business, TOAST faced the challenge of aligning Inovi's operations with sustainable practices while ensuring the wellbeing of its employees and positively impacting the communities it serves, all under the one program. Solution: Drawing on the similar rationale behind their brand name, the Inovi CSR program was titled "Innovation for Impact" and has three key verticals: 'In,' (Innovation at the Core) 'Ov,' (Overall Wellbeing of Our People) and 'I,' (Impact on Cities and Community). These respectively represent Inovi's commitment to integrating sustainability practices, prioritising employee wellbeing and making a positive impact on communities and cities. Ensuring we created a lasting, robust platform that gave the Inovi team vision and guidance in their CSR / ESG endeavours, each pillar is associated with 3 key United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, providing the Inovi team with a clear and actionable path. The double circle symbol of the Innovation for Impact program represents the Inovi brand through a trademarked icon. Carried through for the CSR program 'Innovation for Impact', this design injects Inovi's absolute dedication to creating a lasting, positive impact within their team and wider community as a key undercurrent of their brand identity. The primary CSR logo for Inovi employs a greyscale palette (warm & dark grey), culminating in a clean and distinct brand identity that effectively embodies the focus and commitment within the brand. When developed into the 3 pillars, brighter more recognisable tones are introduced. The colour palette for CSR remains consistent with the master brand, yet with modifications in colour hierarchy. Greys take on a more pronounced role, accompanied by the addition of the three colours specific to each category. This strategic approach enhances brand recognition and positions CSR as a distinct division of the business. Through the tailored CSR program, "Innovation for Impact," Inovi has successfully addressed the challenge of integrating sustainability, prioritising employee wellbeing, and making a positive impact on communities, but not as a one-off claim, as a framework with vision, longevity and lasting relevance. By embracing innovation, fostering a supportive work environment, and actively engaging with communities, Inovi sets a benchmark for responsible and sustainable business practices in the commercial construction industry.

Non-Profit.name: CAW.SYD
Non-Profit.description: Change Through Action. Climate Action Week Sydney 2024 (CAW SYD) was held from 13-19 May and is an annual, global event pulsating with activities in the heart of the City of Sydney. The week encompasses a series of community-led events from all aspects of the climate action ecosystem to bring together like minded individuals, groups and changemakers to amplify the discourse around climate action. As part of the dedicated brand/marketing planning committee including The Being Group, Edge Impact, Greenhouse and Investible, TOAST collaborated on the visionary development and delivery of 2024's Climate Action Week Sydney. Our team was instrumental in crafting the brand framework and identity for the event, a design so impactful that it has also been used for CAW SYD 2025. We are thrilled to see our vision continue to shape and inspire this vital movement. Challenge: The challenge for TOAST was to create a strategic framework and visual identity that captures the essence of Climate Action Week Sydney and resonates with diverse audiences. The goal was to foster an inclusive Australian Grassroots Movement engaging with all walks of life, promote connection, collaboration and commitment to supporting climate action and establish a distinctive CAW SYD identity solidifying Sydney's global leadership in sustainability. Solution: TOAST crafted a dynamic visual identity for CAW SYD that underscores the transformative beauty of change through action and the power of togetherness for a common goal. With a vibrant and adaptable colour scheme, this concept revolves around the collective power of societal action and displays the resounding transformations that can incur from even the simplest of movements. The design is elevated by dynamic graphic elements, infused with colour and emotion to underscore the wealth of opportunity inherent in Sydney's innovative cityscape and reveal the ideas, passion and vision abundant in the community. The strategic framework aimed to establish a platform for ongoing engagement and collaboration, emphasising traditional knowledge, engaging neighbouring nations and ensuring diverse, accessible initiatives, reflecting Sydney's global outlook. This framework underlines CAW SYD as a dynamic climate action event, uniting professionals and communities to engage in discussions and innovatively tackle global climate issues. With the strategic framework and visual identity created by TOAST, Climate Action Week Sydney has amplified the City of Sydney's role in addressing the urgent need for climate action. It embarks on a transformative journey toward becoming a green and inclusive city while fostering a Climate Action Ecosystem that engages all stakeholders and reflects Sydney's commitment to a sustainable future. TOAST is overjoyed to be a founding member of Climate Action Week Sydney and to be part of a growing network of Future Makers across the world.

Non-Profit.name: Earth Hour x EPSON
Non-Profit.description: A Simple Switch. Epson, world-leading printing and electronics manufacturer, is a trailblazer in the corporate world for their rigorous sustainability goals and measures. Their commitment to the environment began close to 80 years ago and is stronger than ever today. Their product designs and business decisions focus on low energy consumption, minimised waste, small environmental footprints, high reliability and minimal moving parts. Epson's environmentally focused vision coincides with the mission of WWF's annual campaign Earth Hour and that of our global branding team here at TOAST - all seeking to create a better, greener future for our planet. Bringing together these like minded teams, WWF Singapore and our TOAST team worked with Epson to spearhead a sub-campaign for Earth Hour 2024. As Earth Hour's first international corporate partner, the collaboration between Epson, TOAST and WWF has created an invaluable partnership as we embark on a mission to amplify Earth Hour's message and encourage collective action towards sustainability. Challenge: The primary challenge of this sub-campaign lay in rallying global, cross-demographic support and engagement to foster a unified movement towards a sustainable planet. Working across 3 time zones and uniting 20+ passionate individuals, TOAST, Epson and WWF-Singapore faced the task of inspiring individuals and communities worldwide to actively participate in Earth Hour's mission. Additionally, the emphasis on community involvement required strategies that resonated at both local and global levels. Collaboration across diverse stakeholders and aligning with Epson's existing initiatives, added depth and complexity to the project, necessitating seamless alignment of objectives and approaches. Solution: The sub-campaign for Epson was aptly named 'A Simple Switch', symbolising the small yet impactful changes all individuals can make to support environmental conservation efforts.
