Naturally, this involved a period of deep and thorough research, with our team devoting two months to a methodological audit and discovery process interviewing and aligning key stakeholders, before casting a net across the entire competitive property landscape — both nationally and internationally — a process of industry benchmarking and collecting insights. But it also required boundary-pushing bravery, and asking ourselves and our client: 'What could we do differently in the UX/UI space that hasn't been done before?' Solution: Creating compelling, relevant solutions relies on more than closed-door strategy and theoretical insight. In a process that was as much geared to stakeholder alignment as it was to discovery to ensure the rebuild pathway addressed genuine needs and objectives, TOAST conducted a series of one-on-one interviews with business founders, leaders, managers and operators from all levels of the organisation who contributed to our real-world understanding of the customer journey optimisation and user experience performance required to drive success. To deliver a website with a strong CRM focus to achieve targeted traction for Highland's multifaceted service offering, we customised the user database solution to create segmented consumer dimensions and user profiles to ensure the needs of target audiences were serviced with relevance in accordance to their individual likes, needs and preferences with a responsive, mobile-first design. Stakeholder interviews, site audits and accessibility tests and analytics tests were repeatedly run to ensure its performance efficacy and suitability to the business' needs. What resulted from deep analytical research and insight generation was so much more than a website. It was a robust lead-generation conversion funnel, seamlessly directing engagement towards relevant property solutions; an elevated mobile-first user experience to reflect the quality of Highland's team and brand, and a benchmark-raising digital destination to connect buyers, sellers, investors and developers, proudly leaving competitors in its wake.

Property.name: Uplifte
Property.tagline: Working with and for the best
Property.description: Working with and for the best. Uplifte, a vertical of Cozzcorp Group, is a pioneering property development company that operates with a unique ethos centred around creating value together. They are renowned for their holistic, end-to-end services that prioritise the needs and aspirations of their clients. With a mission to uplift people's lives through exceptional properties and ongoing relationships, Uplifte has positioned itself as the go-to developer in the industry. TOAST was engaged to create a brand identity and framework for their company that set them apart in the industry and communicated their extensive yet humble expertise. Challenge: TOAST recognised the need to craft a distinct identity that would capture Uplifte's commitment to holistic development and community-centric values. The challenge was to convey Uplifte's unique, client-centric approach and set them apart as the go-to developer for creating value together. Solution: TOAST's strategic branding solution centred on amplifying Uplifte's core values and strengths. Through meticulous research, interviews and client workshops, TOAST worked with their team to develop a brand identity that epitomised progression, innovation and trusted partnerships. The selection of the name 'Uplifte' for the property development vertical of Cozzcorp Group was a strategic decision rooted in the embodiment of key values: progression, success, improvement and growth. The name 'Uplifte' captures the essence of uplifting lives and communities through transformative developments, symbolising a commitment to positive change and advancement. The custom-designed wordmark and understated yet confident palette reflected Uplifte's commitment to excellence and their ability to deliver the best job, every time. Central to TOAST's strategy was the communication of Uplifte's holistic, end-to-end service and their focus on people and partnerships. By showcasing Uplifte's ability to navigate complex challenges and deliver beneficial developments, TOAST highlighted their expertise in property markets and community engagement. The strategic branding efforts culminated in the creation of a compelling tagline, "Working with and for the best," which encapsulates Uplifte's collaborative approach and commitment to consistent excellence. By strategically aligning Uplifte's brand identity with their values and strengths, TOAST has enabled Uplifte to differentiate themselves effectively and appeal as the preferred developer.

Property.name: The Colliery
Property.description: Home of Bespoke Experiences. Working again with the dedicated team at Inovi Projects, TOAST was challenged to create a luxe and alluring brand suite for a bespoke accommodation offering in a respectfully converted mining precinct, The Colliery. Situated in the midst of Australia's coveted Hunter Region, The Colliery stands as a testament to the seamless integration of history, luxury and natural beauty. Formerly known as the 'Paxton Colliery', this remarkable location is more than just a place to stay—it's an immersive experience that pays homage to the site's rich legacy while offering unparalleled hospitality in a setting of unparalleled natural splendour. Challenge: The transformation of the Paxton Colliery into 'The Colliery' presented a unique set of challenges. Firstly, there was a need to preserve the historical significance of the site, which bore the marks of its past as a thriving coal mine. Secondly, the project had to respect the traditional custodians of the land, while also creating a luxury destination that would attract and delight modern travellers. Balancing these elements while maintaining the integrity of the site's heritage required a delicate and strategic branding approach. Solution: To address these challenges, The Colliery project embraced a holistic approach that celebrated the site's heritage, honoured its traditional owners, and elevated the guest experience to new heights. This was translated by our team into the manifesto of 'The Home of Bespoke Experiences', capturing the stateliness of the site and echoing the myriad opportunities the destination beckons. The Colliery's architectural team approached the restoration of the site with meticulous care, ensuring that every aspect of the original buildings is to be respectfully preserved and elevated in a way that maintains the beautiful legacy of the structure. From the brickwork produced onsite to the timber milled in the sawmill, every element is to be retained to showcase the site's industrial heritage. Our team thus approached the branding in a similar vein; the colour palette, reminiscent of the surrounding natural landscape, was incorporated into the design to create a cohesive and immersive experience for guests that blends effortlessly into the time period of the site whilst introducing the desired level of absolute luxury to the converted space. Each building within The Colliery was reimagined to offer a unique and tailored experience for guests. From the Bath House to the Power House, Engine House, Fan House, Shed, and Dwelling, each venue was designed to showcase its individual character while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic that echoed the site's industrial past. TOAST's branding thus took on a 'brand architecture' approach, adapting the core brand to mould to each of the site's offerings. The result is a collection of branded spaces that seamlessly blend luxury with history, offering guests an unforgettable journey through time. The Colliery stands as a shining example of adaptive reuse done right—a luxury hotel that not only respects the site's legacy but also celebrates it at every turn. Our branding suite, incorporating the iconic chimney and the metalworks inherent to the site, and colouring that heroes the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape, perfectly complements the subtle reinterpretation of the site, integrating design aspects that are innate to the region whilst bringing an uplifted appeal of pure luxury and unforgettable experiences.

Property.name: Collection
Property.description: Artisans of Lifestyle. When a prospective buyer steps into your display suite, you only get one chance to make a first impression that could inspire the buy. When the stakes are that high, TOAST's creativity goes higher. Taking brand well beyond the page and screen, TOAST is proud to unveil Sammut Group's Collection Display Suite. Having worked in tandem with PBD Architects and Sammut Group through a brand-first design approach from the very foundation of this project, our teams collaborated to create an interactive display suite to introduce the public to Sammut's corporate brand and projects, primarily showcasing the uniqueness of latest development 'Vue'. Challenge: Stepping into an empty shell, TOAST initially collaborated with PBD Architects to map out and envisage a multi-zoned space which had the capability to showcase 1 hero project and 4 additional live projects at any one time, alongside Sammut's own 'Artisan Wall' paying tribute to the Group's history, achievements, accolades and awards to establish confidence and trust in the experienced development team. Devoted to Sammut's corporate identity, crafted by TOAST, this Group section of the display suite stems from their brand positioning as 'Artisans of lifestyle,' communicating their vision for redefining luxury through a considered, crafted approach. Solution: Following a deep immersion and leveraging a decade of understanding of the triggers influencing purchasing decisions, we engaged the DisplaySweet team to support us in showcasing all content digitally within the space. Together, we delivered a sophisticated multi-media, multi-project display hub, bringing to life over a decade of TOAST's best-practice sales suite design experience with cutting edge technology combining plate plans, 3D modelling and lifestyle video content with innovative environmental design to create a truly interactive experience supporting sales agents to convert. Featuring luxurious branding, signage, sales track functionality and informative, inspiring wall graphics along with multimedia branded video content, TOAST's in depth understanding of the property buyer's sales journey and UX understanding is equally on proud display.

Property.name: 120 Edward St
Property.description:
120 Edward St — DWS investment group. Brand Visualisation. Habitat at 120 Edward. 120 Edward st is an office building owned by DWS investment group in the heart of Brisbane. Located between the city’s Elizabeth and Charlotte Streets, it is in a prime luxury retail precinct lined with heritage buildings that are home to high end boutique offerings by Tag Heuer, Hugo Boss, Cartier, Hermes, and Mont Blanc. The site has many distinguishing attributes and unique usages of the space. It boasts a stylish, homely workplace design with open plan offices and flexible breakout spaces. There are landscaped outdoor balconies with bbq/bar installations on some levels, as well as freshly-appointed end-of-trip facilities available to all tenants. Thus the building actively embraces the latest working trend of open plan offices with bright, natural accents. Yet there are aspects of the site that remain under-utilised as well as a disconnect with the exterior branding, meaning there is an inherent lack of awareness of their brand and site offering.

Challenge: 120 Edward’s leasing experience is currently price and convenience driven, leaning on functional and rational building attributes, yet it is immediately evident that this site offers so much more. This however is un-communicated and thus unknown to the outside. TOAST were engaged to elevate the position of this modern building to corporate tenants and develop a higher-level brand proposition that appeals to the target audience, whilst being aware of their unique drivers and needs. There is a need for an emotive, themed marketing platform. With a fairly generic brand identity and marketing experience, the building lacks a compelling brand proposition to leverage and therefore lacks distinction from a crowded market. Plus, there is a need for a more inspiring proposition for the building, and an internal experience that brings this promise to life. To work closely to DWS’ vision, our team needed to focus on establishing a thematic brand proposition that supports the building identity for tenants, guests and the business community at large.

Solution: In researching the surrounding area, competitors, and immersing ourselves in the space, we highlighted key areas requiring attention to expand on the brand experience. The modernised office suite fit-outs promise a workplace adept with current trends, however the identity and arrival experience remained dull, dated and lacking in emotive theming. Thus there existed an overall disconnect between the internal on-trend offerings with the identity of the overall building offering. To bring new life to 120 Edward, we identified a need to elevate the arrival experience, giving tenants and visitors an opportunity to be enriched by the space as part of their working day. TOAST worked to create pride in the address by elevating the experience for tenants and guests. Our brand narrative for 120 Edward focused on the creation of value and awareness for the building by amplifying the building’s existing green theme as a welcome retreat for the city. Introducing 120 Edward as more than a desk; as a green workplace it is a daytime retreat to work, meet or recharge. This thought analysis lead to the big idea ‘Habitat at 120 Edward’. Habitat at 120 Edward is a place where productivity and purpose exist in harmony with cool, green spaces. Where inspired, modern workplaces reside within a green enclave, to be enjoyed by all. This is a building that supports the working day with healthy, vibrant and modern spaces that inspire fertile thinking and growth. This idea aligns with our society’s changing nature of work. We are not tied to our desks from 9-5; we need areas to recharge, environments that inspire and spaces that are conducive with enjoyable and collaborative productivity. 120 Edward was rebranded as a space offering precisely this.

Property.description:

Comprising designer apartments across 8-storeys, state-of-the-art facilities, and curated retail boutiques including one of Sydney’s largest Harris Farm Markets, it is the intersection of splendour and contemporary convenience. A place where coastal luxury meets urban grandeur, it is a destination that is set to define Cronulla. The vision for this site was to create a lifestyle unlike anything ever seen before in Cronulla, a ‘one-of-a-kind’ interwoven expression of the best aspects of a coastal lifestyle harmoniously combined to create an iconic statement for the future. Building on this vision and the development’s underplayed sophistication, our team crafted the Big Idea ‘The Perfect Blend’; marrying luxe living with urban simplicity and seamlessly integrating resort-style amenities into contemporary dwellings, Vue is an interwoven expression of the best aspects of ocean view living, harmoniously combined with contemporary urban charm. This brand philosophy speaks true to Sammut Group’s mission to deliver an elevated design vision achieving the perfect harmony between the building forms, the people, and the natural world of Cronulla. Mirroring PBD’s architectural approach and Mim Design’s interior visualisations, our designers worked closely with Sammut Group to craft Vue’s brand identity as an amalgamation of attributes and cues inspired by its coastal location. The sense of expanse and perspective, the cultural connection and the ripple effect of the tides all combine to create landmark influences that radiate across the landscape, as reflected in Vue’s name and timeless visual identity. The identity became a creative launchpad for amplification of a sophisticated suite of lead generation and sales support elements including a luxurious coffee table book, a brochure suite, digital and physical advertising campaign, website and digital-led display suite fit out, produced in close collaboration with sales agents Highland, PR team Left Field and marketers The Collective Co. A cornerstone of the creative campaign and marketing materials was sophisticated lifestyle photography and video content, directed and produced on location by TOAST. Showcasing the effortless luxury of coastal living, a two-day photoshoot captured a series of vignettes from yoga at dawn to cocktails at dusk with dozens of spontaneous moments enjoying salt, sea air and sun in between.

Result: Inspired by nature, infused with luxury, engineered for lifestyle; Vue is an elevated vision achieving the perfect blend of coastal and urban style, setting a new benchmark for coastal living.

Property.name: Escape
Property.description:
Escape — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Live Beyond Boundaries. Luxury property development group ‘Luxcon’ is renowned for delivering highly acclaimed projects that surpass expectations and raise the bar for residential luxury living. Their latest beachfront project on the Gold Coast’s Garfield Terrace is no exception. As part of their recently launched ‘Coastal Collection,’ the site at 63-65 Garfield Terrace is a study in contemporary elegance and an unrivalled waterfront urban sanctuary. Positioned on the cusp of Surfers Paradise, a destination buzzing with vibrant nightlife, oceanview dining, contemporary art and a beautiful connection to the natural landscape, their vision was to build an idyllic place that is designed around reconnecting with your environment, your loved ones, and yourself. Crafted by acclaimed architectural firm PBD Architects, Luxcon’s development comprises 28 deluxe penthouse-style apartments with uninterrupted 360-degree ocean and hinterland views - combining the sophistication of ocean-front glamour with timeless beachy serenity. Having previously worked on successful developments with both teams, TOAST was engaged as the branding agency to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development for this deluxe destination. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: Luxcon’s creative mission for their luxury residential offering was to deliver a world of beachfront bliss which redefines coastal living in the Gold Coast. Communicated through the unique architectural form, their development sets out to harmonise the ubiquitous edge of city charm with the freedom and relaxation innate to beachfront living, introducing a level of contemporary design that is unseen in the Gold Coast. TOAST’s challenge was to develop a unique brand design to communicate the building’s unmatched opulence and a place identity which was bolstered with competitive longevity against the Gold Coast’s ever-growing luxury property market. Luxcon envisioned an iconic place, one which marries inspired architecture with the natural beauty of the Gold Coast; a highly unique destination designed for residents to ‘escape’. Through branding, TOAST needed to craft this visionary story and create an enviable beachfront oasis.

Solution: As embodied in its name, Escape is a place offering freedom and sanctuary from daily routine. Having space to reset, reflect and recharge is integral in life - values which were at the core of our placemaking principles. Building on these ideals, our team devised the tagline ‘Live beyond boundaries.’ Not only does this expression complement the qualities of flight and freedom innate to the development’s name, it also reflects the building’s visionary and expansive architectural facade. Bridging urban design with a coastal lifestyle, Escape’s contemporary architectural form oozes sophistication and showcases character that expresses striking individuality in its contextual coastal scene. ‘Live beyond boundaries,’ and the very essence of Escape, embodies these values by delivering a place of contemporary beauty and absolute luxury unmatched on the Gold Coast. Taking inspiration from PBD’s contemporary architectural design which elegantly echoes a boundless winglike form and sleek ripple symmetry, our team designed the Escape logo to mimic the broad wingspan of a bird in flight and the sleek grandeur of the building’s entrance. Marrying its architectural design and core values of flight and freedom, Escape epitomises contemporary beachfront beauty; it is a place which inspires future residents and their visitors by providing them sanctuary from daily routine. Towering above the Gold Coast skyline, Escape is a study of urban decadence. Full-floor privacy, personal concierge services and eclectic luxe architecture; it offers the finest in resort-style luxury living. Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape is to deliver an exclusive life of luxury, balance and freedom. This Place Mission is encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery with connotations of freedom and flight, and a beautiful reflection of the expanse of its building form. Concurrent to the acquisition of 63-65 Garfield Terrace, Luxcon landed a prime development opportunity in Byron Bay, the launch of which was shared with Escape as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography, alongside the production team, XMEDIA. The colour palette across Escape’s branding suite was designed for two visual territories, a primary ‘Night’ palette of Charcoal, Gold and Chalk, the depth of which reflects the ocean, sand and moonlight under an evening sky, and a secondary ‘Day’ palette of Mint Green, Cream and Chalk, capturing the serene colours of the sea, sand and sun. Encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery, the wingspan connoting life, flight and liberty whilst beautifully reflecting the expanse of the building form, our Place Visioning and Brand Identity reflect Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape to be an enviable oasis, delivering an exclusive life of balance, freedom and inspiration.

Property.name: Bohemian
Property.description:
Bohemian — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Life is Beautiful. Luxury developers ‘Luxcon,’ are renowned for delivering projects that surpass expectations and quantify the true meaning of luxury. Acquiring an enviable site at 90-96 Jonson St in the midst of Byron Bay’s town centre, their vision was to bring to life a destination that encapsulates the intangibly tantalising essence of Byron Bay, whilst paying homage to the beauty of the world that oft-inspires their visionary projects. Byron Bay is a place unmatched in its laid back sophistication. Encapsulating the epitome of barefoot luxury, it is a beachfront locale ever the envy of the globe. Luxcon’s development, designed by PBD Architects, was set to be a luxury offering; 44 serene two and three bedroom apartments, exclusive rooftop amenities and an idyllic meander to Byron’s beachfront, for which TOAST was engaged to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: TOAST designs places to work, to live, to come and to come back… we craft compelling stories built on human experiences, culture, landscape, public art and wayfinding. It was with this strategic branding expertise that our team was tasked to ideate the core identity for Luxcon’s development. In a buzzing location that is just moments from the beautiful coastline of Byron Bay, the precinct design for 90-96 Jonson St complements this beachside area’s vibrant community feel. Its worldly touch, through its open-air courtyards, walkable laneways, and interaction with the natural environment, creates an enviably intriguing atmosphere and brings new life to this public realm. With deep strategic research, founded on understanding the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends, global competitors and nearby developments, our team understood that 90-96 Jonson St’s branding and overall place vision needed to seamlessly integrate into the existing Byron environment, remaining on par with the local fashion and beliefs, whilst introducing an air of class and sophistication to elevate the town’s main strip.

Solution: As a name, Bohemian captures the urban and laid-back artistic sophistication of Byron Bay. This destination is a reimagining of home and hospitality that welcomes families and free spirits. Marrying the refined simplicity of a European lifestyle with the blithe and trendy air of Byron; Bohemian was created with a vision to introduce a place to connect, dream and inspire. Mirroring this place ethos, our chosen tagline ‘Life is Beautiful’ expresses the laid-back and eclectic way of life that Bohemian makes its own. Encapsulating the spirit of travel and a taste for exploration and discovery were core to our place-making ethos. Through our brand design, TOAST sought to connect Byron Bay’s coastal way of living with Luxcon’s “Of the World” lifestyle by creating an iconic and unique place; a world where you are grounded, safe and free. Across the brand, our conceptual framework paid homage to Bohemian’s unique architectural form and the contemporary beachside atmosphere unique to Byron Bay. Creating a custom font, with grid lines reflecting its architectural design, the weighted gradient of the building structure and the design’s united feminine and masculine features introduce an organic sense of balance. The logotype is bold as it is subtle, forging the perfect balance between worlds. The stacked structure of the hierarchical logotype layout is replicated for the precinct’s two sub-brands, Plaza and Spice Lane. The identifiable Bohemian logotype is enlarged above, with the sub-brand at the base, maintaining brand equity by remaining uniformly identifiable. Concurrent to the acquisition of 90-96 Jonson St, Luxcon landed a beachfront development opportunity in the Gold Coast, the launch of which was shared with Bohemian as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography. These assets showcased the values at the core of Bohemian’s branding, forging a diptych of harmonised natural elements and vibrant interactions which deliver a place to reset, enjoy and love. Bohemian’s branding suite encapsulates the efficacious, free spirit of Byron Bay. With a neutral colour palette drawn from the dusty-gold of the sand and pure monochromes of the building facade, Bohemian’s campaign assets create an enduring connection to the coast and mirror the natural hues of each meticulously designed apartment. Bohemian is a home that overflows with the alluring aura of Byron. Complementing its contemporary-classical architectural style inspired by renowned beachside towns; Bohemian’s strategic brand assets and visual identity deliver a place with a perfect balance between beach and city life.

Property.name: Highlife
Property.description: Highlife. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage One. Wentworth Point's newest high life. At TOAST, we empower places by providing compelling brand footprints that allow audiences to understand the unique attributes and purposes of the spaces they experience, and our work with Sekisui House demonstrates the success of our approach. In 2016, Sekisui House purchased the 9.4 hectare site that would become Sanctuary. TOAST was brought on board at the project inception stage, working closely with Sekisui House and key architects to immerse ourselves in the site and the region. This process uncovered key insights that would shape the future identity of the masterplanned community. Crafting the core vision and essence of Sanctuary from the project's very inception was a brand-first approach that delivered outstanding outcomes. Challenge: In-depth auditing of the site revealed that a unique characteristic of Sanctuary is the fact that it is completely surrounded by nature, with wetlands, water, and parkland encircling the masterplan's location. The wonder of its geographical positioning paired terrifically with buyer-insights. Market research identified that the top two considerations of Wentworth Point buyers were "safety and security" and "a desirable location". Thus, these insights played a key influence in the creation of Sanctuary's brand identity and the delivery of its First Stage, coined 'Landing'. Landing's delivery consisted of 2 statuesque buildings, home to 364 beautiful, masterfully-built apartments designed for indoor-outdoor living with state-of-the-art appliances and modern finishes. The 'High Life' lifestyle that Landing encapsulates is underpinned by balance and harmony in a community that's perfectly situated to take advantage of the best that Greater Sydney has to offer. The complete synergy between the architecture and natural surroundings established a fantastic standard of living and is an embodiment of the core principles and brand design of Sanctuary. It is this essence of Sanctuary, encompassing balance, harmony, nature and community, that TOAST joined Sekisui House in strategically defining. Each design element is intrinsically linked to natural influences, and demonstrates Sanctuary's vibrant yet calming place identity that lets people live their everyday lives to the fullest. Solution: Landing, and Sanctuary as a whole, offer a unique, integrated living experience. The masterplan community features an oasis of vibrant spaces encompassing all states of being: play, reflection, energy and sustainability. This approach has resulted in a rich, purposeful living experience that integrates the site's core elements of nature, water and sky. TOAST reflected these core elements in the precinct's colour palette and collateral asset design. The colour palette of the 'Landing' logo variant, consists of gold and charcoal. With warm hues and a darker tint these colours are both bold and soft, encapsulating the ever-evolving nature of the world around us. The woody tones within this palette blended with the movement of the cyclical logotype reflect the beautiful evolution that occurs in our environment and beautifully represents the Sanctuary ethos of 'one with nature'. In the launch of Landing, TOAST worked with Sekisui House on a series of targeted social media posts, building intrigue and awareness of this new destination in Wentworth Point. This campaign was centred around the concept of living the 'High Life,' promoting the precinct's connectivity to the city, proximity to a world class entertainment hub and the expansive waterfront views creating a luxurious lifestyle that is immersed in nature. Adapting to the Covid-19 rules and gathering limits, TOAST and Sekisui House pivoted and used the campaign as an opportunity to promote exclusive private tours of the apartments, allowing their off-the-plan purchases to continue to thrive. This safe, tailored approach to sales tied back to the buyer insights our teams established and permitted the desirable location of Sanctuary to continue to be experienced for all interested parties. The success of Landing as Stage 1 of Sanctuary was recognised at the 2021 Urban Taskforce awards, winning a Development Excellence Award in the 'High-rise Development Metro' category.

Property.name: Community
Property.description: Community. Sekisui House. Sanctuary Masterplan. A place for all. The Sekisui House philosophy 'Love of Humanity', integrated with the ancient Japanese cultural principle of Satoyama 'Harmony between the environment and nature,' has guided Sanctuary's design to reflect the benefits of co-dependence between people, nature, and the built environment. Sanctuary places a deep respect for community at the heart of its design and development. It's about weaving nature throughout, the connectivity to the residents, and linkages to the broader community and Sydney as a whole. With a key focus on 'Michi' or 'Spatial Design Experience' Sanctuary's brand has emerged with the need to evolve and appeal to become a centre of life for people. The incorporation of design, innovation and technology with the natural surroundings through the facilities, landscapes and amenities, plays an essential role in the uniqueness of Sanctuary. Vibrant, fulfilling interactions between people, place and nature bring to life a beautiful spirit of community that occurs within and beyond its boundaries. Challenge: The vision for Sanctuary was to create a masterplanned community where a genuine respect for nature is reignited, and where a harmonious relationship between people and built form is nurtured; Sanctuary is a space that is designed to facilitate community connection. Sekisui House's core design principles and community-building ethos uplift the offering of this masterplan and introduce endless benefits that will elevate the lives of all in Wentworth Point. Maximising parkland within the site, expanding retail opportunities, integrating public transport and offering a calendar of community events at the foreshore park; what was once merely the end of the road is now becoming the heart of a revitalised community. Along with creating opportunities for community activity, the connection to the landscape offers boundless benefits to mental and physical health. By delivering a unique residential and community precinct that is at one with nature, Sanctuary will help its residents experience enriched, fulfilling lives that evolve with time and last for generations. Solution: To encapsulate the deep community spirit that Sekisui House has created through Sanctuary, TOAST crafted the tagline 'A place for all,' championing the neighbourly connections and inclusive atmosphere that Sanctuary fosters. This masterplan generates coexistence and co-prosperity by increasing the amount of public open space, and interactive activity areas for the whole community of Wentworth Point to enjoy. Offering more than 6 football-field's worth of public parkland and open space, over 4km of cycling and pedestrian-friendly paths, and with 34% of the entire masterplan dedicated to public green space, Sanctuary is undeniably alive with experiences and possibilities. This is a precinct designed to facilitate community connection, neighbourly interaction, and easy engagement with your native environment. Reflecting the core brand values of 'vibrant interactions' and 'comfortable living,' this approach delivers a unique experience for residents and the greater community, creating cohesion and instilling life, energy & vibrancy.

Property.name: 180 Queen St
Property.description: 180 Queen St. DWS Australia. Brand Visualisation. The Bank of Ideas. DWS Australia is an investment company focused on providing investment solutions and direct real estate assets to clients both locally and internationally. They are the investment company behind Queensland's beautiful and iconic 180 Queen St; a piece of the state's history and its future. This landmark trophy asset is in a dominant position in one of Australia's highest performing retail malls surrounded by city defining developments. In the centre of Brisbane, it offers a connected address within walking distance to Brisbane's urban attractions. The building hosts 6 Levels of private office suites with unique floor layouts and charming heritage features, such as ornate marble interior stairwells. Challenge: Blessed with a beautiful heritage site, TOAST was tasked to develop an activation concept to bring this location to life. Our team needed to create an identity and campaign platform to support 180 Queen St's entire leasing program. To reach the requirements of DWS' leasing campaign, we needed to clearly define the thought-process and behaviours of the key audiences in order to define the ideal product & marketing experience. In addition to this, our campaign needed to breathe new life and bring deep purpose to the heritage building. It is a dignified and chic site with immense history, this needed to be respected and appropriately capitalised on to attract new tenants to the space. Solution: In delving into the solution space, TOAST looked into the site's strengths and weaknesses and where there were opportunities for elevation. We identified there was a disconnect between the external presence and internal atmosphere of the building. Accompanying this, we identified that certain rational elements on their website, such as pricing, services, and amenities, were not readily available. This detracted from the user experience and was a potential demotivator for interested buyers. These insights provided us with valid perspective; we needed to uplift the customer experience. To achieve the customer experience uplift, we uncovered 180 Queen St's competitive advantages, identified an audience seeking this proposition, shaped the offer to appeal to the target audience and created a prioritised plan for implementation & execution. To create the identity for 180 Queen St that DWS was seeking, we embedded the customer journey with a sense of energy and inspiration, to attract interest and commitment from better quality tenants. TOAST created a holistic approach to redefine 180 Queen St, positioning it as a point of intersection for those seeking space to work, create, and meet; we sought to appeal to the core drivers of potential tenants. Our campaign presented 180 Queen St as a site with an eclectic mix of curated tenants utilising quaint, affordable office space that is ideal for creative studios and artisan workshops. This repositioning appeals to the increase in creative and start-up industries and breathes new life into an iconic, heritage location. The big idea, 'The Bank of Ideas' presents 180 Queen St as the place where Brisbane's brightest minds congregate.

Property.name: Altis
Property.description: Altis. Brand Transformation. Work That Works. Altis is an architectural firm based in Sydney. Through combining both architecture and interior design principles, Altis creates gathering places that people love, and where businesses thrive; the driving force behind their business being to create unique hospitality, club and living destinations that communities embrace. They are passionate about helping hospitality and living businesses excel and enhance the lives of the people in their local communities. Altis expertly delivers multi-disciplined business solutions by integrating architecture, interior design, strategy and deep local immersion. However, this passion and expertise was not evidenced in their brand territory. Their actions were progressing beyond the public face of their brand, which needed to change. Challenge: Our team was presented with the challenge of refreshing and elevating the Altis brand to reflect their market-leading stature and growing reputation in the architecture and design realm. At TOAST, we attest that a brand governs how you make an impact on the world. It leaves lasting memories on the people who interact with it. For Altis, our task was thus to cleanly define and effectively articulate their proposition. This involved increasing the understanding of the firm's expertise and projects and boosting awareness of the value within their services. Solution: Altis creates strategic solutions in response to diverse business challenges. They transform places into unique destinations by designing elevated experiences for business success. In reaching the core of this branding challenge, our team had to unwind Altis' business strengths and opportunities, delve into similar market leaders and audit their factors of success, all to rearticulate and strengthen the brand footprint and principles of the Altis brand. The fundamental strength our team consistently uncovered was that Altis has a unique business vision that works. Through a tailored approach with holistic integration, their design solutions enable growth and create impact. TOAST captured this transformative service in their new logotype and brand image. The logotype concept builds upon the previous logo's heritage with minimalist, clean-cut design language to capture the precise, technical backbone of the brand. Exuding a considered and crafted feel, the branding combines structural lines with subtle curves that convey Altis' professionalism. Meanwhile, the overlapping colours in the "A" hint at a process of transformation. This concept combines a powerful burgundy with a solid charcoal in a sophisticated palette that can be translated through the brand's marketing collateral. Altis' uplifted brand territory and visual identity has been refined to elevate the experiential luxury and functionality they expertly deliver across major commercial and hospitality projects.

Property.name: Escarp
Property.description: Escarp. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. A place of outspoken beauty. LAPropertyCo is a development & property group known for their innovative designs that deliver excellence and cultivate maximum return. As a company, they have a history of development and investment in established markets, with their success underpinned by their ability to identify emerging trends and opportunities, particularly within Sydney. The group's core strategy is to acquire and develop high-quality residential and mixed-use buildings that deliver maximum value, both for the company and to the surrounding community. The high achieving property group acquired a site in the Northern Sydney suburb of Northbridge; a gateway project to feature 19 oversized luxury apartments offering expansive Sydney CBD views and an unrivalled lifestyle in one of the Lower North's most historic suburbs. Challenge: For their new site acquisition and property vision, TOAST was engaged to create the brand footprint and place narrative. This residential site was envisioned as a place appealing to the essence of sophisticated Lower North Shore living, embracing the surrounding delights of its stunning Northbridge setting and boasting uninterrupted views of Sydney's vibrant city skyline and picturesque surrounds. Through our strategic design, we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client's expectations. To achieve these outcomes, the brand needed a strong feel of exclusivity and a very aspirational proposition to engage and elicit interest of to-be residents. It needed to be recognised as the next highlight of the Lower North Shore. Solution: To accurately reflect LAPropertyCo.'s visions, TOAST delved into the history of the suburb, the surroundings, the intention for the project and the placemaking approach. We drew key inspiration from the sophisticated and high-end lifestyle of Northbridge and its neighbouring suburbs. Further to this, front and centre of our ideation and design thinking processes were the end-consumers. Our team took the time to delve into their motivations, desires and ambitions, leading to an understanding that they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, ease and tranquility. Additionally, the site is cradled by precincts of style, sophistication and urban polish. Anticipating that residents will quickly become accustomed to the many local conveniences on offer led to the creation of 'Escarp,' a precinct of outspoken beauty presented as the ultimate address where all conveniences are at your command. Escarp is a place made for the indulgence of grand living, for residents to experience the art of exceptional living. To underpin these ideals, for the branding assets of Escarp we settled on a deep blue with copper highlights to build a sense of simple sophistication and high-quality elegance.

Property.name: Xavier Knight
Property.description: Xavier Knight. Brand Transformation. Life is Multiplied. Established 10 years ago, engineering consultancy firm Xavier Knight aim to raise the standard of engineering services currently available in our built environment. The company combines the capabilities of a Tier 1 consultancy with a dynamic, proactive approach to collaboration and design. They work on an array of engineering projects, across structural and civil construction engineering through to modern digital engineering in a 3, 4 and 5D scope. Their team and endeavours are constantly expanding. TOAST was engaged to represent this in a brand footprint that is fit for their growing and progressive vision. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to bring new life to Xavier Knight's brand identity. The brand's positioning had to emphasise their uniquely people-centric, progressive values, whilst reflecting their professionalism and credibility. This positioning would be launched through a 30-second impact video at a UDIA industry event, and further established through collateral including a website, capability statement and tendering document. Solution: TOAST's interview and brand audit process uncovered a clear insight: that Xavier Knight's core purpose was 'to enrich life and the world we live in'. This insight, coupled with the firm's 'X' brandmark, inspired our Big Idea 'Life is Multiplied'. This statement reflects Xavier Knight's intentions to enrich lives and amplify outcomes. This idea was brought to life in an attention-grabbing 30-second impact video, using the 'X' as a multiplication symbol in a series of brand claims. The entire suite of collateral, from website to official documentation, builds upon this idea. A predominantly black and white palette maintains professionalism and consistency with prior brand positioning. However, people-centric imagery, strategic hero messaging and splashes of colour ensure that the brand is given a sense of life and vitality. TOAST has enjoyed creating a brand identity that gives justice to Xavier Knight's unique, people-centric positioning.

Property.name: Muse
Property.description: Muse. Brand Transformation / Site Activation. Inspired Minds. MUSE, known as the House of Inspired Minds, is based in a 5-storey heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's iconic, city-fringe suburb Surry Hills. The neighbourhood's industrial buildings date back to the 1840's. It was during the 1920's that it became home to generations of working-class Chinese immigrant tailors and seamstresses serving the thriving rag trade, and later it became the headquarter of The Chinese Republic Newspaper. Their vision was to challenge the status quo and unlock new and effective ways to work, inspiring bespoke and impactful events and experiences, every single day. Today, MUSE is a different kind of community. In 2017, the building was transformed into a private creative community, combining the industrial heritage of yesteryear with the best of both original architecture and sophisticated, innovative interior design. Challenge: MUSE is now home to creative entrepreneurs and businesses and is an inspiring home for creators in design, film, fashion, branding, architecture, art, journalists and copywriters. MUSE prides itself on offering a private and exclusive space for its members with a focus on innovation and relationship building. MUSE is a space for those looking to take their business to the next level, putting life back into the workplace allowing people to become the best version of themselves. TOAST was engaged by MUSE to style their brand message and convey their holistic business offering. A prime heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's desirable Surry Hills, our team was tasked with crafting their brand narrative to assist the leasing of these bespoke work spaces. Solution: In unravelling this challenge, TOAST worked to unwind the business strengths, opportunities and its factors for success to design the MUSE brand footprint. MUSE is a place that challenges. A place that expands your mind and inspires ideas. This led TOAST to define their brand narrative "Inspired Ideas". Muse gets you moving; a place that creates the next level you, where you can collaborate and co-create in a house built of inspired minds. TOAST focused on the empowerment and autonomy MUSE provides its members; going beyond the co-working and office category by seamlessly integrating work & life in a unique, unexpected and rewarding offering. The end result is a bold and inspiring space that brings co-working to life. It is for those looking for renewal and excitement; to take their business to the next level. TOAST, in collaboration with the award-winning architect Vince Alafaci and acclaimed interior designer Caroline Chocker of ACME & Co (The Grounds of Alexandria), helped create an inspired, collaborative and creative workspace that could offer an experience, and a way of working that other co-working spaces are not providing. The team created an understated and luxurious aesthetic that sweeps effortlessly across spaces from meeting rooms and breakout areas on each level to the private courtyard, rooftop garden, the internal library of architecture and design, and across all amenities. The MUSE project was awarded with Silver at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards in the Interior Design - Co-Working & Studio Space category.

Property.name: Hutch & Hutch
Property.description: Hutch & Hutch. BridgeLane. Place Visioning. A Place of Beauty. Boutique developer BridgeLane embarked upon a significant and enviable design challenge; converting a warehouse into a home. Their efforts and expertise are revealed in their site Hutch & Hutch, in Sydney's Surry Hills. BridgeLane extended and redesigned the historic warehouse to offer a modernised collection of unique apartments of up to 3-bedrooms. They created a unique building, combining original warehouse features with contemporary design, breathing new life into a luxury residence. Challenge: TOAST was challenged with defining the vision and essence of BridgeLane's new project. Enviably positioned in Surry Hills, Hutch & Hutch's brand image needed to compliment the trendy, vibrant appeal of this city-fringe neighbourhood. Solution: Combined with the location's unique history - the site of Australia's first vinyl record plant - for this project, TOAST took inspiration between the parallels of nostalgia and new. Drawing on the creative flair of the location, and the surrounding streets of Hutchinson Street and Hutchinson Lane, TOAST started with the name, and took it from there, developing a branding platform that took the boutique development to a new level of distinction. Our company was awarded REA brand campaign of the year for its collaboration with BridgeLane and award-winning architects SJB and CBRE.

Property.name: Laguna & Glade
Property.description: Laguna & Glade. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage Two. Life Ever Changing. The Sanctuary masterplan in Wentworth Point offers an ever-changing life experience through people, culture and the environments within. Following the completion and success of ‘Landing,’ Stage 1 of Sanctuary, the masterplan is moving forward to its second stage. Positioned to be overlooking the Parramatta River and bordering the neighbourhood green, Stage 2 lies at the very centre of Sanctuary's vibrant community estate and encompasses three new elements, the Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club. Consisting of 171 premium waterside apartments centred around lush open spaces and a multilevel wellbeing facilities building - Revive, the Laguna and Glade residences achieve perfect synergy with nature. This stage is beautifully designed to allow an inside-out communication between landscape and architecture. Embracing the calm, curious flow of the Parramatta River and the best of international living standards, these developments have been designed to allow seamless communication between the surrounding natural landscape and modern architecture. Challenge: As Laguna, Glade and Revive are staged additions in a large-scale masterplan, as opposed to standalone developments, it was imperative that the Sanctuary property branding and strategic vision remained as the common thread that ties all elements together. As, to remain an authentic and highly-regarded brand, it is key to present a united image with a consistent and clear message. Harmony, vibrancy, a sense of calm and liveability are fundamental attributes defining a sanctuary and are wonderfully evident in this Stage 2 development. The Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club bring newfound energy and life to the Sanctuary precinct. Aligned and connected with the overall branding and message of Sanctuary’s masterplan, Laguna and Glade have an infectious spirit. In the heart of the precinct, bookended by both the river and neighbourhood green, these spaces weave beautifully into their natural surrounds and offer occupants a space that is liveable and abundant in lively characteristics. As elements within the Sanctuary masterplan brand, Laguna, Glade and Revive are similarly identifiable by the unique kaleidoscopic logotype. In creating this gracefully fragmented circular imagery, TOAST was inspired by the fundamental principles within Japanese design, such as simplicity, understated beauty and tranquillity. It’s an intricate but elegant wreath, a symbol which ties all elements of Sanctuary together. Solution: Laguna and Glade are highly anticipated boutique developments on the water’s edge offering a serene living experience in the heart of Sanctuary. Across both buildings, nature acts as a bridge between the apartments and the wider landscape, creating an unrivalled living experience where nature and urban living seamlessly integrate. The harmony and communication between our inside and outside worlds is a fundamental element within Sanctuary’s brand footprint, making this masterplan evermore unique. The fluidity of Laguna’s logo variant captures the sense of calm and serenity that the building exudes. The malleable, rejuvenating qualities of water are captured in the building's architecture and are further conveyed in this logo's expression. As for Glade, this logo variant is heavily flora-inspired and integrates natural influences throughout its design. The striking green textural pattern conveys this sense of vitality, promising a life that is energetic and connected to nature. Further, Revive's logo takes the aqueous territory introduced with Laguna and pushes it further. Centred around the uniquely styled, revitalising pool that is a core foundation of the building's offerings, this logo treatment fully reflects the tranquil, restorative qualities of the health club it represents. The Stage 2 triad is an extension of the refuge that is Sanctuary and delivers a beautifully unique experience for residents and the wider community. A space that is in harmony with nature, abundant in vibrant interactions, epitomises comfortable living and offers a fulfilled life experience.

Property.name: Highland
Property.tagline: We Are More Than Just Property
Property.description: Highland. Brand Transformation. “We Are More Than Just Property”. Highland Property Group (HPG) is a full-service real estate group with myriad offerings including residential, commercial, property management, financial services and project marketing. Founded in 2007 by David Highland, the company has grown drastically with an ever-evolving approach to real estate, redefining the industry and positioning themselves as a leader in the Sutherland Shire property market. Challenge: Outperforming their competitors in leasing and property sales, HPG provide a high-level of service and have a strong presence in the St George and Sutherland Shire regions. The challenge that TOAST was tasked to reach through strategic brand messaging, was, how are we going to win the battle and engage the market beyond Southern Sydney and become a national player in the real estate industry? Solution: Highland Property Group (HPG) needed to become bigger, stronger and increasingly performant in new locations. TOAST worked to strengthen and future-proof their brand to be even more unique and recognisable for HPG to resonate across multiple target groups, services and locations. Ultimately, reaching nationwide. The strategic findings of our research uncovered that HPG effectively push the boundaries and the breadth of services offered in the real estate industry to improve the overall customer experience. Their customers are supported throughout the whole process, from beginning to end, providing the confidence that they will be looked after in their real estate decisions. This enabled TOAST to encapsulate the HPG brand narrative: “We build trusted relationships that last for a lifetime”. TOAST’s direction was to shift customers’ perception. HPG are more than just property; they have the confidence to go for it. They build long-lasting, trusted relationships, create unique customer experiences and deliver rewarding, premium results.

Property.name: Sammut Group
Property.description: Sammut Group. Brand Elevation. Artisans of Lifestyle. Sammut Group is a property development company offering luxurious residential and commercial properties, with an unparalleled scope of service and expertise backed by 30 years of experience in the development and construction industry. They have a strong business presence and have achieved great success in the Sutherland Shire, providing high-end mixed-use developments which positively impact the life of residents, communities and surrounding businesses in the area. However their presence beyond this region of Sydney was less impactful, something they sought to change. Challenge: TOAST was presented with the challenge; How are we going to become an even stronger, leading player across multiple business lines, targeting lifestyle destinations along the Eastern seaboard? Asking, how do we become bigger, stronger and performant in new locations with more offerings...It’s about becoming more corporate without losing the core business culture, team spirit and especially without losing the foundation for what makes Sammut Group a great company to belong to, work with or buy from. Solution: To truly tackle the core of this challenge, TOAST had to unwind the business strengths and opportunities, audit its key assets and factors of success in order to rearticulate the existing brand footprint and its great principles to strengthen the brand of Sammut Group for it to resonate across multiple targets, offerings and locations. Through research and workshopping, TOAST uncovered myriad successes of Sammut Group; they lifted the bar in Cronulla & the Sutherland Shire by delivering uniquely designed high calibre projects with a deep attention to detail. We identified that opportunities existed for Sammut Group to become a new corporate identity to support the credibility of their projects, offering living experiences beyond what the market currently provides. Thus, reaching the new conceptual output, ‘Artisans of Lifestyle,’ expressing the thesis behind a company enhancing people’s lives with immersive luxury experiences through sustainable architecture, natural landscapes and beautiful details. The business has strengthened and diversified to elevate all facets of the Australian lifestyle; creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

Property.name: LJ Hooker
Property.description: LJ Hooker. Brand Transformation. When You Know, You Know. Iconic real estate brand LJ Hooker is positioned as a major player in the Australian real estate industry, possessing both the legacy of a rich and successful history and a future-focused, innovative mindset. The company identified that in today’s competitive and evolving climate, resting on past success and market dominance is no guarantee for future success. As such, LJ Hooker had to continue to evolve and differentiate from competitors. LJ Hooker engaged TOAST to help refresh its brand identity. With a global network of 600 offices, it was essential that the brand’s key messaging was aligned across every touchpoint to create a unified brand image. Challenge: The brief was to create a unique and flexible brand proposition embedded in the business’ truth, ambition and vision while being flexible enough to support communication across a range of offerings and diverse market segments (e.g. residential vs. commercial, every kind of suburb vs. being perceived as a brand exclusively for Sydneysiders). LJ Hooker’s messaging needed to apply from a corporate, head office level, right through to the level of specific franchisees. The tagline also needed to reflect the customer-centric values that sit at the core of the brand’s identity. Solution: TOAST created the flexible, relatable tagline ‘When you know, you know.’ The new positioning found its roots in the famous statement from its founder Sir Leslie Joseph Hooker; “Real estate is not about houses, it’s about people”, encompassing the brand’s 92 years of industry experience, placing people, trust and results at the core. Its purpose was also to illustrate the fact that often real estate property matters are a gut-led decision for many of us: at the point when you find the right home, you know… when you know, you know. In terms of application, this tagline has also been created with flexibility in mind, allowing it to be customised to meet the needs of franchisees nationwide. The outcomes of this process were summarised in a comprehensive Brand Kit, which embarked LJ Hooker’s network on the brand refresh journey and outlined clear instructions for implementation.

Property.name: Allcastle Homes
Property.description: Allcastle Homes. Brand Transformation. Make It Home. Allcastle Homes is a residential home builder specialising in high-value, high-quality family homes. The project builder aims to deliver a level of service and product that exceeds industry expectations at every step of the process. However, the organisation’s previous brand identity did not reflect its aspirational vision or holistic value proposition. Challenge: TOAST’s challenge was to create an uplifting brand that would help Allcastle Homes emerge as a clear builder of choice in the minds of its target audiences. The overall objective was to demonstrate the unique proposition and commitment of the business in treating their customers as if they were members of their extended family, providing the opportunity to design their dream home with confidence. This would involve creating a new brand identity from the ground up, from logo and brand messaging to website and marketing collateral. Solution: Immersion into Allcastle Homes’ organisation, including interviews with senior management and sales consultants, revealed that the builder is committed to delivering a high-quality customer experience from start to finish. These insights fuelled the Big Idea ‘Experience is Everything’. This strategic positioning statement reflects both the significant industry experience that the builder has accrued over almost 30 years of operation and the supportive customer experience that the organisation delivers. As a result, the tagline ”Make it Home” was born, aiming to articulate the idea that the customer can transform their home from a dream to reality within a very supportive familial environment (where they feel at home). To ensure that the brand remained instantly recognisable, the company’s signature blue was retained but has been adjusted to a warmer, royal tone. The new gold highlights emphasise Allcastle Homes’ long-standing reputation for quality and prestige. Allcastle Homes’ uplifted identity conveys the builder’s characteristics of experience, legacy and quality, while remaining modern and contemporary, and will help the organisation continue to build the dreams of Australian families, generating both customer acquisition and loyalty for years to come.

Property.name: Trinity Point
Property.description: Trinity Point. Brand Elevation. Above & Beyond. Nestled on the shores of Lake Macquarie, Trinity Point is a Master Plan community offering world-class residential, resort and marina facilities in an immersive 5-star living experience. With the new iconic and transformational design from leading Australian firm Koichi Takada Architects, the Trinity Point precinct is planned to be home to a luxury 220-room hotel, restaurants, function centre, pool and 218 waterfront apartments, along with the already established Trinity Point Marina. The transformational project will inject more than $720million into the local economy and create hundreds of new direct and indirect jobs through construction and, when operational, to service the hotel and restaurant in the longer term. Challenge: Over the project’s 20-year lifespan, Trinity Point’s visual look and feel had undertaken numerous changes to reflect its ever-evolving transformational design without providing true justice to the new luxury regional destination. The brand needed to be uplifted drastically to mirror the prestige of this iconic, environmentally-leading tourism destination for regional New South Wales; one that will showcase the area's greatest quality –Lake Macquarie. A strong elevation of a strategic brand footprint was required to launch the development’s apartment, marina and resort offerings which will set an architectural benchmark for the region. TOAST’s challenge was to find a way to elevate Trinity Point’s Masterbrand identity whilst seamlessly developing and integrating each sub-brand. Solution: TOAST developed a new overarching positioning statement ‘Above and Beyond’ connecting Trinity Point’s commitment to delivering a lakeside lifestyle beyond any other: an architectural and sustainability benchmark for the region. This positioning is being rolled out as a new visual language across the Trinity Point ecosystem including immersive display, online and offline collateral. Allowing Trinity Point to clearly communicate the value of place to drive connection to community and residents.

Property.name: The Revy
Property.description: The Revy. Aqualand. Place Visioning. The Doorway to Sydney’s Harbour. Aqualand distinguishes itself as a developer, As both Strategic Urban Regenerators benefiting areas with close proximity to key public transport, retail hubs and education facilities, and as Creators of Prime Foreshore Residences, boasting views across the iconic Sydney Harbour; Aqualand distinguish themselves as unique, multitalented developers in the property industry. One of their prestigious sites is “The REVY”, home to 44 unique heritage-listed residential apartments tucked away on tranquil Darling Island. With its exceptional waterfront location, heritage building and proximity to the CBD, The REVY is set to become Sydney’s most prestigious address. Challenge: In order to sell the apartments, Aqualand worked on an initial campaign. However, in regards to the overall Covid-19 challenges and market uncertainty, the campaign lost traction while there were still 11 residences available for sale. TOAST was asked to develop a lead generation campaign to support the sales success of the remaining residences. The building has lived many lives, being re-invented over and over to cater for the ebb and flow of culture and the needs of the times. Today, The REVY has once again evolved, transforming into a truly unique and luxury residence that provides those who enter its walls a Sydney experience like no other…. And the brand and campaign needed to reflect this evolution in order to be successful. Solution: To achieve this, TOAST has delved into the specifics of this property's essence to fully understand and communicate its unique value proposition: with towering heritage facades and modern luxury interiors The REVY is a site like no other. While the building has a unique history to communicate and build on a lead generation system, it appeared obvious that the new positioning of the brand and its messaging needed to capitalise on a unique proposition that combines the best of two worlds: Incomparable Contemporary Living and Timeless Heritage Exclusivity. “The doorway to Sydney’s Harbour” claimed this idea of unique access to superior Sydney Harbour living. Historical significance, monumental architecture, sophisticated luxury and scenic waterfront location all combined to make an unrepeatable proposition. The campaign was brought to life through a very engaging website that embarks visitors on a unique journey, and a suite of traditional marketing tools including online and off-line marketing collateral which enabled a successful lead generation funnel for the appointed agents, CBRE.

Property.name: Amaroo
Property.description: Amaroo. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. Nestled Above Castle Cove. LAPropertyCo. is a visionary property group driven to be market leaders, built on generations of experience. The group has an established track record for investing in and developing Real Estate within premium Sydney markets, remaining focused on creating innovative designs and planning solutions. LAPropertyCo. acquired a prime site overlooking the bay, right next to the golf course in Castle Cove and created an exceptional development of 11 luxurious residences with a deep connection to its surroundings. Challenge: This luxurious project presents the future occupants with the opportunity to experience life in the idyllic North Shore suburb of Sydney, best known for its elevated and leisurely lifestyle suited for an older, affluent population. Even though these attributes present immense advantages to the project and the freedom to create an aesthetic brand, it still presents a challenge of maintaining a fine balance of luxury and connectedness in the brand identity. After TOAST’s successful collaboration with LAPropertyCo. on "The Postern", we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client’s expectations. Solution: TOAST delved into the history of the place, the surroundings, the vision for the project and the placemaking approach. We were inspired by how the land naturally contoured, the topography, the rich textures of the materials and utilised the beautiful, naturally occurring designs to create visual elements that would support the brand. We put the end-consumers at front and centre, taking the time to understand their motivations in life. We realised that at this stage in their lives, they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, peace and tranquility, and a connection to nature. TOAST married the sensibilities of the target market with the modernity of the development and its connection to its natural setting to create an elegant and timeless brand identity.

Property.name: Sanctuary
Property.description: Sanctuary. Sekisui House. Masterplan / Stage one. One With Nature. ‘Satoyama – Harmony between the built environment and nature.’ Since its inception, Sanctuary has shifted from being a desirable project to a very tangible precinct that will positively impact the residents and neighbourhood life at Wentworth Point. This masterplan development would be a feat of effort to transform the run-down factory land into a tranquil setting worthy of the water’s edge. The first building “Landing” (stage 1) has started to shape the new landscape of the masterplan, giving the projection of the future experience of living at Sanctuary. Challenge: TOAST was selected to position the project, name it and define a unique and strong identity for this new place achieving longevity for the 10-year development plan and its 7 stages of construction, while helping to connect the vision of the place to the community and its future residents. We also had to ensure the brand footprint of this new development was perfectly aligned with Sekisui House’s overarching brand value of ‘Satoyama – harmony between the built environment and nature’. With the launch of “Landing”, the goal was to hook Sanctuary’s brand as a centre of life for people in perfect connection with its surroundings. Solution: The agency developed the Masterplan to be named “Sanctuary’’ with the Place Essence identified as 'To be both inspired by and “one with nature”'. This strategic platform has influenced Sanctuary’s architecture, placemaking and design initiatives, demonstrating how a brand-first approach creates compelling destinations and place identities. TOAST’s long-term project involvement has encompassed strategy and naming through holistic branding, marketing and community consultation services; illustrating how Sanctuary is becoming a place that reconciles humanity and nature with architecture inspired by Wentworth Point’s environment.

Property.name: The Postern
Property.description: LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. Crafted In Nature. Located 8 kms north of Sydney's central business district on Middle Harbour on the leafy premium escarpment of Castlecrag, The Postern is a truly unique mixed living development containing 7 luxury apartments and 3 commercial offices. Inspired by the original vision of Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin who developed Castlecrag as a planned development in 1921, The Postern has been created to melt into the natural contours of the land, with flat roofs that preserve the skyline and extensive native landscaping which restore the traditional beauty of the natural environment. Challenge: Castlecrag is a suburb of historical significance. It was designed and created as an experiment in community planning and living, accommodating for "the liberal intellectual, theosophical, anthroposophical and natural history views of its inhabitants". Early homes in Castlecrag were built using natural stone to blend into the environment with the focus on creating "the human touch" as distinct from mass production. As the community is very attached to the local culture and lifestyle, and apartment blocks were not part of the planning until now; there were understandably a few detractors, supported by the community, who were against or reticent towards the project. The brand had to articulate the legitimacy of the architecture of the future Postern, as a natural evolution of the suburb while preserving its unique visual aspect and identity. Solution: TOAST delved into the history, natural environment and community of Castlecrag to understand the core of the community's values. Through this exploration, the strategic platform 'Crafted In Nature' was developed. The purpose of this strategic platform was to capture the spirit of Castlecrag and pay homage to Walter and Marion Griffin's original vision for balanced living immersed with nature. The brand narrative needed to build engagement with the community and excite the potential buyers with content sourced from 3 key strategic pillars; 1. Legacy: A shared vision to connect homes to the natural environment 2. Tranquility: A natural paradise hidden a stone's throw from the bustle of the city 3. Synergy: A community of like-minded people living in balance with the natural space. The Postern was born as a celebration of the existing land, and a building that perfectly marries native beauty with refined luxury. Shaped by the land, this exclusive building is a private entrance to a unique paradise offering the best features of Castlecrag: A perfect fusion with the existing topography; An immersion with nature; Water and bushland views; Refined luxury. The marketing campaign was a success as all apartments were sold within 2 months time while the community welcomed the project as part of Castlecrag.

Property.name: Coast
Property.description: Sammut Group. Place Visioning. Sculpted by Water. Coast is a pure expression of modern luxury developed by Sammut Group. This 6-star 43 storey residential building rests on the absolute beachfront of the Gold Coast. Built with precision and functionality to capture the sculpted beauty of nature and the bliss of functional, modern living, Coast is the purest expression of natural, integrated luxury that the Gold Coast has ever seen. Challenge: This property development is the first of its kind and presented the branding and marketing solution with a few challenges to overcome. First of all, it is an offer of absolute luxury for the Gold Coast; a market offering no competition at this level. Furthermore, as much as Sammut Group was highly recognised and well-known for their first class work in the Sydney market, the developer needed to gain awareness, consideration and preference from potential buyers in order to feel comfortable to purchase a property residence from them. The strategic platform and the brand needed to carry the quality and uniqueness of the offering, while demonstrating all the business proof-points which would provide the confidence to buy an apartment from Sammut Group. Solution: TOAST began by digging into the changing dynamics of the beautiful beachside community, understanding the vision of the renowned architects PBD and taking into account the changing structure of the Australian population, their life choices and values resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic. The name Coast was chosen for two reasons: to celebrate the uniqueness of the proposition on the market and, at the same time, showcase the legacy and growth of the developer since their first development, also known as Coast (in Cronulla). This research led to a series of strategic recommendations about the positioning of this truly unique residence and the development of the brand platform 'Sculpted by nature'. Our brand narrative was inspired by the shaping and reshaping of the foreshore by the pure waters of the north coast, the ever-changing shape of the ocean coastline. Coast's design rests as a pure gem, inspired to reflect the layered, refined beauty of the natural environment drawing in the light and revealing to their customers a new perspective on life each and every day. During the month of June, within the first 3 weeks of listing, TOAST ran a campaign that secured sales of over 43 of the 49 total apartments, with sales ranging between $3.5 million and $9 million, at an average of $4.5 million, resulting in record-breaking results for the Gold Coast.

Property.name: Anglicare
Property.description: Project Branding & Activation. Seed Your Future. Anglicare has long strived to discover and implement new services, initiatives and projects, establishing themselves as a service provider who is able to help people from all walks of life (e.g. newly launched Bushfire Relief Efforts). The not-for-profit organisation saw an opportunity to operate in Affordable Housing as there's an urgent need for Australian communities: Expected waiting times for Social Housing applicants in areas such as Liverpool is between 5 - 10 years. Anglicare Australia research found that for single pensioners, only three percent of available rentals were affordable. The project's unique characteristics present an attractive market proposition: Anglicare acquired three sites on which they would build properties, providing affordable housing, in addition to a small selection of strata units that act as an entry point to the market; this initiative was a direct extension of Anglicare's three core pillars: Centred in Christ, Serving customers, and Strengthening community.
