On", showing how they make lives easier through high-speed, reliable broadband. It also inspired a fresh new name for the business: Nexee. A verbal fusion of "Next" and "Connectivity", it's a word that suggests innovation, modernity and the integration of technology into everyday life. Gaming, streaming, browsing, sharing, liking, discovering, striving – all of it is yours to enjoy immediately when you're connected to Nexee. Logo: Inspired by a fibre optic cable that runs from A to B, it symbolises the very technology that makes Nexee's connection possible. Visual Identity: The fibre optic cable from the logo is then applied as a visual device, showing how Nexee facilitates smarter, easier lives. Website: Complete with bold visuals, sharp copy and clear icons, we crafted a web experience that was as simple and streamlined as the broadband itself. The Results: With a brand that appeals to their audiences' need for speed, Nexee are well-positioned to grow for years to come. Their bold new platform shows customers they get them, understand what bad internet feels like, and – ultimately – hate waiting as much as they do.

Technology.name: Grovia
Technology.description: Grovia. Brand Visualisation. It's Time. Bioscientists, horticulturalists, and mechatronic engineers on a bold mission to accelerate ecosystem restoration at scale. Combining plant ecology expertise with world-class mechatronic engineering, AirSeed Technologies embarked on a transformative journey to evolve from a drone-based planting solution into grovia—an holistic land rehabilitation enabler unlocking ecosystem restoration at scale. Partnering with TOAST, grovia sought a brand identity that reflects its expanded mission while driving urgency and momentum around biodiversity restoration and climate action. Challenge: As a leading supplier of land rehabilitation strategy and implementation for governments and major corporations in the mining and resources sector, grovia required a robust and compelling brand identity. The goal was to establish a brand that encapsulated the company's scientific expertise, technological innovation, and commitment to ecological restoration while reinforcing the urgency of addressing biodiversity loss and climate change. This required a brand that would not only support grovia's evolution but also resonate with key stakeholders, driving engagement and trust in large-scale restoration efforts. Solution: To support grovia's business evolution, a strategic brand transformation was implemented. The new identity centres around a plant-inspired emblem, representing the four pillars of the business—science, people, technology, and nature. The tagline "It's Time" was introduced to instil a sense of urgency and momentum in tackling the climate crisis. The transformation began with brand immersion and competitor analysis to refine grovia's positioning within the industry. A comprehensive brand strategy was then developed to align with grovia's expanded capabilities and long-term vision. UI/UX/CX mapping was undertaken to enhance the digital user experience and customer engagement, resulting in a refreshed digital presence that effectively communicates grovia's mission and services. A revitalised brand identity was created to appeal to government agencies and corporations within the mining and resources sector. By integrating science, technology, and a deep commitment to environmental restoration, stands as a powerful force in land rehabilitation, equipped with a brand that reflects its mission and drives action at scale.

Technology.name: Fairview
Technology.description: Fairview. Brand & Website Transformation. Defining Architectural Beauty. Fairview, built upon a foundation of excellence and forward-thinking, excels in delivering top-tier facade solutions throughout Australia, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom. The company, founded by Andrew Gillies, building upon his father's industrial paint coating business, has thrived over three decades, upholding its founding client-centric, family values. Safety and aesthetics are paramount to Fairview's committed team as they navigate the dynamic realm of Australian construction. Emphasising community engagement, Fairview builds enduring relationships and champions regulatory compliance. However, while their values have endured since their business' inception, the growth and reputation of the company is not being represented in their brand identity. Thus, TOAST was engaged to re-establish their brand positioning and strategic identity to bring it up to date with their reputable presence. Challenge: Revamping Fairview's branding and website posed an exciting yet complex challenge to our team here at TOAST. The task involved seamlessly blending the company's rich heritage with its forward-looking vision, encapsulating its commitment to quality, innovation and community. Our team embarked on a journey to redefine Fairview's identity, ensuring it resonated with modern audiences while honouring its longstanding legacy. We aimed to create a visually captivating website that not only showcased Fairview's extensive range of façade solutions but also conveyed its dedication to safety, compliance, and customer satisfaction. Balancing tradition with modernity, we sought to craft a brand narrative that captivated stakeholders and positioned Fairview as a leader in the industry. Through meticulous design and strategic storytelling, we embarked on a mission to elevate Fairview's brand presence and set the stage for continued success in the ever-evolving construction landscape. Solution: Phase 1: Crafting a Credible Exterior. When Fairview first approached us back in 2015, they'd acquired an impressive reputation for their dedication to safety, quality and customer satisfaction. But while their reputation had grown, their brand had stayed the same. Our task was to bring the brand in line with the business and set the stage for the next phase of Fairview's evolution. We developed a new look and feel that doubled down on the premium presence they were known for: clear-cut, interlocking lines spoke to the meticulous craft of their façades, while the entire visual identity seamlessly integrated tradition with innovation, enhancing trust with the architects, builders and installers they wanted to influence. By harmonising every brand element, we created a cohesive narrative that reinforced Fairview's position as a leading industry leader. Phase 2: Adding a Layer of Distinction. This positioning laid a strong foundation for success. But ten years later, their product portfolio had expanded across a range of materials and building types (especially residential). With their offering significantly enhanced, they needed to refresh their brand so it captured the collective value of their beautiful new façades. Our deep immersion in the brand via qualitative interviews, quantitative surveys and stakeholder engagement unearthed a twin truth about these products. Their façades didn't just work on a practical level, they were aesthetically inspiring, too. Looking beautiful and working beautifully all the way through. Not only was this a unique proposition in a cluttered category, it played well with their target audience: as professionals who span both design and construction performance, architects ultimately want to choose a façade that delivers on both levels. Read Our Latest Whitepaper.

Technology.name: Stone & Chalk
Technology.description: Stone & Chalk. Strategic Campaign. We're Not For Everyone. [Page contains no additional prose; the Challenge and Solution sections are present as labels only with no body text.]

Technology.name: Oxplo
Technology.description: As Tough As Australia. In the rugged expanse of the Australian industrial landscape, Oxplo emerges as a beacon of durability and reliability, crafted by the experienced hands of Luyu and the strategic ingenuity of our brilliant team here at TOAST. Designed to embody the spirit of exploration and resilience, Oxplo seamlessly integrates premium quality with the robustness of the Australian outback. Rooted in the ethos of "For Australians, By Australians," Oxplo stands as a testament to Luyu's commitment to delivering machinery solutions that endure the toughest of challenges. Challenge: Oxplo faced the formidable task of not only establishing itself as a premium brand in the Australian machinery market but also embodying the essence of exploration and resilience. With Luyu's reputation for delivering comfortable, precise and reliable products, Oxplo needed to go beyond mere functionality and embrace the adventurous spirit of exploration. Moreover, the brand had to convey its deep understanding of Australian conditions while cutting through a very busy market. Solution: TOAST embarked on a strategic journey to craft Oxplo, infusing the brand with a sense of adventure, resilience and unwavering strength. Leveraging Luyu's expertise, Oxplo ensured that its products surpassed industry standards for quality and reliability. Every Oxplo machine was meticulously engineered to withstand the rigours of exploration and the harsh realities of Australian landscapes, providing customers with unrivalled performance and durability. Given this, TOAST settled on the name Oxplo, derived from 'Explore,' and 'Exploration,' capturing the essence of adventure and discovery. Additionally, the association with the animal Ox symbolises strength, durability and resilience, aligning perfectly with Oxplo's brand identity. The "For Australians, By Australians" ethos that TOAST strategised reinforces the brand's local roots and dedication to serving the needs of the Australian community, fostering a sense of pride and ownership among customers. Thus the tagline "As Tough as Australia" takes this ethos further and encapsulates Oxplo's commitment to resilience and durability, resonating with customers across construction and farming sectors. The brand's colour palette serves as a visual representation of its rugged, Australian-inspired identity. Drawing inspiration from the vast and diverse landscapes of the Australian outback, the palette features a harmonious blend of charcoal grey and dark orange. Reflecting the solidity and durability of the brand's machinery, the grey hues evoke the ruggedness of construction sites and the resilience required to thrive in challenging environments. Complementing this, dark, rusty orange adds a warm yet energetic element to Oxplo's palette. Inspired by the rich tones of Australian terrain, this earthy tone represents vitality, endurance and the untamed beauty of the Australian landscape. Whether on a bustling construction site or a remote farm, Oxplo's machinery stands out as a beacon of reliability and strength, embodying the spirit of "As Tough as Australia."

Technology.name: Case Law
Technology.client: NSW Department of Communities and Justice
Technology.tagline: NSW Department of Communities and Justice
Technology.description: NSW Department of Communities and Justice. Having recently and successfully delivered a project for the Department of Justice called Juror, TOAST was appointed UX/digital partner to strategically assess the online navigation and customer experience of its browser application for NSW Case Law platform. Coupled with strategic UX/UI design, our team was to execute a full brand communications audit as well as create the brand identity, digital brand, Style Guide, templates and stationery. Challenge: Prior research undertaken by the Case Law team which was conducted in the sector with judges and those using the system revealed the importance of simplicity, how technology was being adopted by specific audiences and the methods of navigation used. TOAST embraced all findings and was careful to implement these into a more efficient and sector-appropriate UX. The innovation behind the project resides in the simplicity of the data-driven platform and the direct implications this had on design. Resisting what could easily have been an over-design was pertinent. While design was a key component of the project, it is important to understand that too great a focus on aesthetics was potentially to detract from the UX. The conveying of information needed to be done simply and cleanly. Importantly, with many first time users, it was timely to address challenges within the existing user journey (UX) and implement changes that would create a seamless journey for all. The digital components of the project have been developed with a "mobile-first" philosophy to run on mobiles, tablets and laptop/desktop computer. This removes access barriers to the platform's broad audiences including the general and interested public, teachers, lecturers and students alike. Solution: With research conducted early in the process, many of the issues were ironed out early. With the digital communications component of this project being the crux, we worked closely with the Case Law team to understand the market's needs and how each persona required a different approach. TOAST's review of the comprehensive responsive wireframes was developed after an extensive amount of UX testing by the NSW Case Law team. The purpose and outcome of the project is the dramatic simplification of access to NSW Court and Tribunal case decisions while also being universally accessible and device agnostic to responsive design. Clarity around the customer journey facilitated the design and development of the user interface (UI) which presents information logically, in keeping with not only NSW Case Law's tone of voice but that of the legal profession. It is complemented by a design and colour palette that is implemented across all brand applications including a detailed digital Style Guide. The success of TOAST's collaboration with the NSW Department of Justice to deliver the Case Law online platform and digital presence saw our work awarded a GOLD award at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards for 'Service Design - Government'.

Technology.name: Centre for Pain Impact
Technology.description: Understanding pain to cure it. Centre for Pain IMPACT is a pioneering initiative driven by a team of psychologists and neuroscientists dedicated to revolutionising the field of chronic pain research. With a mission to disrupt traditional approaches and advance towards finding a cure, the organisation stands at the forefront of innovation and collaboration. Rooted in the belief that comprehensive understanding leads to effective solutions, Centre for Pain IMPACT is committed to empowering individuals to reclaim their lives from the grips of chronic pain. As a brand integrated in the NeuRA research group, IMPACT needed to build their own identity and create a recognisable brand for themselves. Challenge: Despite significant advancements in medical science, chronic pain remains a pervasive and debilitating condition for millions worldwide. The challenge lies in not only managing the symptoms but also in unravelling the complex underlying mechanisms of pain. Traditional approaches often fall short in providing holistic solutions tailored to individual experiences. Centre for Pain IMPACT recognised the need for a paradigm shift in how chronic pain is understood, managed and ultimately cured. The challenge that TOAST was engaged to solve was to establish a brand identity that reflects their innovative spirit, collaborative ethos and unwavering commitment to making a meaningful impact on people's lives. Solution: At the heart of Centre for Pain IMPACT's brand identity is the essence of understanding and validating pain as the key to unlocking effective solutions. This mantra not only reflects their scientific approach but also underscores their empathy and dedication to validating the experiences of those affected by chronic pain. Their team engages with scientists, academics, clinicians and individuals impacted by chronic pain to foster an environment of collective intelligence and shared purpose. In this way, they embrace innovation and disruption, challenging the status quo in pain research. Their brand thus communicates a bold and forward-thinking approach, signalling their readiness to explore new avenues and push boundaries in pursuit of a cure. Above all, their brand narrative is about empowering individuals to reclaim their lives from the shackles of chronic pain. By providing tailored solutions and fostering a sense of agency, they aim to make a tangible impact on the lives of those they serve. These core values of IMPACT culminated in a brand identity that is entirely people-focused. With a colour palette of softened vibrant tones interwoven with individual and group-based imagery assets, the identity symbolises IMPACT's comprehensive healthcare approach and their focus on the complete wellbeing of individuals with chronic pain. The logotype incorporates a stylised image of two hands coming together, a symmetric design which reinforces the idea of a coordinated and integrated approach to healthcare and reflects the collaboration between medical experts and patients, working together towards a common goal of pain relief and improved quality of life. Through a strategic brand design process, Centre for Pain IMPACT has successfully established a cohesive brand identity that resonates with their stakeholders and embodies their mission to disrupt, innovate, and ultimately cure chronic pain.

Technology.name: Mezfi
Technology.description: The Best of Both Worlds. MezFi provides an accessible entry point into the restrictive world of investment platforms. From banks, to brokers and beyond, it can be immensely difficult to enter, understand and grow in the market. Thus, the makers of MezFi wanted to provide an accessible investment opportunity for everyday investors. They disagree with the exclusivity of investment access and thus developed a service built around the idea of providing greater opportunity to benefit from restrictive financial products and more simply enter the world of mezzanine finance. Challenge: Mezzanine finance, a financing instrument used as a method to bridge capital attainment in property development and intervene to supplement bank or equity financing, is a form of highly exclusive investing that restricts wider audiences through requiring a large financial sum to gain entry. With MezFi, the everyday person can benefit from mezzanine finance funds just like high net-worth individuals using the power of grouped investments. MezFi provides access to mezzanine finance with a minimum fee of just $10,000 and pools these funds to reach the required investment. Platforms like this are existing, with property investment a growing industry, yet MezFi differs in the market by being a hybrid instrument. Typically an illiquid fund, MezFi provides access to invested mezzanine finance capital at any time through a digital asset secured in Web3 technology - a liquidity feature which can be actioned (or not) within the period of the fund. Their fund thus merges two financial worlds, providing the benefits of traditional mezzanine finance investments with a liquidity feature from Web3. TOAST was engaged to communicate this unique and game-changing service to the market in an evocative, engaging and empowering brand identity. Our challenge was to develop a corporate brand footprint, determining the best way to clearly communicate this to audiences, without dividing the two worlds. Solution: TOAST conducted extensive research and industry analysis to delve into this financial realm. Benchmarking existing local and international platforms and assessing the benefits of both traditional finance and Web3 technology provided the footing we required to build this forward-thinking brand. Identifying a selling funnel for engaging users to invest with MezFi was a crucial part of our strategic process. We recognised that the introduction of liquidity to this method of investment was a fundamental selling point. Investing with MezFi provides the unique benefits and high returns of mezzanine finance, usually only accessible to high net worth individuals, coupled with the security and liquidity functionality of Web3 technology. This insight led to our big idea and tagline generation: 'The Best of Both Worlds'. By combining two financial worlds, MezFi investors receive double the benefits - the benefits of traditional mezzanine finance investment plus the benefits of Web3 technology. Merging the benefits of transparency, regulation and asset tangibility that come with traditional finance, with the liquidity opportunities, lack of global borders and blockchain tracking introduced by Web3, MezFi delivers an opportunistic finance platform where you receive the best of two very different types of financial advantages at the same time. We reflected this highly innovative service in a uniquely future-focused, empowering look & feel. Building on a customised blockchain-like grid design, our concept for their brand identity is a clear depiction of the stability of traditional finance and the forward thinking approach of Web3 which combine to form MezFi. Focusing on the concept of mutualism and the brand's future focused foundation, the logotype design links two different worlds in a dynamic, fresh and contemporary fashion, showcasing a brand that goes beyond boundaries and continually thinks outside the box. With a colour palette of vibrant pink, green, blue and indigo, a dynamic, 'new world' look & feel is created, one that celebrates innovation and breaks norms, and is differentiated from the primary block colours of traditional financial services. Providing access to a mode of investing that is usually highly exclusive, MezFi is a trustworthy equaliser, levelling the playing field within financial institutions. The brand identity we created presents MezFi as knowledgeable and visionary; a platform that delivers a fresh way to make money and paves the way for innovative investment methodologies into the future.

Technology.name: So Shall We
Technology.description: Your growth is our business. For over a decade, digital marketers So Shall We have harnessed the potential of data, creative and marketing strategy to put businesses and organisations on a trajectory of growth, reach and influence. So Shall We's difference lies beyond their creative flair, and can be found in data gained through the latest digital marketing techniques and continual testing and iterations to drive growth, helping B2B & B2C organisations to plan their strategies, anticipate change and make constant improvements in order to meet their acquisition goals. Breathing life and potential into a growing client base of Tier One national and international brands including the Australian Government, Newscorp and several Premier League football clubs, it was time for So Shall We to take the success of their recent past and lay the foundations for the future at the forefront of digital strategy, production and implementation. Challenge: As futuremakers, our role at TOAST is to deeply understand the landscape our clients are performing in, identify their unique strengths, then amplify a creative corridor for the brand to confidently occupy and thrive. We identified the core challenge for So Shall We as elevating the external perception of them from being 'just another digital and social media agency', repositioning the elite team as dedicated growth strategy and execution consultants; establishing confidence in the team's obvious creative talent by grounding the offering in the team's empirical, data and testing-led methodology. This challenge established the foundations of a creative brief, which was: To equally combine artistry with intelligence supported by a strategic territory that appealed to the head as much as the heart. Solution: Through a process of immersion and workshopping, we established 'Business Growth Culture' as the creative platform for their brand evolution. By defining 'growth culture' as a foundational mindset and a set of beliefs that is focused on helping staff and customers develop their limitless potential, So Shall We could 'own' the positioning of Growth Culture as a means to drive business growth – both internally and externally – by mastering creative, data, on-site and media optimisation. Championing the concept of the business growth mindset aligned authentically with So Shall We's methodology and delivery. For So Shall We, it means understanding and appreciating the unique value clients offer their customers, enabling the team to define, implement and follow a growth marketing strategy and action plan that yields the recognition and financial success that So Shall We's clients deserve. From this strategic territory, a bold new creative identity was born. With endless flexibility at its core, the personality-fuelled design concept drew inspiration from ideas of recognition, introduction and interaction, exposing how So Shall We takes action delving into their clients' category, never shying away from complex or adverse ideas. A typographic solution bringing the 'So, Shall We…?' question to life established an invitation for clients to collaborate, learn, explore, create and ultimately grow, delivering on the brand's core purpose within the visual expression of the identity. The tagline 'Your Growth is our Business' creates confidence in So Shall We's role, establishing crystal clear expectations around outcomes to anticipate when partnering with this expert team. So Shall We's growth leadership positioning and bold new brand identity successfully combines the empirical strategy and creative execution, establishing each new client interaction as an opportunity for presence, learning, contribution and excellence, all while constantly improving.

Technology.name: Refilled
Technology.description:
Refilled — Brand Transformation. Push for extraordinary. On average, Australians use 130kg of plastic per person, per year. Less than 12% of this gets properly recycled, meaning there is still 88% of our plastic waste going straight to landfill. Contributing the most to this, worldwide, are beverage companies Coca Cola and PepsiCo. Removing the clear pain point - plastic - is a starkly needed factor to lessen our increasing impact on the environment. Refilled delivers a simple, sustainable solution. Refilled is an eco-tech company providing a sustainable solution for beverage brands, organisations and consumers to go plastic-free. Their brand vision is to deliver an eco-tech service that allows individuals to tackle climate action on their own accord. They provide a service offering that puts the solution to plastic consumption in our very own hands and creates a tangible, trackable way to mitigate climate change on a personal, industrial and global level. However, their branding was inconsistent with this core purpose. With a wide reaching colour palette, busy iconography and generationally-exclusive language, their existing branding did not communicate their mission, was too confusing and disadvantageous for their desired corporate trajectory.

Challenge: The immediate purpose of evolving Refilled as a more robust brand was to uplift the overall business understanding and perception of its sustainable actions, reflecting its unique environmental offering that is reinventing the beverage industry. TOAST was engaged to strategise the brand transformation for the overall Refilled brand, elevating their image and communication style in order to prepare for its break away from the generation z/university market and expand into the startup, SMEs & corporate world. Our team approached this project with the ultimate brand and business objectives of positively articulating the Refilled company to its diverse markets with clear, engaging and outcome-driven messaging. Through a concise brand narrative, we needed to develop a positive reputation, a sense of pride and attract great B2B & B2C clients, helping SMEs and mid-size companies in showcasing their commitment for a better Australia and environment, stimulating the adoption of plastic-free alternatives and to develop a product offering applicable to a wide range of businesses.

Solution: Refilled sends a message of action toward climate change, allows users to track the very impact they are making, and creates a lifestyle around ‘doing good’ for the world. It provides a tangible way for people to bring climate action into their own hands - turning an everyday act into an act of climate action. Through a considered strategic process of stakeholder interviews, an interactive brand workshop and thorough industry analysis, our team gained crucial insights which served as a valuable strategic direction for the future Refilled brand identity. Assessing other ‘change making’ brands highlighted that creating a lifestyle and promoting a clear set of values around the brand was key to consumer intrigue and engagement, awareness raising and to forge a community movement. This insight supported Refilled’s DNA as ‘the facilitator to do good’. We identified the business opportunity for Refilled as to unify people on a positive journey of plastic reduction, providing a platform to contribute to a global plastic reduction movement. We were redirecting Refilled from being viewed as merely a convenient service, to being recognised as an added value to people’s lives. As a ‘facilitator’, Refilled supports and enables: the reduction of individual plastic consumption; corporate companies’ CO2 reduction goals; a desirable sustainable lifestyle; the mitigation of plastic pollution in our local & global environment. In doing this, Refilled transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary. An ordinary act of drinking water becomes something extraordinary by reducing the plastic waste involved. The Refilled dispenser empowers users to change the world by reducing the waste created by plastic bottles. By choosing to drink Refilled, we are pushing for a better future. Together. This direction thus formed the tagline and business direction of ‘Push for Extraordinary,’ ‘Choose. Drink. Refill,’ promoting a cycle where every time a user chooses to drink Refilled, they are pushing for something extraordinary - a cleaner planet. Our brand narrative promotes an attainable, sustainable lifestyle and creates a community of like-minded consumers. This vision is translated in the brand’s visual identity; the bright & fresh appeal of the creative assets embodying the eco-conscious core of the brand. We created a natural, clean colour palette with marine hues of aqua and navy, paired with custom clean-lined, contemporary iconography and graphic assets highlighting the bespoke water droplet of the logotype. This sophisticated and streamlined brand identity positions Refilled as a leader in the industry, preparing it for launch in the corporate world. By simplifying the brand assets, reducing the colour palette and championing its core message of plastic reduction, our brand narrative and strategic visual identity creates an admirable and approachable sustainable lifestyle and showcases its commitment to a better Australia, and globe. Additionally, the clean, elegant design supports the key goal of developing a product offering applicable to a wide range of industries.

Technology.name: Anavo
Technology.description:
Anavo — The Polyglot Group. Brand Visualisation. The energy to do better. Anavo, a subsidiary of The Polyglot Group, is a global Recruitment Agency specialising in industries focused on Renewable Energy, Environmental action, and Sustainability. Operating in 6 countries, spanning 9 time zones and 4 continents, they partner with clients, from large multinational corporations through to local SMEs, providing access to leading talents across the globe to bring climate action industry projects to life. Their mission is to help with Permanent Recruitment, Project & Specialist Hire, Global Mobility, Executive Search & Temporary recruitment for climate-focused sectors. They partner with some of the most innovative, high-growth companies in the environmental / sustainability sector, to match them with exceptional talent. Anavo creates a bridge between businesses & talent to empower individuals and teams to drive the decarbonising change that our planet urgently requires.

Challenge: TOAST was called upon by The Polyglot Group to create an engaging, progressive, and friendly brand footprint that encapsulates their new company’s vision. The challenge for TOAST to reach, through strategic brand messaging, was “how are we going to engage companies in the sustainability market as well as individual job seekers passionate about and searching for employment in the environmental industry?” It was crucial for Anavo’s final brand to be accessible and recognisable. Not only to stand out as a key player in the recruitment realm, but primarily as champions for sustainability. They need to be known by companies working across the environment/future/net-zero space as well as respected by individuals who are passionate about working collectively toward progressive green action, and by global corporate bodies aiming to expand their business values to reflect a sustainable future.

Solution: The company needed to be recognised as a group that is driven by passion and a dedication to a wider cause. Through an iterative research process of interviews, industry analysis and an in-depth strategic workshop, our team developed Anavo’s unique brand footprint which aligned the visions of all key stakeholders and brought their business values to life. Inspired by the Greek word which means “to ignite,” “Anávo” was chosen for the brand name, encompassing their mission as a collective to instigate positive change and help the world transition to cleaner practices for a better future. Accompanying this, TOAST put forth the tagline “The Energy to do better” for their team to adopt. This showcases to their audience that they are a recruitment agency empowering people within the clean energy & environment industries to drive the decarbonising change that our planet needs. The logo that was settled on encompasses the bright ambition intrinsic to renewable energy. The buoyant typeface design reflects that they are a team who is passionate about going the extra mile and encapsulates their deep expertise that is underpinned by a curiosity for new ideas, systems and innovations. At only 2 years old, having been created amidst the uncertain yet innovation-provoking time of the 2020 pandemic, Anavo already has a 10+ local employment team, a 15,000+ LinkedIn network and an extensive library of successful client case studies. Their team has supported the growth ambitions and sustainability goals of global companies such as: Enphase Energy, Akuo Energy, Cress Consulting, SMA Solar Technology, Yingli Green Energy. This rapid growth not only reflects the success of TOAST’s branding suite, our team being responsible for Anavo’s brand narrative, strategic footprint and visual identity, but the deep necessity for a platform such as this.

Technology.name: Juror
Technology.description: Juror. NSW Department of Justice. Observe Listen Decide. The NSW Government's Department of Justice orchestrates the state's compulsory jury service. Juries are used to ensure that legal verdicts are impartial and in line with community standards of behaviour. Serving as a juror is a mandatory role, providing unique insights into the NSW court process. Juries are used in the NSW District Court and NSW Supreme Court to determine criminal and civil matters. People aged over 18 are summoned and subsequently randomly selected to serve on a jury in a particular trial. The process of collating, storing and selecting names of all eligible jurors is a large task which occurs year-round. TOAST was engaged to assist with the ideation and design of an updated user interface and communications platform which simplifies the process on both the distribution and client end. Challenge: The juror selection process is a key part of the Australian justice system. Every year, the names of approximately 200,000 potential jurors are randomly selected from the NSW Electoral Roll and included on the jury list. From this number, up to 150,000 people will be summoned to present to court, with a subsequent 9,000 being selected to fulfil their service on a jury panel. TOAST was tasked with renewing a user management system to reduce the bulk of content and business hours required to orchestrate the juror selection process. Given the evidenced high amount of data being dealt with in the NSW Department of Justice, TOAST worked to strengthen the brand and streamline their processes, aiming to reduce pain points and simplify processes for both the distribution teams and summoned jurors. Solution: TOAST designed a two-part solution with an updated User Interface Design and a Communications Suite. Our team created the overall design for the Department of Justice's online portal, mobile application and management system for jurors and potential jurors, known as Juror. This Jury Management System is an updated user database storing information on NSW jurors and contains algorithms that are used to randomly select the 200,000 jurors each year from the four million-strong NSW electoral roll. With its algorithm for random selection, the system dramatically simplifies the Jury summoning process and provides efficiencies throughout the entire procedure for Jurors and Government alike. In line with this, TOAST crafted a marketing communications suite for the NSW public. Our strategy led us to develop a concept that portrayed a sense of pride and civic duty gained from participation in NSW's Jury Service. Our Big Idea came down to the three verbs "Observe, Listen, Decide." This slogan works hand-in-hand with the authentic imagery, showcasing real people across NSW to portray a sense of ownership, responsibility and recognition for the cause. At the 2017 Sydney Design Awards, TOAST received a Gold Award in the Government Service category for our Juror campaign on behalf of the Department of Justice.

Technology.name: A2B
Technology.description: Cabcharge. Brand Visualisation. Creating Confidence in People's Plans. Operating since 1976, Cabcharge has long been a dominant player in Australia's personal transport market. However, over the years, the iconic company has become so much more than simply an account payment system provider, developing a range of class-leading innovations in the broader fields of payment solutions and communication platforms. Challenge: Cabcharge has grown to become the market leader in the personal transport sector, however the brand was not reflecting this new business reality and unfortunately, was also generating confusion between the digital account payment system and the holistic personal transport proposition. With technological disruption pushing into the marketplace, it was time for Cabcharge to strengthen and clearly communicate its core value propositions. Part of the challenge was to be able to preserve the existing brand equity while opening up new opportunities for brand growth at the group and business line levels, demonstrating progress to their markets and creating confidence for their customers, partners and shareholders. Solution: Within the very first few weeks of the project, TOAST was integrally involved in proposing to Cabcharge's CEO the drastic recommendation of renaming the master-brand in order to better reflect the vast changes that have occurred within both Cabcharge and indeed the wider world itself. Such an impactful adjustment required the buy-in of stakeholders from the ground up, and TOAST played a substantial role in the development and presentation of the case for change. The result? Widespread approval of the proposal and the consequential transformation of 'Cabcharge' into the new master entity 'A2B'. The overall brand proposition to become the preferred personal transport provider for a lot of Australians was based on the strategic idea that "A2B believes in shaping inspiring realities for tomorrow, in growing their business and in making the world a better place". The holistic brand transformation is represented well by our reimagined A2B logo - the typeface pays homage to Cabcharge's origins, whilst symbolising A2B's overarching goal to help its customers get wherever they need to go. TOAST launched the new brand on the ASX500 with great success, which is a testament to TOAST playing a crucial role in A2B's evolution as a business.

Technology.name: Fone King
Technology.tagline: With Fone King, You Can Live ON
Technology.description: With Fone King, You Can Live ON. Fone King is a family-owned mobile phone repair and accessory retailer in Australia, operating for more than 17 years. Their vision is to be the first when it comes to offering fast, professional mobile phone repairs that last. Part of their enormous success is due to their commitment to serving their customers, helping to solve whatever problems they may have, and seeking to keep them connected in our fast-paced world. ...And we know that when a phone or computer fails to work, it is social suicide; repair becoming a matter of life or death. Challenge: The store experience is vibrant, eye-catching and cutting edge in the telecommunications industry, however there was a disconnect between the bricks and mortar retail experience, and the digital experience. TOAST's challenge was to redesign a fully responsive website that brings the charm, fun and character of Fone King's physical environment to digital. And also allow increasing sales across the multiple stores in NSW and QLD, and throughout the website's digital e-commerce experience, across all categories. Our scope of work was to ensure that while providing the ideal user experience (UX) through various browsers and devices, we allow for fast loading times, assure security with a robust and safe payment system while being accessible and appealing to multiple "highly stressed" audiences (e.g. their phone or computer is completely out of order/broken) through both mobile and desktop tablets. Solution: Using plenty of animation, custom characters, balloons and cracked-screen visual gags, the new website replicates the cheeky retail personality the brand has become known for, continuing customers' brand journey online. Along with the fun of animation and fluid motion, the website's functionality features a geo-targeted store locator and a directions finder, a repair CMS management system and an e-commerce store. Importantly too, Fone King wanted to continue to be known as a source of practical and helpful information for mobile phone users, so the site links to its blog as well as a comprehensive repairs section featuring Facebook Messenger as a fast communication option. Fone King saw a 60% increase in website traffic following the rebranding and digital redesign, while general feedback has reported that consumers are finding stores more easily with the addition of geo-location, facilitating an eased path to purchase. The overall results have been excellent with an additional four stores opening since the project launched, taking the number of Fone King stores to 12 nationally. The Fone King design suite was awarded Gold at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards in the Digital - Retail & Shopping category.

Technology.name: Zipmex
Technology.description: Zipmex. Brand Strategy. Enriching Everyday Australians. Zipmex is Australasia's largest cryptocurrency trading platform. The business has quickly expanded across multiple marketplaces with a range of innovative financial products which are bringing a level of value unseen within the traditional cryptocurrency exchange and trading marketplace. Challenge: In July 2021, Zipmex wanted to boost its presence and offering in Australia, in a context where there were already a few significant players in the Australian market. To support the forecasted expansion into the Australian marketplace, Zipmex had to shift from being perceived as another convenience trading platform to a preferred brand to trade from. While we had to consider how to position the brand with an added value to the market, distinguishing Zipmex from its competitors, we also had to connect with multiple audiences whose understanding and knowledge of cryptocurrency were very inconsistent. The success will be based on the ability to connect with the audiences, engage on simple terms, and encourage people to try Zipmex. Solution: To achieve this, TOAST conducted an extensive analysis of the international and local cryptocurrency and financial marketplaces. Engaging senior business leaders across management, marketing and product development to deeply understand the vision, intended growth trajectory and unique financial products made available to Zipmex customers. In addition to this, TOAST worked collaboratively with Zipmex to segment and identify a target audience of Australians believed to be both ripe for initial adoption and for future growth. This process led us to a central brand insight that cryptocurrency was about much more than quick win trading, it was an opportunity to help individuals diversify their portfolios and invest in a product that had the ability to have real-world impact through the power of blockchain technology. The agency developed a more Australian-friendly brand positioning & visual design to support the business' launch and ongoing growth, while ensuring alignment with the larger global positioning that will ensure the brand does not become disjointed across international markets. This insight led to the creation of the brand platform 'Enriching Everyday Australians'. A lead generation campaign was led digitally so we could build a successful customer database for Zipmex for years to come and start the journey with their Australian customers.

projects.name: Miramar Group
projects.tagline: The Group that's Made to Make Waves
projects.description: Miramar Group. Brand Architecture. The Group that's Made to Make Waves. Miramar came to us not as one business, but as seven. It was a range of underwriting agencies owned by Steadfast Group, each specialising in a very different category of insurance. From insurance solutions for property and casualty risks, professional and management liability cover, to solutions for niche and under-served industries, these agencies offered coverage for a broad range of risks across many industries. Sectors: Insurance. Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Big Idea, Audience Personas, Brand Architecture, Logo Design, Tone of Voice. Challenge: They wanted to consolidate their seven agencies under one of their most powerful and longstanding brands, Miramar. This would give them more credibility under the banner of one of their most well-established and well-resourced brands, while showing brokers the full range of what they could cover, creating more cross-selling opportunities, and an enhanced customer experience. But they had to do so in a way that didn't detract from the longstanding brand equity of each individual agency. In an industry where niche expertise is essential, the master brand still had to retain the specialist knowledge these agencies were known for: otherwise, the identity would lose the reputations established by the legacy brands, risking relationships and leads. Solution: This was a textbook case of constructing the right brand architecture, one that combined authority and consistency with flexibility across every touchpoint. We started by building a master brand that channelled the collective value of the seven agencies. After speaking to various business leads, auditing the competitive landscape and investigating each business line, a common UVP emerged: through a mix of seamless digital platforms, responsive support, specialist appetites and a wealth of coverages, the group gives brokers everything they need to succeed. This identity came to life with the tagline "Make Waves", capturing how they're disrupting the industry to power brokers' growth, and an elegant wave-like "M", demonstrating momentum while reflecting their new name: Miramar Group. We then absorbed the seven business lines into three new divisions under a Branded House model: Commercial, Financial Lines and Specialty. This linked all their offerings within a coherent group identity, while preserving their specialist offerings for all to see, with the most niche product lines including Sports, Interruption and Engineering, retained under the Specialty business division. This blend of scale and specialist knowledge informed everything we built for the brand: Considered Colours - Deep Blue and Light Blue formed the primary colours for the master brand, while secondary colours like Emerald, Green and Orange differentiated each business division with a pop of colour. A Versatile Voice - We channelled the voice of a seasoned entrepreneur, which blended qualities of both authority and agility. But we built in flex: certain qualities, like simplicity, expertise and energy, could be dialled up or down depending on which business division was talking. Universal Values - We gave the group four values that captured the style, spirit and substance of every agency and addressed brokers' universal pain points across all business units: Real Backing, Simplicity Wins, Made to Move and Scale for Growth. The result: one group, three divisions and endless growth opportunities.

projects.name: ABINITIO
projects.tagline: Powering your Path from Molecule to Market
projects.description: ABINITIO. Powering your Path from Molecule to Market. ABINITIO Pharma is a drug development partner spanning Research & Development, GMP Manufacturing and Clinical Trials. We partnered with them to create a brand that reflects this integrated model, positioning them as a single, seamless partner from molecule to market. The result is a clear, cohesive identity that simplifies a complex offering and signals progress at every stage. Sectors: Technology, Corporate, Health. Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Big Idea, UX/UI, Web Design, Branded Content, Capability Statement, Brand Architecture, Video Production, Wireframing, Prototyping, Art Direction, Copywriting, Motion Graphics, Stationery. Challenge: Drug development is often fragmented. Businesses rely on multiple partners across different stages, leading to miscommunication, disjointed handovers and increased risk. For ABINITIO, the challenge was to clearly define a model that removes these gaps and to express it in a way that's simple, credible and easy to understand. Solution: We built the brand around a unifying idea: The Power of Three. By defining their offering across R&D, GMP Manufacturing and Clinical Trials, we created a clear, memorable framework that reflects how the business operates. This came to life through a visual and digital system designed for seamless progress - from evolving patterns and colour transitions to a modern typeface and practical tools built for real-world use.

projects.name: Logiko
projects.description: Logiko. ZYL Express becomes Logiko. It's All Good. ZYL Express came to us with some big ambitions. Ambitions as big as Australia, you might say: to get businesses and consumers up and down the country using their logistics services. But how could they scale up down under? Especially when there are so many Australian companies dominating this space already? Sectors: Technology, Logistics. Services: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, Big Idea, UX/UI, Web Design, Branded Content, Social Media Kit, Capability Statement. Challenge: ZYL Express were entering a market that's, at best, sceptical towards logistics businesses. And our social media listening and market analysis revealed why: Many companies promise to make deliveries easy. But more often than not, they're a source of stress: damages, delays, lost shipments, lack of support, hidden fees, "attempted deliveries"... the list of disappointments and thwarted expectations goes on and on. This ultimately has weakened trust in the logistics category as a whole, and any new entrant, like ZYL Express, would need to work hard to reassure customers that their goods would be in safe hands. Solution: ZYL Express was primed to succeed in this context, precisely because they don't operate like a typical logistics company. Following a deep company audit, we discovered that they do everything in their power to make things stress-free, and understand that people would rather be doing a million other things than worrying about where their parcel has got to. They use advanced technology to streamline deliveries and inventory management, offer a flexible service that covers everything from unpacking goods to transporting huge items, and their staff always go the extra mile, handling deliveries safely, efficiently and reliably. So we built their brand around the idea of a stress-free logistics experience for businesses and customers alike. We captured this idea with a very Australian tagline, "It's all good", showing people that wherever you are and whatever you're shipping, ZYL Express will handle it. No fuss, no friction, no worries. And to reflect the seamless service they provide, we made sure the whole brand was beautifully well-coordinated under this one organising idea: A more Logikal name - We renamed the company "Logiko", a simple but powerful reflection of how they do logistics more logically. A more Logikal design system - Levitating parcels, spacious layouts and tech-infused iconography all come together to make Logiko look cutting-edge and switched on. A more Logikal website - We segmented their site into three customer journeys to cater to Logiko's range of customers: senders, receivers and businesses needing full-service logistics. Then precision-engineered the messaging and user flows to appeal to each group's needs.

projects.name: Matched
projects.description: Matched. Property that Puts People First. Matching People to Property. Matched are a buyer's agency that do things differently. Instead of pursuing profits, they prioritise people, combining empathy and strategy to find the place that fits buyers perfectly. To launch their start-up on the Sydney market and appeal to buyers of all shapes and sizes, they turned to TOAST. Sectors: Property. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Architecture, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Out-of-home, Social Media Kit, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: Buyer's agencies are all-too-common, but not all of them are made equal. They were originally created to represent the buyer (and not the seller) in real estate deals, but it hasn't quite panned out that way. Recently, inexperienced players and flashy social personalities have crept into the market. They often make grand promises, but deliver not-so-grand results, lacking the hard-won knowledge to find the right place for their buyers. Unsurprisingly, this has weakened trust in the category and made buyers wary of new agencies who may not have their best interests at heart. Solution: To succeed, Matched needed to strike a different tone, one that's less transactional and more personal. We framed them as the agency that takes a tailored approach to property, matching people to the place that's right for them (and only them). To capture the meticulous care and expertise they deliver throughout the process, we developed The Matched Experience methodology. It shows how Matched get to know the buyer's hopes, dreams, likes and dislikes, before pinpointing a property that ticks all the boxes, be that on a personal, financial, emotional or legal level. Connecting all the pieces of the brand was the puzzle logo, a simple but charming symbol of Matched's personalised process. Blending an upbeat Green Lime with a trustworthy Deep Blue, it served as a flexible device that slotted into a range of brand applications, from highlighting stunning homes on their website, to showcasing the perfect matches they'd delivered for their clients. We then added real buyers into the mix, with photography that captures the genuine emotions people feel when they've finally found the right place: joy, satisfaction, calm, excitement, even relief after months of searching, stressing and getting nowhere. By presenting Matched as a truly trustworthy partner, the brand can appeal to a generation of buyers who are sick of the games, dead ends and empty promises, opening the door to more clients, more success and more perfect matches.

projects.name: SHEETH
projects.description: SHEETH. A Blueprint for Building Relationships. Built Right. Together. Lasting relationships are a tough thing to build in construction. The stakes are high, the pressure even higher, and clients want to be certain they can trust the builders whose shoulders their vision (quite literally) rests on. Against this challenging backdrop, SHEETH wanted to forge partnerships with more developers, architects and business owners all over Australia. And to build those relationships, they needed to build a new brand. Sectors: Construction, Architecture. Services: Brand Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, UX/UI, Web Design, Prototyping, Stationery, Big Idea, Merchandising, Brand Strategy. Challenge: So, what are clients looking for in a new builder? What qualities seal the deal, and which ones break it? Throughout our client interviews, industry trend research and in-depth discovery calls, the same criteria came up time and time again: Clients don't just want technical mastery, they want good old-fashioned empathy. Safety and quality are essential expectations, but if their partner doesn't put as much effort into the relationship as the structure itself, it won't be a pleasant experience overall. From start to finish, they want someone who's responsive, approachable and, crucially, keeps their cool when latent issues (inevitably) rear their head. No egos, no finger-pointing, no dramas. Until they see that kind of emotional intelligence, they won't switch to someone new. Solution: To earn clients' trust, SHEETH needed to show up differently. We positioned them as the firm that brings both excellence and engagement to every partnership. Drawing inspiration from the satisfying symmetry of their name, we developed the Double E Experience, a methodology demonstrating how they deliver precision and collaboration at every project stage, from early coordination to post-completion. This double DNA formed the core pillars of the new brand, supporting every layer of their new look, feel and messaging. Their imagery captured their meticulous processes and moments of human connection alike; the tone of voice channelled the dual personality of the "engineer next door"; and the iconography featured a series of interlocking cinder blocks, a beautifully reassuring metaphor for SHEETH's rock-solid partnerships. The takeaway from all this? In an industry that offers an abundance of expertise, empathy is the most vital material.

projects.name: Goodspace
projects.tagline: A Workspace that Keeps Up with its Workers
projects.description: Goodspace. Sentumar. Brand Transformation. A Workspace that Keeps Up with its Worker. Sentumar Becomes Goodspace. Sentumar wanted to get more entrepreneurs hustling, collaborating and thriving in their exceptionally versatile workplaces. Sectors: Property, Corporate. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Architecture, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Big Idea, Illustration. Challenge: Entrepreneurs' businesses move as fast as they do. One week, they might need a room to take calls in. The next, a meeting space to pitch to clients in. The next, a full-blown office teeming with fresh hires. The week after that, a showroom for their shiny new products. The week after that, a warehouse to ship their stock to the world. Their needs can change in the blink of an ROI. But unfortunately, most workspace providers can't keep up. Usually, they offer one kind of office space that can't grow with founders' businesses, limiting what they can do, who they can work with and where they can go. Solution: Sentumar won't hold you back. They offer a range of workspaces in one place. Co-working rooms, e-comm hubs, full office floors, warehousing, dispatching, event spaces, photography studios, even podcast rooms... This near-limitless range of spaces unlocks near-limitless possibilities. All of a sudden, entrepreneurs have the space they need to do whatever their business requires and grow faster. We saw the opportunity right away and positioned Sentumar as "Flexible spaces where good things happen". Laser-focused on hungry young business, it reflects how Sentumar provides a breadth of spaces that can scale with anyone's ambition. Good Name - To appeal to our audience's need to succeed, we renamed Sentumar "Goodspace". Simple, informal, punchy, it spoke the language of success with charm and gusto. Good Illustrations - We filled their office walls with kaleidoscopic and inspiring doodles that capture the endless possibilities their offices support. Good Visuals - We used bold type, upbeat photography and a vibrant colour palette, nodding to that "sky's-the-limit" feeling of running a growing business. Results: Good things are now happening for Goodspace, too. People are flocking to their hubs, the business is growing all the time, and they've opened up in three new locations. Just as they help entrepreneurs thrive, we've helped them do exactly the same. Good stuff.

projects.name: Wherefit
projects.description: Wherefit. Brand Transformation. Your Way to Wellbeing. Broadening the Brand's Appeal All-round. WHEREFIT, a platform that offers exclusive wellness deals for businesses' employees, came to us to grow their market share. But it was a tough task: they needed to speak to not one but three audiences: a. the companies who could offer their benefits, b. the employees themselves and c. the brands they partner with to make it all happen (e.g. Nike, Hello Fresh). To make things more difficult, they were up against a crowded market full of big players, so they needed a strong, distinctive brand to cut through. How did we help their brand gain the upper hand? Sectors: Retail, Health & Wellness. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Architecture, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Motion Graphics, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: Our company audit and in-depth competitor analysis revealed an interesting opportunity within the market. WHEREFIT and many of their competitors had positioned themselves mainly as fitness brands, with a heavy emphasis on discounts off things like gym membership and sportswear. But this was limiting the number of potential customers they could win over. Our research revealed that businesses and their employees don't want just fitness perks: they want benefits that enhance their overall wellbeing, going beyond exercise to include their mental health, social life and even their bank balance. Long story short, WHEREFIT needed to step outside of the gym. They needed to promote the full range of what they offer, including meditation apps, group classes and everyday grocery discounts. Solution: We repositioned WHEREFIT around a simple slogan: "Your Way To Wellbeing", highlighting how they help businesses and employees thrive in every sense of the word. Social, emotional, physical and financial, WHEREFIT is the employee benefits provider who offers it all. This wasn't simply a punchy tagline: it allowed them to connect to a broader pool of customers and rise above the competition with a bigger, stronger and ultimately more unique brand position. But we didn't end things there. From a high-performing UI/UX-driven website to hard-working social posts and everything in-between, we rolled the brand idea out across a range of touchpoints. That way, we could reach this wider audience wherever they were clicking, scrolling or relaxing. The Result: With a stronger position and proposition in place, the brand now has everything it needs to gain mass appeal and succeed. Because healthy growth always starts with a healthy brand.

projects.name: Solutions +
projects.description: Solutions +. Brand Transformation. We Bring the +. Uniting a World of Services Under One Plus. Solutions Group was a huge collection of specialisms and services. They had one business for turfcare, another for golf courses, another for civil engineering, another for habitat protection... and so on. If you had a construction, maintenance or landscaping issue, chances are they'd be able to fix it. Sectors: Construction, Technology, Community. Services: Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Motion Graphics, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: They'd grown to the point where they needed an overarching brand to unite these services. This would not only create more belonging and coordination between their teams, but also show clients the full breadth of what they could do, allowing them to cross-sell and grow more easily. But to bring all these services together, we needed to find the thread that ran through every single thing they did - from the boardroom all the way to the teams on the ground. Solution: We audited the business on every level, reviewing their capabilities, interviewing staff and workshopping with team leads, to uncover the group's common values, principles and practices. What we found was a common culture of added value: whether it's mowing grass, laying brickwork or fixing faults, their staff always overdeliver. They don't just get the job done: they go above and beyond what's expected with a range of extra benefits and services - from being on-call whenever you need them and engaging with the local community to flagging risks well before they happen. We made this incredible work ethic the value proposition of the whole group, giving them a new name, Solutions+, a new tagline, "We bring the +", and a visual identity brimming with energy. Then it was a question of re-aligning their brand architecture. Their different business units were all re-designed under the new brand, but each one would now be listed as a sub-service on their website, instead of a separate company. And to make sure visitors could quickly find the right specialism for their needs, we restructured the site with plenty of signposts, a simple UX/UI navigation and a clear user journey from start to finish. Result: With one simple symbol to rally behind, every employee now has a clear idea of what unites the group, allowing the whole business to push in the same direction, with more cohesion, efficiency and coordination on every level. And now that clients can see that Solutions+ is a one-stop shop for all their construction, maintenance and landscaping needs, the group is winning business more seamlessly. A plus for their culture, a plus for their operations and, ultimately, a plus for their profits.

projects.name: FORGE
projects.description: FORGE. Brand Transformation. Unlock the Outdoors. FLEETWOOD BECOMING FORGE. How Strategy is a Key Weapon in Brand Transformation. Fleetwood, a leader in outdoor infrastructure solutions, faced the challenge of evolving into a more dynamic, scalable brand that could attract larger clients, expand its community projects from design to delivery, and increase its market share. Through competitive global benchmarking, national industry research, key stakeholders involvement and cultural assessments, we crafted the 2030 Fleetwood strategic-led solution defining a company's unique DNA and positioning for lasting impact. Sectors: Construction, Corporate, Community. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Naming, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, UX/UI, Web Design, Motion Graphics, Video Production. Challenge: How can a well-established business with strong equity reposition itself for greater national impact while retaining its legacy of success? In a fast-changing market, even established brands must evolve to stay competitive. Legacy alone isn't enough and strategic repositioning unlocks new opportunities, strengthening market presence, and driving long-term growth. The challenge was to strategically transition from Fleetwood's existing identity to a stronger, unified national presence; one that encapsulated its ambition, growth mindset, and long-term vision. Solution: Through our rigorous process, we had to extract Fleetwood's core strengths and aspirations, incorporating creative thinking, emotional engagement, and pragmatic execution to establish a new, differentiated brand territory with a compelling name: FORGE. Through our strategic methodology, TOAST helped Fleetwood evolve into FORGE with a comprehensive solution that included: A Unified Brand Vision: Establishing a clear and future-focused brand strategy that strengthens FORGE's leadership in outdoor infrastructure. An Incomparable Selling Weapon: A structured, results-driven methodology that empowers FORGE with a winning approach to pitches, project delivery, and client success. A Compelling and Engaging Tagline: "Unlock The Outdoors"; a brand promise that captures the essence of FORGE's mission to create spaces that inspire and connect. A Strong Brand Visualisation: A distinctive and powerful identity that highlights FORGE's expertise in design thinking, engineering excellence, and flawless execution. A Full Suite of Marketing Collateral: Comprehensive capability statement, look book and brochures designed to enhance FORGE's ability to succeed in every selling opportunity. An Incredible Video Launch: A high-impact brand reveal that engaged stakeholders, elevated FORGE's positioning, and set the stage for future growth. A Lead-Generation Website: A high-performance digital platform optimised for conversion, effectively driving engagement, inquiries, and business growth. The Results: A Future-Proofed Brand. With a renewed vision and strategic foundation, FORGE now stands as a national leader in outdoor infrastructure, ready to scale, innovate, and create lasting impact for Australian communities. Unlocking the outdoors. Building possibilities.

projects.name: NAV ECO
projects.description: NAV ECO. New Age Veneers. Navigating towards a Sustainable Future. ESG & CSR Strategic Framework. New Age Veneers (NAV) has always prioritised responsible sourcing and manufacturing, achieving certifications that attest to the ethical standards of its products. Building upon this foundation, NAV partnered with TOAST and together they launched NAV ECO, a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program rooted in eight United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs). The program's mission is to guide NAV's team and operations towards more environmentally conscious decisions across all activities, ensuring that luxury and sustainability coexist harmoniously. Sectors: Community, Corporate, Environment, Sustainability. Services: Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: New Age Veneers needed to create a long-term sustainability strategic initiative that would not only align with global sustainability standards but also be deeply embedded in their core business practices. The challenge was to structure the program through an ESG framework and translate the CSR in a way that effectively communicates their commitment to ethical sourcing, environmental responsibility, and social impact while achieving measurable business KPIs. Furthermore, the CSR program needed to resonate with both internal teams and external stakeholders, from consumers to business partners. Solution: NAV ECO's objectives are driven by 8 UNSDGs, grouped into four key values: Harmony, Innovation, Equity, and Growth. Harmony: SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) and SDG 5 (Gender Equality) ensure balanced conditions for well-being and gender equity. Innovation: SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) and SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) guide NAV's commitment to sustainable practices and innovative technologies. Equity: SDG 4 (Quality Education) and SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth) provide equal opportunities for education and employment. Growth: SDG 15 (Life on Land) and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals) drive partnerships that promote environmental and economic sustainability. NAV ECO has become central to NAV's identity, showcasing its commitment to sustainability. The initiative reduces environmental impact through renewable energy, responsible production, and sustainable luxury products, enhancing NAV's brand reputation. It empowers teams to drive innovation and sustainability, resulting in stronger partnerships and increased lead generation. By aligning with UNSDGs, NAV is positioned as a leader in merging luxury with sustainability, contributing to economic growth and biodiversity conservation.

projects.name: Aryse
projects.description: Aryse. Brand Visualisation. Your Day, Your Way. ARYSE, a dynamic player in the disability support sector, engaged TOAST to transform their brand identity and digital presence to better serve NDIS participants, carers, and professionals in the industry. Our team collaborated with ARYSE to develop UI/UX/CX design and launch a new, user-centric website, alongside a dynamic brand identity applied to brochureware and environmental design, all aiming to make ARYSE a trusted name in a highly competitive market. Sectors: Health, Community. Services: Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Motion Graphics, UX/UI, Web Design. Solution: Grounded the insight that "a person living with a disability does not want to be defined by their abilities, but by who they are as a person," we crafted an empowering brand proposition around "Your Day, Your Way". This led to the creation of a brand identity that is as flexible, vibrant, and diverse as the community ARYSE serves. Our approach included developing user-centric design principles for their digital platforms and physical environments, enhancing the overall customer experience and engagement across all touchpoints.

projects.name: Willow
projects.description: Willow. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage Three. Immerse Yourself in Nature. Nestled on the water's edge in Wentworth Point, Sekisui House's masterplan community 'Sanctuary' presents a dynamic lifestyle that intertwines people, culture, and the natural environment. Building on the great success of Stage 2 of Sanctuary comprising Laguna, Glade & Revive, the project has advanced gracefully into its third stage, 'Willow'. Overlooking the Parramatta River and bordering the masterplan's neighbourhood green, Stage 3 is beautifully located within national parkland, offering breathtaking river and city views. Willow, sequestered in this serene site, features a holistic design that includes a private lagoon pool and meticulously curated podium gardens, providing an exclusive oasis for Stage 3 residents. Willow comprises 323 premium waterside apartments centred around lush open spaces, achieving perfect harmony with nature. These residences are elegantly designed to facilitate an inside-out connection between landscape and architecture, embracing the tranquil, curious flow of the Parramatta River and the highest international living standards. This development seamlessly integrates the surrounding natural landscape with modern architecture, offering a unique and harmonious living experience. Sectors: Property, Luxury, Lifestyle. Services: Place Visioning, Brand Architecture, Brand Positioning, Brand Territory, Brand Visualisation, Editorial Design, Marketing, Motion Graphics, Naming, UX/UI, Web Design, Video Production. Challenge: Having worked with Sekisui House from the inception of Sanctuary's Place Vision, our TOASTies were excited to embark on Stage 3's campaign; as a staged addition in a large-scale masterplan, it was imperative that the Sanctuary property branding and strategic vision remained as the common thread that ties all elements together. Harmony, vibrancy, a sense of calm, and livability are fundamental attributes defining a sanctuary and are wonderfully evident across the Stage 3 development. The Willow residences bring newfound energy and life to the Sanctuary precinct. Aligned and connected with the overall branding and message of Sanctuary's masterplan, these buildings have an infectious spirit. Stage 3, nestled in a lush parkland setting, acts as a natural refuge with its unobstructed views and unrivalled access to nature. As an element within the Sanctuary masterplan brand, Willow is identifiable by the unique kaleidoscopic logotype. In creating this gracefully fragmented circular imagery, TOAST was inspired by the fundamental principles within Japanese design, such as simplicity, understated beauty, and tranquillity. It's an intricate but elegant wreath, a symbol that ties all elements of Sanctuary together. Solution: Set back from the water and surrounded by wild parklands, Willow leverages the verdant energy of parkside life. For Stage 3 in Sanctuary's development, TOAST created the tagline 'Immerse Yourself in Nature,' showcasing Willow as the incomparable green heart of Sanctuary and harnessing Sekisui House's principle of 'Satoyama,' to create harmony between humans and nature. Across Willow, nature acts as a bridge between the apartments and the wider landscape, creating an unrivalled living experience where nature and urban living seamlessly integrate. The harmony and communication between our inside and outside worlds are fundamental elements within Sanctuary's brand footprint, making this masterplan evermore unique. Willow's logo was thus inspired by its 47+ hectares of verdant surrounding parklands. Bejewelled by vibrant greens to suggest a life surrounded by the lush, expansive landscape to explore, Willow's logotype and stage identity lives in proud connection to the land. Stage 3, as the absolute green heart of Sanctuary, delivers a beautifully unique experience for residents and the wider community. Spaces that are in harmony with nature and abundant in vibrant interactions epitomise comfortable living and offer a fulfilled life experience.

projects.name: Rethink Group
projects.description: Rethink Group. Brand Transformation. Wealth of Ideas. At TOAST, we recently had the privilege of working with premium property investment firm, Rethink Investing. Founded by Scott O'Neill in 2009 and based in Bondi Junction, they have created a leading name for themselves in the property investing realm. The company distinguished itself in the early days by focusing on cash-flow-positive commercial properties in high-growth areas, diverging from the conventional focus on residential investments. This success laid the groundwork for the new, consolidated corporate brand 'Rethink Group,' which now includes multiple verticals such as Rethink Financing, Rethink Residential Investing & Rethink Property Lawyers. It was the creation of this group branding approach that TOAST was engaged to establish and lay the foundation for. Sectors: Corporate, Luxury, Property, Finance.
