Services: Brand Architecture, Brand Strategy, Brand Positioning, Unique Value Proposition, Service Positioning, Brand Territory, Visual Identity, Brand Essence, Tone of Voice, Brand Guidelines, Stationery, Motion Graphics, UX/UI, Web Design. Challenge: Rethink Investing approached our team at the end of 2023 with a significant challenge: to create an overarching Group brand that would unify their diverse vertical businesses while maintaining their unique identities. They needed a cohesive brand architecture that reflected their rapid growth and industry success, ensuring a consistent and professional image that would resonate with their high-end clients. Solution: Our team of Toasties embarked on a comprehensive strategic roadmap for Rethink Group, initiating the process with extensive research, analysis and numerous stakeholder interviews. This approach allowed us to deeply understand the unique qualities and market positions of each vertical business within the Group. Collaborating closely with Rethink Group's leadership and marketing teams, we developed a brand strategy that highlighted their core values, strengths, and collective vision for the future. A central element of the new brand identity for Rethink Group was the tagline, "Wealth of Ideas," an evolution of their core DNA, "Wealth Creators Through Property," devised in our stakeholder strategy session. This tagline encapsulates Rethink Group's dedication to empowering financial journeys through unique and forward-thinking property investment services. It also offers extensive flexibility, allowing for variations such as "Wealth of Opportunities," "Wealth of Experience," and "Wealth of Knowledge," tailored to different audiences and contexts. Building on this brand narrative of "Wealth of Ideas" we created a 'house of brands' company architecture, enabling each vertical to retain its distinct identity while aligning under the unified Rethink Group umbrella. Our design team crafted a versatile and cohesive visual identity system, including logos, colour schemes, and typography that differentiated each business while maintaining visual coherence. We delivered a comprehensive brand guidelines document with specifications for each vertical, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints. These final designs and colour palettes played a crucial role in conveying each brand's values and the new image of Rethink Group. The primary Rethink Group logotype is an elegant evolution of their original keyhole icon. Our team enhanced its design, reflecting the known 'R' of Rethink in a bespoke style that embodies the dedication and unwavering ingenuity underpinning the brand. This design echoes the values of authenticity, empowerment, excellence, and disruption, setting Rethink apart as a true industry leader. The conceptual framework behind the Rethink Group logotype captures the brand's core values, creating an ownable icon that champions their legacy while elevating it to the highly respectable status it has achieved to date. The Rethink Group corporate colour palette features luxurious tones of navy and champagne, with varying hues indicating the quality, expertise and dedication that underpin the brand. These colours were carefully chosen to reflect the sophistication and premium nature of the Group's offerings. Staying within the elegant, luxurious territory of the Group brand, the palette is slightly tweaked throughout the verticals to create individual identities for each brand while simultaneously setting them apart and uniting them with the overall company. Result: The result of our collaboration was a refined, professional brand identity for Rethink Group that effectively represents their expansive portfolio and industry leadership. This new brand architecture not only unified their vertical businesses but also positioned them for continued growth and success in the competitive property investment landscape.

projects.name: Bowerbird
projects.description: Bowerbird — Brand Transformation. The Art of Connecting. Crafting the Perfect First Impression. When it comes to property, you only get one chance to make the right first impression. And in the Australian market, where standards are high and competition is intense, every detail matters. From commercial to residential, Bowerbird is an interior design and property styling team that excels at connecting people and place. They've grown quickly by creating success where it matters: curating environments that set the stage for great experiences, and ultimately, great results. As futuremakers, we were asked to support Bowerbird in shaping the brand's next chapter, presenting their offering to the market in a way that hits exactly the right note. Challenge: Right from the outset, it was clear they were all about artistry. Through their unique mix of creativity, passion, expertise and dedication, they can see the full potential of a space, and bring that out through their designs. But they're not just about stunning spaces. They think hard about the functionality of the location, so that it can meet the needs of whoever's living, socialising or working in it, be they a tenant, colleague or customer. In this way, they blend form and function across everything they make. The challenge, then, was to build a brand positioning and identity that married the aesthetic with the strategic; the creative flair with outcomes that create value for their clients, owners and residents. And in a category defined by minimalist branding with little cut-through, the design needed to have more personality, while maintaining the sophistication needed to appeal to clients across a broad range of categories. If that balance was off even a little, potential clients would switch off and move on. Solution: We built a brand that focused on creating a connection between people and place. On a creative level, they connect people to beautiful spaces and design features, so that they can admire them, appreciate them and enjoy them. And on a strategic level, those spaces connect people to each other, so they can live or work to their full potential. In this way, their brand footprint is centered "value creation" in the fullest sense of the word, turning their labour and resources into something that meets the needs of others both aesthetically and functionally. This creative idea translated to a brand identity; a visual territory which celebrates curation and collection, supported by the tagline 'The Art of Connecting'. At its heart was the 'BB' monogram, a seal of quality, taste and also character, without limiting the brand to a particular style or territory. A flexible colour system (revolving around a signature dusty blue) was introduced, allowing the brand to sub-brand their whole suite of services – from private residential and commercial residential to special projects. The Result: With a brand identity that emphasises the connection of ideas, people and places without boundaries, anything is now possible for Bowerbird. By elevating their brand so it's both creatively appealing and commercially compelling, Bowerbird has the identity it needs to secure new clients, expand their business and, ultimately, meet the high expectations of the Australian property market during that crucial first call, pitch or meeting. Because branding isn't just about building the right identity. It's about striking the right impression, too.

projects.name: Calico Marina
projects.description: Calico Marina — Place Visioning. The Place to Be. Located in the pristine waters of Port Hacking River, Calico Marina is a destination of seaside bliss boasting stunning beaches, tidal rock pools and incredible sunset viewpoints. A renewal of this underused side of Cronulla - Calico is a perfectly positioned destination for a sunny day, afternoon and evening by the water. A serene beachside location and community hub bustling with the daily marina activity, the creative vision behind this marina's uplift was for a place of connection, celebration and exclusivity; the place to be in Cronulla. Challenge: The rise in desirability for a coastal lifestyle positions Cronulla as a thriving cosmopolitan area and an increasingly sought-after destination to live and work. This luxe marina destination is built with precision and beautiful functionality; the curvature of the architecture mimicking the coastal grace of its natural setting. This revitalised waterfront precinct integrates luxury that redefines Cronulla. Becoming the main attraction of this previously underused bayside region, the place narrative required the area to be painted as an exclusive opportunity - a unique destination on the water. The overall brand footprint and strategic vision for this site thus needed to encapsulate its natural beauty and deluxe allure, whilst recognising its historical functionality as a marina. Solution: Building on knowledge gleaned from benchmark analyses, our team recognised that successful marinas go beyond their functional purpose. They are destinations in their own right; surrounded by buzzing restaurants, bars and clubs, they are key local access points to the region all wrapped in an air of sophistication. To create this sophisticated site, we capitalised on the marina's neighbouring unrivalled area of Gunnamatta Bay. TOAST looked into the history and usage of this site and in doing so discovered the meaning for Cronulla, or 'Kurranulla' in the local Gweagal dialect, as 'place of the pink seashells'. This became key to the place narrative and led to the name generation of 'Calico', derived from the sleek pink Calico Scallop seashell. Being unique, eye-catching and inspiring, this name mirrors the curved shell-like architectural form of the precinct design whilst beautifully linking with the area's indigenous history. Our strategic brand positioning thus connects community, a coastal lifestyle and innovative design by creating an iconic marina; a true destination reimagining hospitality and engaging the senses. Harmonising a beachside lifestyle with contemporary design, Calico Marina oozes lavish opulence with a laid-back coastal air to deliver a unique destination for all to indulge. Without losing its functional purpose, this is a luxe waterfront destination which enriches daily lives today and into the future; an indulgent place for socialising and celebrating, for love, fun and community connection. With Calico's intrinsic feel of exclusivity, it is more than a destination; a strong statement in the Cronulla landscape, Calico Marina is a game-changer destination.

projects.name: Greenhouse
projects.tagline: Connected. We Co-Innovate for Climate Action.
projects.description: Greenhouse — Investible. Brand Visualisation. Connected. We Co-Innovate for Climate Action. The effects of climate change are becoming rapidly evident. Higher temperatures, prolonged natural disasters and rising sea levels forecast for the coming decades. However, with these pressing issues come new opportunities for growth and innovation. The rapidly growing climate-focused technology sector, or 'climate-tech,' is seen as the solution to mitigating the lasting effects of our changing climate, with climate-tech innovation giving rise to entirely new industries that may well determine the future of our planet. Located in Sydney's brand new Salesforce Tower and created by Venture Capital group Investible, Greenhouse is an innovation ecosystem dedicated to accelerating the collaboration, adoption and impact of climate technologies on a global scale. Their core focus is addressing the issues and opportunities introduced by Climate Change through new climate-tech solutions. As part of a government initiative with the City of Sydney, Greenhouse provides affordable space for Australian scaleups to accelerate their expansion and connect with like-minded groups, investors and partners across the globe. Their vision being to unite multidisciplinary knowledge and accelerate the businesses that will help us respond to pressing climate challenges and capitalise on the opportunities therein. Challenge: Working with key stakeholders of the Investible team, TOAST was engaged to strategically design Greenhouse's innovative brand identity, creating a footprint that will generate awareness and boost global consideration for its climate-tech offerings. The Greenhouse brand needed to be respected by diverse key stakeholders and gain credibility among corporate companies - their number one key stakeholder for success. Through fostering a culture formed on disruption, Greenhouse endeavours to create & strengthen new ideas, connections and businesses. It is a place for growth and has a mission to provide climate-focused technology companies with the right expertise and connections to scale. TOAST's brand footprint and visual identity needed to harness this innovative power and unwavering ambition - and communicate it on a global scale. Solution: Strategic industry analysis, research and stakeholder workshops informed Greenhouse's overall brand footprint, building a brand that is optimised for growth and ingrained with modernity and creativity. Connecting groups, companies and visions in a multidisciplinary ecosystem, Greenhouse introduces the potential to create vast change through the immense power that is harnessed when working together. For Greenhouse, this comes to life through the power of 'co-innovation'. Reflecting this core brand value, TOAST crafted the tagline "Connected. We co-innovate for climate action," capturing their brand purpose of connecting the dots between people, ideas, and ultimately, countries, to co-create innovative solutions that will mitigate the effects of climate change. We mirrored their highly prolific, climate-focused world in a visual identity that draws inspiration from the cycle of the sun, the 'warming stripes' climate barcode and soft colour gradients within nature. Our design concept reflects the innate power within our natural, interconnected ecosystem and translates it into the collaborative community that Greenhouse fosters. Mirroring the agility and creativity within the business itself, the Greenhouse branding suite is versatile and highly dynamic. To reflect the 'revolutionary' approach of the brand, we utilised a free form colour gradient across the logotype and brand iconography. This gradient, with each colour connecting to 'co-create' something new, reflects Greenhouse's unstructured, creative approach to tackling climate issues. Complementing this, a halftone effect is applied across the brand, a graphic approach which reflects the 'connecting the dots' culture within Greenhouse and the myriad elements which make up its purpose, reach and impact. Beyond the visual territory, we sought to imbue their brand values across all aspects of the Greenhouse identity, exploring eco-fonts and climate-focused digital design. An eco-font minimises the consumption of ink and paper in print applications, and can reduce power usage by 30% in digital applications on Organic LED screens (increased further in combination with black backgrounds). Gilroy was selected as the Greenhouse typeface. Its sans-serif structure connotes modernity and innovation whilst its compact, clean line design equates to smaller file storage and fewer pixels when digitally presented. The introduction of an eco-font to Greenhouse's branding suite allows for a holistic representation of their brand values and emphasises the forward-thinking approach of their business. With understanding of the interrelationship between Masterbrand and a series of supporting programs and venues, a brand architecture was devised by TOAST and executed across all sub-brands. The signature colour gradient element of the Greenhouse masterbrand logo then became the common visual thread to unite a series of sub-brands, collaborating to execute the organisation's overall mission, with verticals including a climate tech hub, commercialisation booster 'Amped', the 'Greenhouse Challenge' program, and branding for climate supporters and venture capital investors.

projects.name: ACME Framing
projects.description: ACME Framing — A Brand as Beautiful as their Frames. One of a Kind. The world of framing can be a bit samey. Many framers offer the same materials, the same mats, the same glass, the same dimensions… Based in the heart of Sydney's Surry Hills, ACME Framing takes a more artisanal approach. They always start with the customer, getting to know their tastes, identity and story, before handcrafting a bespoke frame that's true to who they are. The result: a rare masterpiece, infused with care, flair and eye-catching individuality. Challenge: ACME's aim was simple: to build a brand that reflected the craft and originality of their process, while expanding their market share in a competitive category. To do that, they needed to fine tune the way they looked, talked and showed up in the world: a new positioning, new logo and new identity that framed their business in the best way possible. Solution: We crafted a brand as bespoke as their frames. And just like the artisans in their studio, we built it layer by layer. It all started with the brand story. We recentered their identity around individuality, and how every frame they make is a rich and vivid form of self-expression. Hanging at their heart of this idea was the tagline "One-of-a-kind", reflecting how ACME transforms every artwork into something personally significant and undeniably unique. The next layer, of course, was the design. A visualisation ablaze with vibrant colours. A logotype that spoke to the human touch and attention-to-detail of their process. And a frame-like icon, to be worn as a badge of honour by anyone who values craft and creativity in their art and on their walls. The finishing touch: the studio itself. We infused the brand into the very architecture of the studio façade, contrasting clean-cut minimalism with a head-turning pop of colour, while giving enough space for the frames to sell themselves to any passersby.

projects.name: SHCS
projects.description: SHCS — Care That Helps You Get There. Supporting Safety, Confidence & Possibilities. SHCS is a care provider that offers way more than just care. They help people facing physical, social or emotional challenges reach their personal goals by making them feel safe – and confident – enough to try things out. It could be making a meal, taking a walk or getting out of bed for the first time in years. Whatever the goal, SHCS is here to help you get there. To bring this life-changing service to more people across Australia, they needed a brand that would help them expand. One that captured the essence of their care, while building exposure in a crowded sector. They also needed a system that would reflect the kaleidoscopic breadth of what they do, from NDIS and Allied Health to Programs & Engagement, in a neat and digestible way. Here's how we helped their brand flex, grow and show the world what makes them different. Visit Website. Challenge: The problem we needed to solve for our audience became very clear, very quickly. People facing physical or emotional challenges can often very patronised, pitied and limited by society. They're often told they can't do things because of the difficulties they've gone through and the experiences they've had, so much so that they feel judged by the people around them and end up avoiding new activities. This stereotype can be reinforced by the certain brands within the care category, where participants are presented as objects of pity rather than active agents of change in their own lives. If SHCS were to succeed, they couldn't fall into the same trap. Solution: Enter some much-needed optimism. We wanted SHCS to stand for something more upbeat and positive in the sector, positioning them as the care provider who makes new things possible for people, no matter what society has to say about it. To back up this concept, we shone a light on SHCS' process: their support workers really get to know people, structure the care around their needs and encourage them to try new things. This helps people feel safe, accepted and, ultimately, gives them the confidence to go for their goals. Here's how we embedded this can-do philosophy throughout the brand: A Smile on the Typeface. We gave the brand a joyful new font, Gilroy, and added a subtle 'smile' symbol into the 'H' of SHCS. A great way to show that wherever there's SHCS, there's a little more optimism. Colours that Flex the Services. To promote SHCS' range of services, we built a four-colour brand. Each colour represented a clear area of service in a vibrant but distinct hue: NDIS (Pink), Aged Care (Aqua Green), Allied Health (Yellow), and Programs & Engagement (Orange), with gradients that added an extra pop of energy to each vertical. Photography Full of Possibilities. In stark contrast to sector norms, we showed participants enjoying themselves while trying out new things, depicting them in a positive light that celebrates the limitless potential of every individual. A Positive Voice. We gave them the tone of voice of an inspiring support worker. This struck just the right balance: caring and sensitive, speaking to participants' everyday need for safety, but also encouraging and clear, encouraging them to zoom out, look ahead and pursue goals that give their life a greater sense of direction, purpose and fulfilment.

projects.name: Sekisui House
projects.description: Sekisui House — Advancing Sekisui House's brand impact within Australia. Here for better. Since 2016, TOAST has partnered with global property leader Sekisui House, the world's largest residential developer and a benchmark for sustainable living. What began as a single engagement has grown into a long-term collaboration built on shared ambition, integrity and an obsession with craft. Together, we've helped redefine how a property brand can look, feel and behave in the Australian market. Challenge: Sekisui House's legacy of innovation is unmatched globally, yet in Australia the brand needed a refreshed, connected experience—one that translated its philosophy of better living into a contemporary, local context. The task was to bring clarity, cohesion and emotional resonance to a brand operating in a competitive and rapidly shifting property landscape, while honouring its deep design principles and human-centred values. Solution: TOAST worked side-by-side with Sekisui House to elevate every touchpoint of its brand experience—uniting strategy, design and storytelling into a single, purposeful narrative. This collaborative foundation ultimately led to TOAST being entrusted with full branding and marketing responsibilities for Sekisui House Australia's two newest Sydney communities in Norwest and Wentworth Point. The result is a partnership that continues to shape how Australians engage with place: thoughtful, detailed, quietly bold—and always moving toward what's next.

projects.name: United Nations
projects.description: United Nations — United Nations Association of Australia. A Movement to Move the World Forward. United in Action. The United Nations turned 80 this year. To mark the milestone, they were looking to host a once-in-a-generation conference at Sydney's Sheraton Grand Hotel. NGOs, business leaders, academics and civil servants – the UN wanted to bring them all together for a day of talks, networking, collaboration, and defining the organisation's role in the 21st century. And it was a big deal. Many giants of Australian politics, like Penny Wong, Australian Minister for Foreign Affairs and Dr Anne Aly MP, Minister for Small Business, International Development and Multicultural Affairs, were booked to speak at the event. Challenge: So how were we going to get people to sign up? In recent years, there's a perception that the UN hasn't done enough to solve the modern world's biggest challenges: be that inequality, instability, insecurity or anything in-between. This meant we had to convince people that the conference was worth their while, and that it would be a forum for genuine action (not just talks). A chance to actually get things fixed, in one place, on one day, under one roof. Solution: To solve this problem, we asked ourselves: what does the UN do best? The answer: they unite people (the clue is in their name). For decades, they've brought people together as an international forum to solve major global challenges, from eradicating smallpox and reducing extreme poverty to defining the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Our work reminded people of this superpower, positioning the conference as a rare opportunity to join forces with other leading thinkers and make a tangible impact through collective action. #UnitedInAction became the rallying cry for the event, with messaging that flexed across speaker topics ("Unite for Human Rights", "Unite for Wildlife", "Unite for Facts' Sake") and showed people that they'd be helping to solve a range of issues by taking part. The sense of unity linked up our design system, too. The logo showed three circles interlocking into a single dynamic shape and the individual executions displayed policymakers, gamechangers and humanitarians standing shoulder to shoulder in solidarity. The campaign worked. It was a full house. The atmosphere was electric. And the event played a pivotal role in building alliances and shaping plans of action in multiple industries. A fitting way to mark 80 years of the United Nations.

projects.name: Calira
projects.description: Calira — Anchor Group. Painting Properties in a Luxurious Light. Where Life Flows Naturally. Nestled near the banks of the Paramatta River, Calira is a luxury development teeming with beautiful amenities. Featuring panoramic views of the Sydney Harbour and CBD, thoughtfully crafted and expansive interiors, a landscaped rooftop wellness zone, and natural walking paths that trace the contours of the water, it has everything you need in one idyllic haven. Anchor Group, the developer of this collection of residences, approached us to create an identity that would reflect its undeniable beauty to Sydney's discerning downsizers. Challenge: The natural stone finishes. The state-of-the-art gym. The thriving local community. The flowing balconies. There were layers upon layers of features that made Calira a premium and high-end property. But in a near-flooded market, we needed to home in on the one thing that made these residences truly distinctive, the one feature that would catch the eye of buyers who had no shortage of excellent choices all over the city. We led research, workshops and collaborative discovery calls with the architect, Lewis Lau, the developer, Charbel Obeid, and the sales agent, Clayton Ross, and conducted our own in-depth site visit to the development and the surrounding urban neighbourhood. Drawing on first-hand insight and desktop research alike, we uncovered what made Calira truly luxurious and one-of-a-kind: the shimmer of the river itself. Solution: With north-facing apartments looking out onto the Paramatta River, Calira's residents are treated to the sunlight dancing on the water every sunrise and sunset, facilitating a lifestyle that's serene, glamorous and calming. This natural glimmer shone a light on the direction for the entire campaign: we gave the development the tagline "Where Life Flows Naturally" and crafted a visual identity that channelled a sense of ease, light and fluidity at every turn, with an iconic glint symbol, undulating lines and gold-tinged fonts at its heart. Campaign materials such as the EDM, website, social cutdowns and brochure then teased the glimmer from every angle: up-close, by the riverbank, from the balcony and from far, far above, while artfully highlighting all the other amenities Calira had to offer, from the interior to the wellness facilities to the surrounding lifestyle. The perfect way to paint a luxurious collection of residences in a truly luxurious light.

projects.name: Pickle
projects.description: Pickle — Iphub. Brand Visualisation. Simply Awesome. Pickle (previously IpHub) is a leading provider of inbound telecommunications solutions, including 1300 numbers and 1800 phone system solutions. Challenge: IpHub reached out to TOAST with the brief of building a new brand identity, strategic outlook, digital offering, and marketing strategy. TOAST needed to elevate the brand and increase lead generation, in a market where existing providers are all "same same" providing very technical offerings and using boring jargon. Solution: Through an intensive, collaborative workshop, research and interview phase, TOAST developed a strategic brand essence that speaks to the key concerns of the target audience. For cut-through in a crowded, noisy market (where distrust of the industry is rife), the ideal refreshed positioning is a brand that is straightforward, innovative, and friendly with no nasty surprises. TOAST developed a conversational, playful brand hero – Mr. Pickle, representing the new brand, Pickle. Playfully subverting a common frustration amongst the target audience: "I'm in a pickle. Could somebody help me out?" Mr. Pickle is the fresh face of telecommunications systems, who guides businesses towards a phone system that suits their particular needs, while keeping a smile on their face. Being "Simply Awesome" became the core of the brand narrative sitting at the heart of everything the company does. It's about putting the customer first, acknowledging they deserve to get more out of their business phone number by giving them instant access to marketing analytics and call insights, all in real-time. Pickle is the character who will be extremely friendly while doing good for the businesses and the people behind them. From a digital experience and lead generation, TOAST's UI/UX team crafted a customer journey for users through the website that preempts customers' needs, providing an intuitive sales experience. The website is a mobile-first, one-stop-shop, where users can select a phone number, choose a plan and develop a call routing journey, within only a few minutes. The relaunch of the brand has been highly successful, with an extreme spike in new customer acquisition.

projects.name: Agylix
projects.description: Agilyx (Agylix) — Agresso. Brand Visualisation. Change Ready. Agresso is a change-ready technology services company dedicated to delivering high quality ERP implementations and services to people-focused organisations in the commercial, government, education and not-for-profit sectors. The business delivers an unrivalled business transformation experience through their service offerings: implementation services, project management, training and Cloud services. They operate from their headquarters in Sydney, Australia, along with offices in New Zealand, North America, Asia and Europe. Challenge: Having undergone considerable change and growth since launching in 2001, Agresso wanted to create a new brand to reflect the power and scope of its digitally-ready business solutions, to maintain its authority in the sector and also have stronger female appeal which the old wordmark had lacked. The challenge was to redefine a strategic roadmap for their brand that would include naming and a new wordmark. Solution: Following a series of strategic brand workshops, Agilyx was born. Shifting the brand from the sector's tired look and feel, TOAST designed a wordmark using agility as it's base to clearly communicate the business' competence to change quickly. Then, it conceived "Change Ready" as the brand's descriptor to highlight the same. Agility, efficiency and performance underscore Agilyx's goal to be known for the quality and innovation of their software, services and partnerships. TOAST's new positioning "Change Ready" sets the brand up for exactly that. The brand has been implemented across all key assets including website and all marketing collateral.

projects.name: Anchor Group
projects.description: Anchor Group — Elevating the Brand to Reflect the Business. The Art of Elevated Living. What do you do when your business has outgrown your brand? That was the key challenge Anchor Group came to us with. As a leading development, construction and asset management firm, they excel at designing luxury homes and commercial spaces that embody elegance, detail and distinction in Sydney's most aspirational areas. They now wanted to align the way they looked with the way they worked, so that their true philosophy could shine through everything they do. It was a textbook case of harmonising business and brand on every level. Challenge: But why are Anchor's properties so exceptional? What was the essence of the business that the new brand needed to express? Following a detailed audit of the business, the answer became unmistakably clear: Anchor Group don't just design properties to impress, but to enhance the way people live. In other words, their focus isn't just on the buildings themselves, but the lifestyles they house, shape and support. Solution: We made this distinctive approach the foundation for the brand, giving rise to a value proposition that's all about lifestyle curation: "The Art of Elevated Living". Elevated Logo: Smooth, sophisticated but also sturdy, the logo embodies the flair and practicality that defines Anchor Group. Elevated Design System: Designed not just for clarity, but also emotion, the artisanal fonts and intricate patterns reflect Anchor Group's obsessive attention to detail. Elevated Website: The art of elevated scrolling: stunning property photography, clean layouts and effortless navigation all come together to create a flawless user experience. The Results: Today, the look, feel and tone of the brand doesn't eclipse the excellent work Anchor Group does, but reflects it. With brand and business singing from the same hymn sheet, their underlying value is clear for all to see. When an elevated brand meets an elevated business, it leads to elevated results.

projects.name: Nexee
projects.description: Nexee — Brand Transformation. Here. Now. On. Harbour ISP Becoming Nexee. Harbour ISP wanted to take their business to the next level. As an ultrafibre broadband company, they were looking to grow their market share by becoming the go-to provider for customers and property developers. To build trust and win confidence, they needed to create a brand that was laser-focused on customers' needs, tempting them to make the switch with a smart, targeted and compelling brand proposition. Challenge: Our audit of the category uncovered a market that was plagued with frustration. The culprit? Slow, unreliable internet. We've all been there: clicking and tapping and huffing and puffing away at our computers, frustrated at a connection that won't fix itself no matter what you do (or how much you turn it off and on again). And it's not just a problem limited to customers: developers can struggle with the installation speeds many broadband providers offer for their properties, which has a real impact on their tight timelines. Solution: Harbour ISP are here to fix this. Their ultrafibre service not only offers zero interruptions for everyday users, their fibre is integrated into every building and unit, offering a turnkey solution that developers can use straightaway. The key insight in all this? Everything is instant. The installation. The connection. And everything in-between. This led to our core proposition for the brand, "Here. Now. On", showing how they make lives easier through high-speed, reliable broadband. It also inspired a fresh new name for the business: Nexee. A verbal fusion of "Next" and "Connectivity", it's a word that suggests innovation, modernity and the integration of technology into everyday life. Gaming, streaming, browsing, sharing, liking, discovering, striving – all of it is yours to enjoy immediately when you're connected to Nexee. Logo: Inspired by a fibre optic cable that runs from A to B, it symbolises the very technology that makes Nexee's connection possible. Visual Identity: The fibre optic cable from the logo is then applied as a visual device, showing how Nexee facilitates smarter, easier lives. Website: Complete with bold visuals, sharp copy and clear icons, we crafted a web experience that was as simple and streamlined as the broadband itself. The Results: With a brand that appeals to their audiences' need for speed, Nexee are well-positioned to grow for years to come. Their bold new platform shows customers they get them, understand what bad internet feels like, and – ultimately – hate waiting as much as they do.

projects.name: Arclane
projects.description: Arclane — Brand Transformation. Makers of Modern Living. Standing Out by Standing for Artistry. Arclane are an ultra-creative, premium property developer. Like any ambitious business at the height of their craft, they were looking to strengthen their presence in the Australian property market. And they didn't just want an immediate impact or a quick win: they wanted to build a brand that would nurture steady growth for years to come. Challenge: Cutting through in the world of property is a tall order. It's a market with big players and considerable competition, each striving to be top of mind for buyers, architects and investors alike, so it's very easy to be crowded out and become invisible. But while there's no shortage of developers, there is a gap in the market: there are many formulaic, standard-issue developments out there. They tick the boxes and make commercial sense, but lack the sense of flair or beauty that make them a truly high-value property. But Arclane is different. Following a series of in-depth strategic interviews with their team, we discovered their unique value in the market: They approach every space with the care and consideration of a craftsperson, blending aesthetics and functionality to create spaces that are as beautiful as they are usable. They're places that inspire and you can admire, while still having the right features to support living, working and playing with ease. Instead of being places people just spend time in or move through, they're places people love. Solution: This insight led to our brand idea, "Makers of Modern Living". It captures how every development perfectly marries form and function, beauty and purpose, to provide a refined and modern living experience. By giving residents the best of both worlds, and standing for something more aspirational than transactional, it was a real challenge to the status quo of the market. It was then a question of applying this philosophy to everything the brand made, said and did. We created a design system that was spacious, clean and easily navigable, but with plenty of flourishes mixed in: flowing lines, elegant curves and elevated imagery, all the finishing touches that make you stop and stare. The logo then brought it all together in a symbol of incredible visual economy. "Makers of Modern Living" was etched into its very shape, with three arched versions of the letter "M" combining to create a stunning building. A true work of art, just like their developments. The Results: "Makers of Modern Living" proved to be the perfect platform for the brand. Not only is the idea distinctive in the market, it elegantly summarises what makes Arclane's developments of superior value. Which just goes to show: to avoid becoming invisible, you need to lean into your beauty.

projects.name: FORGE Website
projects.description: FORGE Website. Digital Transformation. Unlock the Outdoors. UNLOCKING A NEW ERA Demonstrating Deep Expertise Delivered at Scale. After five decades of excellence as Fleetwood, TOAST rebranded the company to FORGE, marking a new era for the brand. On the back of this dynamic evolution, TOAST transformed the business' website to perfectly position the team to expand its market share and continue delivering some of the largest and most exciting community infrastructure projects across the country. Through a comprehensive digital strategy that included competitive benchmarking, national industry research, involvement from key partners and senior-ranking Government stakeholders, TOAST thoroughly optimised FORGE's user experience. This deep dive into the company's methodologies and unique selling propositions informed a compelling new digital experience, aligning seamlessly with FORGE's strategic and commercial objectives. This evolution not only reflects the company's growth but also enhances its ability to meet and exceed the evolving needs of its partners, communities, and Government and corporate stakeholders. Challenge: In the realm of public infrastructure, the expectations from local governments, property developers, and communities are continually advancing. FORGE has led from the forefront of this movement, consistently delivering structures that not only deliver the necessary functional amenity, but leverages the opportunity for people to connect with the outdoors in ever more enriching and uplifting ways. But beyond the creative imagination of FORGE's awe-inspiring team lies deep knowledge and experience, a company that understands the importance of providing clients with certainty and confidence to execute major projects, addressing significant logistical, safety, and sustainability challenges at every phase. TOAST's task was to understand the needs and decision-levers of prospective clients securing vendors for major public outdoor amenity works, and position FORGE as the ideal partner to seamlessly and consistently deliver positive outcomes. This involved developing a UX/UI solution that achieved the delicate balance between the emotive appeal of FORGE's new brand proposition, "Unlock The Outdoors" crafted by TOAST, and the rational strengths of FORGE's comprehensive expertise and methodology, ensuring confidence and assurance in FORGE's capabilities. Solution: The FORGE website was meticulously crafted to reflect the company's leading role in delivering exceptional public infrastructure. The development process was rooted in a deep understanding of industry needs, derived from category insights and one-on-one interviews with corporate and government clients. This foundational research informed the UI/UX planning, ensuring that the website not only presents FORGE's major Unique Selling Propositions (USPs) but does so in a manner that instils confidence and underscores FORGE's capability for excellence in the sector. The website's user experience is a testament to the importance of thorough UX/UI planning and research. Each element of the interface has been designed with user engagement in mind, making information accessible and interactions intuitive. This strategic approach ensures that each visit to the website is informative, user-friendly, and reassuring, directly reflecting FORGE's expertise and reliability in transforming outdoor spaces. Through well-structured content and a thoughtfully designed user interface, the website effectively communicates FORGE's commitment to quality and their ability to meet the complex demands of modern public infrastructure projects.

projects.name: Grovia
projects.description: Grovia. Brand Visualisation. It's Time. Bioscientists, horticulturalists, and mechatronic engineers on a bold mission to accelerate ecosystem restoration at scale. Combining plant ecology expertise with world-class mechatronic engineering, AirSeed Technologies embarked on a transformative journey to evolve from a drone-based planting solution into grovia—an holistic land rehabilitation enabler unlocking ecosystem restoration at scale. Partnering with TOAST, grovia sought a brand identity that reflects its expanded mission while driving urgency and momentum around biodiversity restoration and climate action. Challenge: As a leading supplier of land rehabilitation strategy and implementation for governments and major corporations in the mining and resources sector, grovia required a robust and compelling brand identity. The goal was to establish a brand that encapsulated the company's scientific expertise, technological innovation, and commitment to ecological restoration while reinforcing the urgency of addressing biodiversity loss and climate change. This required a brand that would not only support grovia's evolution but also resonate with key stakeholders, driving engagement and trust in large-scale restoration efforts. Solution: To support grovia's business evolution, a strategic brand transformation was implemented. The new identity centres around a plant-inspired emblem, representing the four pillars of the business—science, people, technology, and nature. The tagline "It's Time" was introduced to instil a sense of urgency and momentum in tackling the climate crisis. The transformation began with brand immersion and competitor analysis to refine grovia's positioning within the industry. A comprehensive brand strategy was then developed to align with grovia's expanded capabilities and long-term vision. UI/UX/CX mapping was undertaken to enhance the digital user experience and customer engagement, resulting in a refreshed digital presence that effectively communicates grovia's mission and services. A revitalised brand identity was created to appeal to government agencies and corporations within the mining and resources sector. By integrating science, technology, and a deep commitment to environmental restoration, stands as a powerful force in land rehabilitation, equipped with a brand that reflects its mission and drives action at scale.

projects.name: Rethink Website
projects.description: Rethink Website. Rethink Group. Website Transformation. Wealth of Ideas. Creating a Group Lead-Generating Digital Ecosystem. In today's digital landscape, a fragmented online presence can hinder a group's growth. At TOAST, we architect digital ecosystems that drive performance, combining strategic brand thinking, human-centred design, and results-driven UX/UI to unlock brands' full digital potential. Challenge: How can Rethink group achieve unity while allowing individual business units to maintain distinct digital identities? Our approach focused on establishing a consistent design language across all sites, developing flexible customised templates, refining the Group Brand Picture to meet each business line business requirements, enabling seamless cross-navigation, and designing conversion-optimised user journeys. Solution: We began with in-depth research to define a unified Brand Picture and UVP, conducting stakeholder interviews, user analytics, competitor analysis, and collaborative workshops. This strategic framework was then translated in an engaging brand visualisation that unified the group while preserving each vertical's unique identity. Next, we focused on user experience and interface design. By collaborating with each unit's leadership, we developed digital narratives aligning with the group's mission and individual objectives. Tailored content strategies, decision-making flows, and actionable CTAs were crafted for each vertical. Leveraging our research insights, we crafted a conversion-optimised and visually engaging digital experience. Our approach emphasised mobile-first design, visual consistency, user-centred functionality, performance optimisation, and seamless integrations to enhance marketing and operational efficiency. The Results: Each business unit now boasts a refined, results-driven digital identity. A transformation which was applied across multiple business units within the Rethink Group, including: Rethink Investing: Designed to engage investors and simplify property investment education; Rethink Financing: Connecting clients with tailored financial solutions and mortgage brokers; Rethink Commercial Education: Providing expert-led programs to educate and empower investors; Rethink Property Lawyers: Establishing a trustworthy online presence for property law services, making legal guidance more accessible; Rethink Residential: Elevating the property development experience with an engaging, high-performance digital platform; Rethink Property Insurance: Offering seamless access to property-related insurance policies through a user-friendly digital experience; Rethink Renewables: Showcasing sustainability-driven solutions with a forward-thinking digital strategy. Today, Rethink Group benefits from a cohesive, trust-building brand experience that enhances engagement and boosts lead generation.

projects.name: New Age Veneers
projects.description: New Age Veneers. Brand Repositioning. Your Space, Your Story. New Age Veneers (NAV) has long been at the forefront of design innovation, providing high-quality veneer products to designers, architects, and creative professionals. Since the business evolved, NAV sought a stronger brand presence and a more engaging website. As a starting point, TOAST developed a strategic brand framework through research, interviews, and workshops to uncover NAV's unique value proposition (UVP), leading to the creation of the powerful tagline: "Your Space, Your Story." This tagline encapsulates NAV's mission to redefine Australian space design through transformative, sustainable materials that inspire stories, leave a legacy, and shape the future. Challenge: Simultaneously, NAV's website needed an upgrade to strengthen its brand presence, boost engagement, and improve user experience for interior designers, architects, and joiners. The goal was to create a digital platform that showcased NAV's curated veneer selection while driving leads and conversions, solidifying its position as the supplier of choice in both residential and commercial markets. Key challenges includes: Articulating NAV's four core values: Customer Centricity, Creativity, Innovation and Sustainability; Capturing NAV's Australian-made heritage while positioning it as a global leader in veneer markets; Optimising the user journey to guide visitors towards conversion points with clear calls to action; Maintaining strong SEO performance and engagement rates while enhancing the user experience. Solution: TOAST conducted a comprehensive UX/UI analysis, including competitor benchmarking, Google Analytics review, and stakeholder interviews. This shaped the website's strategy, aligning with NAV's brand goals while enhancing user experience. The redesigned platform now inspires designers and professionals with stunning visuals, interactive product discovery, and curated content, highlighting NAV's sustainability, quality, and design innovation. Key Features: Immersive Product Exploration: High-quality visuals and detailed product information help users envision how NAV's veneers can inspire their projects; Sample Requests: Users can easily request samples, fostering engagement with NAV's products; NAV ECO Introduction: The site highlights NAV's CSR program, aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals. Conclusion: The revamped NAV website strengthens its position as a design industry leader, with an improved user journey that enhances lead generation and conversions. It serves as a vital resource for designers, driving engagement and sales.

projects.name: Perifa
projects.description: Perifa. Versatile Group. Brand Visualisation. Your Tomorrow is Our Today. Versatile, a well-established name in the construction and property sector, approached TOAST with a clear objective: to re-establish their group brand architecture and effectively separate their service offerings into distinct verticals. This strategic initiative began with the creation of the 'Perifa' brand, which would serve as the development arm of the business. The new brand would encompass three core verticals: Capital, Investments and Property. TOAST's task was to work closely with Perifa's leadership to craft a visual and strategic foundation that elevated the brand and aligned with their ambitious growth trajectory. The goal was to position Perifa as a forward-thinking, integrated solutions provider in the Australian market. Challenge: Transitioning from the legacy of Versatile, a company renowned for delivering construction, fit-out and refurbishment projects since 1974, to the newly created Perifa brand posed a unique challenge. While Versatile's heritage in the construction industry was strong, the shift to Perifa marked a pivotal moment, positioning the business as a diversified entity offering integrated solutions across Capital, Investments and Property. TOAST needed to clarify and elevate each of these verticals within the brand architecture while ensuring Perifa's overarching identity represented the company's expansive service offering. The challenge lay in creating clarity and cohesion across the newly defined verticals, while simultaneously evolving the market perception to align with Perifa's broader capabilities. TOAST's role was to ensure that Perifa's brand communicated its comprehensive value proposition to investors, clients and internal teams, highlighting its ability to deliver certainty, innovation, and end-to-end value across the entire development lifecycle. Solution: TOAST collaborated closely with Perifa's management to create a brand identity and architecture that clearly distinguished each of the group's verticals while maintaining a cohesive, unified brand presence. Starting with the foundation of Perifa, TOAST developed the strategic framework to ensure it was clearly defined and positioned as a high-calibre entity within the brand. Perifa's new tagline, "Your tomorrow is our today," encapsulates the brand's forward-thinking philosophy and underscores its role in delivering certainty and value across its diverse offerings. To visually communicate this, TOAST crafted an uber-contemporary brand identity, featuring a core metallic teal palette, accentuated by regal-toned foils to differentiate each vertical while maintaining a harmonious aesthetic across the brand. The visual language was anchored by a contemporary brand icon, combining the letter "P" with a forward-pointing arrow, symbolising Perifa's commitment to progress and innovation. This strategic brand architecture allowed Perifa to present itself as an integrated, multi-disciplined group with a strong focus on future-oriented solutions. TOAST's comprehensive rebranding for Perifa ultimately resulted in a clearly defined, elevated group structure that enhanced market perception, bolstered internal cohesion, and positioned Perifa as a leading player in property development, capital investment and construction solutions.

projects.name: 20 Martin Place
projects.description: 20 Martin Place. Pembroke. Web Transformation. A Luminous Landmark. Pembroke, an international real estate business with over twenty-five years of experience, operates from eight offices worldwide. Their thoughtful approach combines global insight and local expertise to create community-focused spaces. Pembroke's core mission is to create long-term value through this integration and a passionate real estate team. To enhance their digital presence and streamline documentation, Pembroke enlisted TOAST to revamp their website and produce a comprehensive leasing document for their new city-centre acquisition in Sydney. Our goal was to empower Pembroke to lease and sell office space more efficiently. Challenge: [no descriptive text provided]. Solution: TOAST's website redesign for Pembroke reflected the brands' leading status and cohesive team approach, along with positioning their new acquisition, 20 Martin Place, as a prestigious location, appealing to businesses seeking a prominent address with excellent access and amenities. We focused on User Experience by dividing the site into accessible segments to highlight leasing opportunities at 20 Martin Place and other properties. Implementing a robust CRM-focused solution, we customised the user database to support segmented consumer profiles for personalised engagement. Our mobile-first, responsive design ensured accessibility across all devices, providing a premium user experience. Similarly, the leasing document presented 20 Martin Place as a signature building in Sydney, known for its prime location, flexibility, and top-tier tenant amenities. The refreshed website and leasing campaign bolsters Pembroke's brand credibility establishing them as a leader in connecting buyers, sellers, investors and developers, and encourages tenants to relocate their business to Sydney's premier business address.

projects.name: Vue - Brochure
projects.description: Vue - Brochure. Sammut Group. The Perfect Blend. Sammut Group is a full-service luxury property development company. They elevate industry standards and expectations by applying principles of superior design and construction to residential, commercial, retail and hotel precincts from coast to coast. With a primary focus on strengthening their luxury property development arm and diversifying the company into other lifestyle businesses, the group is creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality-centred projects. This business core rings true in Vue, their latest project, an oceanview luxury mixed-use precinct in the heart of Cronulla. Offering intricately designed apartments, deluxe amenities and streetfront dining and retail, Vue, designed by PBD Architects, will be pivotal in generating economic investment in the heart of Sydney's Southern beaches. Challenge: Vue is set to be a catalyst project for Cronulla. Transforming the iconic Kingsway, this development will create public engagement with the surrounding pedestrian streetscape. It will be a place that goes beyond premium homes, delivering a harmonious interplay between the built environment, individuals, and local communities. Beautifully positioned in the heart of Cronulla, Vue is a residential, retail and commercial precinct of coastal luxury. Having previously worked with Sammut Group, PBD Architects and Highland on multiple award-winning projects, our team at TOAST was brought onboard to craft the Place Vision, Place Thinking, Brand Footprint and Visual Identity of this destination. Founded on deep strategic research, immersing ourselves in the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends and competitors, our team understood that this place branding needed to be suave yet understated, showcasing its luxury lifestyle offering whilst seamlessly integrating into the locale. Solution: TOAST's passion is creating brands for places which become destinations for years to come. With a deep understanding of the marketing fundamentals of the property industry, we craft strategic brand platforms built for success. Sammut Group's Vue embodies the lure of understated luxury. Comprising designer apartments across 8-storeys, state-of-the-art facilities, and curated retail boutiques including one of Sydney's largest Harris Farm Markets, it is the intersection of splendour and contemporary convenience. A place where coastal luxury meets urban grandeur, it is a destination that is set to define Cronulla. The vision for this site was to create a lifestyle unlike anything ever seen before in Cronulla, a 'one-of-a-kind' interwoven expression of the best aspects of a coastal lifestyle harmoniously combined to create an iconic statement for the future. Building on this vision and the development's underplayed sophistication, our team crafted the Big Idea 'The Perfect Blend'; marrying luxe living with urban simplicity and seamlessly integrating resort-style amenities into contemporary dwellings, Vue is an interwoven expression of the best aspects of ocean view living, harmoniously combined with contemporary urban charm. This brand philosophy speaks true to Sammut Group's mission to deliver an elevated design vision achieving the perfect harmony between the building forms, the people, and the natural world of Cronulla. Mirroring PBD's architectural approach and Mim Design's interior visualisations, our designers worked closely with Sammut Group to craft Vue's brand identity as an amalgamation of attributes and cues inspired by its coastal location. The sense of expanse and perspective, the cultural connection and the ripple effect of the tides all combine to create landmark influences that radiate across the landscape, as reflected in Vue's name and timeless visual identity. The identity became a creative launchpad for amplification of a sophisticated suite of lead generation and sales support elements including a luxurious coffee table book, a brochure suite, digital and physical advertising campaign, website and digital-led display suite fit out, produced in close collaboration with sales agents Highland, PR team Left Field and marketers The Collective Co. A cornerstone of the creative campaign and marketing materials was sophisticated lifestyle photography and video content, directed and produced on location by TOAST. Showcasing the effortless luxury of coastal living, a two-day photoshoot captured a series of vignettes from yoga at dawn to cocktails at dusk with dozens of spontaneous moments enjoying salt, sea air and sun in between. Inspired by nature, infused with luxury, engineered for lifestyle; Vue is an elevated vision achieving the perfect blend of coastal and urban style, setting a new benchmark for coastal living.

projects.name: Fairview
projects.description: Fairview. Brand & Website Transformation. Defining Architectural Beauty. Fairview, built upon a foundation of excellence and forward-thinking, excels in delivering top-tier facade solutions throughout Australia, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom. The company, founded by Andrew Gillies, building upon his father's industrial paint coating business, has thrived over three decades, upholding its founding client-centric, family values. Safety and aesthetics are paramount to Fairview's committed team as they navigate the dynamic realm of Australian construction. Emphasising community engagement, Fairview builds enduring relationships and champions regulatory compliance. However, while their values have endured since their business' inception, the growth and reputation of the company is not being represented in their brand identity. Thus, TOAST was engaged to re-establish their brand positioning and strategic identity to bring it up to date with their reputable presence. Challenge: Revamping Fairview's branding and website posed an exciting yet complex challenge to our team here at TOAST. The task involved seamlessly blending the company's rich heritage with its forward-looking vision, encapsulating its commitment to quality, innovation and community. Our team embarked on a journey to redefine Fairview's identity, ensuring it resonated with modern audiences while honouring its longstanding legacy. We aimed to create a visually captivating website that not only showcased Fairview's extensive range of façade solutions but also conveyed its dedication to safety, compliance, and customer satisfaction. Balancing tradition with modernity, we sought to craft a brand narrative that captivated stakeholders and positioned Fairview as a leader in the industry. Through meticulous design and strategic storytelling, we embarked on a mission to elevate Fairview's brand presence and set the stage for continued success in the ever-evolving construction landscape. Solution: Phase 1: Crafting a Credible Exterior. When Fairview first approached us back in 2015, they'd acquired an impressive reputation for their dedication to safety, quality and customer satisfaction. But while their reputation had grown, their brand had stayed the same. Our task was to bring the brand in line with the business and set the stage for the next phase of Fairview's evolution. We developed a new look and feel that doubled down on the premium presence they were known for: clear-cut, interlocking lines spoke to the meticulous craft of their façades, while the entire visual identity seamlessly integrated tradition with innovation, enhancing trust with the architects, builders and installers they wanted to influence. By harmonising every brand element, we created a cohesive narrative that reinforced Fairview's position as a leading industry leader. Phase 2: Adding a Layer of Distinction. This positioning laid a strong foundation for success. But ten years later, their product portfolio had expanded across a range of materials and building types (especially residential). With their offering significantly enhanced, they needed to refresh their brand so it captured the collective value of their beautiful new façades. Our deep immersion in the brand via qualitative interviews, quantitative surveys and stakeholder engagement unearthed a twin truth about these products. Their façades didn't just work on a practical level, they were aesthetically inspiring, too. Looking beautiful and working beautifully all the way through. Not only was this a unique proposition in a cluttered category, it played well with their target audience: as professionals who span both design and construction performance, architects ultimately want to choose a façade that delivers on both levels. Read Our Latest Whitepaper.

projects.name: Good Work Program
projects.description: Good Work Program. Governing Principles. CSR/ESG Framework. After working with Governing Principles to create the brand for their leading governance company, our teams partnered up again to enhance their brand new corporate brand with the development of a tailored CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) framework. This initiative aimed to elevate Governing Principles' business and align it with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) while addressing economic, social, and environmental challenges. Challenge: Governing Principles recognised the critical importance of good governance in driving organisational success alongside the paramount integration of CSR principles into their operations to foster a sustainable and equitable world by 2030. They reached out to TOAST to create a CSR framework that not only upheld their values of integrity, transparency and ethical conduct but also created a positive social impact for their stakeholders. The challenge lay in developing a program that effectively addressed economic, social, and environmental challenges while aligning with the UN's SDGs to bring longevity and actionable vision to their brand. Solution: TOAST worked closely with Governing Principles to develop their framework, which together we titled the 'Good Work Program'. This tailored framework consists of three core pillars: Good Ethics, Good Wellbeing, and Good Employment. Each pillar is designed to address specific aspects of CSR and is strategically linked to corresponding United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. 1. Good Ethics: This pillar emphasises transparency, accountability, and ethical behaviour in all aspects of operations, aligning with Goal 16 - Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions. 2. Good Wellbeing: Focused on ensuring healthy lives and promoting wellbeing for all stakeholders, this pillar aligns with Goal 3 - Good Health and Wellbeing. 3. Good Employment: This pillar promotes inclusive and sustainable economic growth, aligning with Goal 8 - Decent Work and Economic Growth. The design of the Good Work Program is an iconography set that draws directly from the graphic language of Governing Principles' corporate brand image. This approach enables optimum brand equity and positions their CSR framework as a core vertical of their business operations. The 'Good Work Program' not only enhances Governing Principles' brand reputation but also builds trust with stakeholders by actively contributing to sustainable development initiatives outlined by the United Nations. It demonstrates Governing Principles' commitment to excellence in corporate social responsibility while making a meaningful difference in their work environments and communities - showcasing how aligning with CSR principles can lead to enduring success in a thriving corporate ecosystem.

projects.description: United We Shine. WWF Australia. Campaign Development. As the world shifts to a low carbon future, Australia has everything we need to take the lead and become a renewable energy export superpower. We've got endless sunshine, plenty of space, powerful winds, world-class expertise and strong trade relationships: it's a winning combination. The twin crises of the 2019/2020 bushfires and the Covid-19 pandemic have created a need for a recovery package that helps the country rebuild. WWF-Australia is calling on our leaders to make Australia the world's leading exporter of renewable energy by 2030. [Page contains no additional prose; the Challenge and Solution sections are present as labels only with no body text.]

projects.name: Governing Principles
projects.description: Governing Principles. Brand Visualisation. Good Governance is Good Business. Our strategy and design teams at TOAST collaborated with governance agency 'Governing Principles' to create their strategic brand foundation and brand identity. As a new player in the industry providing corporate governance assistance, this collaboration aimed to establish Governing Principles as a knowledgeable, confident and experienced provider of corporate governance solutions, propelling organisations towards enduring success, sustainability, and a thriving corporate ecosystem. Challenge: Governing Principles sought to differentiate themselves in the competitive landscape of corporate governance assistance. They aimed to communicate their expertise in navigating legal complexities ethically and with principled decision-making. Additionally, they wanted to emphasise their commitment to upholding the highest standards of integrity and their belief that good corporate governance fosters ethical business practices, leading to financial viability. Solution: TOAST worked closely with Governing Principles to develop a comprehensive brand foundation and identity that aligned with their values and objectives. The brand DNA, 'Safeguard,' which came about during our workshopping process, reflects Governing Principles' role in safeguarding and protecting businesses, allowing them to thrive long into the future. This concept emphasises their expertise in effective governance, strategic legal counsel and upholding the highest standards of integrity. The tagline, 'Good Governance is Good Business,' reinforces Governing Principles' belief that effective governance practices are not only morally responsible but also beneficial for an organisation's financial performance and overall success. This tagline communicates their commitment to partnering with key stakeholders to elevate their governing principles and assist businesses in upholding fundamental and ethical rules, beliefs, values or guidelines. The brand identity palette and visual territory were carefully crafted to align with Governing Principles' positioning as a modern and approachable brand. The warm purple, orange, and dusty blue hues project a modern image, setting Governing Principles apart from competitors. The fusion of strength and cleanliness symbolises professionalism, making their design direction a distinctive visual statement. The logotype was designed to reflect Governing Principles' people-centred approach, focus on financial growth and their institutional strength. It portrays a robust, corporate brand that offers an edge in the industry, utilising a unique geometric language to create a distinctive visual identity. Overall, the brand foundation and identity developed by our cohesive teams at TOAST effectively communicate Governing Principles' expertise, values and commitment to excellence in corporate governance assistance. It positions them as a trusted partner for organisations seeking to uphold ethical business practices and achieve enduring success in a competitive corporate landscape.

projects.name: Highland Website
projects.tagline: We Are More Than Just Property
projects.description: Highland Website. Website Transformation. We Are More Than Just Property. In the hyper-competitive property and real estate market, breaking down all barriers to search, sell, rent or buy can be the difference between stagnation and success. With an attitude of dynamic innovation at its core and growth in its ambition, Highland approached TOAST with the challenge of genuinely raising the bar for how property services could be delivered. Challenge: On the back of two major digital transformation projects (our work for Juror and Caselaw) delivered for the NSW State Government, TOAST once again partnered with renowned UX/UI expert and published author Jerry Gaffney to transform and evolve the digital experience for real estate agency Highland. From residential to commercial sales, and property management to financial services, Highland offers it all. Our team's objective for the website transformation was to deliver these services in the most intuitive, compelling and customer-centric way possible. Naturally, this involved a period of deep and thorough research, with our team devoting two months to a methodological audit and discovery process interviewing and aligning key stakeholders, before casting a net across the entire competitive property landscape — both nationally and internationally — a process of industry benchmarking and collecting insights. But it also required boundary-pushing bravery, and asking ourselves and our client: 'What could we do differently in the UX/UI space that hasn't been done before?' Solution: Creating compelling, relevant solutions relies on more than closed-door strategy and theoretical insight. In a process that was as much geared to stakeholder alignment as it was to discovery to ensure the rebuild pathway addressed genuine needs and objectives, TOAST conducted a series of one-on-one interviews with business founders, leaders, managers and operators from all levels of the organisation who contributed to our real-world understanding of the customer journey optimisation and user experience performance required to drive success. To deliver a website with a strong CRM focus to achieve targeted traction for Highland's multifaceted service offering, we customised the user database solution to create segmented consumer dimensions and user profiles to ensure the needs of target audiences were serviced with relevance in accordance to their individual likes, needs and preferences with a responsive, mobile-first design. Stakeholder interviews, site audits and accessibility tests and analytics tests were repeatedly run to ensure its performance efficacy and suitability to the business' needs. What resulted from deep analytical research and insight generation was so much more than a website. It was a robust lead-generation conversion funnel, seamlessly directing engagement towards relevant property solutions; an elevated mobile-first user experience to reflect the quality of Highland's team and brand, and a benchmark-raising digital destination to connect buyers, sellers, investors and developers, proudly leaving competitors in its wake.

projects.name: Uplifte
projects.tagline: Working with and for the best
projects.description: Working with and for the best. Uplifte, a vertical of Cozzcorp Group, is a pioneering property development company that operates with a unique ethos centred around creating value together. They are renowned for their holistic, end-to-end services that prioritise the needs and aspirations of their clients. With a mission to uplift people's lives through exceptional properties and ongoing relationships, Uplifte has positioned itself as the go-to developer in the industry. TOAST was engaged to create a brand identity and framework for their company that set them apart in the industry and communicated their extensive yet humble expertise. Challenge: TOAST recognised the need to craft a distinct identity that would capture Uplifte's commitment to holistic development and community-centric values. The challenge was to convey Uplifte's unique, client-centric approach and set them apart as the go-to developer for creating value together. Solution: TOAST's strategic branding solution centred on amplifying Uplifte's core values and strengths. Through meticulous research, interviews and client workshops, TOAST worked with their team to develop a brand identity that epitomised progression, innovation and trusted partnerships. The selection of the name 'Uplifte' for the property development vertical of Cozzcorp Group was a strategic decision rooted in the embodiment of key values: progression, success, improvement and growth. The name 'Uplifte' captures the essence of uplifting lives and communities through transformative developments, symbolising a commitment to positive change and advancement. The custom-designed wordmark and understated yet confident palette reflected Uplifte's commitment to excellence and their ability to deliver the best job, every time. Central to TOAST's strategy was the communication of Uplifte's holistic, end-to-end service and their focus on people and partnerships. By showcasing Uplifte's ability to navigate complex challenges and deliver beneficial developments, TOAST highlighted their expertise in property markets and community engagement. The strategic branding efforts culminated in the creation of a compelling tagline, "Working with and for the best," which encapsulates Uplifte's collaborative approach and commitment to consistent excellence. By strategically aligning Uplifte's brand identity with their values and strengths, TOAST has enabled Uplifte to differentiate themselves effectively and appeal as the preferred developer.

projects.name: Oxplo
projects.description: As Tough As Australia. In the rugged expanse of the Australian industrial landscape, Oxplo emerges as a beacon of durability and reliability, crafted by the experienced hands of Luyu and the strategic ingenuity of our brilliant team here at TOAST. Designed to embody the spirit of exploration and resilience, Oxplo seamlessly integrates premium quality with the robustness of the Australian outback. Rooted in the ethos of "For Australians, By Australians," Oxplo stands as a testament to Luyu's commitment to delivering machinery solutions that endure the toughest of challenges. Challenge: Oxplo faced the formidable task of not only establishing itself as a premium brand in the Australian machinery market but also embodying the essence of exploration and resilience. With Luyu's reputation for delivering comfortable, precise and reliable products, Oxplo needed to go beyond mere functionality and embrace the adventurous spirit of exploration. Moreover, the brand had to convey its deep understanding of Australian conditions while cutting through a very busy market. Solution: TOAST embarked on a strategic journey to craft Oxplo, infusing the brand with a sense of adventure, resilience and unwavering strength. Leveraging Luyu's expertise, Oxplo ensured that its products surpassed industry standards for quality and reliability. Every Oxplo machine was meticulously engineered to withstand the rigours of exploration and the harsh realities of Australian landscapes, providing customers with unrivalled performance and durability. Given this, TOAST settled on the name Oxplo, derived from 'Explore,' and 'Exploration,' capturing the essence of adventure and discovery. Additionally, the association with the animal Ox symbolises strength, durability and resilience, aligning perfectly with Oxplo's brand identity.
