The "For Australians, By Australians" ethos that TOAST strategised reinforces the brand's local roots and dedication to serving the needs of the Australian community, fostering a sense of pride and ownership among customers. Thus the tagline "As Tough as Australia" takes this ethos further and encapsulates Oxplo's commitment to resilience and durability, resonating with customers across construction and farming sectors. The brand's colour palette serves as a visual representation of its rugged, Australian-inspired identity. Drawing inspiration from the vast and diverse landscapes of the Australian outback, the palette features a harmonious blend of charcoal grey and dark orange. Reflecting the solidity and durability of the brand's machinery, the grey hues evoke the ruggedness of construction sites and the resilience required to thrive in challenging environments. Complementing this, dark, rusty orange adds a warm yet energetic element to Oxplo's palette. Inspired by the rich tones of Australian terrain, this earthy tone represents vitality, endurance and the untamed beauty of the Australian landscape. Whether on a bustling construction site or a remote farm, Oxplo's machinery stands out as a beacon of reliability and strength, embodying the spirit of "As Tough as Australia."

projects.name: Case Law
projects.client: NSW Department of Communities and Justice
projects.tagline: NSW Department of Communities and Justice
projects.description: NSW Department of Communities and Justice. Having recently and successfully delivered a project for the Department of Justice called Juror, TOAST was appointed UX/digital partner to strategically assess the online navigation and customer experience of its browser application for NSW Case Law platform. Coupled with strategic UX/UI design, our team was to execute a full brand communications audit as well as create the brand identity, digital brand, Style Guide, templates and stationery. Challenge: Prior research undertaken by the Case Law team which was conducted in the sector with judges and those using the system revealed the importance of simplicity, how technology was being adopted by specific audiences and the methods of navigation used. TOAST embraced all findings and was careful to implement these into a more efficient and sector-appropriate UX. The innovation behind the project resides in the simplicity of the data-driven platform and the direct implications this had on design. Resisting what could easily have been an over-design was pertinent. While design was a key component of the project, it is important to understand that too great a focus on aesthetics was potentially to detract from the UX. The conveying of information needed to be done simply and cleanly. Importantly, with many first time users, it was timely to address challenges within the existing user journey (UX) and implement changes that would create a seamless journey for all. The digital components of the project have been developed with a "mobile-first" philosophy to run on mobiles, tablets and laptop/desktop computer. This removes access barriers to the platform's broad audiences including the general and interested public, teachers, lecturers and students alike. Solution: With research conducted early in the process, many of the issues were ironed out early. With the digital communications component of this project being the crux, we worked closely with the Case Law team to understand the market's needs and how each persona required a different approach. TOAST's review of the comprehensive responsive wireframes was developed after an extensive amount of UX testing by the NSW Case Law team. The purpose and outcome of the project is the dramatic simplification of access to NSW Court and Tribunal case decisions while also being universally accessible and device agnostic to responsive design. Clarity around the customer journey facilitated the design and development of the user interface (UI) which presents information logically, in keeping with not only NSW Case Law's tone of voice but that of the legal profession. It is complemented by a design and colour palette that is implemented across all brand applications including a detailed digital Style Guide. The success of TOAST's collaboration with the NSW Department of Justice to deliver the Case Law online platform and digital presence saw our work awarded a GOLD award at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards for 'Service Design - Government'.

projects.name: Innovation for Impact
projects.description: CSR/ESG Framework. Elevating the award winning strategic brand platform that TOAST completed for the Inovi team in 2023, our teams collaborated once again to embark on defining a tailored CSR framework that emulates the future-focused vision of the Inovi brand and the team behind it. Inovi is a prominent player in the commercial construction sector and introducing a CSR program to their business is leading them on a transformative journey towards sustainability and social responsibility. Strategised by TOAST through extensive workshopping sessions, their program "Innovation for Impact" is rooted in the pillars of 'In,' 'Ov,' and 'I,' and represents Inovi's commitment to integrating sustainability practices, prioritising employee wellbeing, and making a positive impact on communities and cities. Challenge: Introducing a CSR program to their business provides a framework for both their short and long term goals on both an internal and external level. The company recognised that merely transitioning to environmentally friendly procedures and materials wasn't enough; thus a comprehensive CSR strategy was what was needed to drive meaningful change across its business lines. Incorporating it into an already bustling business, TOAST faced the challenge of aligning Inovi's operations with sustainable practices while ensuring the wellbeing of its employees and positively impacting the communities it serves, all under the one program. Solution: Drawing on the similar rationale behind their brand name, the Inovi CSR program was titled "Innovation for Impact" and has three key verticals: 'In,' (Innovation at the Core) 'Ov,' (Overall Wellbeing of Our People) and 'I,' (Impact on Cities and Community). These respectively represent Inovi's commitment to integrating sustainability practices, prioritising employee wellbeing and making a positive impact on communities and cities. Ensuring we created a lasting, robust platform that gave the Inovi team vision and guidance in their CSR / ESG endeavours, each pillar is associated with 3 key United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, providing the Inovi team with a clear and actionable path. The double circle symbol of the Innovation for Impact program represents the Inovi brand through a trademarked icon. Carried through for the CSR program 'Innovation for Impact', this design injects Inovi's absolute dedication to creating a lasting, positive impact within their team and wider community as a key undercurrent of their brand identity. The primary CSR logo for Inovi employs a greyscale palette (warm & dark grey), culminating in a clean and distinct brand identity that effectively embodies the focus and commitment within the brand. When developed into the 3 pillars, brighter more recognisable tones are introduced. The colour palette for CSR remains consistent with the master brand, yet with modifications in colour hierarchy. Greys take on a more pronounced role, accompanied by the addition of the three colours specific to each category. This strategic approach enhances brand recognition and positions CSR as a distinct division of the business. Through the tailored CSR program, "Innovation for Impact," Inovi has successfully addressed the challenge of integrating sustainability, prioritising employee wellbeing, and making a positive impact on communities, but not as a one-off claim, as a framework with vision, longevity and lasting relevance. By embracing innovation, fostering a supportive work environment, and actively engaging with communities, Inovi sets a benchmark for responsible and sustainable business practices in the commercial construction industry.

projects.name: Centre for Pain Impact
projects.description: Understanding pain to cure it. Centre for Pain IMPACT is a pioneering initiative driven by a team of psychologists and neuroscientists dedicated to revolutionising the field of chronic pain research. With a mission to disrupt traditional approaches and advance towards finding a cure, the organisation stands at the forefront of innovation and collaboration. Rooted in the belief that comprehensive understanding leads to effective solutions, Centre for Pain IMPACT is committed to empowering individuals to reclaim their lives from the grips of chronic pain. As a brand integrated in the NeuRA research group, IMPACT needed to build their own identity and create a recognisable brand for themselves. Challenge: Despite significant advancements in medical science, chronic pain remains a pervasive and debilitating condition for millions worldwide. The challenge lies in not only managing the symptoms but also in unravelling the complex underlying mechanisms of pain. Traditional approaches often fall short in providing holistic solutions tailored to individual experiences. Centre for Pain IMPACT recognised the need for a paradigm shift in how chronic pain is understood, managed and ultimately cured. The challenge that TOAST was engaged to solve was to establish a brand identity that reflects their innovative spirit, collaborative ethos and unwavering commitment to making a meaningful impact on people's lives. Solution: At the heart of Centre for Pain IMPACT's brand identity is the essence of understanding and validating pain as the key to unlocking effective solutions. This mantra not only reflects their scientific approach but also underscores their empathy and dedication to validating the experiences of those affected by chronic pain. Their team engages with scientists, academics, clinicians and individuals impacted by chronic pain to foster an environment of collective intelligence and shared purpose. In this way, they embrace innovation and disruption, challenging the status quo in pain research. Their brand thus communicates a bold and forward-thinking approach, signalling their readiness to explore new avenues and push boundaries in pursuit of a cure. Above all, their brand narrative is about empowering individuals to reclaim their lives from the shackles of chronic pain. By providing tailored solutions and fostering a sense of agency, they aim to make a tangible impact on the lives of those they serve. These core values of IMPACT culminated in a brand identity that is entirely people-focused. With a colour palette of softened vibrant tones interwoven with individual and group-based imagery assets, the identity symbolises IMPACT's comprehensive healthcare approach and their focus on the complete wellbeing of individuals with chronic pain. The logotype incorporates a stylised image of two hands coming together, a symmetric design which reinforces the idea of a coordinated and integrated approach to healthcare and reflects the collaboration between medical experts and patients, working together towards a common goal of pain relief and improved quality of life. Through a strategic brand design process, Centre for Pain IMPACT has successfully established a cohesive brand identity that resonates with their stakeholders and embodies their mission to disrupt, innovate, and ultimately cure chronic pain.

projects.name: The Colliery
projects.description: Home of Bespoke Experiences. Working again with the dedicated team at Inovi Projects, TOAST was challenged to create a luxe and alluring brand suite for a bespoke accommodation offering in a respectfully converted mining precinct, The Colliery. Situated in the midst of Australia's coveted Hunter Region, The Colliery stands as a testament to the seamless integration of history, luxury and natural beauty. Formerly known as the 'Paxton Colliery', this remarkable location is more than just a place to stay—it's an immersive experience that pays homage to the site's rich legacy while offering unparalleled hospitality in a setting of unparalleled natural splendour. Challenge: The transformation of the Paxton Colliery into 'The Colliery' presented a unique set of challenges. Firstly, there was a need to preserve the historical significance of the site, which bore the marks of its past as a thriving coal mine. Secondly, the project had to respect the traditional custodians of the land, while also creating a luxury destination that would attract and delight modern travellers. Balancing these elements while maintaining the integrity of the site's heritage required a delicate and strategic branding approach. Solution: To address these challenges, The Colliery project embraced a holistic approach that celebrated the site's heritage, honoured its traditional owners, and elevated the guest experience to new heights. This was translated by our team into the manifesto of 'The Home of Bespoke Experiences', capturing the stateliness of the site and echoing the myriad opportunities the destination beckons. The Colliery's architectural team approached the restoration of the site with meticulous care, ensuring that every aspect of the original buildings is to be respectfully preserved and elevated in a way that maintains the beautiful legacy of the structure. From the brickwork produced onsite to the timber milled in the sawmill, every element is to be retained to showcase the site's industrial heritage. Our team thus approached the branding in a similar vein; the colour palette, reminiscent of the surrounding natural landscape, was incorporated into the design to create a cohesive and immersive experience for guests that blends effortlessly into the time period of the site whilst introducing the desired level of absolute luxury to the converted space. Each building within The Colliery was reimagined to offer a unique and tailored experience for guests. From the Bath House to the Power House, Engine House, Fan House, Shed, and Dwelling, each venue was designed to showcase its individual character while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic that echoed the site's industrial past. TOAST's branding thus took on a 'brand architecture' approach, adapting the core brand to mould to each of the site's offerings. The result is a collection of branded spaces that seamlessly blend luxury with history, offering guests an unforgettable journey through time. The Colliery stands as a shining example of adaptive reuse done right—a luxury hotel that not only respects the site's legacy but also celebrates it at every turn. Our branding suite, incorporating the iconic chimney and the metalworks inherent to the site, and colouring that heroes the natural beauty of the surrounding landscape, perfectly complements the subtle reinterpretation of the site, integrating design aspects that are innate to the region whilst bringing an uplifted appeal of pure luxury and unforgettable experiences.

projects.name: CAW.SYD
projects.description: Change Through Action. Climate Action Week Sydney 2024 (CAW SYD) was held from 13-19 May and is an annual, global event pulsating with activities in the heart of the City of Sydney. The week encompasses a series of community-led events from all aspects of the climate action ecosystem to bring together like minded individuals, groups and changemakers to amplify the discourse around climate action. As part of the dedicated brand/marketing planning committee including The Being Group, Edge Impact, Greenhouse and Investible, TOAST collaborated on the visionary development and delivery of 2024's Climate Action Week Sydney. Our team was instrumental in crafting the brand framework and identity for the event, a design so impactful that it has also been used for CAW SYD 2025. We are thrilled to see our vision continue to shape and inspire this vital movement. Challenge: The challenge for TOAST was to create a strategic framework and visual identity that captures the essence of Climate Action Week Sydney and resonates with diverse audiences. The goal was to foster an inclusive Australian Grassroots Movement engaging with all walks of life, promote connection, collaboration and commitment to supporting climate action and establish a distinctive CAW SYD identity solidifying Sydney's global leadership in sustainability. Solution: TOAST crafted a dynamic visual identity for CAW SYD that underscores the transformative beauty of change through action and the power of togetherness for a common goal. With a vibrant and adaptable colour scheme, this concept revolves around the collective power of societal action and displays the resounding transformations that can incur from even the simplest of movements. The design is elevated by dynamic graphic elements, infused with colour and emotion to underscore the wealth of opportunity inherent in Sydney's innovative cityscape and reveal the ideas, passion and vision abundant in the community. The strategic framework aimed to establish a platform for ongoing engagement and collaboration, emphasising traditional knowledge, engaging neighbouring nations and ensuring diverse, accessible initiatives, reflecting Sydney's global outlook. This framework underlines CAW SYD as a dynamic climate action event, uniting professionals and communities to engage in discussions and innovatively tackle global climate issues. With the strategic framework and visual identity created by TOAST, Climate Action Week Sydney has amplified the City of Sydney's role in addressing the urgent need for climate action. It embarks on a transformative journey toward becoming a green and inclusive city while fostering a Climate Action Ecosystem that engages all stakeholders and reflects Sydney's commitment to a sustainable future. TOAST is overjoyed to be a founding member of Climate Action Week Sydney and to be part of a growing network of Future Makers across the world.

projects.name: Earth Hour x EPSON
projects.description: A Simple Switch. Epson, world-leading printing and electronics manufacturer, is a trailblazer in the corporate world for their rigorous sustainability goals and measures. Their commitment to the environment began close to 80 years ago and is stronger than ever today. Their product designs and business decisions focus on low energy consumption, minimised waste, small environmental footprints, high reliability and minimal moving parts. Epson's environmentally focused vision coincides with the mission of WWF's annual campaign Earth Hour and that of our global branding team here at TOAST - all seeking to create a better, greener future for our planet. Bringing together these like minded teams, WWF Singapore and our TOAST team worked with Epson to spearhead a sub-campaign for Earth Hour 2024. As Earth Hour's first international corporate partner, the collaboration between Epson, TOAST and WWF has created an invaluable partnership as we embark on a mission to amplify Earth Hour's message and encourage collective action towards sustainability. Challenge: The primary challenge of this sub-campaign lay in rallying global, cross-demographic support and engagement to foster a unified movement towards a sustainable planet. Working across 3 time zones and uniting 20+ passionate individuals, TOAST, Epson and WWF-Singapore faced the task of inspiring individuals and communities worldwide to actively participate in Earth Hour's mission. Additionally, the emphasis on community involvement required strategies that resonated at both local and global levels. Collaboration across diverse stakeholders and aligning with Epson's existing initiatives, added depth and complexity to the project, necessitating seamless alignment of objectives and approaches. Solution: The sub-campaign for Epson was aptly named 'A Simple Switch', symbolising the small yet impactful changes all individuals can make to support environmental conservation efforts. By simply making a slight switch in our daily habits, we can have a great combined impact on our environment. TOAST's involvement in the campaign was enormously comprehensive, beginning with a 2-day strategic alignment session for the three teams in Singapore. Emile, our Head of Strategy, ran two 6 hour collaborative sessions with the Epson team. This involved strategic visioning and campaign development - pivotal moves for aligning all stakeholders towards a unified vision and approach. Using the defined campaign concept of 'A Simple Switch', The Toasties leveraged our expertise in script writing, storyboarding and video production to create compelling video campaigns that captured the essence of Earth Hour's message and highlighted Epson's dedication to sustainability through its #MakeTheSwitch campaign. A comprehensive social media strategy devised by TOAST and WWF ensured maximum outreach, amplifying Earth Hour's impact and raising awareness of Epson's sustainability initiatives on a global scale. Recognising the importance of internal alignment within Epson's team for the roll out and comprehension of the campaign, with WWF, TOAST produced valuable documentation and resources, including a campaign communications guideline, operations manual and detailed employee e-handbook. These resources empowered Epson's team to champion the campaign internally and externally, ensuring alignment with the campaign's objectives and Earth Hour's initiatives. Beyond the immediate campaign objectives, the collaboration fostered a lasting legacy of partnership and innovation in the fight against climate change. By harnessing the collective power of creativity, technology and environmental advocacy, the collaboration exemplified the transformative potential of cross-sector partnerships in addressing global challenges. In an era defined by environmental urgency, the collaboration between TOAST, Epson and WWF-Singapore stands as a beacon of hope and progress. Through strategic alignment, creative execution and a shared unwavering environmental commitment, our three teams demonstrated the power of collaboration in driving meaningful change. And as the world continues to grapple with environmental challenges, this campaign partnership serves as a testament to the transformative impact that can be achieved when organisations unite towards a common purpose: to create a more sustainable future for generations to come. The collaboration between WWF-Singapore, TOAST, and Epson resulted in a resounding success, with the 'A Simple Switch' sub-campaign making a significant impact on raising awareness and driving action for sustainability. WWF-Singapore is open to develop more meaningful partnerships for now and the future.

projects.name: Earth Hour
projects.tagline: Switch off. Give an hour for Earth.
projects.description: Switch off. Give an hour for Earth. Earth Hour, the largest environmental grassroots movement in the world, is a household name for environmentally conscious activities. First taking place via its famed 'switch off' campaign in 2007, Earth Hour has grown to be an annual celebration and epicentre for coming together for our environment and doing activities we enjoy which protect and preserve our Earth. In a powerful collaboration, TOAST is utterly overjoyed to be working with WWF International's Singapore team as part of the team behind Earth Hour 2024. This alliance signifies a shared commitment to environmental sustainability, community engagement, and a vision for a more eco-conscious future. The collaboration draws on TOAST's strategic branding expertise and Earth Hour's global influence, our collaboration has helped amplify the campaign's impact, so much so that our design and branding will continue to be used for Earth Hour 2025. Challenge: The challenge for the 2024 campaign lies in maximising recognition and engagement to foster a global movement towards a sustainable planet. TOAST and Earth Hour faced the task of inspiring individuals and communities worldwide to actively participate in Earth Hour's mission to protect the planet. Additionally, the emphasis on community involvement requires strategies that resonate at both local and global levels. This campaign involved multi-level global collaboration across a number of months. Ideation sessions, seminars and interviews needed to take place for this to come to life effectively and efficiently. Solution: TOAST's innovative strategies, including cutting-edge digital campaigns and compelling storytelling, are at the forefront of the solution. As Future Makers, our team at TOAST is committed to adopting new methodologies, questioning our internal viewpoints and challenging the status quo in order to make a statement and encourage change. The collaboration between WWF Singapore's Earth Hour team and TOAST here in Sydney leverages our creative ingenuity to develop narratives and visuals that captivate diverse audiences, ensuring global resonance. The key solution this year lay in mobilising communities from grassroots initiatives to global events, encouraging participation in ways that align with the overarching goal of sustainability and showcasing that everyday activities, that we already participate in and enjoy, are in fact actions that help our planet. Collaborating over 6 months, TOAST worked with the Earth Hour team in Singapore to visualise this year's concept through captivating video content (featuring none other than Ed Sheeran!). Following the Earth Hour style guide, we worked closely to develop multiple scripts that communicated the 2024 mission, ensuring they were punchy, accessible and globally relevant. This was converted into both Radio and Video content where we created detailed storyboards and developed custom graphic elements and transitions to build a story around the 2024 concept, encouraging the globe to #GiveAnHourForEarth. The TOAST and Earth Hour collaboration for the 2024 campaign is a fusion of creativity, passion and purpose. Together, we are striving to create ripples of positive change, leaving an indelible mark on the global community. The solution lies in transformative strategies that redefine the narrative of environmental initiatives, inspiring a collective commitment to a sustainable future!

projects.name: Zama
projects.description: The Beginning of Something New. Bondi Rd is a fast growing foodie scene in the eastern edge of Bondi Beach. Home to Totti's, The Corner House and Carbon, the last few years have seen many acclaimed names pop up in this enviable side of Sydney. Zama is the newest name in the Bondi Rd scene. A bar/restaurant with an exotic Latin American feel, Zama is an innovative foodie sensation adding undeniable value to Bondi locals. Challenge: Zama, meaning 'Dawning of the sun' or 'Sunrise', was created with a vision to deliver an Argentinian asado venue in the heart of Bondi. A place inspired by Tulum - its culture, history and its jungle aesthetic, merging a relaxed restaurant-feel with the enticing allure of a late-night cocktail bar. It is a place full of flavours, recipes and cultures, a blend of seasonality and exotic experiences. TOAST was engaged by their team to ideate the brand behind this vision. Our team was tasked with crafting a place narrative that encapsulated something raw and authentic, a warm, inviting restaurant by the beach with the desirable "Bondi vibe," whilst staying exotic. Zama needed to be recognised as a friendly venue, a place to feel good & make friends. We needed to curate a sense of belonging and desire. Solution: Looking at competing restaurants along Bondi Rd and Argentinian steakhouses throughout Sydney, our team understood that Zama needed to focus on the experience - to be aspirational, not just functional, and to stand out in this way. Drawing on the cultural history of Tulum and the depth of meaning behind 'Zama', we built the Zama brand around this 'new beginning' and crafted assets around nature's four classical elements. Holding endless possibilities and consistently allowing for an essence of discovery, the four elements of Fire, Earth, Air and Water formed the foundation of this brand. Tying in with the unfussy / bohemian chic / Tulum style that formed the brand vision, the four elements bring life to the brand and embody its core values of creating a space that elevates our being and delivers a joyful spark of flavours, experiences and memories. Our team crafted the logotype and overall look & feel using this foundation and tying in the namesake sunrise to sunset notion. The contemporary, geometric custom typography of the logotype draws on the four classical elements of earth, water, air and fire, championing the cultural legacy these elements hold. Tying in with this, Zama's corporate brand colours feature muted, natural tones from bone and beige through to black; the palette comes alive through the day to night organic colour transition, indicative of the cultural exoticism and elemental exploration underpinning the brand. TOAST's branding suite for Zama was delivered across internal and external collateral including brand guideline documentation, external signage, full website, social media and restaurant collateral.

projects.name: Mezfi
projects.description: The Best of Both Worlds. MezFi provides an accessible entry point into the restrictive world of investment platforms. From banks, to brokers and beyond, it can be immensely difficult to enter, understand and grow in the market. Thus, the makers of MezFi wanted to provide an accessible investment opportunity for everyday investors. They disagree with the exclusivity of investment access and thus developed a service built around the idea of providing greater opportunity to benefit from restrictive financial products and more simply enter the world of mezzanine finance. Challenge: Mezzanine finance, a financing instrument used as a method to bridge capital attainment in property development and intervene to supplement bank or equity financing, is a form of highly exclusive investing that restricts wider audiences through requiring a large financial sum to gain entry. With MezFi, the everyday person can benefit from mezzanine finance funds just like high net-worth individuals using the power of grouped investments. MezFi provides access to mezzanine finance with a minimum fee of just $10,000 and pools these funds to reach the required investment. Platforms like this are existing, with property investment a growing industry, yet MezFi differs in the market by being a hybrid instrument. Typically an illiquid fund, MezFi provides access to invested mezzanine finance capital at any time through a digital asset secured in Web3 technology - a liquidity feature which can be actioned (or not) within the period of the fund. Their fund thus merges two financial worlds, providing the benefits of traditional mezzanine finance investments with a liquidity feature from Web3. TOAST was engaged to communicate this unique and game-changing service to the market in an evocative, engaging and empowering brand identity. Our challenge was to develop a corporate brand footprint, determining the best way to clearly communicate this to audiences, without dividing the two worlds. Solution: TOAST conducted extensive research and industry analysis to delve into this financial realm. Benchmarking existing local and international platforms and assessing the benefits of both traditional finance and Web3 technology provided the footing we required to build this forward-thinking brand. Identifying a selling funnel for engaging users to invest with MezFi was a crucial part of our strategic process. We recognised that the introduction of liquidity to this method of investment was a fundamental selling point. Investing with MezFi provides the unique benefits and high returns of mezzanine finance, usually only accessible to high net worth individuals, coupled with the security and liquidity functionality of Web3 technology. This insight led to our big idea and tagline generation: 'The Best of Both Worlds'. By combining two financial worlds, MezFi investors receive double the benefits - the benefits of traditional mezzanine finance investment plus the benefits of Web3 technology. Merging the benefits of transparency, regulation and asset tangibility that come with traditional finance, with the liquidity opportunities, lack of global borders and blockchain tracking introduced by Web3, MezFi delivers an opportunistic finance platform where you receive the best of two very different types of financial advantages at the same time. We reflected this highly innovative service in a uniquely future-focused, empowering look & feel. Building on a customised blockchain-like grid design, our concept for their brand identity is a clear depiction of the stability of traditional finance and the forward thinking approach of Web3 which combine to form MezFi. Focusing on the concept of mutualism and the brand's future focused foundation, the logotype design links two different worlds in a dynamic, fresh and contemporary fashion, showcasing a brand that goes beyond boundaries and continually thinks outside the box. With a colour palette of vibrant pink, green, blue and indigo, a dynamic, 'new world' look & feel is created, one that celebrates innovation and breaks norms, and is differentiated from the primary block colours of traditional financial services. Providing access to a mode of investing that is usually highly exclusive, MezFi is a trustworthy equaliser, levelling the playing field within financial institutions. The brand identity we created presents MezFi as knowledgeable and visionary; a platform that delivers a fresh way to make money and paves the way for innovative investment methodologies into the future.

projects.name: So Shall We
projects.description: Your growth is our business. For over a decade, digital marketers So Shall We have harnessed the potential of data, creative and marketing strategy to put businesses and organisations on a trajectory of growth, reach and influence. So Shall We's difference lies beyond their creative flair, and can be found in data gained through the latest digital marketing techniques and continual testing and iterations to drive growth, helping B2B & B2C organisations to plan their strategies, anticipate change and make constant improvements in order to meet their acquisition goals. Breathing life and potential into a growing client base of Tier One national and international brands including the Australian Government, Newscorp and several Premier League football clubs, it was time for So Shall We to take the success of their recent past and lay the foundations for the future at the forefront of digital strategy, production and implementation. Challenge: As futuremakers, our role at TOAST is to deeply understand the landscape our clients are performing in, identify their unique strengths, then amplify a creative corridor for the brand to confidently occupy and thrive. We identified the core challenge for So Shall We as elevating the external perception of them from being 'just another digital and social media agency', repositioning the elite team as dedicated growth strategy and execution consultants; establishing confidence in the team's obvious creative talent by grounding the offering in the team's empirical, data and testing-led methodology. This challenge established the foundations of a creative brief, which was: To equally combine artistry with intelligence supported by a strategic territory that appealed to the head as much as the heart. Solution: Through a process of immersion and workshopping, we established 'Business Growth Culture' as the creative platform for their brand evolution. By defining 'growth culture' as a foundational mindset and a set of beliefs that is focused on helping staff and customers develop their limitless potential, So Shall We could 'own' the positioning of Growth Culture as a means to drive business growth – both internally and externally – by mastering creative, data, on-site and media optimisation. Championing the concept of the business growth mindset aligned authentically with So Shall We's methodology and delivery. For So Shall We, it means understanding and appreciating the unique value clients offer their customers, enabling the team to define, implement and follow a growth marketing strategy and action plan that yields the recognition and financial success that So Shall We's clients deserve. From this strategic territory, a bold new creative identity was born. With endless flexibility at its core, the personality-fuelled design concept drew inspiration from ideas of recognition, introduction and interaction, exposing how So Shall We takes action delving into their clients' category, never shying away from complex or adverse ideas. A typographic solution bringing the 'So, Shall We…?' question to life established an invitation for clients to collaborate, learn, explore, create and ultimately grow, delivering on the brand's core purpose within the visual expression of the identity. The tagline 'Your Growth is our Business' creates confidence in So Shall We's role, establishing crystal clear expectations around outcomes to anticipate when partnering with this expert team. So Shall We's growth leadership positioning and bold new brand identity successfully combines the empirical strategy and creative execution, establishing each new client interaction as an opportunity for presence, learning, contribution and excellence, all while constantly improving.

projects.name: Collection
projects.description: Artisans of Lifestyle. When a prospective buyer steps into your display suite, you only get one chance to make a first impression that could inspire the buy. When the stakes are that high, TOAST's creativity goes higher. Taking brand well beyond the page and screen, TOAST is proud to unveil Sammut Group's Collection Display Suite. Having worked in tandem with PBD Architects and Sammut Group through a brand-first design approach from the very foundation of this project, our teams collaborated to create an interactive display suite to introduce the public to Sammut's corporate brand and projects, primarily showcasing the uniqueness of latest development 'Vue'. Challenge: Stepping into an empty shell, TOAST initially collaborated with PBD Architects to map out and envisage a multi-zoned space which had the capability to showcase 1 hero project and 4 additional live projects at any one time, alongside Sammut's own 'Artisan Wall' paying tribute to the Group's history, achievements, accolades and awards to establish confidence and trust in the experienced development team. Devoted to Sammut's corporate identity, crafted by TOAST, this Group section of the display suite stems from their brand positioning as 'Artisans of lifestyle,' communicating their vision for redefining luxury through a considered, crafted approach. Solution: Following a deep immersion and leveraging a decade of understanding of the triggers influencing purchasing decisions, we engaged the DisplaySweet team to support us in showcasing all content digitally within the space. Together, we delivered a sophisticated multi-media, multi-project display hub, bringing to life over a decade of TOAST's best-practice sales suite design experience with cutting edge technology combining plate plans, 3D modelling and lifestyle video content with innovative environmental design to create a truly interactive experience supporting sales agents to convert. Featuring luxurious branding, signage, sales track functionality and informative, inspiring wall graphics along with multimedia branded video content, TOAST's in depth understanding of the property buyer's sales journey and UX understanding is equally on proud display.

projects.name: Coore
projects.description:
Coore — Brand Transformation. Your Driving Force. As any Australian car enthusiast who seeks performance when they get behind the wheel would know, you need a car that can support your passion. In the world of elite motorsports, seconds matter and millimetres make the difference between victory and defeat. From road to race, Coore believes every Australian looking to maximise the performance of a vehicle, deserves access to the best products and services on the market. Located in Sydney and servicing a national network of wholesale customers, Coore is an industry-leading team with a background in motorsport. They understand that car modifications represent that “magic power” in moving forward with your vehicle and give you a competitive advantage, through high-end quality automotive parts (especially suspension, brake kits and tuning) delivering speed and performance for all applications and budgets.

Challenge: With deep pockets and extensive international marketing assets at their disposal, many automotive products, particularly elite European products, claim to be the best of their type on the market in both performance and fitment. Regarded by their loyal customers as leaders in their field, and home to several lines of exclusively distributed high-end European product, Coore was doing everything right in terms of product, price and service. It was time for the business to embrace a new brand identity that could play in the elite field of expertise Coore so humbly inhabited, and create a platform to showcase and sell their high-quality product range.

Solution: A process of deep immersion, research and collaborative workshopping was required for TOAST to get to the core of Coore: to authentically understand and appreciate what makes cars perform. By actively seeking high-end products in suspension, brake kits and tunings made overseas and then acting on getting their exclusivity in Australia, Coore’s success lay in being in the business of driving better outcomes for their clients, and their business. This approach has fundamentally structured Coore’s offering and the distribution of the products through an exclusive e-commerce channel. By always looking for the best, for the best performance: Best brands, best products, best delivery and packaging, best warranties, best user journey and online purchase, and best advice along the journey, we identified Coore as ‘a driving force’ for their customers - delivering the best of the best in the industry. ‘Your Driving Force’ became the central creative brief for a brand transformation befitting some of the world’s most coveted automotive products. Under the tagline ‘Your Driving Force’, we were able to position Coore as so much more than a sales team stocking a large volume of automotive enhancement product. A future-forward type-led brand identity was developed to support this strategic positioning based on an interlinking cable chain symbol, representing Coore’s delivery of holistic end-to-end service. Indicative of continuous improvement and expert knowledge, this logotype design celebrates Coore's dedication to uplifting a vehicle's operational power. They exist to empower, to maximise and to inspire. The result of the brand transformation confidently establishes Coore as your pit stop. Coore as being by your side. Coore as part of your team. Alongside its customers, Coore shares the thrill of the challenge. Together, they strive to propel their customers faster along their journey towards performance, and victory.

projects.name: 120 Edward St
projects.description:
120 Edward St — DWS investment group. Brand Visualisation. Habitat at 120 Edward. 120 Edward st is an office building owned by DWS investment group in the heart of Brisbane. Located between the city’s Elizabeth and Charlotte Streets, it is in a prime luxury retail precinct lined with heritage buildings that are home to high end boutique offerings by Tag Heuer, Hugo Boss, Cartier, Hermes, and Mont Blanc. The site has many distinguishing attributes and unique usages of the space. It boasts a stylish, homely workplace design with open plan offices and flexible breakout spaces. There are landscaped outdoor balconies with bbq/bar installations on some levels, as well as freshly-appointed end-of-trip facilities available to all tenants. Thus the building actively embraces the latest working trend of open plan offices with bright, natural accents. Yet there are aspects of the site that remain under-utilised as well as a disconnect with the exterior branding, meaning there is an inherent lack of awareness of their brand and site offering.

Challenge: 120 Edward’s leasing experience is currently price and convenience driven, leaning on functional and rational building attributes, yet it is immediately evident that this site offers so much more. This however is un-communicated and thus unknown to the outside. TOAST were engaged to elevate the position of this modern building to corporate tenants and develop a higher-level brand proposition that appeals to the target audience, whilst being aware of their unique drivers and needs. There is a need for an emotive, themed marketing platform. With a fairly generic brand identity and marketing experience, the building lacks a compelling brand proposition to leverage and therefore lacks distinction from a crowded market. Plus, there is a need for a more inspiring proposition for the building, and an internal experience that brings this promise to life. To work closely to DWS’ vision, our team needed to focus on establishing a thematic brand proposition that supports the building identity for tenants, guests and the business community at large.

Solution: In researching the surrounding area, competitors, and immersing ourselves in the space, we highlighted key areas requiring attention to expand on the brand experience. The modernised office suite fit-outs promise a workplace adept with current trends, however the identity and arrival experience remained dull, dated and lacking in emotive theming. Thus there existed an overall disconnect between the internal on-trend offerings with the identity of the overall building offering. To bring new life to 120 Edward, we identified a need to elevate the arrival experience, giving tenants and visitors an opportunity to be enriched by the space as part of their working day. TOAST worked to create pride in the address by elevating the experience for tenants and guests. Our brand narrative for 120 Edward focused on the creation of value and awareness for the building by amplifying the building’s existing green theme as a welcome retreat for the city. Introducing 120 Edward as more than a desk; as a green workplace it is a daytime retreat to work, meet or recharge. This thought analysis lead to the big idea ‘Habitat at 120 Edward’. Habitat at 120 Edward is a place where productivity and purpose exist in harmony with cool, green spaces. Where inspired, modern workplaces reside within a green enclave, to be enjoyed by all. This is a building that supports the working day with healthy, vibrant and modern spaces that inspire fertile thinking and growth. This idea aligns with our society’s changing nature of work. We are not tied to our desks from 9-5; we need areas to recharge, environments that inspire and spaces that are conducive with enjoyable and collaborative productivity. 120 Edward was rebranded as a space offering precisely this.

projects.name: Inovi
projects.description:
Inovi — Cozzcorp Group. Brand Visualisation. Design & Build Excellence. Inovi, a division of Cozzcorp Group, exists to deliver excellence. Delivering end-to-end construction services with a ‘can do’ attitude, this is a brand that rolls up its sleeves and always delivers for its clients. For close to 20 years the Cozzcorp brand has delivered excellence through attention to detail, a love for design and qualified architectural skills, they have grown from experience and display a passion for perfection in all that they do. (Case study includes brand launch videos.)

Challenge: Until recently, Cozzcorp has primarily existed as a brand offering building services across commercial, industrial and office/retail fit out. TOAST was engaged to identify the purpose of their commercial building arm and assess how our team could successfully support its transformation by creating a new, aspirational brand. Looking at a business and brand transformation, our relevant challenges were to: Develop awareness of Cozzcorp in the hospitality industry; Shift the business ambition & model; Communicate the brand’s vision, mission & purpose; Showcase the business’ unwavering client commitment. We needed to clearly express the business’ rational and emotional value; helping to connect and build loyalty with customers.

Solution: Introducing Inovi. Embodying the integrity and ingenuity that underpin the company, Inovi reflects a commitment to delivering excellence. This brand concept positions design and innovation at the centre and harnesses methodologies which advance in tandem with emerging technologies and client needs. Going above and beyond to deliver the perfect outcome, Inovi embraces innovation, builds trustworthy relationships and always goes the extra mile. On an internal level and with small to large scale clients, those at Cozzcorp Group do what they say and say what they do. Always looking to do the right thing and raise the bar in everyday delivery, they apply a superior, qualitative and comprehensive process for their people, clients and suppliers. Building on this foundation of consistently looking to deliver passion and excellence, we created the tagline ‘Design & Build Excellence,’ not only capturing their dedication to raising the bar, yet capturing the two areas wherein they work best. When ideating the brand’s translation into an uplifted visual look & feel, our stakeholder interviews and market analysis revealed that Cozzcorp was seeking an innovative, fresh and clean brand. One that clearly communicated their passion and drive for advancing in tandem with the market and staying abreast of trends and emerging technologies. With a nod to innovation, future-focused thinking and cutting edge approaches, this brand came to life in a bronze-toned wordmark formulated in a uniform grid pattern. This design embodies the forward thinking approach that is core to the brand and conveys the quality techniques that separate Inovi as a leader in the industry. Furthermore, their corporate colour palette features tones of white, charcoal and bronze; monochromatic and metallic colours which are indicative of the quality, strength and dedication that underpin Inovi. Cozzcorp Group successfully launched Inovi in March of 2023. TOAST partnered with their team to deliver their full branding suite, website design, logotype VFX and the creative direction of a brand launch video for this important event.

projects.name: Refilled
projects.description:
Refilled — Brand Transformation. Push for extraordinary. On average, Australians use 130kg of plastic per person, per year. Less than 12% of this gets properly recycled, meaning there is still 88% of our plastic waste going straight to landfill. Contributing the most to this, worldwide, are beverage companies Coca Cola and PepsiCo. Removing the clear pain point - plastic - is a starkly needed factor to lessen our increasing impact on the environment. Refilled delivers a simple, sustainable solution. Refilled is an eco-tech company providing a sustainable solution for beverage brands, organisations and consumers to go plastic-free. Their brand vision is to deliver an eco-tech service that allows individuals to tackle climate action on their own accord. They provide a service offering that puts the solution to plastic consumption in our very own hands and creates a tangible, trackable way to mitigate climate change on a personal, industrial and global level. However, their branding was inconsistent with this core purpose. With a wide reaching colour palette, busy iconography and generationally-exclusive language, their existing branding did not communicate their mission, was too confusing and disadvantageous for their desired corporate trajectory.

Challenge: The immediate purpose of evolving Refilled as a more robust brand was to uplift the overall business understanding and perception of its sustainable actions, reflecting its unique environmental offering that is reinventing the beverage industry. TOAST was engaged to strategise the brand transformation for the overall Refilled brand, elevating their image and communication style in order to prepare for its break away from the generation z/university market and expand into the startup, SMEs & corporate world. Our team approached this project with the ultimate brand and business objectives of positively articulating the Refilled company to its diverse markets with clear, engaging and outcome-driven messaging. Through a concise brand narrative, we needed to develop a positive reputation, a sense of pride and attract great B2B & B2C clients, helping SMEs and mid-size companies in showcasing their commitment for a better Australia and environment, stimulating the adoption of plastic-free alternatives and to develop a product offering applicable to a wide range of businesses.

Solution: Refilled sends a message of action toward climate change, allows users to track the very impact they are making, and creates a lifestyle around ‘doing good’ for the world. It provides a tangible way for people to bring climate action into their own hands - turning an everyday act into an act of climate action. Through a considered strategic process of stakeholder interviews, an interactive brand workshop and thorough industry analysis, our team gained crucial insights which served as a valuable strategic direction for the future Refilled brand identity. Assessing other ‘change making’ brands highlighted that creating a lifestyle and promoting a clear set of values around the brand was key to consumer intrigue and engagement, awareness raising and to forge a community movement. This insight supported Refilled’s DNA as ‘the facilitator to do good’. We identified the business opportunity for Refilled as to unify people on a positive journey of plastic reduction, providing a platform to contribute to a global plastic reduction movement. We were redirecting Refilled from being viewed as merely a convenient service, to being recognised as an added value to people’s lives. As a ‘facilitator’, Refilled supports and enables: the reduction of individual plastic consumption; corporate companies’ CO2 reduction goals; a desirable sustainable lifestyle; the mitigation of plastic pollution in our local & global environment. In doing this, Refilled transforms the ordinary into the extraordinary. An ordinary act of drinking water becomes something extraordinary by reducing the plastic waste involved. The Refilled dispenser empowers users to change the world by reducing the waste created by plastic bottles. By choosing to drink Refilled, we are pushing for a better future. Together. This direction thus formed the tagline and business direction of ‘Push for Extraordinary,’ ‘Choose. Drink. Refill,’ promoting a cycle where every time a user chooses to drink Refilled, they are pushing for something extraordinary - a cleaner planet. Our brand narrative promotes an attainable, sustainable lifestyle and creates a community of like-minded consumers. This vision is translated in the brand’s visual identity; the bright & fresh appeal of the creative assets embodying the eco-conscious core of the brand. We created a natural, clean colour palette with marine hues of aqua and navy, paired with custom clean-lined, contemporary iconography and graphic assets highlighting the bespoke water droplet of the logotype. This sophisticated and streamlined brand identity positions Refilled as a leader in the industry, preparing it for launch in the corporate world. By simplifying the brand assets, reducing the colour palette and championing its core message of plastic reduction, our brand narrative and strategic visual identity creates an admirable and approachable sustainable lifestyle and showcases its commitment to a better Australia, and globe. Additionally, the clean, elegant design supports the key goal of developing a product offering applicable to a wide range of industries.

projects.name: The Know
projects.tagline: Australian Emerging Drug Information & Resources Hub
projects.description:
The Know — NCCRED PRN. Brand Visualisation. Australian Emerging Drug Information & Resources Hub. Recreational drug use is common practice worldwide. With various ‘illicit’ drugs becoming easier to access and, in some cases, decriminalised, their usage is continuing to rise. With this comes rising cases of drug overdose, potential poisoning and long term harm to users’ health. Incidents of such harm resulting from recreational use or heavy usage can be mitigated, and even avoided entirely, if information is readily available on drugs’ safety. This is the founding mission of NCCRED’s Prompt Response Network and their newly crafted online platform ‘The Know’. Designed to provide free, up-to-date and judgement-free advice or alerts about the harm factor or legitimacy of current drug strains in the community, The Know will inform users of toxic chemicals and cases of lacing or the illegitimacy of emerging illicit drugs. Through their Prompt Response Network (PRN), NCCRED runs several programs related to emerging drugs. Their programs deliver harm reduction services, helping to develop nuanced understandings around emerging drugs (and drugs in general) used among our communities, and empowering the people affected, and the general public, with relevant information through alerts.

Challenge: Worldwide, incidents of drug abuse and drug-related accidents are increasing as people experiment with emerging drugs and the strengths increase of ‘old-school’ drugs. Such harms can be prevented and reduced by the timely sharing of accurate, relevant information. TOAST was approached by NCCRED’s PRN platform to assess this situation, looking at how information can be made accessible and clearly understood whilst remaining accurate for all Australian communities. In this vein, our team was engaged to strategise, design and launch a public-facing brand which will act as a trusted and highly reliable source of information to help reduce harm across the drug landscape in Australia. From the outset of this project, we recognised that reduction of drug use was not PRN’s core goal. Their goal was to provide accurate and up-to-date information to reduce the negative consequences that arise from drug misinformation and the consumption of compromised strains. The brand’s core purpose was to shift the narrative on drugs; supportive and open-minded values needed to be at the heart of the messaging. TOAST needed to create an altruistic brand which can be trusted. Our challenge was around building an influential platform which would be successful in engaging diverse audience groups on such a critical matter.

Solution: PRN exists to improve the health and wellbeing of Australians who partake in recreational or heavy drug use, aiming to prevent and minimise drug-related harm. Developed by a network of mixed contributors, including people who use drugs, bystanders, government bodies, and medical organisations, their new service provides access to a unique, accurate and timely source of information on emerging drugs and safe drug use. To create a brand platform that is relevant, recognisable and ownable by PRN, TOAST delved deep into their space, interviewing a vast array of community groups, from recreational drug users, sober ex-users and festival attendees, to policy makers, GPs and coroners. It was paramount that our branding resonated across multiple targets, peak bodies and locations. Having myriad audiences, our team needed to formulate a broad yet targeted brand approach, one that is flexible and provides user-centric information. PRN’s overall focus on harm reduction respects that you can use drugs and reduce potential harm, without abstinence. They are there to support and assist, not punish. A ‘people first attitude’ is core to their DNA and needed to be central to their new service’s brand footprint. Building on this, we crafted their brand and communications suite to be judgement-free - focusing solely on awareness, education, and respect. TOAST crafted a brand platform that is for people who actively use drugs, for the general public, and for professionals. Allowing drug safety information to be accessible by users, relatives and the general public, whilst also delivering a platform for the police, coroners and GPs which consolidates information to aid in policy making, trials or clinical studies. The visual identity was strongly based on insights from our qualitative user testing and interview process, wherein preferences arose for a design that did not induce shame or embarrassment and used clean layouts to allow for information to be easily understood. Logotype preferences were for a word that was simple and memorable, connoting “information sharing” or “harm reduction,” paired with a realistic, trustworthy image. Common Cause Australia’s ‘Drug Stigma Message Guide’ declared that “messages based around altruistic and community-oriented values including honesty, helpfulness and equality, were significantly more effective at activating supportive attitudes in persuadable audiences than purely fact-based messages.” Insights which led to our big idea ‘Keeping you in the know,’ which was subsequently moulded for the platform’s name ‘The Know.’ ‘Keeping (users) in the know’ is about keeping them informed and mindful, providing knowledge on dangerous drug strains and more broadly on the side effects of recreational or recurrent drug usage. Users are kept in the know through having access to accurate, comprehensive and timely information which can save lives. Beyond their pill imagery, the connected circles within The Know’s logotype are founded on a conceptual framework underpinned by community connection, collaboration and support, and the colour-blocked design highlighting ‘now’ in a contrasting orange reflects the urgency, accuracy and immediacy of their services. The primary colour palette of Purple, Orange and Green is deliberately dissimilar to the typical blue of medical and law enforcement industries to create a safe space that is not connected with punishment or pain - building on the ‘judgement-free’ aspect of their brand narrative - with purple, orange and green chosen specifically for their symbolism of wisdom, change and growth, respectively. TOAST developed this brand identity across The Know’s corporate presence, creating a cohesive brand suite and initial social media Look & Feel. Working in such a sensitive, and dangerous, environment, we focused deeply on the human-to-human dynamic of our brand design. Paying close attention to our use of language and imagery to not induce shame or create further stigma through our discourse. The Know connects individuals with the information to make safer choices, providing inspiration, knowledge and an action plan for improving individual and societal health outcomes, and saving lives.

projects.name: Vue
projects.description:
Vue — Sammut Group. Place Visioning. The Perfect Blend. Sammut Group is a full-service luxury property development company. They elevate industry standards and expectations by applying principles of superior design and construction to residential, commercial, retail and hotel precincts from coast to coast. With a primary focus on strengthening their luxury property development arm and diversifying the company into other lifestyle businesses, the group is creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality-centred projects. This business core rings true in Vue, their latest project, an oceanview luxury mixed-use precinct in the heart of Cronulla. Offering intricately designed apartments, deluxe amenities and streetfront dining and retail, Vue, designed by PBD Architects, will be pivotal in generating economic investment in the heart of Sydney’s Southern beaches. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: Vue is set to be a catalyst project for Cronulla. Transforming the iconic Kingsway, this development will create public engagement with the surrounding pedestrian streetscape. It will be a place that goes beyond premium homes, delivering a harmonious interplay between the built environment, individuals, and local communities. Beautifully positioned in the heart of Cronulla, Vue is a residential, retail and commercial precinct of coastal luxury. Having previously worked with Sammut Group, PBD Architects and Highland on multiple award-winning projects, our team at TOAST was brought onboard to craft the Place Vision, Place Thinking, Brand Footprint and Visual Identity of this destination. Founded on deep strategic research, immersing ourselves in the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends and competitors, our team understood that this place branding needed to be suave yet understated, showcasing its luxury lifestyle offering whilst seamlessly integrating into the locale.

Solution: TOAST’s passion is creating brands for places which become destinations for years to come. With a deep understanding of the marketing fundamentals of the property industry, we craft strategic brand platforms built for success. Sammut Group’s Vue embodies the lure of understated luxury. Comprising designer apartments across 8-storeys, state-of-the-art facilities, and curated retail boutiques including one of Sydney’s largest Harris Farm Markets, it is the intersection of splendour and contemporary convenience. A place where coastal luxury meets urban grandeur, it is a destination that is set to define Cronulla. The vision for this site was to create a lifestyle unlike anything ever seen before in Cronulla, a ‘one-of-a-kind’ interwoven expression of the best aspects of a coastal lifestyle harmoniously combined to create an iconic statement for the future. Building on this vision and the development’s underplayed sophistication, our team crafted the Big Idea ‘The Perfect Blend’; marrying luxe living with urban simplicity and seamlessly integrating resort-style amenities into contemporary dwellings, Vue is an interwoven expression of the best aspects of ocean view living, harmoniously combined with contemporary urban charm. This brand philosophy speaks true to Sammut Group’s mission to deliver an elevated design vision achieving the perfect harmony between the building forms, the people, and the natural world of Cronulla. Mirroring PBD’s architectural approach and Mim Design’s interior visualisations, our designers worked closely with Sammut Group to craft Vue’s brand identity as an amalgamation of attributes and cues inspired by its coastal location. The sense of expanse and perspective, the cultural connection and the ripple effect of the tides all combine to create landmark influences that radiate across the landscape, as reflected in Vue’s name and timeless visual identity. The identity became a creative launchpad for amplification of a sophisticated suite of lead generation and sales support elements including a luxurious coffee table book, a brochure suite, digital and physical advertising campaign, website and digital-led display suite fit out, produced in close collaboration with sales agents Highland, PR team Left Field and marketers The Collective Co. A cornerstone of the creative campaign and marketing materials was sophisticated lifestyle photography and video content, directed and produced on location by TOAST. Showcasing the effortless luxury of coastal living, a two-day photoshoot captured a series of vignettes from yoga at dawn to cocktails at dusk with dozens of spontaneous moments enjoying salt, sea air and sun in between.

Result: Inspired by nature, infused with luxury, engineered for lifestyle; Vue is an elevated vision achieving the perfect blend of coastal and urban style, setting a new benchmark for coastal living.

projects.name: My Vet
projects.description:
My Vet — Brand Transformation. Crazy About You. MyVet is a veterinary care company working to ensure a pet’s health always comes first. They offer dedicated pet services from specialist consultations, dental care and nutrition, through to microchipping, diagnostic imaging, and surgery. They want to empower pet parents through the creation of pet wellness centres. At their centres, pet parents can learn how to best care for their pets; enriching their pets’ lives and becoming the best owners they can be. Their centres are community-focused gathering hubs for all pet parents to gather and share their passion for their pets. TOAST previously worked with the MyVet team on their initial branding and advertising launch materials. Our collaboration was a huge success, with the business going on to service a diverse client group and receive rave testimonials. Based on their success, the team was ready to rebrand. They sought to reflect their growing expertise and experienced footprint in a brand identity that was fun, engaging and accurately mirrored their pet passion.

Challenge: MyVet’s overall business vision is to transform veterinary clinics into pet wellness centres. A welcoming place that will be recognised as the one-stop-shop for all things pet wellness related, where pets go when they are happy and healthy, not only when they are sick. Auditing their current assets and social presence revealed that their actual strengths were no longer communicated through their website and that their brand was not standing out from the rest within the pet industry, even if their services are exceling. TOAST was re-approached to create uplifted graphic branding materials for their team which imbued their core values and accurately reflected their skill and expertise in the pet care industry.

Solution: At TOAST, strategy is our foundation; we started by unwinding MyVet’s business strengths and opportunities, auditing its key assets and factors of success... in order to rearticulate the existing brand footprint and its great principles in an increasingly cohesive, singular and powerful way. We worked to strengthen the brand equity to be even more Unique, Recognisable and Ownable by MyVet, so it can resonate across multiple targets, services and locations. Our stakeholder analysis and interviews unveiled some terrific insights. The vets do not rush through the session, allocating ample time to connect with both the pets and the owners at a personal level; the vets genuinely enjoy working with the animals and ensure they make them comfortable by going down to their level, playing with, and giving them treats. Their animal-first approach displays their innate love for pets - they provide a holistic approach to the health and wellbeing of your cats and dogs every step of the way so they can live a happy and healthy life. From these insights, TOAST developed the Big Idea and creative platform “Crazy About You,” reflecting MyVet’s dedication, passion and true commitment to their role as veterinarians and pet carers. To accompany this tagline, our design team created customised graphic assets for their brand. This collection of animal graphics, injected with a vivid colour palette of purples and oranges, allows the endless character and jovial personality of their team to shine through and be clearly communicated to their audience. Paired with a series of fun pet puns and silly phrasing, this brand identity is overflowing with joy, passion and personality, an up-to-date representation of the dedicated platform MyVet is expertly delivering.

projects.name: Applaws
projects.description:
Applaws — Brand Transformation. Good. Well. Happy. Applaws is a natural pet food company developing 100% natural food. They are passionate about seeing pets thrive on healthy food, to see their eyes sparkle and for each animal to grow to be the best that they can be. The Applaws brand was born in the UK in 2006 and, after proven success, they launched their company and product offering in Australia in 2012.

Challenge: Competing in a saturated market in Australia and New Zealand, the company was suffering from low brand recognition amongst an enormous range of price points and quality disparity in the pet food market. The Applaws team approached TOAST to put together a sustained strategic marketing programme and manage Applaws’ overall strategy to help the brand build a greater share of market voice which, if effective, would grow the brand’s awareness and ultimately gain sales traction in both the Australian and New Zealand markets.

Solution: Through delving into the company’s belief systems and core purposes, whilst mirroring the importance of remaining a globally competitive brand, the fresh Applaws visual identity was conceived by TOAST. This new brand activation held the potential to achieve exceptional brand exposure across multiple channels and generate their business growth and recognition in the Australian and New Zealand markets. Through our strategic research we identified that Applaws is unique in the pet food industry given their focus and unwavering attention to fresh, natural ingredients. Using excellent quality meats, they offer 100% natural wet foods with no additives or fillers. However, this is a claim that is easily stated and oft-declared by multitudes of brands, so we needed to clearly communicate the validity of the product quality to Applaws’ market. To combat this and inject their claims with evidence, TOAST designed packaging that was translucent - pet food bags with a see-through window allowing purchasers to see the product inside and recognise the natural ingredients that are used. Accompanying this packaging redesign, TOAST devised the tagline ‘Good. Well. Happy.’ This simple statement encapsulates the key pillars of their brand, pet and owner values. Always striving to help all pets live the best lives they can, Applaws is an experienced and trustworthy pet lover; offering natural, simple food they are a GOOD brand. By purchasing Applaws food, pets are healthy, their lifestyle is improved and their coat is shiny, thus the pet is WELL. And with a healthy pet, owners are content that they are making the right choice for their pet and giving them quality food, resulting in a HAPPY pet owner. Our team communicated these brand values in both the tagline and the redesigned packaging, providing Applaws with a reputable and engaging new brand with a clearly outlined set of core values.

projects.name: Escape
projects.description:
Escape — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Live Beyond Boundaries. Luxury property development group ‘Luxcon’ is renowned for delivering highly acclaimed projects that surpass expectations and raise the bar for residential luxury living. Their latest beachfront project on the Gold Coast’s Garfield Terrace is no exception. As part of their recently launched ‘Coastal Collection,’ the site at 63-65 Garfield Terrace is a study in contemporary elegance and an unrivalled waterfront urban sanctuary. Positioned on the cusp of Surfers Paradise, a destination buzzing with vibrant nightlife, oceanview dining, contemporary art and a beautiful connection to the natural landscape, their vision was to build an idyllic place that is designed around reconnecting with your environment, your loved ones, and yourself. Crafted by acclaimed architectural firm PBD Architects, Luxcon’s development comprises 28 deluxe penthouse-style apartments with uninterrupted 360-degree ocean and hinterland views - combining the sophistication of ocean-front glamour with timeless beachy serenity. Having previously worked on successful developments with both teams, TOAST was engaged as the branding agency to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development for this deluxe destination. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: Luxcon’s creative mission for their luxury residential offering was to deliver a world of beachfront bliss which redefines coastal living in the Gold Coast. Communicated through the unique architectural form, their development sets out to harmonise the ubiquitous edge of city charm with the freedom and relaxation innate to beachfront living, introducing a level of contemporary design that is unseen in the Gold Coast. TOAST’s challenge was to develop a unique brand design to communicate the building’s unmatched opulence and a place identity which was bolstered with competitive longevity against the Gold Coast’s ever-growing luxury property market. Luxcon envisioned an iconic place, one which marries inspired architecture with the natural beauty of the Gold Coast; a highly unique destination designed for residents to ‘escape’. Through branding, TOAST needed to craft this visionary story and create an enviable beachfront oasis.

Solution: As embodied in its name, Escape is a place offering freedom and sanctuary from daily routine. Having space to reset, reflect and recharge is integral in life - values which were at the core of our placemaking principles. Building on these ideals, our team devised the tagline ‘Live beyond boundaries.’ Not only does this expression complement the qualities of flight and freedom innate to the development’s name, it also reflects the building’s visionary and expansive architectural facade. Bridging urban design with a coastal lifestyle, Escape’s contemporary architectural form oozes sophistication and showcases character that expresses striking individuality in its contextual coastal scene. ‘Live beyond boundaries,’ and the very essence of Escape, embodies these values by delivering a place of contemporary beauty and absolute luxury unmatched on the Gold Coast. Taking inspiration from PBD’s contemporary architectural design which elegantly echoes a boundless winglike form and sleek ripple symmetry, our team designed the Escape logo to mimic the broad wingspan of a bird in flight and the sleek grandeur of the building’s entrance. Marrying its architectural design and core values of flight and freedom, Escape epitomises contemporary beachfront beauty; it is a place which inspires future residents and their visitors by providing them sanctuary from daily routine. Towering above the Gold Coast skyline, Escape is a study of urban decadence. Full-floor privacy, personal concierge services and eclectic luxe architecture; it offers the finest in resort-style luxury living. Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape is to deliver an exclusive life of luxury, balance and freedom. This Place Mission is encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery with connotations of freedom and flight, and a beautiful reflection of the expanse of its building form. Concurrent to the acquisition of 63-65 Garfield Terrace, Luxcon landed a prime development opportunity in Byron Bay, the launch of which was shared with Escape as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography, alongside the production team, XMEDIA. The colour palette across Escape’s branding suite was designed for two visual territories, a primary ‘Night’ palette of Charcoal, Gold and Chalk, the depth of which reflects the ocean, sand and moonlight under an evening sky, and a secondary ‘Day’ palette of Mint Green, Cream and Chalk, capturing the serene colours of the sea, sand and sun.
