Encapsulated in the branding’s birdlike imagery, the wingspan connoting life, flight and liberty whilst beautifully reflecting the expanse of the building form, our Place Visioning and Brand Identity reflect Luxcon’s driving force and mission for Escape to be an enviable oasis, delivering an exclusive life of balance, freedom and inspiration.

projects.name: Bohemian
projects.description:
Bohemian — Luxcon. Place Visioning. Life is Beautiful. Luxury developers ‘Luxcon,’ are renowned for delivering projects that surpass expectations and quantify the true meaning of luxury. Acquiring an enviable site at 90-96 Jonson St in the midst of Byron Bay’s town centre, their vision was to bring to life a destination that encapsulates the intangibly tantalising essence of Byron Bay, whilst paying homage to the beauty of the world that oft-inspires their visionary projects. Byron Bay is a place unmatched in its laid back sophistication. Encapsulating the epitome of barefoot luxury, it is a beachfront locale ever the envy of the globe. Luxcon’s development, designed by PBD Architects, was set to be a luxury offering; 44 serene two and three bedroom apartments, exclusive rooftop amenities and an idyllic meander to Byron’s beachfront, for which TOAST was engaged to design the Place Thinking, Visioning, Branding & Concept Development. (Case study includes a brand video.)

Challenge: TOAST designs places to work, to live, to come and to come back… we craft compelling stories built on human experiences, culture, landscape, public art and wayfinding. It was with this strategic branding expertise that our team was tasked to ideate the core identity for Luxcon’s development. In a buzzing location that is just moments from the beautiful coastline of Byron Bay, the precinct design for 90-96 Jonson St complements this beachside area’s vibrant community feel. Its worldly touch, through its open-air courtyards, walkable laneways, and interaction with the natural environment, creates an enviably intriguing atmosphere and brings new life to this public realm. With deep strategic research, founded on understanding the consumer market, insights and beliefs, and analysing market trends, global competitors and nearby developments, our team understood that 90-96 Jonson St’s branding and overall place vision needed to seamlessly integrate into the existing Byron environment, remaining on par with the local fashion and beliefs, whilst introducing an air of class and sophistication to elevate the town’s main strip.

Solution: As a name, Bohemian captures the urban and laid-back artistic sophistication of Byron Bay. This destination is a reimagining of home and hospitality that welcomes families and free spirits. Marrying the refined simplicity of a European lifestyle with the blithe and trendy air of Byron; Bohemian was created with a vision to introduce a place to connect, dream and inspire. Mirroring this place ethos, our chosen tagline ‘Life is Beautiful’ expresses the laid-back and eclectic way of life that Bohemian makes its own. Encapsulating the spirit of travel and a taste for exploration and discovery were core to our place-making ethos. Through our brand design, TOAST sought to connect Byron Bay’s coastal way of living with Luxcon’s “Of the World” lifestyle by creating an iconic and unique place; a world where you are grounded, safe and free. Across the brand, our conceptual framework paid homage to Bohemian’s unique architectural form and the contemporary beachside atmosphere unique to Byron Bay. Creating a custom font, with grid lines reflecting its architectural design, the weighted gradient of the building structure and the design’s united feminine and masculine features introduce an organic sense of balance. The logotype is bold as it is subtle, forging the perfect balance between worlds. The stacked structure of the hierarchical logotype layout is replicated for the precinct’s two sub-brands, Plaza and Spice Lane. The identifiable Bohemian logotype is enlarged above, with the sub-brand at the base, maintaining brand equity by remaining uniformly identifiable. Concurrent to the acquisition of 90-96 Jonson St, Luxcon landed a beachfront development opportunity in the Gold Coast, the launch of which was shared with Bohemian as part of their ‘Coastal Collection’. For both projects’ launch, our team devised the strategic brand footprint and visual identity, executing the brand across a campaign brochure, sales book, full website and brand video, for which we directed the photography, talent, voiceover and videography. These assets showcased the values at the core of Bohemian’s branding, forging a diptych of harmonised natural elements and vibrant interactions which deliver a place to reset, enjoy and love. Bohemian’s branding suite encapsulates the efficacious, free spirit of Byron Bay. With a neutral colour palette drawn from the dusty-gold of the sand and pure monochromes of the building facade, Bohemian’s campaign assets create an enduring connection to the coast and mirror the natural hues of each meticulously designed apartment. Bohemian is a home that overflows with the alluring aura of Byron. Complementing its contemporary-classical architectural style inspired by renowned beachside towns; Bohemian’s strategic brand assets and visual identity deliver a place with a perfect balance between beach and city life.

projects.name: Kela X
projects.description:
Kela X — Brand Activation. by Harry Georje. When internationally acclaimed jewellery designer Harry Georje partnered with KELA Tech, the leading brand behind the world’s first non-slip hair accessory, something incredible was bound to happen. In fact, an entirely new category was to be born: fine jewellery for hair. A proposition that magically blends the luxury jewellery, hair and fashion industries. KELA X is a hair accessories brand delivering high-quality pieces which elevate the style and sophistication of its wearers. This incredible proposition is a world-first, luxury brand in a category of its own. A fusion of fine jewellery, fashion and patented hair technology - KELA X is set to inspire multiple industries at once - industries where both KELA and Harry Georje hold immense respect due to their highly admired bodies of work.

Challenge: Harry Georje is a master of his craft - an unrivalled expert whose reputation precedes him. He is a three times De Beers international award-winning diamond jeweller, with over 30 years’ experience. For Georje, trust is everything. Renowned for his passion and knowledge of diamonds in particular, he treats every piece of jewellery as an investment - a piece to ignite decades of joy. And business partner, KELA, has deep expertise in the hair industry, with an offering that began in hair charms and extended into a patented technology known as KELA Tech. With this in mind, TOAST was tasked with crafting a highly sophisticated, yet approachable and trustworthy brand which reflected skill, knowledge and craftsmanship for this new business partnership. The fusion of carefully crafted design and innovation creates the magic of KELA X, a revolution in fine-jewellery for hair that invites a new level of inspired self-expression; they needed to be showcased as a brand that elevates natural beauty through bold attitude, timeless elegance and absolute luxury.

Solution: For KELA X by Harry Georje, every aspect is considered. With the brand values of artful innovation, sophistication and design aesthetic, unapologetic exclusivity and superior performance, our team at TOAST crafted a brand footprint for KELA X that evokes opulence, expertise and unmistakable quality. With exclusivity as the halo of their prestige; their brand creates unique experiences through which customers and brand loyalists are intrinsically connected. Their narrative is a luxury brand story underpinned by innovation that pushes their brand to excellence and beyond. Encapsulating this brand essence, we identified the USP “we believe in capturing the ultimate form of self expression through pure aesthetics and world-class technology,” reflecting the fusion of carefully crafted design and innovative creation which is the magic of KELA X. They are a brand that elevates natural beauty through bold attitude, timeless elegance and absolute luxury. Thus, our overall branding suite used a deep toned and metallic colour palette to connote their refined sophistication, with the duo of dark blue and gold lending a touch of royalty and signifying the authority and idealism within the brand. These attributes were similarly championed through the Tone of Voice we crafted for their launch; a territory of sophisticated language, effusive descriptions and decorative, idyllic terms painting a brand picture of pure excellence and ultimate luxury.

projects.name: Bondi Chic
projects.description:
Bondi Chic — Brand Activation. In and Out Beauty. Established in 2018, Bondi Chic is a premium cosmetics brand operating within the ‘Clean Beauty’ niche of the ‘Green Beauty’ market segment. Their product range is made with only the best of Australia's native, skin-loving ingredients.

Challenge: Faced with a crowded market (both domestically and internationally), Bondi Chic sought a brand identity that would position the skincare company at the forefront of modern trends whilst also creating a strong, ownable brand footprint with genuine longevity. Reaching out to TOAST, it was understood that the brand voice needed to be more consistent across all of their platforms and follow a clear strategy, whilst a target audience needed to be defined and their brand image transformed to be strongly relevant for their demographic. The Bondi Chic brand has unique values, strong principles, and a core purpose to its name - many of which are potential selling points to customers - however, they are combined in an ad-hoc way that indicates a lack of firm brand identity and lead to a confused and ineffective value proposition. TOAST could clearly see a brand that has the potential to satisfy a consumer need and to eventually take ownership of the ‘Clean Beauty’ segment. However, to get there, Bondi Chic needed to clarify exactly where it sits in the crowded cosmetics market, what exactly it offers to consumers and what values the brand embodies.

Solution: Bondi Chic exists because they believe in creating skincare products the right way, helping people feel healthy and beautiful, inside and out. As a brand, they seek to simultaneously innovate solutions and respect age-old traditions; they approach skincare with an open mind to find the best ways to enhance beauty by only using ingredients that holistically care for one’s skin. TOAST devised a brand footprint & USP which reflected this ethos. Building on stakeholder research and user insights, their brand narrative champions that no other brand offers a comprehensive yet uncomplicated program that uses non-toxic, Australian ingredients. Their USP, “Our products create beauty in the healthiest way possible - inside and out,” highlights their difference in the market as dedicated specialists providing natural and innovative products which are kind to your skin. From these insights came our big idea, “In and Out Beauty.” At the core of Bondi Chic is the belief that real beauty begins when we are true to ourselves, our beauty coming from within. Thus, for inner and outer beauty, they only use ingredients that will holistically enhance your beauty - if they don’t belong on your skin, they don’t belong in their products. TOAST identified their market demographic as 25 – 50 year old Australian women who enjoy an active lifestyle and lean toward ‘natural’ and ‘organic’ products. To speak to this audience, the packaging and Tone of Voice we devised used earthy and herbal yet sophisticated language. Emphasising the natural, native Australian ingredients and toxin-free formulas, we showcased Bondi Chic as a classy yet contemporary brand that encompasses all things natural. Disciples of the ‘clean beauty’ philosophy - products that deliver on their promises of completely non-toxic ingredients - Bondi Chic’s brand identity reflects both their connection to nature and their commitment to creating products that deliver real results.

projects.name: Anavo
projects.description:
Anavo — The Polyglot Group. Brand Visualisation. The energy to do better. Anavo, a subsidiary of The Polyglot Group, is a global Recruitment Agency specialising in industries focused on Renewable Energy, Environmental action, and Sustainability. Operating in 6 countries, spanning 9 time zones and 4 continents, they partner with clients, from large multinational corporations through to local SMEs, providing access to leading talents across the globe to bring climate action industry projects to life. Their mission is to help with Permanent Recruitment, Project & Specialist Hire, Global Mobility, Executive Search & Temporary recruitment for climate-focused sectors. They partner with some of the most innovative, high-growth companies in the environmental / sustainability sector, to match them with exceptional talent. Anavo creates a bridge between businesses & talent to empower individuals and teams to drive the decarbonising change that our planet urgently requires.

Challenge: TOAST was called upon by The Polyglot Group to create an engaging, progressive, and friendly brand footprint that encapsulates their new company’s vision. The challenge for TOAST to reach, through strategic brand messaging, was “how are we going to engage companies in the sustainability market as well as individual job seekers passionate about and searching for employment in the environmental industry?” It was crucial for Anavo’s final brand to be accessible and recognisable. Not only to stand out as a key player in the recruitment realm, but primarily as champions for sustainability. They need to be known by companies working across the environment/future/net-zero space as well as respected by individuals who are passionate about working collectively toward progressive green action, and by global corporate bodies aiming to expand their business values to reflect a sustainable future.

Solution: The company needed to be recognised as a group that is driven by passion and a dedication to a wider cause. Through an iterative research process of interviews, industry analysis and an in-depth strategic workshop, our team developed Anavo’s unique brand footprint which aligned the visions of all key stakeholders and brought their business values to life. Inspired by the Greek word which means “to ignite,” “Anávo” was chosen for the brand name, encompassing their mission as a collective to instigate positive change and help the world transition to cleaner practices for a better future. Accompanying this, TOAST put forth the tagline “The Energy to do better” for their team to adopt. This showcases to their audience that they are a recruitment agency empowering people within the clean energy & environment industries to drive the decarbonising change that our planet needs. The logo that was settled on encompasses the bright ambition intrinsic to renewable energy. The buoyant typeface design reflects that they are a team who is passionate about going the extra mile and encapsulates their deep expertise that is underpinned by a curiosity for new ideas, systems and innovations. At only 2 years old, having been created amidst the uncertain yet innovation-provoking time of the 2020 pandemic, Anavo already has a 10+ local employment team, a 15,000+ LinkedIn network and an extensive library of successful client case studies. Their team has supported the growth ambitions and sustainability goals of global companies such as: Enphase Energy, Akuo Energy, Cress Consulting, SMA Solar Technology, Yingli Green Energy. This rapid growth not only reflects the success of TOAST’s branding suite, our team being responsible for Anavo’s brand narrative, strategic footprint and visual identity, but the deep necessity for a platform such as this.

projects.name: Highlife
projects.description: Highlife. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage One. Wentworth Point's newest high life. At TOAST, we empower places by providing compelling brand footprints that allow audiences to understand the unique attributes and purposes of the spaces they experience, and our work with Sekisui House demonstrates the success of our approach. In 2016, Sekisui House purchased the 9.4 hectare site that would become Sanctuary. TOAST was brought on board at the project inception stage, working closely with Sekisui House and key architects to immerse ourselves in the site and the region. This process uncovered key insights that would shape the future identity of the masterplanned community. Crafting the core vision and essence of Sanctuary from the project's very inception was a brand-first approach that delivered outstanding outcomes. Challenge: In-depth auditing of the site revealed that a unique characteristic of Sanctuary is the fact that it is completely surrounded by nature, with wetlands, water, and parkland encircling the masterplan's location. The wonder of its geographical positioning paired terrifically with buyer-insights. Market research identified that the top two considerations of Wentworth Point buyers were "safety and security" and "a desirable location". Thus, these insights played a key influence in the creation of Sanctuary's brand identity and the delivery of its First Stage, coined 'Landing'. Landing's delivery consisted of 2 statuesque buildings, home to 364 beautiful, masterfully-built apartments designed for indoor-outdoor living with state-of-the-art appliances and modern finishes. The 'High Life' lifestyle that Landing encapsulates is underpinned by balance and harmony in a community that's perfectly situated to take advantage of the best that Greater Sydney has to offer. The complete synergy between the architecture and natural surroundings established a fantastic standard of living and is an embodiment of the core principles and brand design of Sanctuary. It is this essence of Sanctuary, encompassing balance, harmony, nature and community, that TOAST joined Sekisui House in strategically defining. Each design element is intrinsically linked to natural influences, and demonstrates Sanctuary's vibrant yet calming place identity that lets people live their everyday lives to the fullest. Solution: Landing, and Sanctuary as a whole, offer a unique, integrated living experience. The masterplan community features an oasis of vibrant spaces encompassing all states of being: play, reflection, energy and sustainability. This approach has resulted in a rich, purposeful living experience that integrates the site's core elements of nature, water and sky. TOAST reflected these core elements in the precinct's colour palette and collateral asset design. The colour palette of the 'Landing' logo variant, consists of gold and charcoal. With warm hues and a darker tint these colours are both bold and soft, encapsulating the ever-evolving nature of the world around us. The woody tones within this palette blended with the movement of the cyclical logotype reflect the beautiful evolution that occurs in our environment and beautifully represents the Sanctuary ethos of 'one with nature'. In the launch of Landing, TOAST worked with Sekisui House on a series of targeted social media posts, building intrigue and awareness of this new destination in Wentworth Point. This campaign was centred around the concept of living the 'High Life,' promoting the precinct's connectivity to the city, proximity to a world class entertainment hub and the expansive waterfront views creating a luxurious lifestyle that is immersed in nature. Adapting to the Covid-19 rules and gathering limits, TOAST and Sekisui House pivoted and used the campaign as an opportunity to promote exclusive private tours of the apartments, allowing their off-the-plan purchases to continue to thrive. This safe, tailored approach to sales tied back to the buyer insights our teams established and permitted the desirable location of Sanctuary to continue to be experienced for all interested parties. The success of Landing as Stage 1 of Sanctuary was recognised at the 2021 Urban Taskforce awards, winning a Development Excellence Award in the 'High-rise Development Metro' category.

projects.name: Community
projects.description: Community. Sekisui House. Sanctuary Masterplan. A place for all. The Sekisui House philosophy 'Love of Humanity', integrated with the ancient Japanese cultural principle of Satoyama 'Harmony between the environment and nature,' has guided Sanctuary's design to reflect the benefits of co-dependence between people, nature, and the built environment. Sanctuary places a deep respect for community at the heart of its design and development. It's about weaving nature throughout, the connectivity to the residents, and linkages to the broader community and Sydney as a whole. With a key focus on 'Michi' or 'Spatial Design Experience' Sanctuary's brand has emerged with the need to evolve and appeal to become a centre of life for people. The incorporation of design, innovation and technology with the natural surroundings through the facilities, landscapes and amenities, plays an essential role in the uniqueness of Sanctuary. Vibrant, fulfilling interactions between people, place and nature bring to life a beautiful spirit of community that occurs within and beyond its boundaries. Challenge: The vision for Sanctuary was to create a masterplanned community where a genuine respect for nature is reignited, and where a harmonious relationship between people and built form is nurtured; Sanctuary is a space that is designed to facilitate community connection. Sekisui House's core design principles and community-building ethos uplift the offering of this masterplan and introduce endless benefits that will elevate the lives of all in Wentworth Point. Maximising parkland within the site, expanding retail opportunities, integrating public transport and offering a calendar of community events at the foreshore park; what was once merely the end of the road is now becoming the heart of a revitalised community. Along with creating opportunities for community activity, the connection to the landscape offers boundless benefits to mental and physical health. By delivering a unique residential and community precinct that is at one with nature, Sanctuary will help its residents experience enriched, fulfilling lives that evolve with time and last for generations. Solution: To encapsulate the deep community spirit that Sekisui House has created through Sanctuary, TOAST crafted the tagline 'A place for all,' championing the neighbourly connections and inclusive atmosphere that Sanctuary fosters. This masterplan generates coexistence and co-prosperity by increasing the amount of public open space, and interactive activity areas for the whole community of Wentworth Point to enjoy. Offering more than 6 football-field's worth of public parkland and open space, over 4km of cycling and pedestrian-friendly paths, and with 34% of the entire masterplan dedicated to public green space, Sanctuary is undeniably alive with experiences and possibilities. This is a precinct designed to facilitate community connection, neighbourly interaction, and easy engagement with your native environment. Reflecting the core brand values of 'vibrant interactions' and 'comfortable living,' this approach delivers a unique experience for residents and the greater community, creating cohesion and instilling life, energy & vibrancy.

projects.name: 180 Queen St
projects.description: 180 Queen St. DWS Australia. Brand Visualisation. The Bank of Ideas. DWS Australia is an investment company focused on providing investment solutions and direct real estate assets to clients both locally and internationally. They are the investment company behind Queensland's beautiful and iconic 180 Queen St; a piece of the state's history and its future. This landmark trophy asset is in a dominant position in one of Australia's highest performing retail malls surrounded by city defining developments. In the centre of Brisbane, it offers a connected address within walking distance to Brisbane's urban attractions. The building hosts 6 Levels of private office suites with unique floor layouts and charming heritage features, such as ornate marble interior stairwells. Challenge: Blessed with a beautiful heritage site, TOAST was tasked to develop an activation concept to bring this location to life. Our team needed to create an identity and campaign platform to support 180 Queen St's entire leasing program. To reach the requirements of DWS' leasing campaign, we needed to clearly define the thought-process and behaviours of the key audiences in order to define the ideal product & marketing experience. In addition to this, our campaign needed to breathe new life and bring deep purpose to the heritage building. It is a dignified and chic site with immense history, this needed to be respected and appropriately capitalised on to attract new tenants to the space. Solution: In delving into the solution space, TOAST looked into the site's strengths and weaknesses and where there were opportunities for elevation. We identified there was a disconnect between the external presence and internal atmosphere of the building. Accompanying this, we identified that certain rational elements on their website, such as pricing, services, and amenities, were not readily available. This detracted from the user experience and was a potential demotivator for interested buyers. These insights provided us with valid perspective; we needed to uplift the customer experience. To achieve the customer experience uplift, we uncovered 180 Queen St's competitive advantages, identified an audience seeking this proposition, shaped the offer to appeal to the target audience and created a prioritised plan for implementation & execution. To create the identity for 180 Queen St that DWS was seeking, we embedded the customer journey with a sense of energy and inspiration, to attract interest and commitment from better quality tenants. TOAST created a holistic approach to redefine 180 Queen St, positioning it as a point of intersection for those seeking space to work, create, and meet; we sought to appeal to the core drivers of potential tenants. Our campaign presented 180 Queen St as a site with an eclectic mix of curated tenants utilising quaint, affordable office space that is ideal for creative studios and artisan workshops. This repositioning appeals to the increase in creative and start-up industries and breathes new life into an iconic, heritage location. The big idea, 'The Bank of Ideas' presents 180 Queen St as the place where Brisbane's brightest minds congregate.

projects.name: Altis
projects.description: Altis. Brand Transformation. Work That Works. Altis is an architectural firm based in Sydney. Through combining both architecture and interior design principles, Altis creates gathering places that people love, and where businesses thrive; the driving force behind their business being to create unique hospitality, club and living destinations that communities embrace. They are passionate about helping hospitality and living businesses excel and enhance the lives of the people in their local communities. Altis expertly delivers multi-disciplined business solutions by integrating architecture, interior design, strategy and deep local immersion. However, this passion and expertise was not evidenced in their brand territory. Their actions were progressing beyond the public face of their brand, which needed to change. Challenge: Our team was presented with the challenge of refreshing and elevating the Altis brand to reflect their market-leading stature and growing reputation in the architecture and design realm. At TOAST, we attest that a brand governs how you make an impact on the world. It leaves lasting memories on the people who interact with it. For Altis, our task was thus to cleanly define and effectively articulate their proposition. This involved increasing the understanding of the firm's expertise and projects and boosting awareness of the value within their services. Solution: Altis creates strategic solutions in response to diverse business challenges. They transform places into unique destinations by designing elevated experiences for business success. In reaching the core of this branding challenge, our team had to unwind Altis' business strengths and opportunities, delve into similar market leaders and audit their factors of success, all to rearticulate and strengthen the brand footprint and principles of the Altis brand. The fundamental strength our team consistently uncovered was that Altis has a unique business vision that works. Through a tailored approach with holistic integration, their design solutions enable growth and create impact. TOAST captured this transformative service in their new logotype and brand image. The logotype concept builds upon the previous logo's heritage with minimalist, clean-cut design language to capture the precise, technical backbone of the brand. Exuding a considered and crafted feel, the branding combines structural lines with subtle curves that convey Altis' professionalism. Meanwhile, the overlapping colours in the "A" hint at a process of transformation. This concept combines a powerful burgundy with a solid charcoal in a sophisticated palette that can be translated through the brand's marketing collateral. Altis' uplifted brand territory and visual identity has been refined to elevate the experiential luxury and functionality they expertly deliver across major commercial and hospitality projects.

projects.name: Escarp
projects.description: Escarp. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. A place of outspoken beauty. LAPropertyCo is a development & property group known for their innovative designs that deliver excellence and cultivate maximum return. As a company, they have a history of development and investment in established markets, with their success underpinned by their ability to identify emerging trends and opportunities, particularly within Sydney. The group's core strategy is to acquire and develop high-quality residential and mixed-use buildings that deliver maximum value, both for the company and to the surrounding community. The high achieving property group acquired a site in the Northern Sydney suburb of Northbridge; a gateway project to feature 19 oversized luxury apartments offering expansive Sydney CBD views and an unrivalled lifestyle in one of the Lower North's most historic suburbs. Challenge: For their new site acquisition and property vision, TOAST was engaged to create the brand footprint and place narrative. This residential site was envisioned as a place appealing to the essence of sophisticated Lower North Shore living, embracing the surrounding delights of its stunning Northbridge setting and boasting uninterrupted views of Sydney's vibrant city skyline and picturesque surrounds. Through our strategic design, we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client's expectations. To achieve these outcomes, the brand needed a strong feel of exclusivity and a very aspirational proposition to engage and elicit interest of to-be residents. It needed to be recognised as the next highlight of the Lower North Shore. Solution: To accurately reflect LAPropertyCo.'s visions, TOAST delved into the history of the suburb, the surroundings, the intention for the project and the placemaking approach. We drew key inspiration from the sophisticated and high-end lifestyle of Northbridge and its neighbouring suburbs. Further to this, front and centre of our ideation and design thinking processes were the end-consumers. Our team took the time to delve into their motivations, desires and ambitions, leading to an understanding that they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, ease and tranquility. Additionally, the site is cradled by precincts of style, sophistication and urban polish. Anticipating that residents will quickly become accustomed to the many local conveniences on offer led to the creation of 'Escarp,' a precinct of outspoken beauty presented as the ultimate address where all conveniences are at your command. Escarp is a place made for the indulgence of grand living, for residents to experience the art of exceptional living. To underpin these ideals, for the branding assets of Escarp we settled on a deep blue with copper highlights to build a sense of simple sophistication and high-quality elegance.

projects.name: The Good Sort
projects.description: The Good Sort. Brand Elevation. For a Happy Body. Natural nutrition for women on the go, The Good Sort offers a range of all-natural, nutritious and body-friendly shakes for busy women always on the move. They seek to empower the lives of individuals with a unique and healthy balance. The company integrates the intrinsic pillars of health and wellness into clean eating and weight loss management with suggested, achievable ideas to incorporate into your everyday life. The Good Sort is not rigid nor prescriptive, they present themselves as a company that works in collaboration with the customer to help them improve their self-esteem. Challenge: TOAST was asked to come onboard to assist with the conceptualisation and vision for The Good Sort brand. Our team was tasked to look into how The Good Sort can reach and connect to women with this new weight loss brand offering of everyday health and happiness. Imperative to this challenge was to stand out; when researching and launching to their target group it was key to focus on showcasing a point of difference amongst a growing trend of health and wellness brands. Solution: To conceptualise this health food brand, TOAST worked to strengthen and future-proof their idea, seeking to create a more unique and recognisable idea to stand out in the market and resonate across the target group. TOAST designed an energetic and fresh brand from the inside-out, along with launching engaging social media strategies and The Good Sort's accompanying website. The Big Idea 'For a Happy Body' was the overarching concept, encompassing the underlying health and wellness idea of listening to your body and doing what makes you feel good. The colours used across the brand, promotional material and product packaging are vibrant and engaging, to convey a zest for life and activating a sense of fun. The showcased brand values were all around the idea of comfortable ownership over one's health, in a fun, enticing and accessible framework.

projects.name: Aurelia
projects.description: Aurelia. Brand Transformation. Energy Enhancement Clinic. Aurelia is an energy enhancement clinic built on the belief that everyone deserves to achieve their optimal potential and discover a healthier version of their mind, body and soul. By combining the power of the latest Bio-field technology underpinned by metaphysics and quantum physics, they have created an innovative healing clinic, a 'world-class sanctuary', where everyone is welcome to rest, recharge and regenerate on a cellular level. Their goal is to help the community to understand the benefits of a healthier body, mind and soul, through understanding their needs and conditions. The service offerings include consultations with Energy Medicine practitioners, consultants, natural health professionals and life coaches to customise support for customers every step of the way. Further, they provide seminars to educate a growing audience on their signature treatments and natural health principles. Challenge: TOAST was tasked with assisting with the brand redesign of this company, to engage with a wider audience and portray their unique industry strengths and expertise. Aurelia empowers customers to become their optimum self, offering a unique energy healing experience, where customers relax and learn about their wellbeing through signature advanced technologies. They help their customers to understand the benefits of a healthier body, mind and soul. This business model needed to be presented in an engaging and mindful way, to educate interested parties and open people up to their services. Solution: For this challenge, it was imperative that our team understood the stakeholders' desires and needs; delving into the purpose and drive behind this company and the benefits that their service offers. TOAST's solution presented Aurelia as an innovative healing clinic; a place where everyone is welcome to rest, recharge and regenerate. The name Aurelia pays homage to its namesake, the Aurelia Moon Jellyfish, which has the ability to self-heal and survive. This concept resonates deeply with the clinic, with the chosen name thus symbolising their services in helping people regenerate and heal on a cellular level. Similarly, the logo was chosen for its representation of the Tortion field, a modern and simple visual representation for their energy treatments. The brand narrative and logotypes TOAST designed were chosen to strategically position Aurelia as an industry group taking the lead in Australia's wellness and energy healing industry, focusing on the technologies used and the indepth healing services they offer.

projects.name: Space Logic
projects.description: Space Logic. Brand Strategy. Medical Solutions. Space Logic is a family business that specialises in space and logistical storage management. The company has been successfully operating for more than 30 years and have been visible in 3 different categories for space and storage solutions: commercial, industrial and medical. They have an enviable reputation for providing end-to-end services to their clients, supplying project design, planning and installation services across their own innovative and customisable range of products. Their strength as a company has increasingly been evidenced through their work in the medical field. Thus through reflecting on their successes, it was decided to reposition their focus for their primary offering to be creating storage solutions for the healthcare and medical industry. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to rebrand the company with its new industry focus, re-creating a refreshed identity for Space Logic that communicates the company's expertise in space management in the medical category. Accompanying this brand redirection, the business sought to develop a monthly subscription package to maintain an informed relationship with their clients. Within this, Space Logic will be activating their resources on the ground, becoming more visible and recognisable for their swift follow-up actions and response manner akin to that of NRMA. Further, they also expressed their desire to expand and deliver their business services beyond Australia, creating further impetus to appropriately redesign their brand footprint. Solution: In reaching their business solution, TOAST first needed to understand their key target audiences across the medical sphere, and what their needs and challenges are at present. A safe and secure storage environment was primarily identified as a need across CSS Departments (Central Sterile Services), Pharmacies and Operation Theatres. To separate Space Logic from its competitors in the market, TOAST positioned their business as one that "enhances the healthcare experience with advanced medical storage solutions". The contemporary shape of their final logotype is symbolic of the bespoke manufacturing solutions offered by Space Logic, separating them from market competitors. Further, the brain iconography of their logotype accompanies this message, demonstrating their company mission of providing a clever and optimised use of space. The curved, organic shapes present an approachable and human-focused company, positively setting them apart in their global expansion ambitions.

projects.name: Xavier Knight
projects.description: Xavier Knight. Brand Transformation. Life is Multiplied. Established 10 years ago, engineering consultancy firm Xavier Knight aim to raise the standard of engineering services currently available in our built environment. The company combines the capabilities of a Tier 1 consultancy with a dynamic, proactive approach to collaboration and design. They work on an array of engineering projects, across structural and civil construction engineering through to modern digital engineering in a 3, 4 and 5D scope. Their team and endeavours are constantly expanding. TOAST was engaged to represent this in a brand footprint that is fit for their growing and progressive vision. Challenge: TOAST's challenge was to bring new life to Xavier Knight's brand identity. The brand's positioning had to emphasise their uniquely people-centric, progressive values, whilst reflecting their professionalism and credibility. This positioning would be launched through a 30-second impact video at a UDIA industry event, and further established through collateral including a website, capability statement and tendering document. Solution: TOAST's interview and brand audit process uncovered a clear insight: that Xavier Knight's core purpose was 'to enrich life and the world we live in'. This insight, coupled with the firm's 'X' brandmark, inspired our Big Idea 'Life is Multiplied'. This statement reflects Xavier Knight's intentions to enrich lives and amplify outcomes. This idea was brought to life in an attention-grabbing 30-second impact video, using the 'X' as a multiplication symbol in a series of brand claims. The entire suite of collateral, from website to official documentation, builds upon this idea. A predominantly black and white palette maintains professionalism and consistency with prior brand positioning. However, people-centric imagery, strategic hero messaging and splashes of colour ensure that the brand is given a sense of life and vitality. TOAST has enjoyed creating a brand identity that gives justice to Xavier Knight's unique, people-centric positioning.

projects.name: Healthy Habits
projects.description: Healthy Habits. Brand Transformation. Real Food, Real Fast. Healthy Habits is a recognised, leading member of the food outlet industry providing tasty and healthy food options. They offer a healthy lunch alternative to ever-present fast-food outlets. Launched in 1992 and franchising from 2004, they sell fresh meal options to lunchtime customers across Eastern Australia and New Zealand. Almost 40,000 people purchase their sandwiches each week. Challenge: TOAST was called upon by Healthy Habits to create a striking, friendly brand. The brief outlined that their desired brand was to be non-gender specific whilst easily identifiable in a sea of lunchtime options. Fast-food outlets utilise bright, primary colour combinations, making them eye-catching and memorable. This needed to be replicated for Healthy Habits but in a way that made them positively stand out amongst competitors. Solution: (No solution prose text was present on the page under the Solution heading.)

projects.name: Juror
projects.description: Juror. NSW Department of Justice. Observe Listen Decide. The NSW Government's Department of Justice orchestrates the state's compulsory jury service. Juries are used to ensure that legal verdicts are impartial and in line with community standards of behaviour. Serving as a juror is a mandatory role, providing unique insights into the NSW court process. Juries are used in the NSW District Court and NSW Supreme Court to determine criminal and civil matters. People aged over 18 are summoned and subsequently randomly selected to serve on a jury in a particular trial. The process of collating, storing and selecting names of all eligible jurors is a large task which occurs year-round. TOAST was engaged to assist with the ideation and design of an updated user interface and communications platform which simplifies the process on both the distribution and client end. Challenge: The juror selection process is a key part of the Australian justice system. Every year, the names of approximately 200,000 potential jurors are randomly selected from the NSW Electoral Roll and included on the jury list. From this number, up to 150,000 people will be summoned to present to court, with a subsequent 9,000 being selected to fulfil their service on a jury panel. TOAST was tasked with renewing a user management system to reduce the bulk of content and business hours required to orchestrate the juror selection process. Given the evidenced high amount of data being dealt with in the NSW Department of Justice, TOAST worked to strengthen the brand and streamline their processes, aiming to reduce pain points and simplify processes for both the distribution teams and summoned jurors. Solution: TOAST designed a two-part solution with an updated User Interface Design and a Communications Suite. Our team created the overall design for the Department of Justice's online portal, mobile application and management system for jurors and potential jurors, known as Juror. This Jury Management System is an updated user database storing information on NSW jurors and contains algorithms that are used to randomly select the 200,000 jurors each year from the four million-strong NSW electoral roll. With its algorithm for random selection, the system dramatically simplifies the Jury summoning process and provides efficiencies throughout the entire procedure for Jurors and Government alike. In line with this, TOAST crafted a marketing communications suite for the NSW public. Our strategy led us to develop a concept that portrayed a sense of pride and civic duty gained from participation in NSW's Jury Service. Our Big Idea came down to the three verbs "Observe, Listen, Decide." This slogan works hand-in-hand with the authentic imagery, showcasing real people across NSW to portray a sense of ownership, responsibility and recognition for the cause. At the 2017 Sydney Design Awards, TOAST received a Gold Award in the Government Service category for our Juror campaign on behalf of the Department of Justice.

projects.name: Muse
projects.description: Muse. Brand Transformation / Site Activation. Inspired Minds. MUSE, known as the House of Inspired Minds, is based in a 5-storey heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's iconic, city-fringe suburb Surry Hills. The neighbourhood's industrial buildings date back to the 1840's. It was during the 1920's that it became home to generations of working-class Chinese immigrant tailors and seamstresses serving the thriving rag trade, and later it became the headquarter of The Chinese Republic Newspaper. Their vision was to challenge the status quo and unlock new and effective ways to work, inspiring bespoke and impactful events and experiences, every single day. Today, MUSE is a different kind of community. In 2017, the building was transformed into a private creative community, combining the industrial heritage of yesteryear with the best of both original architecture and sophisticated, innovative interior design. Challenge: MUSE is now home to creative entrepreneurs and businesses and is an inspiring home for creators in design, film, fashion, branding, architecture, art, journalists and copywriters. MUSE prides itself on offering a private and exclusive space for its members with a focus on innovation and relationship building. MUSE is a space for those looking to take their business to the next level, putting life back into the workplace allowing people to become the best version of themselves. TOAST was engaged by MUSE to style their brand message and convey their holistic business offering. A prime heritage-listed building in the heart of Sydney's desirable Surry Hills, our team was tasked with crafting their brand narrative to assist the leasing of these bespoke work spaces. Solution: In unravelling this challenge, TOAST worked to unwind the business strengths, opportunities and its factors for success to design the MUSE brand footprint. MUSE is a place that challenges. A place that expands your mind and inspires ideas. This led TOAST to define their brand narrative "Inspired Ideas". Muse gets you moving; a place that creates the next level you, where you can collaborate and co-create in a house built of inspired minds. TOAST focused on the empowerment and autonomy MUSE provides its members; going beyond the co-working and office category by seamlessly integrating work & life in a unique, unexpected and rewarding offering. The end result is a bold and inspiring space that brings co-working to life. It is for those looking for renewal and excitement; to take their business to the next level. TOAST, in collaboration with the award-winning architect Vince Alafaci and acclaimed interior designer Caroline Chocker of ACME & Co (The Grounds of Alexandria), helped create an inspired, collaborative and creative workspace that could offer an experience, and a way of working that other co-working spaces are not providing. The team created an understated and luxurious aesthetic that sweeps effortlessly across spaces from meeting rooms and breakout areas on each level to the private courtyard, rooftop garden, the internal library of architecture and design, and across all amenities. The MUSE project was awarded with Silver at the 2018 Sydney Design Awards in the Interior Design - Co-Working & Studio Space category.

projects.name: Hutch & Hutch
projects.description: Hutch & Hutch. BridgeLane. Place Visioning. A Place of Beauty. Boutique developer BridgeLane embarked upon a significant and enviable design challenge; converting a warehouse into a home. Their efforts and expertise are revealed in their site Hutch & Hutch, in Sydney's Surry Hills. BridgeLane extended and redesigned the historic warehouse to offer a modernised collection of unique apartments of up to 3-bedrooms. They created a unique building, combining original warehouse features with contemporary design, breathing new life into a luxury residence. Challenge: TOAST was challenged with defining the vision and essence of BridgeLane's new project. Enviably positioned in Surry Hills, Hutch & Hutch's brand image needed to compliment the trendy, vibrant appeal of this city-fringe neighbourhood. Solution: Combined with the location's unique history - the site of Australia's first vinyl record plant - for this project, TOAST took inspiration between the parallels of nostalgia and new. Drawing on the creative flair of the location, and the surrounding streets of Hutchinson Street and Hutchinson Lane, TOAST started with the name, and took it from there, developing a branding platform that took the boutique development to a new level of distinction. Our company was awarded REA brand campaign of the year for its collaboration with BridgeLane and award-winning architects SJB and CBRE.

projects.name: Laguna & Glade
projects.description: Laguna & Glade. Sekisui House. Sanctuary - Stage Two. Life Ever Changing. The Sanctuary masterplan in Wentworth Point offers an ever-changing life experience through people, culture and the environments within. Following the completion and success of ‘Landing,’ Stage 1 of Sanctuary, the masterplan is moving forward to its second stage. Positioned to be overlooking the Parramatta River and bordering the neighbourhood green, Stage 2 lies at the very centre of Sanctuary's vibrant community estate and encompasses three new elements, the Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club. Consisting of 171 premium waterside apartments centred around lush open spaces and a multilevel wellbeing facilities building - Revive, the Laguna and Glade residences achieve perfect synergy with nature. This stage is beautifully designed to allow an inside-out communication between landscape and architecture. Embracing the calm, curious flow of the Parramatta River and the best of international living standards, these developments have been designed to allow seamless communication between the surrounding natural landscape and modern architecture. Challenge: As Laguna, Glade and Revive are staged additions in a large-scale masterplan, as opposed to standalone developments, it was imperative that the Sanctuary property branding and strategic vision remained as the common thread that ties all elements together. As, to remain an authentic and highly-regarded brand, it is key to present a united image with a consistent and clear message. Harmony, vibrancy, a sense of calm and liveability are fundamental attributes defining a sanctuary and are wonderfully evident in this Stage 2 development. The Laguna and Glade residences and Revive health club bring newfound energy and life to the Sanctuary precinct. Aligned and connected with the overall branding and message of Sanctuary’s masterplan, Laguna and Glade have an infectious spirit. In the heart of the precinct, bookended by both the river and neighbourhood green, these spaces weave beautifully into their natural surrounds and offer occupants a space that is liveable and abundant in lively characteristics. As elements within the Sanctuary masterplan brand, Laguna, Glade and Revive are similarly identifiable by the unique kaleidoscopic logotype. In creating this gracefully fragmented circular imagery, TOAST was inspired by the fundamental principles within Japanese design, such as simplicity, understated beauty and tranquillity. It’s an intricate but elegant wreath, a symbol which ties all elements of Sanctuary together. Solution: Laguna and Glade are highly anticipated boutique developments on the water’s edge offering a serene living experience in the heart of Sanctuary. Across both buildings, nature acts as a bridge between the apartments and the wider landscape, creating an unrivalled living experience where nature and urban living seamlessly integrate. The harmony and communication between our inside and outside worlds is a fundamental element within Sanctuary’s brand footprint, making this masterplan evermore unique. The fluidity of Laguna’s logo variant captures the sense of calm and serenity that the building exudes. The malleable, rejuvenating qualities of water are captured in the building's architecture and are further conveyed in this logo's expression. As for Glade, this logo variant is heavily flora-inspired and integrates natural influences throughout its design. The striking green textural pattern conveys this sense of vitality, promising a life that is energetic and connected to nature. Further, Revive's logo takes the aqueous territory introduced with Laguna and pushes it further. Centred around the uniquely styled, revitalising pool that is a core foundation of the building's offerings, this logo treatment fully reflects the tranquil, restorative qualities of the health club it represents. The Stage 2 triad is an extension of the refuge that is Sanctuary and delivers a beautifully unique experience for residents and the wider community. A space that is in harmony with nature, abundant in vibrant interactions, epitomises comfortable living and offers a fulfilled life experience.

projects.name: Highland
projects.tagline: We Are More Than Just Property
projects.description: Highland. Brand Transformation. “We Are More Than Just Property”. Highland Property Group (HPG) is a full-service real estate group with myriad offerings including residential, commercial, property management, financial services and project marketing. Founded in 2007 by David Highland, the company has grown drastically with an ever-evolving approach to real estate, redefining the industry and positioning themselves as a leader in the Sutherland Shire property market. Challenge: Outperforming their competitors in leasing and property sales, HPG provide a high-level of service and have a strong presence in the St George and Sutherland Shire regions. The challenge that TOAST was tasked to reach through strategic brand messaging, was, how are we going to win the battle and engage the market beyond Southern Sydney and become a national player in the real estate industry? Solution: Highland Property Group (HPG) needed to become bigger, stronger and increasingly performant in new locations. TOAST worked to strengthen and future-proof their brand to be even more unique and recognisable for HPG to resonate across multiple target groups, services and locations. Ultimately, reaching nationwide. The strategic findings of our research uncovered that HPG effectively push the boundaries and the breadth of services offered in the real estate industry to improve the overall customer experience. Their customers are supported throughout the whole process, from beginning to end, providing the confidence that they will be looked after in their real estate decisions. This enabled TOAST to encapsulate the HPG brand narrative: “We build trusted relationships that last for a lifetime”. TOAST’s direction was to shift customers’ perception. HPG are more than just property; they have the confidence to go for it. They build long-lasting, trusted relationships, create unique customer experiences and deliver rewarding, premium results.

projects.name: Sammut Group
projects.description: Sammut Group. Brand Elevation. Artisans of Lifestyle. Sammut Group is a property development company offering luxurious residential and commercial properties, with an unparalleled scope of service and expertise backed by 30 years of experience in the development and construction industry. They have a strong business presence and have achieved great success in the Sutherland Shire, providing high-end mixed-use developments which positively impact the life of residents, communities and surrounding businesses in the area. However their presence beyond this region of Sydney was less impactful, something they sought to change. Challenge: TOAST was presented with the challenge; How are we going to become an even stronger, leading player across multiple business lines, targeting lifestyle destinations along the Eastern seaboard? Asking, how do we become bigger, stronger and performant in new locations with more offerings...It’s about becoming more corporate without losing the core business culture, team spirit and especially without losing the foundation for what makes Sammut Group a great company to belong to, work with or buy from. Solution: To truly tackle the core of this challenge, TOAST had to unwind the business strengths and opportunities, audit its key assets and factors of success in order to rearticulate the existing brand footprint and its great principles to strengthen the brand of Sammut Group for it to resonate across multiple targets, offerings and locations. Through research and workshopping, TOAST uncovered myriad successes of Sammut Group; they lifted the bar in Cronulla & the Sutherland Shire by delivering uniquely designed high calibre projects with a deep attention to detail. We identified that opportunities existed for Sammut Group to become a new corporate identity to support the credibility of their projects, offering living experiences beyond what the market currently provides. Thus, reaching the new conceptual output, ‘Artisans of Lifestyle,’ expressing the thesis behind a company enhancing people’s lives with immersive luxury experiences through sustainable architecture, natural landscapes and beautiful details. The business has strengthened and diversified to elevate all facets of the Australian lifestyle; creating new standards of experiential luxury through major residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

projects.name: Innovate to Regenerate
projects.description: Innovate to Regenerate. WWF Australia. Campaign Strategy & Messaging. It's Up to You. WWF have been a leading voice for conservation, regeneration and environmental protection for over half a century. They are present in over 100 countries and have the help of 5 million supporters, and growing. Partnering with businesses, individuals and the community, WWF address pressing environmental issues that can be fixed through collaborative action. They spread messages of positive, community action to ensure our planet is cared for and protected for years to come. Innovate to Regenerate is about finding innovative solutions to regenerate and future-proof Australia’s precious natural environment and communities. Challenge: Looking back across just one generation, we have experienced remarkable weather events which have undeniably changed the Australian environment. Through these repeated shared experiences, we have gained an understanding that we can do more to protect our world when we are connected with nature. WWF attest that regenerative development is what can actively reverse environmental degradation, creating a positive impact for people and the planet. TOAST was tasked with redefining this WWF message to engage wider audiences, in the hope that WWF’s initiative has a larger reach and therefore a more positive outcome for our shared natural environment. Solution: To reach the appropriate brand solution to WWF’s initiative, TOAST refocused on their key organisational outputs, their existing audience and the opportunities available to them. Our team looked to redefine their strategic angle, focusing on their longstanding message of collective community action. WWF call on the government and business stakeholders to reach a platform where their messages can be heard by the masses. But, why wait? On our own, we too can make a statement. It’s never too late to take action into our own hands. It’s in the hands and interest of everyone to create a future in which people and nature live in harmony. And if not now, when? If not you, who? Ultimately; It’s Up To Us. It’s Up To You.

projects.name: The Salvation Army
projects.description: The Salvation Army. Brand Transformation / Campaign Activation. The Freedom Partnership. Together with The Salvation Army, TOAST devised a campaign to educate, raise public awareness and empower those affected by modern slavery within Australia today. Slavery in Australia comes in many forms including trafficking, forced labour, abusive living and working conditions, isolation, violence, psychological and sexual abuse. It is often hidden and goes unreported despite being a serious crime affecting the lives of thousands. Challenge: A social media campaign was implemented using an animated project video EDM, which prompts the viewer to show support by ‘Making The Pledge’ and ‘Joining The Chain of Good’. The two-year awareness campaign also aims to extend its impact and engagement by leveraging social media communities on Facebook and Twitter. Solution: ‘The Freedom Pledge’ is a striking and bold campaign utilising an ancient symbol of law and justice, slavery and captivity known as ‘Epa’. The symbol reminds offenders of the uncompromising nature of the law and discourages all forms of slavery. This iconic symbol acts as the primary brand asset for the ‘Ending Modern Slavery’ campaign across all channels.

projects.name: LJ Hooker
projects.description: LJ Hooker. Brand Transformation. When You Know, You Know. Iconic real estate brand LJ Hooker is positioned as a major player in the Australian real estate industry, possessing both the legacy of a rich and successful history and a future-focused, innovative mindset. The company identified that in today’s competitive and evolving climate, resting on past success and market dominance is no guarantee for future success. As such, LJ Hooker had to continue to evolve and differentiate from competitors. LJ Hooker engaged TOAST to help refresh its brand identity. With a global network of 600 offices, it was essential that the brand’s key messaging was aligned across every touchpoint to create a unified brand image. Challenge: The brief was to create a unique and flexible brand proposition embedded in the business’ truth, ambition and vision while being flexible enough to support communication across a range of offerings and diverse market segments (e.g. residential vs. commercial, every kind of suburb vs. being perceived as a brand exclusively for Sydneysiders). LJ Hooker’s messaging needed to apply from a corporate, head office level, right through to the level of specific franchisees. The tagline also needed to reflect the customer-centric values that sit at the core of the brand’s identity. Solution: TOAST created the flexible, relatable tagline ‘When you know, you know.’ The new positioning found its roots in the famous statement from its founder Sir Leslie Joseph Hooker; “Real estate is not about houses, it’s about people”, encompassing the brand’s 92 years of industry experience, placing people, trust and results at the core. Its purpose was also to illustrate the fact that often real estate property matters are a gut-led decision for many of us: at the point when you find the right home, you know… when you know, you know. In terms of application, this tagline has also been created with flexibility in mind, allowing it to be customised to meet the needs of franchisees nationwide. The outcomes of this process were summarised in a comprehensive Brand Kit, which embarked LJ Hooker’s network on the brand refresh journey and outlined clear instructions for implementation.

projects.name: Allcastle Homes
projects.description: Allcastle Homes. Brand Transformation. Make It Home. Allcastle Homes is a residential home builder specialising in high-value, high-quality family homes. The project builder aims to deliver a level of service and product that exceeds industry expectations at every step of the process. However, the organisation’s previous brand identity did not reflect its aspirational vision or holistic value proposition. Challenge: TOAST’s challenge was to create an uplifting brand that would help Allcastle Homes emerge as a clear builder of choice in the minds of its target audiences. The overall objective was to demonstrate the unique proposition and commitment of the business in treating their customers as if they were members of their extended family, providing the opportunity to design their dream home with confidence. This would involve creating a new brand identity from the ground up, from logo and brand messaging to website and marketing collateral. Solution: Immersion into Allcastle Homes’ organisation, including interviews with senior management and sales consultants, revealed that the builder is committed to delivering a high-quality customer experience from start to finish. These insights fuelled the Big Idea ‘Experience is Everything’. This strategic positioning statement reflects both the significant industry experience that the builder has accrued over almost 30 years of operation and the supportive customer experience that the organisation delivers. As a result, the tagline ”Make it Home” was born, aiming to articulate the idea that the customer can transform their home from a dream to reality within a very supportive familial environment (where they feel at home). To ensure that the brand remained instantly recognisable, the company’s signature blue was retained but has been adjusted to a warmer, royal tone. The new gold highlights emphasise Allcastle Homes’ long-standing reputation for quality and prestige. Allcastle Homes’ uplifted identity conveys the builder’s characteristics of experience, legacy and quality, while remaining modern and contemporary, and will help the organisation continue to build the dreams of Australian families, generating both customer acquisition and loyalty for years to come.

projects.name: MECLA
projects.description: MECLA. NSW Govt, WWF, Lendlease & Presync. Brand Activation. Game Changer Leadership. Materials Embodied Carbon Leaders’ Alliance (MECLA) is an association of leaders in the building & construction industry, government bodies and not-for-profit organisations who are committed to improving the procurement, supply chain and use of materials that cause harm to the environment. The core members of MECLA, NSW Government, WWF-Australia, Lendlease & Presync, came together with the belief that Australia can tackle the climate change threat and aligned with the Paris Agreement targets if we help transform the building and construction industry. Challenge: The built environment sector is responsible for one-quarter of Australia’s emissions. The majority of these emissions (at least 40%) occur from the embodied or upfront carbon of the materials used in building and construction in particular, steel, cement, concrete and aluminium representing over 9% of global emissions. TOAST was briefed to create a strategic positioning and brand identity to engage multiple stakeholders involved in the construction industry and rally them towards a common goal of creating a better future for Australia. The new MECLA brand needed to inspire radical collaboration, provide guidance to all market players, facilitate knowledge sharing and the uptake of low/zero-carbon materials. Solution: TOAST delved into the reason for why MECLA exists, the values that drive the organisation, and how it could be translated into a visionary brand by creating a strong strategic framework. Based on its research and the insights derived through the interviews with multiple stakeholders, TOAST created a well thought out strategic platform for the organisation: “Game Changer Leadership”, focusing on the central belief that “We are the change needed to reach net-zero emissions”. The logo and the overall brand identity created by TOAST explores the unified action of the different sectors in the construction industry; it demonstrates the intention of the organisation, with the central diamond representing a perfect collaboration between all entities' purity and a brighter future. It signifies the collaborative efforts to tackle this complex issue, the integrity to work in an ethical manner, the transparency to share knowledge and expertise, and the opportunity to move towards a zero-carbon economy future, positioning Australia in the top 5 zero-carbon materials suppliers.

projects.name: Today Fitness
projects.description: Today Fitness. Brand Visualisation. Your Best You. A new gym operator approached TOAST with the vision of creating a new hyper-premium gym in Villawood (NSW) and duplicable in other areas later on, to cater towards people who wanted more from the fitness and wellness experience designed from the ground up. Challenge: TOAST was tasked to develop a fresh and engaging approach to brand this new gym that challenged the conventions of the category and dive into the core of what real people truly wanted from their fitness and wellbeing experiences. Working with the client’s team, TOAST conducted extensive research into understanding the competitor landscape, national trends and into the hearts and minds of Australians to understand their needs, behaviours and drivers within the fitness and wellbeing industry. Our central insights were that people were sick of being compared to others, tired of intimidating gym environments and were looking for more than just a set of weights and poorly scribbled instructions on the side of gym equipment. Solution: From a robust strategic framework, we created the Big Idea: “Your Best You” and a name to operate the business: “Today”. With a strong purpose, the new brand Today mirrors a humble and genuine proposition that resonates with our audiences: everyone is simply trying to become the best version of themselves, every day, at their own pace, and that also means something different to everyone. Working with the interior designers, we worked to unpack how this guiding philosophy would spread across the environment to make a truly inclusive and collaborative space in which people could become the best version of themselves. Visually, we looked to challenge the traditional colours of the gym industry by creating a fresh, open palette of colours, inviting people to come along for the journey. Your Best You is a promising customer proposition which has been well welcomed and has a long life with inclusiveness at the very core of its value proposition.

projects.name: Trinity Point
projects.description: Trinity Point. Brand Elevation. Above & Beyond. Nestled on the shores of Lake Macquarie, Trinity Point is a Master Plan community offering world-class residential, resort and marina facilities in an immersive 5-star living experience. With the new iconic and transformational design from leading Australian firm Koichi Takada Architects, the Trinity Point precinct is planned to be home to a luxury 220-room hotel, restaurants, function centre, pool and 218 waterfront apartments, along with the already established Trinity Point Marina. The transformational project will inject more than $720million into the local economy and create hundreds of new direct and indirect jobs through construction and, when operational, to service the hotel and restaurant in the longer term. Challenge: Over the project’s 20-year lifespan, Trinity Point’s visual look and feel had undertaken numerous changes to reflect its ever-evolving transformational design without providing true justice to the new luxury regional destination. The brand needed to be uplifted drastically to mirror the prestige of this iconic, environmentally-leading tourism destination for regional New South Wales; one that will showcase the area's greatest quality –Lake Macquarie. A strong elevation of a strategic brand footprint was required to launch the development’s apartment, marina and resort offerings which will set an architectural benchmark for the region. TOAST’s challenge was to find a way to elevate Trinity Point’s Masterbrand identity whilst seamlessly developing and integrating each sub-brand. Solution: TOAST developed a new overarching positioning statement ‘Above and Beyond’ connecting Trinity Point’s commitment to delivering a lakeside lifestyle beyond any other: an architectural and sustainability benchmark for the region. This positioning is being rolled out as a new visual language across the Trinity Point ecosystem including immersive display, online and offline collateral. Allowing Trinity Point to clearly communicate the value of place to drive connection to community and residents.

projects.name: The Revy
projects.description: The Revy. Aqualand. Place Visioning. The Doorway to Sydney’s Harbour. Aqualand distinguishes itself as a developer, As both Strategic Urban Regenerators benefiting areas with close proximity to key public transport, retail hubs and education facilities, and as Creators of Prime Foreshore Residences, boasting views across the iconic Sydney Harbour; Aqualand distinguish themselves as unique, multitalented developers in the property industry. One of their prestigious sites is “The REVY”, home to 44 unique heritage-listed residential apartments tucked away on tranquil Darling Island. With its exceptional waterfront location, heritage building and proximity to the CBD, The REVY is set to become Sydney’s most prestigious address. Challenge: In order to sell the apartments, Aqualand worked on an initial campaign. However, in regards to the overall Covid-19 challenges and market uncertainty, the campaign lost traction while there were still 11 residences available for sale. TOAST was asked to develop a lead generation campaign to support the sales success of the remaining residences. The building has lived many lives, being re-invented over and over to cater for the ebb and flow of culture and the needs of the times. Today, The REVY has once again evolved, transforming into a truly unique and luxury residence that provides those who enter its walls a Sydney experience like no other…. And the brand and campaign needed to reflect this evolution in order to be successful. Solution: To achieve this, TOAST has delved into the specifics of this property's essence to fully understand and communicate its unique value proposition: with towering heritage facades and modern luxury interiors The REVY is a site like no other. While the building has a unique history to communicate and build on a lead generation system, it appeared obvious that the new positioning of the brand and its messaging needed to capitalise on a unique proposition that combines the best of two worlds: Incomparable Contemporary Living and Timeless Heritage Exclusivity. “The doorway to Sydney’s Harbour” claimed this idea of unique access to superior Sydney Harbour living. Historical significance, monumental architecture, sophisticated luxury and scenic waterfront location all combined to make an unrepeatable proposition. The campaign was brought to life through a very engaging website that embarks visitors on a unique journey, and a suite of traditional marketing tools including online and off-line marketing collateral which enabled a successful lead generation funnel for the appointed agents, CBRE.

projects.name: Amaroo
projects.description: Amaroo. LAPropertyCo. Place Visioning. Nestled Above Castle Cove. LAPropertyCo. is a visionary property group driven to be market leaders, built on generations of experience. The group has an established track record for investing in and developing Real Estate within premium Sydney markets, remaining focused on creating innovative designs and planning solutions. LAPropertyCo. acquired a prime site overlooking the bay, right next to the golf course in Castle Cove and created an exceptional development of 11 luxurious residences with a deep connection to its surroundings. Challenge: This luxurious project presents the future occupants with the opportunity to experience life in the idyllic North Shore suburb of Sydney, best known for its elevated and leisurely lifestyle suited for an older, affluent population. Even though these attributes present immense advantages to the project and the freedom to create an aesthetic brand, it still presents a challenge of maintaining a fine balance of luxury and connectedness in the brand identity. After TOAST’s successful collaboration with LAPropertyCo. on "The Postern", we needed to ensure that we not only did justice to the calibre of this project, but also raise the standards and go well beyond the client’s expectations. Solution: TOAST delved into the history of the place, the surroundings, the vision for the project and the placemaking approach. We were inspired by how the land naturally contoured, the topography, the rich textures of the materials and utilised the beautiful, naturally occurring designs to create visual elements that would support the brand. We put the end-consumers at front and centre, taking the time to understand their motivations in life. We realised that at this stage in their lives, they are seeking understated luxury, comfort, peace and tranquility, and a connection to nature. TOAST married the sensibilities of the target market with the modernity of the development and its connection to its natural setting to create an elegant and timeless brand identity.

projects.name: Sanctuary
projects.description: Sanctuary. Sekisui House. Masterplan / Stage one. One With Nature. ‘Satoyama – Harmony between the built environment and nature.’ Since its inception, Sanctuary has shifted from being a desirable project to a very tangible precinct that will positively impact the residents and neighbourhood life at Wentworth Point. This masterplan development would be a feat of effort to transform the run-down factory land into a tranquil setting worthy of the water’s edge. The first building “Landing” (stage 1) has started to shape the new landscape of the masterplan, giving the projection of the future experience of living at Sanctuary.
